examples.en: Potassium is a highly reactive metal that must be stored under mineral oil.
examples.zh: 钾是一种高活性金属，必须保存在矿物油中。

lemmas.def_zh: 反动的, 反动主义的, 反对改革的
lemmas.def_en: extremely conservative

examples.en: The politician faced sharp criticism for his reactionary stance on modern social reforms.
examples.zh: 该政客因在现代社会改革上的反对立场而面临严厉批评。

lemmas.def_zh: 不起化学反应的,化学上惰性的
lemmas.def_en: (chemistry) not reacting chemically

examples.en: Noble gases are largely unreactive because they have complete outer electron shells.
examples.zh: 稀有气体基本不起反应，因为它们拥有完整的外层电子壳层。

family_guide.root_logic: 由前缀 re-（反向、回应）与 act（行动、作用）构成，核心含义是受外界刺激或作用后产生反向行动，引申出心理反应、行为回应及化学反应。
family_guide.core_distinction: reactive 强调'事后被动的/易起反应的'（常与主动前瞻的 proactive 相对）；reaction 是反应的动作、现象或结果本身。

lemmas.def_zh: 疾病，病症；弊端，痼疾
lemmas.def_en: an illness affecting humans, animals, or plants, typically caused by infection or internal dysfunction

examples.en: Regular exercise and a balanced diet significantly reduce the risk of heart disease.
examples.zh: 规律运动和均衡饮食能显著降低患心脏病的风险。

examples.en: Public health officials are working tirelessly to stop the spread of the infectious disease.
examples.zh: 公共卫生官员正不知疲倦地工作，以阻止这种传染病的传播。

family_guide.root_logic: 由否定前缀 dis-（缺乏、离开）与 ease（舒适、安乐）组合而成，原指“失去舒适安宁的状态”，后专门演变指破坏机体正常生理功能的“疾病”。

lemmas.def_zh: 方向；指导，管理；说明，指南
lemmas.def_en: the path along which something moves; guidance or supervision; instructions on how to do something

examples.en: They drove off in the opposite direction after the meeting.
examples.zh: 会议结束后，他们朝相反的方向开走了。

examples.en: Always read the directions carefully before taking any medication.
examples.zh: 服用任何药物之前，请务必仔细阅读使用说明。

lemmas.def_zh: 漫无目的的；无目标的；无计划的
lemmas.def_en: aimlessly drifting

examples.en: After graduating from college, he felt directionless and unsure about his career.
examples.zh: 大学毕业后，他感到迷茫无目标，对自己的职业生涯感到不确定。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 dirigere（指引、使变直），核心逻辑是从“引向一条笔直的轨道”引申出空间上的“方向”、行动上的“指引/说明”以及管理上的“指导”。

lemmas.def_zh: 持反对态度的，反对的；反对者，反对派
lemmas.def_en: opposed to something (adj.); a person who is opposed to a particular policy or proposal (n.)

examples.en: She was very anti the proposed changes to the curriculum.
examples.zh: 她对课程体系的修改提议持强烈反对态度。

examples.en: When the votes were counted, the antis had won by a narrow margin.
examples.zh: 计票结果揭晓时，反对派以微弱优势赢得了胜利。

lemmas.def_zh: 持反对态度的，反对的；反对者，反对派
lemmas.def_en: opposed to something (adj.); a person who is opposed to a particular policy or proposal (n.)

examples.en: She was very anti the proposed changes to the curriculum.
examples.zh: 她对课程体系的修改提议持强烈反对态度。

examples.en: When the votes were counted, the antis had won by a narrow margin.
examples.zh: 计票结果揭晓时，反对派以微弱优势赢得了胜利。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古希腊语前缀 anti-（反对、对抗、相反），后在现代英语中独立成词，核心语义始终为“反对、对抗”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词表示“持反对态度的”，常用于非正式口语（后接名词或介词短语）；名词常以复数 antis 形式出现，专指“反对者”或“反对派阵营”。

lemmas.def_zh: 每年的，年度的；年刊，年鉴；一年生植物
lemmas.def_en: happening once every year; a book or magazine published yearly; a plant that lives for only one year

examples.en: The company will hold its annual general meeting next week.
examples.zh: 公司将于下周召开年度股东大会。

examples.en: Sunflowers are popular annuals that bloom throughout the summer.
examples.zh: 向日葵是广受欢迎的一年生植物，整个夏天都会绽放。

lemmas.def_zh: 每年，一年一次地
lemmas.def_en: once every year; per annum

examples.en: The international film festival is held annually in May.
examples.zh: 该国际电影节于每年五月举行。

lemmas.def_zh: 每年的，年度的；年刊，年鉴；一年生植物
lemmas.def_en: happening once every year; a book or magazine published yearly; a plant that lives for only one year

examples.en: The company will hold its annual general meeting next week.
examples.zh: 公司将于下周召开年度股东大会。

examples.en: Sunflowers are popular annuals that bloom throughout the summer.
examples.zh: 向日葵是广受欢迎的一年生植物，整个夏天都会绽放。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 annus（年），核心语义围绕“一年”的时间周期展开，表示“每年的”或与年度周期相关的事物。
family_guide.core_distinction: annual 兼具形容词（年度的）和名词（年刊/一年生植物）词性；annually 为副词，专指“每年一次地”的发生频次。

lemmas.def_zh: 在前面，向前；提前，预先；领先
lemmas.def_en: further forward in space or time; in advance; in a leading position

examples.en: We need to plan ahead to avoid any last-minute complications.
examples.zh: 我们需要提前做好规划，以防最后关头出现差错。

examples.en: The road ahead was blocked by fallen trees after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨过后，前方的道路被倒下的树木阻断了。

examples.en: With ten minutes left in the match, our team was two points ahead.
examples.zh: 比赛还剩十分钟时，我们队领先两分。

family_guide.root_logic: 由前缀 a-（朝向、处于……状态）与 head（头部、前部）融合而成，本义为“头部所朝的方向”，后引申为空间向前、时间提前以及竞争中领先。

lemmas.def_zh: 商标, 牌子, 烙印
lemmas.def_en: a name given to a product or service

examples.en: She always buys the same brand of coffee because she loves its flavor.
examples.zh: 她总是买同一个品牌的咖啡，因为她喜欢那个风味。

lemmas.def_zh: 打烙印于；铭刻；加污名于，谴责
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To mark permanently with a branding iron to indicate ownership or identity. 2. To impress permanently on the mind or memory. 3. To label someone as bad or shameful.

examples.en: She always buys the same brand of coffee because she loves its flavor.
examples.zh: 她总是买同一个品牌的咖啡，因为她喜欢那个风味。

lemmas.def_zh: 未打上烙印的,无物主(姓名或标记)的
lemmas.def_en: not marked with a brand

examples.en: The store sells unbranded white t-shirts at a fraction of the designer price.
examples.zh: 这家店出售无品牌的白色T恤，价格仅为名牌的一小部分。

lemmas.def_en: branded or labeled falsely and in violation of statutory requirements

examples.en: The agency seized the misbranded medication because the label hid potential side effects.
examples.zh: 该机构查扣了这批贴错标签的药品，因为其标签隐瞒了潜在的副作用。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语表示“燃烧、火木”之义，演变为用热铁烧烫留下的“烙印”，再引申为现代商业中的“品牌、商标”以及引申义“将…打上标签”。

lemmas.def_zh: 冲击, 冲突, 影响, 效果
lemmas.def_en: the striking of one body against another

examples.en: The sudden economic crisis had a devastating impact on small local businesses.
examples.zh: 这场突如其来的经济危机对当地小企业造成了毁灭性影响。

lemmas.def_zh: 装紧, 压紧
lemmas.def_en: the condition of being pressed closely together and firmly fixed

examples.en: Severe wisdom tooth impaction can cause persistent pain and require surgical removal.
examples.zh: 严重的智齿阻生会导致持续疼痛，需要手术拔除。

lemmas.def_zh: 压紧，压实；撞击，冲击；对……产生影响
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To press or pack firmly together into a solid mass. 2. [I, T] To hit with great force, or have a strong effect on something.

examples.en: The sudden economic crisis had a devastating impact on small local businesses.
examples.zh: 这场突如其来的经济危机对当地小企业造成了毁灭性影响。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 impingere（im- 向内 + pangere 钉入/固定/撞击）的过去分词词干，本义为‘猛烈撞击’，后由物理碰撞引申为事物带来的‘巨大冲击与深远影响’。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名动同形但发音有别：名词重音在前（/ˈɪmpækt/），动词重音通常在后（/ɪmˈpækt/）；动词既可作及物动词（直接接宾语），也可作不及物动词（常与 on/upon 连用）。

lemmas.def_zh: 顾客；主顾；客户
lemmas.def_en: a person or organization that buys goods or services from a store or business

examples.en: The company is committed to improving customer satisfaction and service quality.
examples.zh: 该公司致力于提高客户满意度与服务质量。

examples.en: They offered special discounts to attract new customers.
examples.zh: 他们提供特别折扣以吸引新顾客。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 custom（习惯），原指“习惯性地经常光顾某店铺的人”，后演变指一切购买商品或服务的“顾客、买家”。

lemmas.def_zh: 地板, 楼层, 底部, 底价；地面, 地板, 基底
lemmas.def_en: the inside lower horizontal surface (as of a room, hallway, tent, or other structure)

examples.en: Please do not leave your dirty clothes scattered all over the bedroom floor.
examples.zh: 请不要把你的脏衣服散落得满卧室地板都是。

lemmas.def_zh: 使彻底震惊，使目瞪口呆；击倒
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (informal) To surprise, shock, or confuse someone so thoroughly that they do not know what to say or do. 2. [T] To knock someone down to the ground.

examples.en: Please do not leave your dirty clothes scattered all over the bedroom floor.
examples.zh: 请不要把你的脏衣服散落得满卧室地板都是。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语源，本义为“平坦的地面”，后具体化为建筑物的“地板/楼层”、会议中的“发言席”，动词则引申为“击倒在地”以及比喻义“使震惊、难倒”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词常指物理地面、楼层或抽象底线与发言权；动词除“铺地板”外，多用于比喻义，指被问题或消息“彻底难倒或震慑住”。

lemmas.def_zh: 运输，运送；流放
lemmas.def_en: [T] To carry or convey people or goods from one place to another by vehicle, ship, or aircraft.

examples.en: The newly built pipeline is used to transport crude oil across the country.
examples.zh: 新建的管道用于在全国范围内输送原油。

examples.en: Public transport is often the most convenient way to travel around the city.
examples.zh: 公共交通通常是在城市内出行最便捷的方式。

lemmas.def_zh: v. 运输，运送；n. 交通运输系统；交通工具
lemmas.def_en: v. to take or carry people or goods from one place to another; n. a system or vehicle for carrying passengers or goods

examples.en: The newly built pipeline is used to transport crude oil across the country.
examples.zh: 新建的管道用于在全国范围内输送原油。

examples.en: Public transport is often the most convenient way to travel around the city.
examples.zh: 公共交通通常是在城市内出行最便捷的方式。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 交通运输系统；客运/货运；交通方式
lemmas.def_en: the action of transporting someone or something, or a system for doing so

examples.en: The government is investing heavily in the improvement of public transportation.
examples.zh: 政府正在大力投资改善公共交通系统。

examples.en: Bicycles provide a cheap and eco-friendly mode of transportation.
examples.zh: 自行车提供了一种廉价且环保的交通出行方式。

lemmas.def_zh: 输送人, 运输机
lemmas.def_en: a long truck for carrying motor vehicles

examples.en: The heavy equipment transporter moved the broken excavator back to the main workshop.
examples.zh: 重型设备运输车将损坏的挖掘机运回了主车间。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁前缀 trans-（穿越、跨越）+ portare（携带、运送），核心含义即“将人或货物从一地携带转移至另一地”。
family_guide.core_distinction: transport 可作动词和名词，作为名词在英式英语中广泛指代“交通工具/公共交通”；transportation 是其派生名词，主要在美式英语中指代“交通运输系统”，或通用指代宏观的“运输业/运输过程”。

lemmas.def_zh: 记忆力；回忆，记忆；（计算机的）内存，存储器
lemmas.def_en: the ability to store and recall information; a recollection of past events; the capacity of a computer to store data

examples.en: She has an exceptional memory for names and faces.
examples.zh: 她对人名和长相有着出色的记忆力。

examples.en: Childhood memories came flooding back as he walked through his hometown.
examples.zh: 当他走过故乡的街道时，童年的回忆如潮水般涌上心头。

lemmas.def_zh: 凭记忆, 暗记
lemmas.def_en: learning so as to be able to remember verbatim

examples.en: True understanding of mathematics requires logical problem-solving rather than rote memorization.
examples.zh: 真正理解数学需要逻辑解题能力，而不是死记硬背。

lemmas.def_zh: 记住，熟记，背熟
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To learn something so thoroughly that you can remember it exactly.

examples.en: Actors must memorize their lines thoroughly before shooting the first scene tomorrow.
examples.zh: 演员在明天拍摄第一场戏之前必须彻底背熟台词。

lemmas.def_zh: 记住，熟记，背熟（memorize 的英式拼写）
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (British English) To learn something so thoroughly that you can remember it exactly.

examples.en: She tried to memorise the complex recipe before the cooking competition started.
examples.zh: 在烹饪比赛开始前，她试图记下这个复杂的食谱。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 memor（留心的、记住的），核心语义指心智存储、保留并重现过去经历、信息的能力或所留下的印记。

lemmas.def_zh: 制造，生产；虚构，捏造
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To make or produce goods on a large scale using machinery. 2. [T] To invent, fabricate, or make up a false story, excuse, or evidence.

examples.en: The company plans to manufacture electric vehicles at its new plant next year.
examples.zh: 该公司计划明年在其新工厂生产电动汽车。

lemmas.def_zh: 产品, 制造
lemmas.def_en: the organized action of making of goods and services for sale

examples.en: The company plans to manufacture electric vehicles at its new plant next year.
examples.zh: 该公司计划明年在其新工厂生产电动汽车。

lemmas.def_zh: 制造业者, 厂商
lemmas.def_en: a business engaged in manufacturing some product

examples.en: The smartphone manufacturer announced a massive recall due to faulty battery components.
examples.zh: 这家智能手机制造商因电池元件故障宣布进行大规模召回。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. （工业）制造的；虚构的，捏造的
lemmas.def_en: produced in a large-scale industrial operation; fabricated or artificially created rather than natural
lemmas.usage_note: 常用于修饰经过工厂批量生产的商品，也可引申修饰虚假、人为制造的争议或情感（如 manufactured outrage）。

examples.en: The country has drastically reduced its reliance on imported manufactured goods.
examples.zh: 该国大幅降低了对进口工业制成品的依赖。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 manu（手）和 facere（制作），字面原指“手工制作”，工业革命后演变为主指“利用机器大规模工业化生产”。
family_guide.core_distinction: manufacture 既可作动词（生产）也可作名词（生产过程/制造业），而 manufacturer 专指从事生产的企业或制造商。

lemmas.def_zh: 配备，装备；使具备（能力、素质等）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] to provide someone or something with the necessary tools, equipment, or items. 2. [T] to prepare someone mentally or practically with needed skills or qualities

examples.en: The school was fully equipped with interactive whiteboards and modern computers.
examples.zh: 该学校完全配备了交互式电子白板和现代计算机。

examples.en: The course aims to equip students with practical skills for the job market.
examples.zh: 该课程旨在让学生掌握适应就业市场的实用技能。

lemmas.def_zh: 设备；器材；装备
lemmas.def_en: the set of tools, devices, or clothing needed for a particular activity or purpose

examples.en: All workers are required to wear safety equipment while inside the factory.
examples.zh: 所有工人在厂区内都必须佩戴安全装备。

examples.en: They bought a range of high-tech medical equipment for the new clinic.
examples.zh: 他们为新诊所采购了一系列高科技医疗设备。

lemmas.def_zh: 装备
lemmas.def_en: equipment and supplies of a military force

examples.en: The general inspected the military equipage to ensure the troops were ready.
examples.zh: 将军检查了军事装备，以确保部队做好了准备。

lemmas.def_zh: 无准备的；无配备的；无能力的
lemmas.def_en: without necessary physical or intellectual equipment

examples.en: The hikers were completely unequipped for the sudden drop in mountain temperatures.
examples.zh: 徒步旅行者完全没有准备好应对山上气温的骤降。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语，原义指整备船只出航，引申为‘为了特定目的而备齐所需的工具、物品或能力’。
family_guide.core_distinction: equip 是动作（配备、使具备），而 equipment 是其对应的不可数集合名词（设备、器材总称，切勿加复数 -s）。

lemmas.def_zh: 锁上，锁住；固定，卡住；（使）紧密结合
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] to fasten or secure something with a lock; to become firmly fixed or held in place.

examples.en: Make sure to lock the front door securely before leaving the house.
examples.zh: 出门前务必将前门锁好。

lemmas.def_zh: 开……的锁，开启；解开，揭示
lemmas.def_en: [T] To open the lock of a door, container, or device; to make something accessible or revealed.

examples.en: She used the master key to unlock the front door quickly.
examples.zh: 她用万能钥匙迅速打开了前门。

lemmas.def_zh: 锁, 刹车, 水闸, 一缕头发
lemmas.def_en: a fastener fitted to a door or drawer to keep it firmly closed

examples.en: Make sure you turn the lock before leaving the house today.
examples.zh: 今天出门前一定要锁好门。

lemmas.def_zh: 抽屉, 小柜, 上锁人
lemmas.def_en: a storage compartment for clothes and valuables; usually it has a lock

examples.en: Please keep your gym bag in the designated metal locker downstairs.
examples.zh: 请把你的健身包放在楼下指定的金属柜里。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 未锁上的；开着的
lemmas.def_en: not fastened or secured with a lock
lemmas.usage_note: 通常作表语或前置定语，修饰门、窗或设备，强调处于未上锁的安全隐患或通行状态。

examples.en: The thieves entered the building through an unlocked rear window.
examples.zh: 盗贼是从一扇未上锁的后窗进入大楼的。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语族核心词，本义指'紧固、关闭、阻隔'，演化为通过装置进行物理上的封锁、固定，并引申至隐喻层面的受困或潜能释放。
family_guide.core_distinction: lock 既可指上锁的行为也可指锁具本身，而 locker 专指带有锁扣供个人储物的储物柜。

lemmas.def_zh: 脑
lemmas.def_en: that part of the central nervous system that includes all the higher nervous centers; enclosed within the skull; continuous with the spinal cord

examples.en: The human brain requires adequate sleep to function at its best.
examples.zh: 人脑需要充足的睡眠才能处于最佳状态。

lemmas.def_zh: 猛击头部，打碎……的脑袋
lemmas.def_en: [T] (informal) To hit someone very hard on the head.

examples.en: The human brain requires adequate sleep to function at its best.
examples.zh: 人脑需要充足的睡眠才能处于最佳状态。

lemmas.def_zh: 无头脑的, 愚笨的
lemmas.def_en: not using intelligence

examples.en: It was a brainless decision to leave your wallet on the table.
examples.zh: 把钱包落在桌子上真是一个愚蠢的决定。

lemmas.def_zh: 脑筋好的, 聪明的
lemmas.def_en: having or marked by unusual and impressive intelligence

examples.en: Her brainy younger brother solved the complex math puzzle in minutes.
examples.zh: 她那聪明的弟弟几分钟内就解开了这道复杂的数学题。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，核心指解剖学意义上的“脑器官”，由生理器官自然引申出“智力、脑力、智囊”等抽象概念，转为动词时意象具体化为“猛击头部”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词常单数指大脑器官、复数指智力或脑力；动词极为口语化且具动作感，专指暴力打击头部。

lemmas.def_zh: 激励，鼓舞；赋予灵感；引起，激起
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To fill someone with confidence, enthusiasm, or the desire to do something. 2. [T] To stimulate someone's creative capacity or produce inspiration for something.

examples.en: Her courage inspired generations of young scientists to pursue their dreams.
examples.zh: 她的勇气激励了一代又一代年轻科学家去追求自己的梦想。

examples.en: The novel was inspired by a series of real historical events.
examples.zh: 这部小说是受一系列真实历史事件的启发而创作的。

lemmas.def_zh: 灵感；鼓舞；灵感之源，启发人的人或物
lemmas.def_en: the process of being mentally stimulated; a sudden brilliant idea, or a person/thing that stimulates creative work

examples.en: Nature has always been a constant source of inspiration for her artwork.
examples.zh: 大自然一直是她艺术创作源源不断的灵感来源。

examples.en: He had a sudden flash of inspiration that solved the long-standing problem.
examples.zh: 他灵光一现，解开了困扰已久的难题。

lemmas.def_zh: 启发灵感、鼓舞（或激励）人心的人
lemmas.def_en: a leader who stimulates and excites people to action

examples.en: The dedicated teacher served as a great inspirer for all her students.
examples.zh: 这位敬业的老师激励了她所有的学生。

lemmas.def_zh: 鼓舞人心的；励志的；启发灵感的
lemmas.def_en: providing or showing creative or spiritual inspiration; encouraging and uplifting

examples.en: She delivered an inspirational speech that left the audience deeply moved.
examples.zh: 她发表了一场鼓舞人心的演讲，令全场观众深受触动。

examples.en: His journey from poverty to success has become an inspirational story for many.
examples.zh: 他从一贫如洗走向成功的人生历程，成了鼓舞许多人的励志故事。

lemmas.def_zh: 未受灵感启迪的, 无灵感的, 缺乏创见的
lemmas.def_en: having no intellectual or emotional or spiritual excitement

examples.en: The critics dismissed his latest novel as dull and completely uninspired.
examples.zh: 评论家们批评他的最新小说枯燥乏味且毫无创意。

lemmas.def_zh: 引不起兴趣的, 无鼓舞作用的, 无指望的
lemmas.def_en: depressing to the spirit

examples.en: We walked out of the cinema because the plot was thoroughly uninspiring.
examples.zh: 由于剧情实在乏味无趣，我们中途退场了。

lemmas.def_zh: 吸气的, 吸入的
lemmas.def_en: pertaining to the drawing in phase of respiration

examples.en: Deep inspiratory exercises can help improve lung capacity after a major chest surgery.
examples.zh: 深吸气锻炼有助于在大胸腔手术后改善肺活量。

lemmas.def_zh: insplrational（给予灵感的）的变形
lemmas.def_en: with inspiration; in an inspiring manner,

examples.en: She spoke inspirationally about overcoming adversity to achieve her lifelong dreams.
examples.zh: 她鼓舞人心地讲述了战胜逆境以实现终生梦想的故事。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 inspirare（in- '注入' + spirare '呼吸'），本义为'吹气入心'，引申为精神上的唤醒、激发灵感与鼓舞斗志。
family_guide.core_distinction: inspiration 是名词，既表抽象的'灵感/鼓舞'，也可指具体的'灵感之源'；inspirational 是形容词，专指事物本身具备'鼓舞人心、励志'的特质。

lemmas.def_zh: 几乎；差不多；将近
lemmas.def_en: almost, but not completely or not quite

examples.en: It took nearly three hours to reach the summit in the heavy snow.
examples.zh: 在大雪中花了将近三个小时才到达山顶。

examples.en: I nearly missed my flight because of the morning traffic jam.
examples.zh: 因为早高峰堵车，我差点错过了航班。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语表示“靠近”的 near 加副词后缀 -ly，语义从空间上的“近距离”引申为抽象程度、数量或状态上的“接近”与“几乎”。
family_guide.core_distinction: near 作副词多表示空间或时间上的“在附近、靠近”，而 nearly 专指程度、数量上的“几乎、差不多（未完全达到）”。

lemmas.def_zh: 打招呼；问候（一声“嗨”）
lemmas.def_en: an informal greeting or the utterance of the word 'hi'

examples.en: She gave me a quick hi as she rushed past my desk.
examples.zh: 她匆匆路过我的办公桌时，简短地向我打了个招呼。

examples.en: I just dropped by to say a quick hi.
examples.zh: 我顺道过来打个招呼。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于自然发声的感叹词（类似于 hey 或 hail），后演变为最常用的非正式打招呼用语，作名词时指“一声问候”或“打个招呼”。

lemmas.def_zh: 尽管；不管；不顾
lemmas.def_en: without being affected by; in spite of

examples.en: Despite the heavy rain, they decided to continue their hike.
examples.zh: 尽管下着大雨，他们还是决定继续徒步。

examples.en: She managed to stay calm despite being under immense pressure.
examples.zh: 尽管承受着巨大的压力，她仍设法保持了镇定。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 despicere（俯视、鄙视，de- 向下 + specere 看），原义为“轻视、蔑视”，后经短语 in despite of 演变为介词，核心逻辑为“不顾及、不受……的阻碍”。
family_guide.core_distinction: despite 本身即为介词，后面直接接名词、代名词或动名词，绝不能加 of（与 in spite of 区分），接句子时须用 despite the fact that。

lemmas.def_zh: 文件, 公文, 文档
lemmas.def_en: writing that provides information (especially information of an official nature)

examples.en: Please sign the legal document and return it to our office.
examples.zh: 请在这份法律文件上签字并寄回我们办公室。

lemmas.def_en: a film or TV program presenting the facts about a person or event
lemmas.def_zh: 纪录片，纪实节目

examples.en: The documentary shed light on the plight of endangered sea turtles.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片揭示了濒危海龟的困境。

lemmas.def_zh: (总称)文件
lemmas.def_en: confirmation that some fact or statement is true through the use of documentary evidence

examples.en: You must provide proper documentation to verify your employment history today.
examples.zh: 你今天必须提供相关文件来核实你的工作经历。

lemmas.def_zh: 详细记录，记载；用文件（或文献、证据）证明
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To record the details of an event, process, or situation in writing, film, or photographs. 2. [T] To support or prove something with evidence or official documents.

examples.en: Please sign the legal document and return it to our office.
examples.zh: 请在这份法律文件上签字并寄回我们办公室。

lemmas.def_zh: 无正式文件的, 无事实证明的
lemmas.def_en: lacking necessary documents (as for e.g. permission to live or work in a country)

examples.en: The charity provides essential medical care to undocumented immigrants in need.
examples.zh: 该慈善机构为有需要的无证移民提供基本的医疗服务。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 公文的, 证书的, 文件的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or consisting of or derived from documents

examples.en: The lawyer presented strong documental evidence to support his client's claim.
examples.zh: 律师出示了有力的公文证据来支持其当事人的主张。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 docere（教导、证明），最初指用于示范或提供凭证的材料，演变为主词义“载有信息的凭证/文件”，动词相应引申为“记录、用文件证明”。
family_guide.core_distinction: document 通常指单份具体的文件、证件或公文（可数）；documentation 为集合/不可数名词，指成套的证明材料、文献记录或技术文档。

lemmas.def_zh: 叫喊，大声呼叫；哭泣，流泪
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] to shout or utter a loud call, exclamation, or sound. 2. [I] to shed tears because of pain, sadness, or joy.

examples.en: The frightened child began to cry loudly in the crowded store.
examples.zh: 受惊的孩子在拥挤的商店里大声哭了起来。

lemmas.def_zh: 叫声, 哭声, 大叫
lemmas.def_en: a loud utterance; often in protest or opposition

examples.en: The frightened child began to cry loudly in the crowded store.
examples.zh: 受惊的孩子在拥挤的商店里大声哭了起来。

lemmas.def_zh: 喊叫者, 哭泣者, 传呼员
lemmas.def_en: a person who weeps

examples.en: The town crier announced the king's royal decree to the gathered crowd.
examples.zh: 传令官向聚集的人群宣读了国王的敕令。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 crier（呼喊、大叫），核心逻辑为“强烈情绪驱动下的出声”，在演变中分化并稳固出“哭泣（流泪）”与“呼喊（叫嚷）”两重核心语义。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词与名词同形，二者内部均兼具“流泪痛哭”与“高声喊叫”两层含义，需根据语境是强调情绪宣泄还是声响来判断具体含义。

lemmas.def_zh: 额外的, 特别的
lemmas.def_en: more than is needed, desired, or required

examples.en: We packed extra water bottles for our long hike up the mountain.
examples.zh: 为了这次漫长的登山徒步，我们额外装了几瓶水。

lemmas.def_zh: 额外的事物, 另外的收费
lemmas.def_en: a minor actor in crowd scenes

examples.en: We packed extra water bottles for our long hike up the mountain.
examples.zh: 为了这次漫长的登山徒步，我们额外装了几瓶水。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语前缀 extra-（在……之外、超出），引申为超出常规、额外添加的人或事物。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词表示“额外的、另外收费的”；名词派生指“额外的事物/费用”，在影视中特指“群演/临时演员”，亦可指报纸“号外”。

lemmas.def_zh: 放置，平放；铺设；下（蛋）
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To put someone or something down carefully or in a flat position. 2. (of a bird or insect) to produce an egg.

examples.en: Please lay the fragile package flat on the table.
examples.zh: 请把这个易碎的包裹平放在桌上。

examples.en: The committee met to lay the groundwork for the upcoming summit.
examples.zh: 委员会举行会议，为即将举行的高峰会奠定基础。

lemmas.def_zh: 放置，平放（lay 的过去式和过去分词）；铺设；产（卵）
lemmas.def_en: [T] Past tense and past participle of lay; to have put something down flat or carefully.

examples.en: He laid his hand gently on her shoulder to reassure her.
examples.zh: 他轻轻地把手放在她的肩膀上，让她安心。

examples.en: The construction crew laid thousands of bricks to finish the wall.
examples.zh: 施工队砌了数千块砖才把墙修好。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To arrange, stack, or place things in layers.
lemmas.def_zh: 分层堆放，把……分层排列；用压条法培育

examples.en: A thick layer of snow covered the entire roof during the winter storm.
examples.zh: 在冬季暴风雪期间，厚厚的积雪覆盖了整个屋顶。

lemmas.def_en: single thickness of usually some homogeneous substance
lemmas.def_zh: 层, 产卵鸡, 放置者

examples.en: A thick layer of snow covered the entire roof during the winter storm.
examples.zh: 在冬季暴风雪期间，厚厚的积雪覆盖了整个屋顶。

lemmas.def_zh: 俗人, 外行
lemmas.def_en: in Christianity, members of a religious community that do not have the priestly responsibilities of ordained clergy

examples.en: The reform movement aimed to give the church laity a much greater active voice.
examples.zh: 该改革运动旨在让教会的俗人信徒拥有更大的话语权。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语中“躺（lie）”的使役形式，核心概念为“使某物躺下”，由此衍生出放置、铺设、产卵及提出计划等及物动作语义。
family_guide.core_distinction: lay 是及物动词原形（后必须接宾语），laid 为其规则演变的过去式和过去分词；需注意勿将其与不及物动词 lie（躺）的过去式 lay 混淆。

lemmas.def_zh: 悬挂，挂；下垂；绞死，吊死
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To attach or be fastened to something from above so that the lower part is free; to suspend. 2. [I, T] To kill someone, or die, by dropping with a rope around the neck.

examples.en: You can hang your coat on the peg behind the door.
examples.zh: 你可以把大衣挂在门后的挂钩上。

examples.en: A thick layer of smog hung over the city all morning.
examples.zh: 整整一个上午，一层浓重的雾霾都笼罩在城市上空。

lemmas.def_zh: 悬挂，吊；垂挂（hang 的过去式和过去分词，绞刑除外）
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] Past tense and past participle of hang (used for suspending objects, not execution).

examples.en: She hung the newly framed painting directly above the fireplace.
examples.zh: 她把新装裱好的画挂在壁炉的正上方。

examples.en: A delicate scent of lavender hung in the warm evening air.
examples.zh: 温暖的晚风中弥漫着淡淡的薰衣草香气。

lemmas.def_zh: 绞刑；悬挂物，织物挂饰（如壁毯、窗帘）
lemmas.def_en: the practice of execution by suspending by the neck; a decorative cloth draped on a wall

examples.en: The castle walls were draped with magnificent medieval tapestry hangings.
examples.zh: 城堡的墙壁上挂着华丽的中世纪织锦挂毯。

examples.en: Capital punishment by hanging was abolished in the country decades ago.
examples.zh: 该国在几十年前就废除了绞刑这一极刑。

lemmas.def_zh: 挂钩, 吊架, 衣架, 挂衣钩
lemmas.def_en: a worker who hangs something

examples.en: Hang your heavy winter coat on the wooden hanger by the entrance.
examples.zh: 把你厚重的冬装外套挂在入口处的木衣架上。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，核心意象为“悬空下垂”，由此延伸出日常物品的悬挂、静止悬浮的状态，以及专指死刑的绞决。
family_guide.core_distinction: hang作一般悬挂讲时过去式和过去分词为hung；专指“绞死、绞刑”时则规则变化为hanged；hanging既可指绞刑执行，也可指墙壁挂饰。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）膨胀，（使）扩大，（使）扩展；详述
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To become or make larger in size, volume, scope, or extent. 2. [I] (+ on/upon) To give more details about something.

examples.en: The tech company plans to expand its operations into emerging markets next year.
examples.zh: 这家科技公司计划明年将业务拓展至新兴市场。

examples.en: Metals expand when heated and contract when cooled.
examples.zh: 金属遇热膨胀，遇冷收缩。

lemmas.def_zh: 扩大；扩展；膨胀；扩建
lemmas.def_en: the act of increasing in size, volume, quantity, or scope

examples.en: Rapid economic expansion has led to a surge in demand for clean energy.
examples.zh: 经济的快速扩张导致对清洁能源的需求激增。

examples.en: The university is undergoing a major expansion to accommodate more students.
examples.zh: 该大学正在进行大规模扩建以容纳更多学生。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 夸张性
lemmas.def_en: a quality characterized by magnificence of scale or the tendency to expand

examples.en: The doctor noted signs of grandiosity and expansiveness in the patient's behavior.
examples.zh: 医生注意到该患者的行为中表现出夸大和妄想倾向。

lemmas.def_zh: 扩张性的, 使扩大的, 广阔的
lemmas.def_en: able or tending to expand or characterized by expansion

examples.en: The resort offers expansive views of the calm ocean and green hills.
examples.zh: 该度假村坐拥平静海洋与葱郁山丘的广阔景色。

lemmas.def_zh: 能扩张的, 会膨胀的
lemmas.def_en: able to expand or be expanded

examples.en: This flexible luggage features an expansible compartment for extra travel gear.
examples.zh: 这款便携行李箱配有可扩张的隔层，方便容纳更多旅行装备。

lemmas.def_zh: 可扩张地, 辽阔地
lemmas.def_en: in an impressively expansive manner

examples.en: He smiled expansively and welcomed all the guests into his modern home.
examples.zh: 他热情开朗地微笑着，欢迎所有客人走进他的现代住宅。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 ex-（向外）结合拉丁语 pandere（铺开、展开），核心逻辑是从内向外铺开，引申为体积、规模、业务或范围的“扩大与拓展”。

lemmas.def_zh: 车辆，交通工具；媒介，载体，手段
lemmas.def_en: a machine used for transporting people or goods; a thing used to express, embody, or achieve something

examples.en: Electric vehicles are becoming increasingly popular due to lower running costs and zero emissions.
examples.zh: 由于运行成本较低且零排放，电动汽车正变得越来越受欢迎。

examples.en: The novel served as a vehicle for the author's political ideas.
examples.zh: 这部小说成为了作者表达其政治思想的载体。

lemmas.def_zh: 车的, 作为媒介的, 用车辆运载的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or intended for (motor) vehicles

examples.en: Heavy snowfall caused severe vehicular traffic delays across the entire metropolitan area.
examples.zh: 强降雪导致整个大都市区的车辆交通严重延误。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 vehere（运送、携带），核心语义为“运载之物”，由物理层面的“车辆、交通工具”引申为抽象层面的思想、情感或目的的“传播媒介、载体与手段”。

lemmas.def_zh: 元（美、加、澳等国货币单位）；美元；一元纸币（或硬币）
lemmas.def_en: the basic monetary unit of the US, Canada, Australia, and several other countries; a note or coin worth one dollar

examples.en: Crude oil is traditionally priced and traded in US dollars worldwide.
examples.zh: 在全球范围内，原油传统上以美元计价和交易。

examples.en: Every dollar raised from the charity event will go directly to cancer research.
examples.zh: 慈善活动筹集的每一美元都将直接用于癌症研究。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于早期德语银币名 Thaler（源自产银地圣约阿希姆斯塔尔 Joachimsthal），后经荷兰语 daler 进入英语，由泛指大型银币演变为多国法定货币的基本单位。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 海岸，海滨；v. （车辆等）惯性滑行；轻而易举地取得成功，得过且过
lemmas.def_en: n. the land near the sea; v. to move effortlessly without using power; to succeed or progress with little effort

examples.en: They bought a small cottage on the rugged south coast.
examples.zh: 他们在崎岖的南海岸边买了一座小乡村别墅。

examples.en: Instead of pedaling hard, he coasted down the hill on his bicycle.
examples.zh: 他没有用力踩脚踏板，而是骑着自行车顺着山坡滑了下去。

lemmas.def_zh: （垫在茶杯或酒杯下的）杯垫；过山车（roller coaster 简称）
lemmas.def_en: a small mat placed under a glass or mug; a roller coaster

examples.en: Please use a coaster so that the hot coffee cup doesn't leave a mark on the table.
examples.zh: 请垫个杯垫，免得热咖啡杯在桌上留下印痕。

lemmas.def_zh: 沿海的；临海的
lemmas.def_en: located on or near a coast

examples.en: Severe storms have caused significant erosion in low-lying coastal areas.
examples.zh: 剧烈的风暴导致地势低洼的沿海地区遭受了严重的侵蚀。

lemmas.def_zh: （车辆等）滑行，惯性前行；轻易成功，得过且过
lemmas.def_en: [I] To move effortlessly without using power or pedaling; to succeed or make progress with little effort.

examples.en: They bought a small cottage on the rugged south coast.
examples.zh: 他们在崎岖的南海岸边买了一座小乡村别墅。

examples.en: Instead of pedaling hard, he coasted down the hill on his bicycle.
examples.zh: 他没有用力踩脚踏板，而是骑着自行车顺着山坡滑了下去。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 costa（肋骨、侧边），引申为大陆的边缘即“海岸”；动词则源于沿岸顺势滑行，引申为“借助惯性滑行”及“毫不费力地前行”。
family_guide.core_distinction: coaster 常指具体的器物（如杯垫、过山车），而 coastal 是描述性的形容词，专指“沿海的、近海的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 独立的，自主的；无党派人士，独立候选人（或机构）
lemmas.def_en: not influenced or controlled by others; a person or organization free from outside control or political affiliation

examples.en: She made an independent decision without relying on her family's financial support.
examples.zh: 她在没有依赖家庭经济支持的情况下，做出了自主的决定。

examples.en: In the local election, many swing voters decided to back an independent.
examples.zh: 在地方选举中，许多摇摆选民决定支持一位无党派候选人。

lemmas.def_zh: 独立地；自立地
lemmas.def_en: without being controlled or influenced by others; on one's own

examples.en: The two research teams worked independently and arrived at the same conclusion.
examples.zh: 两个研究团队各自独立开展工作，却得出了相同的结论。

lemmas.def_zh: 独立的，自主的；无党派人士，独立候选人（或机构）
lemmas.def_en: not influenced or controlled by others; a person or organization free from outside control or political affiliation

examples.en: She made an independent decision without relying on her family's financial support.
examples.zh: 她在没有依赖家庭经济支持的情况下，做出了自主的决定。

examples.en: In the local election, many swing voters decided to back an independent.
examples.zh: 在地方选举中，许多摇摆选民决定支持一位无党派候选人。

lemmas.def_en: freedom from control or influence of another or others
lemmas.def_zh: n. 独立；自主

examples.en: The country gained full independence after decades of colonial rule.
examples.zh: 经历数十年的殖民统治后，该国获得了完全独立。

lemmas.def_zh: 独立, 独立国, 组合教会制
lemmas.def_en: freedom from control or influence of another or others

examples.en: The small colony fought bravely to secure complete independency from the empire.
examples.zh: 该小殖民地英勇抗争，以获得脱离帝国的彻底独立。

family_guide.root_logic: 由否定前缀 in-（不）与 depend（依靠，源自‘悬挂于…之下’）组合而成，核心逻辑是‘不依附、不依赖于外部力量’。
family_guide.core_distinction: independent 兼具形容词（独立的）与名词（无党派人士/独立候选人或机构）属性；independently 为副词，用于修饰自主或单独行动的状态。

lemmas.def_zh: 发生；存在，出现；（想法等）浮现于脑中
lemmas.def_en: [I] 1. To happen or take place. 2. To exist or be found. 3. (of an idea or thought) To come into a person's mind.

examples.en: It didn't occur to me to check the weather forecast before leaving.
examples.zh: 出门前我完全没想起要看一眼天气预报。

examples.en: Most of the traffic accidents occur during the morning rush hour.
examples.zh: 大多数交通事故都发生在早高峰期间。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 occurrere（ob- 迎向 + currere 跑），字面意为“迎面奔来”，引申为事情“迎面发生”或想法“突然闪现入脑海”。

lemmas.def_zh: 富裕的, 富饶的, 浓厚的, 贵重的
lemmas.def_en: possessing material wealth

examples.en: The city is famous for its rich history and delicious local cuisine.
examples.zh: 这座城市以其丰富的历史底蕴和美味的当地美食而闻名。

lemmas.def_en: people who have possessions and wealth (considered as a group)

examples.en: The city is famous for its rich history and delicious local cuisine.
examples.zh: 这座城市以其丰富的历史底蕴和美味的当地美食而闻名。

lemmas.def_zh: 富裕, 丰富, 肥沃
lemmas.def_en: the property of being extremely abundant

examples.en: The deep richness of the soil helps these delicate flowers bloom beautifully.
examples.zh: 深层土壤的肥沃使这些娇嫩的花朵绽放得格外美丽。

lemmas.def_zh: 富裕地, 丰富地, 充分地
lemmas.def_en: to an ample degree or in an ample manner

examples.en: The historic theater was richly decorated with velvet curtains and gold trim.
examples.zh: 这座历史悠久的剧院装饰极为华丽，配有天鹅绒窗帘和金色镶边。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语，与拉丁语 rex（国王）同源，最初指‘有权势的’，后引申为‘拥有大量财富与资源的、丰富浓郁的’。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词 rich 表示‘富有的’或‘丰富的’；作名词时通常与定冠词结合为 the rich，作为集合名词表示‘富人群体’。

lemmas.def_zh: 怀疑, 疑惑
lemmas.def_en: the state of being unsure of something

examples.en: She had no doubt that her team would finish the complex project.
examples.zh: 她毫不怀疑自己的团队能够完成这项复杂的项目。

lemmas.def_zh: 抱怀疑态度的人；不信宗教的人；怀疑论者
lemmas.def_en: someone who habitually doubts accepted beliefs

examples.en: His remarkable success finally silenced every doubter who questioned his natural ability.
examples.zh: 他非凡的成功最终让质疑他天资的每位怀疑者哑口无言。

lemmas.def_zh: 怀疑，不相信；不能肯定
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To feel uncertain about something or consider it unlikely to be true.

examples.en: She had no doubt that her team would finish the complex project.
examples.zh: 她毫不怀疑自己的团队能够完成这项复杂的项目。

lemmas.def_zh: 怀疑的；不太可能的；未定的
lemmas.def_en: feeling uncertain, or unlikely to happen or be true

examples.en: Doctors are doubtful about his chances of a full recovery.
examples.zh: 医生对他完全康复的几率表示怀疑。

examples.en: It is doubtful that the weather will improve by tomorrow.
examples.zh: 天气明天是否会好转还很难说。

lemmas.def_zh: 无疑地, 确定地
lemmas.def_en: without doubt; certainly

examples.en: The successful exhibition will doubtless attract more international visitors to this gallery.
examples.zh: 这次成功的展览无疑会为该美术馆吸引更多国际访客。

lemmas.def_en: without doubt; certainly

examples.en: She is doubtlessly the most qualified candidate for this senior engineering position.
examples.zh: 她无疑是担任这一高级工程师职位最合适的人选。

lemmas.def_zh: 含糊地；怀疑地
lemmas.def_en: in a doubtful manner

examples.en: The mechanic shook his head doubtfully after examining the damaged car engine.
examples.zh: 检查过损坏的汽车发动机后，机械师满腹怀疑地摇了摇头。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 dubitare（与 duo'二'同源），核心逻辑是在两种可能之间摇摆不定，引申为‘不确定、怀疑’。
family_guide.core_distinction: doubtful 既可形容人内心‘感到怀疑的’（主观），也可形容事情‘不太可能的、存疑的’（客观）。

lemmas.def_zh: 理论，学说；推测，见解
lemmas.def_en: a formal set of ideas intended to explain something, or an idea that explains why something happens

examples.en: In theory, the new system should streamline our workflow, but in practice it has caused several delays.
examples.zh: 理论上新系统应该能简化我们的工作流程，但实际上它却导致了几次延误。

examples.en: The researchers designed a series of experiments to test their theory on climate feedback loops.
examples.zh: 研究人员设计了一系列实验来检验他们关于气候反馈回路的理论。

lemmas.def_zh: 理论家, 理论工作者
lemmas.def_en: someone who theorizes (especially in science or art)

examples.en: The economic theorist presented a groundbreaking model on market trends today.
examples.zh: 这位经济理论家今天提出了一个关于市场趋势的开创性模型。

lemmas.def_zh: 理论家
lemmas.def_en: someone who theorizes (especially in science or art)

examples.en: The physics theoretician spent decades developing new equations to explain cosmic expansion.
examples.zh: 这位理论物理学家花了数十年时间推导新方程来解释宇宙膨胀。

lemmas.def_zh: 理论化
lemmas.def_en: the production or use of theories

examples.en: His latest paper focuses on the theorization of modern urban social movements.
examples.zh: 他的最新论文着眼于现代城市社会运动的理论化研究。

lemmas.def_zh: 建立理论，推测，提出假说
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (+ about/that) To develop or propose a theory or explanation to account for something.

examples.en: Scientists theorize that deep ocean currents play a crucial role in climate.
examples.zh: 科学家推测，深海洋流在气候变化中扮演着至关重要的角色。

lemmas.def_zh: 建立理论，推测，提出假说
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (+ about/that) (British English spelling of theorize) To develop or propose a theory or explanation for a phenomenon.

examples.en: Sociologists theorise that social media greatly affects communication habits among teenagers.
examples.zh: 社会学家推论，社交媒体对青少年的交流习惯有着极大影响。

lemmas.def_zh: 理论上的, 好理论的
lemmas.def_en: concerned primarily with theories or hypotheses rather than practical considerations

examples.en: His conclusions remain largely theoretic without concrete support from field experiments.
examples.zh: 没有现场实验的具体支持，他的结论在很大程度上仍停留在理论层面。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 theōria（注视、沉思、观察），语义由肉眼的“观看、审视”引申为心智上的“沉思”，最终演变为用于系统性解释客观现象的“理论”或思维假设。

lemmas.def_zh: 正义，公平；司法，审判；法官
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being fair and reasonable; the legal system that administers the law; a judge

examples.en: The police are determined to bring those responsible for the crime to justice.
examples.zh: 警方决心将这起罪行的责任人绳之以法。

examples.en: A deeply rooted sense of justice drove her to pursue a career as a human rights lawyer.
examples.zh: 根深蒂固的正义感驱使她走上了人权律师的职业道路。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 justus（公正的、合法的），派生自 jus（法律、权利），核心意涵始终围绕“合乎法律与道德的公道”及“法律的实施机构或人员”。

lemmas.def_zh: 一件物品；（清单、议程上的）项目；（新闻）一条
lemmas.def_en: an individual article or unit, especially one on a list, agenda, or in a collection

examples.en: The next item on the agenda is the approval of the annual budget.
examples.zh: 议程上的下一个项目是批准年度预算。

examples.en: Handmade leather bags have become popular luxury items.
examples.zh: 手工制作的皮包已成为受欢迎的奢侈品。

lemmas.def_zh: 逐条列记, 详细说明
lemmas.def_en: the act of making a list of items

examples.en: Please provide an itemization of your travel expenses before submitting the report.
examples.zh: 在提交报告之前，请提供一份详尽的差旅费明细单。

lemmas.def_zh: 逐条列出，分项列举；详细罗列
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To list each individual item, detail, or expense separately and specifically.

examples.en: The honest mechanic agreed to itemize all parts and labor costs clearly.
examples.zh: 诚实的汽修师傅同意清楚地逐项列出所有零部件和人工费用。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语副词 item（意为“同样地、还有”），原用于罗列清单时引出下一项，后名词化为清单中的“单件物品、条款或个别事项”。

lemmas.def_zh: 浪费，挥霍，滥用；（使）消瘦，衰弱；破坏，使荒芜
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To use more of something than is necessary, or to use it carelessly or uselessly. 2. [I, T] (often 'waste away') To gradually become thin and weak, especially from illness. 3. [T] (slang) To kill or destroy.

examples.en: Do not waste valuable time arguing over small issues during the meeting.
examples.zh: 开会期间不要把宝贵的时间浪费在争论细枝末节上。

lemmas.def_zh: 浪费, 废物, 损耗, 消耗, 荒地, 垃圾, 地面风化物
lemmas.def_en: any materials unused and rejected as worthless or unwanted

examples.en: Do not waste valuable time arguing over small issues during the meeting.
examples.zh: 开会期间不要把宝贵的时间浪费在争论细枝末节上。

lemmas.def_zh: 浪费, 浪费量, 废物
lemmas.def_en: the process of wasting

examples.en: The restaurant introduced new food practices to effectively reduce kitchen wastage.
examples.zh: 该餐厅引入了新的餐饮举措，以有效减少厨房的损耗。

lemmas.def_zh: 造成浪费的人, 造成损坏的人, 挥霍者, 浪子, 无用的人, 废品, 次品
lemmas.def_en: someone who dissipates resources self-indulgently

examples.en: His father called him an irresponsible waster after seeing the credit card bills.
examples.zh: 看到信用卡账单后，他的父亲骂他是个不负责任的败家子。

lemmas.def_zh: 浪费, 挥霍, 耗费
lemmas.def_en: the trait of wasting resources

examples.en: The manager strictly warned the office staff against the wastefulness of paper.
examples.zh: 经理严厉告诫办公室员工切勿浪费纸张。

lemmas.def_zh: 浪费的, 不经济的
lemmas.def_en: inefficient in use of time and effort and materials

examples.en: Leaving the heating on with open windows is extremely wasteful and costly.
examples.zh: 开着窗户还开暖气是极其浪费且昂贵的。

lemmas.def_zh: 挥霍地；浪费地
lemmas.def_en: to a wasteful manner or to a wasteful degree

examples.en: The department wastefully spent its entire remaining budget on unnecessary office supplies.
examples.zh: 该部门极其浪费地将剩余预算全花在了不必要的办公用品上。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 vastus（荒凉的、空旷的），由“使成荒芜、消耗殆尽”引申为“无益地消耗、滥用”，并衍生出“用后弃置的废料”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 同形多词性词；动词侧重“不珍惜地消耗/滥用”，名词既可表抽象的“浪费行为”，也可表具体的“废弃物/工业垃圾”。

lemmas.def_zh: 风，气流；呼吸；缠绕，卷绕；蜿蜒
lemmas.def_en: a natural movement of air; breath; to twist, coil, or follow a curving path

examples.en: A bitter cold wind was blowing hard from the north.
examples.zh: 一阵凛冽的寒风从北方猛烈地刮来。

examples.en: The narrow road winds steeply up through the mountains.
examples.zh: 狭窄的公路蜿蜒陡峭地穿行于群山之中。

lemmas.def_zh: 弯曲，弯道；（电机的）线圈，绕组
lemmas.def_en: a twisting movement, turn, or bend; a coil of wire in an electrical device

examples.en: The old path followed the countless windings of the river.
examples.zh: 那条古道顺着河流的无数个弯道蜿蜒延伸。

lemmas.def_zh: 络纱工, 络筒机, 络纱机, 开发条的钥匙
lemmas.def_en: a worker who winds (e.g., a winch or clock or other mechanism)

examples.en: He misplaced the small metal winder needed to keep the antique clock running.
examples.zh: 他把让那台老式钟表保持运转所需的小金属发条钥匙弄丢了。

lemmas.def_zh: (windy 的复数) a. 多风的, 风强的, 腹胀的, 吹牛的

examples.en: The sudden windies made sailing across the wide open bay rather challenging.
examples.zh: 突如其来的阵阵强风使得横穿这片开阔的海湾变得相当具有挑战性。

lemmas.def_zh: 盘绕，缠绕；蜿蜒，迂回
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. To twist, wrap, or coil around something. 2. [I] To follow a curving, bending, or twisting course.

examples.en: A bitter cold wind was blowing hard from the north.
examples.zh: 一阵凛冽的寒风从北方猛烈地刮来。

examples.en: The narrow road winds steeply up through the mountains.
examples.zh: 狭窄的公路蜿蜒陡峭地穿行于群山之中。

lemmas.def_zh: 放松，释怀，平复情绪；解开，展开（卷绕之物）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (informal) To relax and stop feeling anxious or tense after a period of work or worry. 2. [I, T] To unroll, uncoil, or untwist something that has been wound, or to become unwound.

examples.en: She likes to listen to classical music to unwind after a stressful day.
examples.zh: 在紧张忙碌的一天后，她喜欢听古典音乐来放松身心。

lemmas.def_zh: unwind的过去式和过去分词
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] Past tense and past participle of unwind; to unroll something coiled, or to relax after stress.

examples.en: The nurse gently unwound the bandage from the patient's injured left arm.
examples.zh: 护士轻轻解开了缠在病人受伤左臂上的绷带。

lemmas.def_zh: 多风的，风大的；冗长空洞的
lemmas.def_en: marked by strong or abundant wind; using too many words

examples.en: It was too windy to set up the camping tent on the ridge.
examples.zh: 山脊上风太大，根本无法搭建露营帐篷。

lemmas.def_zh: 无风的, 平静的
lemmas.def_en: without or almost without wind

examples.en: The lake was perfectly calm and mirror-like on that warm, windless summer morning.
examples.zh: 在那个温暖无风的夏日清晨，湖面水平如镜，极为平静。

family_guide.root_logic: 该词族拼写上涵盖两大源头：一指流动之气（读音 /wɪnd/，意为风、气息）；二指回环转动（读音 /waɪnd/，意为缠绕、蜿蜒）。
family_guide.core_distinction: 注意异音同形现象：读 /wɪnd/ 时作名词指自然界的“风”并派生形容词 windy；读 /waɪnd/ 时作动词表“缠绕/拐弯”，其名词 winding 指“弯曲处/线圈”。

lemmas.def_zh: 收入；所得；收益
lemmas.def_en: money received, especially on a regular basis, for work or through investments

examples.en: Many households find it increasingly difficult to meet rising living costs on a single income.
examples.zh: 许多家庭发现，单靠一份收入越来越难以应对不断上涨的生活成本。

examples.en: He invested in dividend-paying stocks to generate a reliable stream of passive income.
examples.zh: 他投资了派息股票，以产生稳定可靠的被动收入流。

family_guide.root_logic: 由前缀 in-（进入）与动词 come（来）组合而成，字面本义为“流进来的东西”，后引申为工作或投资所带来的“收入、进账”。

lemmas.def_zh: 突然出现，迅速窜出；突然蹦出；发出砰声
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To move, appear, or come out suddenly and unexpectedly. 2. [I, T] To make or cause to make a short, sharp explosive sound.

examples.en: The balloon popped with a loud bang when it touched the cactus.
examples.zh: 气球碰到仙人掌时砰的一声爆了。

examples.en: I'll just pop into the post office on my way to work.
examples.zh: 我会在上班途中顺道去一趟邮局。

lemmas.def_zh: 发出砰的响声的人
lemmas.def_en: British philosopher (born in Austria) who argued that scientific theories can never be proved to be true, but are tested by attempts to falsify them (1902-1994)

examples.en: The kids gathered excitedly around the hot-air popper as fresh popcorn burst out.
examples.zh: 当新鲜的爆米花喷涌而出时，孩子们兴奋地围在热风爆米花机旁。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于拟声词，模仿短促清脆的爆裂声，由此引申出“爆裂/开弹”、“突然出现”及“快速移动”等核心动态意象。

lemmas.def_zh: 猛击；重击
lemmas.def_en: a powerful stroke with the fist or a weapon

examples.en: He was knocked out by a heavy blow to the head.
examples.zh: 他的头部遭受了一记重击，被打晕了过去。

lemmas.def_zh: 吹制工, 鼓风机, 吹风机
lemmas.def_en: a device that produces a current of air

examples.en: The gardener used a powerful leaf blower to clear the messy stone pathway.
examples.zh: 园丁用一台大功率吹叶机清理凌乱的石板小路。

lemmas.def_zh: （风）吹，刮；吹动；吹气；吹响
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (of wind or air) to move or be in motion. 2. [I, T] to force air out through the mouth or into an instrument.

examples.en: Losing his job unexpectedly was a crushing blow to his fragile confidence.
examples.zh: 意外失业对他脆弱的自信心是一个毁灭性的打击。

lemmas.def_zh: 吹，刮，被风吹走（blow 的过去分词）
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (past participle of blow) To move creating an air current, or be moved or shaped by the wind.

examples.en: Several power lines were blown down during the severe storm.
examples.zh: 在暴风雨中，数条电线被强风吹断倒地。

lemmas.def_zh: 吹，刮（blow 的过去式）
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] past tense of blow; to move as a current of air, or force air out through the mouth.

examples.en: A sudden gust of wind blew the door shut with a loud bang.
examples.zh: 一阵突如其来的强风砰的一声把门吹关上了。

lemmas.def_zh: 刮风的, 风大的
lemmas.def_en: abounding in or exposed to the wind or breezes

examples.en: It was a cold, blowy afternoon, so we decided to stay indoors together.
examples.zh: 那是一个寒冷且风大的下午，所以我们决定一起呆在室内。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于原始印欧语拟声词根，本义为“吹气、强劲气流”，引申出“像骤风扑面般的猛烈击打、挫折”之意。
family_guide.core_distinction: blew 为过去式，blown 为过去分词；名词 blow 常表示“重击、打击”，动词 blow 则兼有“吹气/刮风”与口语“搞砸”等义。

lemmas.def_zh: 坚定的, 坚强的, 牢固的, 结实的, 坚硬的, 坚挺的, 严格的, 确定的
lemmas.def_en: marked by firm determination or resolution; not shakable

examples.en: You need to maintain a firm grip on the steering wheel while driving.
examples.zh: 驾驶时你需要牢牢握紧方向盘。

lemmas.def_zh: 公司, 商号
lemmas.def_en: the members of a business organization that owns or operates one or more establishments

examples.en: You need to maintain a firm grip on the steering wheel while driving.
examples.zh: 驾驶时你需要牢牢握紧方向盘。

lemmas.def_zh: 坚固, 坚牢, 坚定
lemmas.def_en: the muscle tone of healthy tissue

examples.en: The teacher handled the unruly students with impressive firmness and undeniable patience.
examples.zh: 老师以令人钦佩的坚定和无可否认的耐心管教了那些任性的学生。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）变坚实，（使）变牢固；（使）稳定，确定
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. To make or become physically firmer, more solid, or compact. 2. (often 'firm up') To make or become settled, definite, or steady.

examples.en: You need to maintain a firm grip on the steering wheel while driving.
examples.zh: 驾驶时你需要牢牢握紧方向盘。

lemmas.def_zh: 牢固地；坚固地；坚定地
lemmas.def_en: in a secure, resolute, or unwavering manner

examples.en: Make sure the handrail is firmly attached to the wall.
examples.zh: 务必确保扶手牢固地固定在墙上。

examples.en: She firmly believes that dedication is the key to mastering any skill.
examples.zh: 她坚信专注是掌握任何技能的关键。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 firmus（稳固的、坚强的），核心意象为“牢固、稳定”；名词由“签名以示确立”的中世纪商业用语引申为商业组织（字号、商行）。
family_guide.core_distinction: firm 形容词表“坚固的/坚决的”，动词表“使巩固/企稳”，名词特指“商行/事务所”（多用于合伙制专业机构如律所、会计所）。

lemmas.def_zh: 遍及，到处；自始至终，贯穿
lemmas.def_en: in every part of a place; during the whole period of time

examples.en: The news spread rapidly throughout the entire country.
examples.zh: 这个消息迅速传遍了全国。

examples.en: She remained calm and professional throughout the crisis.
examples.zh: 在整场危机期间，她始终保持着冷静与专业。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 through（穿过、贯穿）与 out（彻底）复合而成，核心意象为“完全贯穿”，引申为空间上的“遍及各处”与时间上的“自始至终”。
family_guide.core_distinction: through 强调“从一端到另一端”的路径或中介，而 throughout 强调“无死角地完全覆盖”整个空间或时间段。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）鸣响，（使）发出清脆声响；响铃，按铃，敲钟；包围，环绕
lemmas.def_en:
1. [I, T] to make a clear, resonant sound, or to cause a bell or other object to do this
2. [T] to surround or encircle

examples.en: She wore an elegant silver ring adorned with a tiny sparkling diamond.
examples.zh: 她戴着一枚饰有璀璨小钻石的优雅银戒指。

lemmas.def_zh: 鸣响，发出清脆的声音；打电话给（ring的过去式）
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] Past tense of ring: made a clear resonant bell sound, or telephoned someone.

examples.en: The telephone rang loudly three times before anyone hurried to answer it.
examples.zh: 电话大声响了三下才有人急忙跑去接听。

lemmas.def_zh: 环, 环形物, 拳击场, 戒指, 角逐, 小集团, 铃声, 钟声, 声调
lemmas.def_en: a characteristic sound

examples.en: She wore an elegant silver ring adorned with a tiny sparkling diamond.
examples.zh: 她戴着一枚饰有璀璨小钻石的优雅银戒指。

lemmas.def_zh: (梯子)踏步, 横档, 轮辐, 粗棍
lemmas.def_en: a crosspiece between the legs of a chair

examples.en: He carefully stepped onto the bottom rung of the tall wooden ladder.
examples.zh: 他小心翼翼地踩上了高高木梯的最底下一层横档。

lemmas.def_zh: 套环, 投环, 按铃者, 敲钟者
lemmas.def_en: a person who rings church bells (as for summoning the congregation)

examples.en: The rival team brought in a ringer to ensure an easy tournament victory.
examples.zh: 对手队伍请来了一位外援枪手，以确保轻松赢得锦标赛。

family_guide.root_logic: 该族词汇在历史上融合了两大脉络：一源自拟声词，模拟金属撞击的清脆响声（鸣钟、响铃、电话通知）；二源自古日耳曼语表示“弯曲、环形”的词根，演化为圆环、戒圈以及梯子的横向横档。
family_guide.core_distinction: 注意 ring 的不规则动词变化为 ring-rang-rung，而名词 rung 专指梯子的横档或事业晋升的台阶，不可与戒指或铃声的 ring 混淆。

lemmas.def_zh: 海峡, 航道, 频道
lemmas.def_en: a path over which electrical signals can pass

examples.en: She switched the television channel to catch the latest evening news broadcast.
examples.zh: 她换了电视机频道以收看最新的晚间新闻广播。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 通道化
lemmas.def_en: management through specified channels of communication

examples.en: The channelization of network traffic significantly improved the server's overall response time.
examples.zh: 网络流量的信道化显著缩短了服务器的整体响应时间。

lemmas.def_zh: 引导，把…引向；输送，灌注；开凿水渠
lemmas.def_en: [T] to direct, guide, or focus money, energy, or resources toward a particular purpose or through a particular route

examples.en: She switched the television channel to catch the latest evening news broadcast.
examples.zh: 她换了电视机频道以收看最新的晚间新闻广播。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 信道化, 能道化
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (formal / technical) To channelize a river, traffic, or resources means to direct them along a fixed course or specific system.

examples.en: Engineers plan to channelize incoming wireless signals to reduce interference between devices.
examples.zh: 工程师计划将传入的无线信号信道化，以减少设备间的干扰。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 canalis（水管、水槽），核心意象为“引导流动的狭长通道”，后引申至通信媒体的“频道”及信息、资源的传输“渠道/导向”。

lemmas.def_zh: 副本, 摹仿, 一册
lemmas.def_en: a reproduction of a written record (e.g. of a legal or school record)

examples.en: Please make a clear digital copy of the signed contract for our files.
examples.zh: 请将已签署的合同制作一份清晰的电子副本以供我们存档。

lemmas.def_zh: 誊写者, 模仿者, 抄写员
lemmas.def_en: apparatus that makes copies of typed, written or drawn material

examples.en: Before modern printing, a skilled copier would spend months transcribing a single manuscript.
examples.zh: 在现代印刷术出现之前，熟练的抄写员要花几个月的时间誊抄一份手稿。

lemmas.def_zh: 抄写员, 模仿者
lemmas.def_en: someone employed to make written copies of documents and manuscripts

examples.en: The medieval copyist worked by candlelight to reproduce religious texts with great precision.
examples.zh: 中世纪的抄写员在烛光下极其精确地复制宗教文本。

lemmas.def_zh: 复制，复印；抄写；抄袭，模仿
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To make a duplicate or reproduction of something written, printed, or recorded. 2. [I, T] To imitate or mimic someone's actions, style, or work.

examples.en: You should never copy someone else's work without giving them proper credit.
examples.zh: 你绝不应该在不注明出处的情况下抄袭别人的作品。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 copia（丰盛、大量），后引申为通过抄写使文本数量增多，最终沉淀出“复制、副本”的核心概念。

lemmas.def_zh: 明确的；确切的；肯定的
lemmas.def_en: clearly stated, decided, or unambiguous; certain

examples.en: We need a definite answer by tomorrow morning to finalize the contract.
examples.zh: 我们需要在明天早晨之前得到明确答复，以便敲定合同。

examples.en: There is a definite improvement in your spoken English this semester.
examples.zh: 这学期你的英语口语有了显而易见的进步。

lemmas.def_zh: 明确地；肯定地；毫无疑问地；（口语）当然
lemmas.def_en: without any doubt; certainly

examples.en: I will definitely consider your proposal during the meeting.
examples.zh: 开会时我一定会认真考虑你的提议。

examples.en: "Are you coming to the party tonight?" "Definitely!"
examples.zh: “你今晚来参加聚会吗？”“当然去！”

lemmas.def_zh: 确定性
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being predictable with great confidence

examples.en: Her instructions lacked definiteness, leaving the team confused about what to do next.
examples.zh: 她的指示缺乏明确性，让团队不知道下一步该做什么。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 definire（de- 完全 + finis 边界），核心逻辑是“划清界限、画出边界”，引申为明确的、确定的、毫无疑问的。
family_guide.core_distinction: definite 是形容词，用来修饰具体事物或状态表示“界限分明的、确凿的”；definitely 是副词，常用于加强语气表示“毫无疑问地、肯定”或在日常口语中作肯定回答。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 烟，烟雾；抽烟；v. 冒烟；吸烟；熏制（食物）
lemmas.def_en: n. the visible gas produced by burning; the act of smoking; v. to emit smoke; to inhale tobacco smoke; to preserve food using smoke

examples.en: Thick black smoke was pouring from the burning warehouse.
examples.zh: 浓黑的烟雾从着火的仓库中滚滚涌出。

examples.en: Smoking is strictly prohibited throughout the entire hospital.
examples.zh: 整座医院内严禁吸烟。

lemmas.def_zh: 吸烟者, 吸烟的人, 吸烟车厢, (美)(非正式)蒸汽火车头
lemmas.def_en: a person who smokes tobacco

examples.en: As a heavy smoker, he found it difficult to climb the stairs.
examples.zh: 作为一个重度吸烟者，他发现爬楼梯十分吃力。

lemmas.def_zh: 不抽烟的人
lemmas.def_en: a person who does not smoke tobacco

examples.en: The hotel provides special rooms to ensure every nonsmoker enjoys fresh air.
examples.zh: 酒店提供专用客房，以确保每位不吸烟的人都能呼吸到新鲜空气。

lemmas.def_zh: 吸烟，抽（烟）；冒烟，冒气；熏制（食物）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To inhale and exhale the smoke of tobacco or drugs. 2. [I] To emit smoke. 3. [T] To preserve meat or fish by exposing it to smoke.

examples.en: Thick black smoke was pouring from the burning warehouse.
examples.zh: 浓黑的烟雾从着火的仓库中滚滚涌出。

examples.en: Smoking is strictly prohibited throughout the entire hospital.
examples.zh: 整座医院内严禁吸烟。

lemmas.def_zh: 冒烟的, 满是烟的, 熏脏的, 烟灰色的
lemmas.def_en: marked by or emitting or filled with smoke

examples.en: We stepped out of the smoky bar into the cool and refreshing night air.
examples.zh: 我们走出满是烟雾的酒吧，步入清凉舒爽的夜空下。

lemmas.def_zh: 无烟的
lemmas.def_en: emitting or containing little or no smoke

examples.en: Many campers now prefer smokeless fire pits to avoid burning their eyes.
examples.zh: 许多露营者现在更喜欢无烟火坑，以免熏到眼睛。

lemmas.def_zh: (smoky 的第三人称 -s形式) a. 冒烟的, 满是烟的, 熏脏的, 烟灰色的

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 smoca，核心表象为燃烧释放的可见气体，后由名词衍生出冒烟、吸烟、熏制保存食物等一系列动作及隐喻。

lemmas.def_zh: 相等的, 平等的, 胜任的, 合适的, 平静的, 不相上下的
lemmas.def_en: having the same quantity, value, or measure as another

examples.en: All citizens deserve equal access to quality healthcare regardless of their income.
examples.zh: 无论收入如何，所有公民都应享有平等获得优质医疗服务的权利。

lemmas.def_zh: 不相等的, 不规则的, 不能胜任的
lemmas.def_en: poorly balanced or matched in quantity or value or measure

examples.en: The two boxers were an unequal match, leading to a quick knockout.
examples.zh: 这两位拳击手实力悬殊，很快就出现了击倒胜。

lemmas.def_zh: 等于，相等；比得上，敌得过
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To be the same in quantity, size, number, value, or status as something else. 2. [T] To match or be as good as someone or something else.

examples.en: All citizens deserve equal access to quality healthcare regardless of their income.
examples.zh: 无论收入如何，所有公民都应享有平等获得优质医疗服务的权利。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (+ with/to) To consider or make one thing equivalent or identical to another.
lemmas.def_zh: 把……视作等同，使等同；等同于

examples.en: You cannot equate wealth with genuine happiness.
examples.zh: 你不能把财富与真正的幸福划等号。

lemmas.def_zh: 同样地；平均地；相等地
lemmas.def_en: in an equal manner; to the same degree or amount

examples.en: The profits were divided equally among all four partners.
examples.zh: 利润在四位合伙人之间进行了平均分配。

examples.en: Both candidates are equally qualified for the position.
examples.zh: 两位候选人对这个职位的胜任程度不相上下。

lemmas.def_zh: 不相等地；不公平地；不均匀地
lemmas.def_en: in an unequal or partial manner

examples.en: Resources were distributed unequally, favoring larger schools over the smaller rural ones.
examples.zh: 资源分配不均，相比小型乡村学校，大型学校得到了更多优待。

lemmas.def_zh: 平等；均等；等同
lemmas.def_en: the state of being equal, especially in status, rights, or opportunities

examples.en: The organization works to promote gender equality in the workplace.
examples.zh: 该机构致力于促进职场中的性别平等。

examples.en: They are fighting for equality before the law for all citizens.
examples.zh: 他们正在为所有公民争取法律面前人人平等的权利。

lemmas.def_en: a mathematical statement that two expressions are equal
lemmas.def_zh: 方程式；综合考量因素

examples.en: Personal satisfaction is an important part of the career equation.
examples.zh: 个人满足感是职业规划中需要综合考量的一个重要因素。

lemmas.def_en: an imaginary line around the Earth forming the great circle that is equidistant from the north and south poles
lemmas.def_zh: 赤道

examples.en: Countries located near the equator generally experience warm weather all year round.
examples.zh: 靠近赤道的国家通常全年气候温暖。

lemmas.def_en: a telescope whose mounting has only two axes of motion, one parallel to the Earth's axis and the other one at right angles to it
lemmas.def_zh: [医] 中纬线的

examples.en: The region is well known for its dense equatorial rainforests and humidity.
examples.zh: 该地区以其茂密的赤道雨林和湿热气候而闻名。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 aequus（平的、均匀的、公平的），核心演化逻辑始终围绕在数量、价值、地位或权利上的“齐平与对等”。
family_guide.core_distinction: equal 既可作形容词表示“平等的/等同的”，也可作动词表示“等于/追平”；equality 是抽象名词“平等状态”，equally 则是副词“同等地/平均地”。

lemmas.def_zh: 证实，证明；确认，批准
lemmas.def_en: [T] to state or prove that something is true, correct, or definite

examples.en: Subsequent laboratory tests have confirmed the initial diagnosis.
examples.zh: 随后的实验室检测证实了最初的诊断。

examples.en: Please write to confirm your hotel reservation by tomorrow afternoon.
examples.zh: 请在明天下午之前发函确认您的酒店预订。

lemmas.def_zh: 证实，证据；确认书，确认函
lemmas.def_en: a statement, document, or piece of evidence that shows something is true or settled

examples.en: You will receive an email confirmation once the payment has been processed.
examples.zh: 付款处理完毕后，您将收到一封电子邮件确认函。

examples.en: Police are still waiting for official confirmation of the victim's identity.
examples.zh: 警方仍在等待对受害者身份的官方确认。

lemmas.def_zh: 未最后认可的, 未最后确定的, 未确证的, 未证实的
lemmas.def_en: not finally established or settled

examples.en: There are unconfirmed reports that the company will announce a major merger tomorrow.
examples.zh: 有未经证实的报道称，该公司将于明天宣布一项重大合并。

lemmas.def_zh: 起确定作用的, 坚信礼的, 证实的
lemmas.def_en: serving to support or corroborate

examples.en: The doctor ordered a confirmatory blood test before making the final diagnosis.
examples.zh: 医生在做出最终诊断前安排了一次确认性血液检查。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 con-（完全、加强）加词根 firm（坚固、稳固），核心逻辑是“使之彻底稳固、确凿”，引申为证实、确认或正式批准。

lemmas.def_zh: 小山, 丘陵, 小土堆
lemmas.def_en: a local and well-defined elevation of the land

examples.en: We walked to the top of the hill to watch the sunset.
examples.zh: 我们走到了小山顶上看日落。

lemmas.def_zh: (Hillier)人名；(法、葡)伊利耶；(德、英、匈)希利尔

examples.en: Mr. Hillier delivered a brief speech before presenting awards to the top students.
examples.zh: 希利尔先生在给优秀学生颁奖前发表了简短的讲话。

lemmas.def_zh: 堆成土堆；把（土）培在……周围
lemmas.def_en: [T] To form into a mound or heap; to draw earth up around the roots of plants.

examples.en: We walked to the top of the hill to watch the sunset.
examples.zh: 我们走到了小山顶上看日落。

lemmas.def_zh: 多丘陵的, 多山岗的, 险峻的
lemmas.def_en: having hills and crags

examples.en: The marathon route is quite hilly, making it a challenge for many runners.
examples.zh: 马拉松路线多丘陵起伏，这对许多跑者来说是个挑战。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 hyll，源于印欧语系词根 *kel-（突出、耸立），核心意象为“隆起的土丘”，后引申出园艺和农耕中“堆土、培土”的动词动作。
family_guide.core_distinction: hill 作为名词指天然隆起的“小山/丘陵”或人工土堆；作为动词则专指农事中的“培土/把土堆起”（常搭配 up）。

lemmas.def_zh: 周末, 周末休假
lemmas.def_en: a time period usually extending from Friday night through Sunday; more loosely defined as any period of successive days including one and only one Sunday

examples.en: We are planning a relaxing trip to the countryside over the upcoming weekend.
examples.zh: 我们正计划在即将到来的周末去乡下放松旅行。

lemmas.def_zh: 外出度周末的人
lemmas.def_en: someone who vacations on a weekend

examples.en: As a frequent weekender, she packed light for her quick trip to Paris.
examples.zh: 作为一个经常度周末的人，她为去巴黎的短途旅行简装出行。

lemmas.def_zh: 过周末，度周末
lemmas.def_en: [I] to spend a weekend in a particular place, especially for leisure or holiday

examples.en: We are planning a relaxing trip to the countryside over the upcoming weekend.
examples.zh: 我们正计划在即将到来的周末去乡下放松旅行。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 week（周）和 end（末尾）组合而成，核心指一周工作与学习日结束后的休息时间段，引申出动词活用表示“度周末”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词表示周末时间段或周末假期，动词表示在某地度过周末。

lemmas.def_zh: 情感；情绪；强烈的感情
lemmas.def_en: a strong feeling deriving from one's circumstances, mood, or relationships

examples.en: She struggled to control her emotions during the difficult interview.
examples.zh: 在那场艰难的面试中，她极力克制自己的情绪。

examples.en: Music has an extraordinary power to evoke deep human emotions.
examples.zh: 音乐拥有一种唤起人类深层情感的非凡力量。

lemmas.def_zh: 富于感情, 多情, 动情
lemmas.def_en: emotional nature or quality

examples.en: The intense emotionality of her performance brought several members of the audience to tears.
examples.zh: 她表演中强烈的充沛情感让几位观众流下了眼泪。

lemmas.def_zh: 情感上的；情绪化的；充满感情的
lemmas.def_en: relating to emotions, or having and showing strong feelings

examples.en: Children need both financial stability and emotional support to thrive.
examples.zh: 孩子的茁壮成长既需要经济上的稳定，也需要情感上的支持。

examples.en: He gave an emotional farewell speech to his long-time colleagues.
examples.zh: 他向共事多年的同事们发表了一番情真意切的告别演讲。

lemmas.def_zh: 使感动的, 动感情的, 感情的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by emotion

lemmas.def_zh: 不露情感的, 没有情感的
lemmas.def_en: unmoved by feeling; ; -Margaret Deland

examples.en: He gave an emotionless response, refusing to show any signs of anger or sadness.
examples.zh: 他做出了毫无感情的回应，拒绝表现出任何愤怒或悲伤的迹象。

lemmas.def_zh: 不易动感情的, 缺乏感情的, 冷漠的, 铁石心肠的
lemmas.def_en: unsusceptible to or destitute of or showing no emotion

examples.en: The judge remained completely unemotional while listening to the shocking details of the crime.
examples.zh: 法官在听取这起案件令人震惊的细节时，始终保持完全冷静克制。

lemmas.def_zh: 在情感上；情绪激动地
lemmas.def_en: in a way that relates to or expresses emotions

examples.en: Working in intensive care can be physically and emotionally exhausting.
examples.zh: 在重症监护室工作在身体上和心理情感上都极度劳累。

examples.en: He found it difficult to connect emotionally with people.
examples.zh: 他发现自己在情感层面上很难与他人建立深层联系。

lemmas.def_zh: unemotional的变形
lemmas.def_en: in an unemotional manner

examples.en: She stated the facts unemotionally, treating the tragic accident like a simple routine event.
examples.zh: 她不动声色地陈述了事实，把那场悲惨的事故当作一件普通的日常事件。

lemmas.def_zh: 表达感情，流露情绪；（表演时）做作地表现情感
lemmas.def_en: [I] to express emotion openly and demonstratively, especially when acting on stage or screen

examples.en: The young actor was told to emote naturally rather than overact his role.
examples.zh: 年轻演员被要求自然地表达情感，而不是表演过度。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 emovere（e- 向外 + movere 移动/震动），本义为“向外搅动、激发”，后引申为内心受到触动而引发的“情感”或“情绪”。
family_guide.core_distinction: emotional 既可作客观修饰词表示“情感/情绪层面的”（如 emotional support），也可表示“情绪激动的、感情脆弱的”（如 get emotional）。

lemmas.def_zh: 大自然，自然界；天性，本性；本质，性质
lemmas.def_en: the physical world including plants, animals, and landscapes; the basic or inherent features, character, or qualities of something

examples.en: Spending time in nature has been shown to reduce stress and improve mental well-being.
examples.zh: 研究表明，身处大自然中能够减轻压力并改善心理健康。

examples.en: It is human nature to seek companionship and a sense of belonging.
examples.zh: 寻求陪伴和归属感是人类的天性。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 natura（出生、天性），由动词 nasci（出生）派生而来，从“与生俱来的特征”引申为万物的本质，进而指代未经人类雕琢的“大自然”。

lemmas.def_zh: 恰当的，合适的；符合规范的，得体的；严格意义上的，真正的
lemmas.def_en: suitable, correct, or socially acceptable; genuine or strictly defined

examples.en: Make sure you follow the proper procedures when handling hazardous materials.
examples.zh: 处理危险品时，请务必遵守规范的流程。

examples.en: After days of eating fast food, he finally sat down to a proper meal.
examples.zh: 连吃了几天快餐后，他终于坐下来好好吃了一顿像样的饭。

lemmas.def_zh: 正确地，恰当地；合乎规范地；彻底地，完全地
lemmas.def_en: in a correct, suitable, or thorough manner

examples.en: The software will not function properly if your system is outdated.
examples.zh: 如果系统版本过旧，该软件将无法正常运行。

examples.en: Make sure the equipment is properly cleaned and stored after each use.
examples.zh: 每次使用后，请确保设备得到彻底清洁并妥善存放。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 proprius（自身的、专属的），引申出“符合自身身份或特定规则”的含义，核心意象为“恰当的、正规的、名副其实的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 保持，维持；保养，维修；坚持，主张
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] to make something continue at the same level or standard. 2. [T] to keep a road, machine, or building in good condition by regular repair. 3. [T] to state firmly that something is true.

examples.en: The two countries have managed to maintain friendly relations for decades.
examples.zh: 几十年来，两国一直努力保持着友好关系。

examples.en: The highway is regularly maintained to ensure driver safety.
examples.zh: 该高速公路会定期进行维护保养，以确保行车安全。

examples.en: Despite mounting evidence, he continued to maintain his innocence.
examples.zh: 尽管证据不断增加，他仍然坚称自己是无辜的。

lemmas.def_en: activity involved in maintaining something in good working order
lemmas.def_zh: n. 维护；保养；抚养费；维持

examples.en: Regular maintenance is essential to keep the machine running smoothly.
examples.zh: 定期维护是保证机器平稳运行的关键。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 保持器
lemmas.def_en: someone who upholds or maintains

examples.en: The orthodontist fitted a space maintainer to prevent the child's other teeth from shifting.
examples.zh: 正畸医生安装了间隙保持器，以防止孩子的其他牙齿移位。

lemmas.def_zh: 可维持的, 可维修的, 可保持的, 可供养的, 可主张的, 可坚持的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being maintained

examples.en: The software engineers wrote clean code to ensure the system would be easily maintainable.
examples.zh: 软件工程师编写了整洁的代码，以确保系统易于维护。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 manu tenere（手持、托住），核心逻辑由“用手托住稳固”引申为使状态持续不变（维持、保养），以及在言论中站稳立场（坚称）。

lemmas.def_zh: 照相机；摄像机
lemmas.def_en: a device for taking photographs or recording moving images

examples.en: She pointed her camera at the sunset and took several stunning photos.
examples.zh: 她把相机对准日落，拍下了几张绝美的照片。

examples.en: The entire robbery was captured on a nearby security camera.
examples.zh: 整起抢劫过程都被附近的监控摄像头拍了下来。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 camera（暗室、房间），本指光学投影装置“暗箱”（camera obscura），后缩简用于指代拍摄影像的“照相机”或“摄像机”。

lemmas.def_zh: 在……较远的一边；超出……的范围；非……所能及
lemmas.def_en: at or to the farther side of; outside the range, limits, or understanding of

examples.en: The situation has deteriorated beyond our control, requiring immediate intervention.
examples.zh: 局势已恶化到失控的地步，需要立即进行干预。

examples.en: His dedication to the research was beyond doubt, earning the respect of the entire team.
examples.zh: 他对这项研究的投入毋庸置疑，赢得了整个团队的尊敬。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 be-（在……边）与 geond（远方），核心逻辑为“在更远处”，由具体的空间距离“越过彼端”引申为抽象的“超出范围、限度或认知”。

lemmas.def_zh: 除非；如果不
lemmas.def_en: except if; if not

examples.en: I won't go to the party unless you come with me.
examples.zh: 除非你跟我一起去，否则我是不会去参加派对的。

examples.en: Unless we take immediate action, the project will fail.
examples.zh: 除非我们立即采取行动，否则该项目将会失败。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中古英语短语 upon/on less than（处于更少/更低的条件下），核心语义演变为引入唯一的排除条件，即“若非、如果不”。

lemmas.def_zh: 参与，从事；与……建立联系，进行互动；吸引（注意力）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (+ in/with) To become involved in an activity; to interact or communicate with someone. 2. [T] To attract and hold someone's interest or attention.

examples.en: The speaker used storytelling to engage the audience from the very beginning.
examples.zh: 演讲者从一开始就通过讲故事吸引了听众的注意力。

examples.en: She actively engages in local community projects on weekends.
examples.zh: 她周末积极参与当地的社区服务项目。

lemmas.def_zh: 约定，约会；订婚；参与度，互动
lemmas.def_en: an arrangement to do something; an agreement to marry; the state of being involved or interacting

examples.en: I'm afraid I cannot attend the meeting due to a prior engagement.
examples.zh: 很遗憾，由于事先另有安排，我无法出席此次会议。

examples.en: The new interactive app has significantly boosted user engagement.
examples.zh: 这款全新的互动应用程序显著提升了用户参与度。

lemmas.def_zh: 有吸引力地; 动人地, 吸引人地
lemmas.def_en: in an engaging manner

examples.en: She smiled engagingly at the audience before starting her presentation about art.
examples.zh: 在开始关于艺术的演讲之前，她向观众动人地微笑了笑。

lemmas.def_zh: 无约的, 未订婚约的, 没有事的
lemmas.def_en: not busy or occupied; free

examples.en: With an unengaged weekend ahead, he finally had time to read his favorite books.
examples.zh: 周末没有任何安排，他终于有时间读自己喜欢的书了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于古法语“以誓约或抵押物约束”，核心逻辑由“绑定/受约束”引申为“投身参与”、“吸引关注”、“订立婚约”乃至“机械啮合与交战”。
family_guide.core_distinction: engage 为动词，强调“参与、吸引或绑定”的动作；engagement 为名词，既指“既定日程/婚约”的承诺状态，也指“参与度与互动”。

lemmas.def_zh: 庆祝，庆贺；颂扬，赞美
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To do something enjoyable to mark an important day or event. 2. [T] To praise or honor someone or something publicly.

examples.en: We gathered with close friends to celebrate her recent promotion.
examples.zh: 我们和几位密友聚在一起庆祝她最近的晋升。

examples.en: The novel celebrates the resilience and diversity of the immigrant community.
examples.zh: 这部小说赞美了移民群体坚韧不拔的精神与多元文化。

lemmas.def_zh: 庆祝活动，庆典；庆祝，庆贺
lemmas.def_en: a social gathering or special event to mark an occasion; the act of celebrating

examples.en: The city held a massive street celebration to mark the team's championship win.
examples.zh: 该市举行了盛大的街头庆典以纪念球队夺冠。

examples.en: Spectacular fireworks lit up the night sky in celebration of the New Year.
examples.zh: 绚烂的烟花点亮了夜空，庆祝新年的到来。

lemmas.def_zh: 主持仪式的人, 主持弥撒的教父
lemmas.def_en: a person who is celebrating

examples.en: The celebrant raised his hands to bless the newly married couple before the congregation.
examples.zh: 主礼人在会众面前举起双手为这对新婚夫妇祈福。

lemmas.def_zh: 祝贺的人
lemmas.def_en: a person who is celebrating

examples.en: Every celebrator in the square cheered loudly as the midnight fireworks lit up the sky.
examples.zh: 当午夜的烟花点亮夜空时，广场上的每位庆祝者都大声欢呼。

lemmas.def_zh: 快乐的, 兴高采烈的
lemmas.def_en: used for celebrating

examples.en: The team gathered for a celebratory dinner after winning the championship trophy.
examples.zh: 赢得冠军奖杯后，全队齐聚一堂享用庆祝晚宴。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 celeber（常去的、热闹的），核心意象为“众人聚集举行盛事”，后引申为以特殊活动进行“庆祝、庆贺”及公开“赞美、颂扬”。

lemmas.def_zh: 打猎，猎杀；搜寻，追踪
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To pursue and kill wild animals for food or sport. 2. [I, T] To search determinedly for someone or something.

examples.en: Lions usually hunt in groups during the cool hours of the night.
examples.zh: 狮子通常在夜间凉爽的时段成群捕猎。

examples.en: Police are still hunting for clues to identify the suspect.
examples.zh: 警方仍在搜寻线索以确认嫌疑人的身份。

lemmas.def_zh: 猎人，捕猎者；搜寻者
lemmas.def_en: a person or animal that hunts wild animals; a person searching for a specific thing

examples.en: The owl is an efficient nocturnal hunter with sharp hearing.
examples.zh: 猫头鹰是一种听觉敏锐的高效夜间捕食者。

examples.en: Many bargain hunters gathered outside the store before the sale began.
examples.zh: 许多淘便宜货的人在促销开始前就聚集在店外。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，核心语义为“追逐并捕获野兽”，后引申为广泛的搜寻、追踪与搜捕。
family_guide.core_distinction: hunt 表示捕猎或搜寻的动作本身，hunter 则是执行这一动作的人或动物。

lemmas.def_zh: 规划，安排（常与out连用）；绘制……的地图；映射
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (often 'map out') To plan or arrange something in detail. 2. [T] To make a map of an area or show the features of something. 3. [T] (mathematics) To associate each element of a set with an element of another.

examples.en: Scientists are trying to map the entire ocean floor using advanced sonar technology.
examples.zh: 科学家们正试图利用先进的声呐技术绘制整个洋底的地图。

lemmas.def_zh: 地图, 天体图, 映像
lemmas.def_en: a diagrammatic representation of the earth's surface (or part of it)

examples.en: Scientists are trying to map the entire ocean floor using advanced sonar technology.
examples.zh: 科学家们正试图利用先进的声呐技术绘制整个洋底的地图。

lemmas.def_zh: 地图绘制；绘制过程；映射，对应关系
lemmas.def_en: the activity or process of creating a map; an operation that associates each element of a given set with an element of another set

examples.en: The complete mapping of the human genome marked a major milestone in medicine.
examples.zh: 人类基因组图谱的完整绘制标志着医学领域的一座重要里程碑。

examples.en: The software establishes a one-to-one mapping between customer IDs and order records.
examples.zh: 该软件在客户标识符与订单记录之间建立了精准的一对一映射关系。

lemmas.def_zh: 制图人
lemmas.def_en: a clerk who marks data on a chart

examples.en: The skilled mapper carefully drew the boundaries of the newly discovered island.
examples.zh: 那位熟练的制图员仔细绘制了这座新发现岛屿的边界。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中世纪拉丁语 mappa（布巾、餐巾），原指绘制在布匹上的图表，后核心语义由“绘制地理图示”引申至“记录、规划、使事物间产生对应与连接”。
family_guide.core_distinction: map 侧重具体的地图、图表实体或规划结果；mapping 侧重测绘绘制的动态过程，或数学、计算机及认知科学中的逻辑“映射/对应”关系。

lemmas.def_zh: 意识到的；知道的；觉察到的
lemmas.def_en: having knowledge or perception of a situation or fact

examples.en: She was fully aware of the potential risks before signing the contract.
examples.zh: 她在签署合同前充分意识到了潜在的风险。

examples.en: The campaign aims to make the public more environmentally aware.
examples.zh: 该活动旨在提高公众的环保意识。

lemmas.def_zh: 未意识到的；不知情的；没察觉到的
lemmas.def_en: not having knowledge or realization of a situation or fact

examples.en: He seemed completely unaware of the tension in the room.
examples.zh: 他似乎完全没有察觉到房间里的紧张气氛。

examples.en: Caught unaware by the sudden downpour, they ran for shelter.
examples.zh: 突降的暴雨让他们猝不及防，纷纷跑去避雨。

lemmas.def_zh: 意识；认识；知晓度
lemmas.def_en: knowledge or understanding of a subject, issue, or situation

examples.en: The charity works to raise public awareness of mental health issues.
examples.zh: 该慈善机构致力于提高公众对心理健康问题的认识。

examples.en: Lack of brand awareness remains a major challenge for the startup.
examples.zh: 品牌知名度不足仍然是这家初创企业面临的主要挑战。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 不知觉, 不留神, 不察觉
lemmas.def_en: unconsciousness resulting from lack of knowledge or attention

examples.en: His complete unawareness of the approaching danger surprised everyone around him.
examples.zh: 他对逼近的危险毫无察觉，这让周围的所有人都感到惊讶。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语中表示“警惕、留意”的词根（与 wary 同源），核心逻辑演变为“感知并了解某事物的存在或状态”。

lemmas.def_zh: 木材，木头；树林，林地
lemmas.def_en: the hard fibrous substance of trees used for fuel or timber; an area of land covered with trees

examples.en: The dining table is handcrafted from solid oak wood.
examples.zh: 这张餐桌是由橡木实木手工制作的。

examples.en: They went for a morning walk along the path through the woods.
examples.zh: 他们清晨沿着穿过树林的小路散步。

lemmas.def_zh: 多树林, 木质
lemmas.def_en: the quality of abounding in trees

examples.en: The woodiness of the overgrown carrots made them tough and difficult to chew.
examples.zh: 这些长得过大的胡萝卜木质化严重，嚼起来又硬又费劲。

lemmas.def_zh: 木质的，木本的；长满树木的；具木头香气的
lemmas.def_en: consisting of, containing, or resembling wood; covered with trees; having a smell or taste suggestive of wood

examples.en: Lavender develops woody stems as the plant matures.
examples.zh: 薰衣草随着植株成熟会长出木质化的茎。

examples.en: The fragrance combines crisp floral notes with a warm, woody undertone.
examples.zh: 这款香水将清新的花香与温暖的木质基调融合在一起。

lemmas.def_zh: 树林的
lemmas.def_en: characteristic or suggestive of woods

examples.en: We enjoyed a peaceful walk along the woodsy trail behind our quiet mountain cabin.
examples.zh: 我们在安静的山间小屋后方那条充满林木气息的小径上悠闲散步。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 wudu，本义为成片的树木（树林），后自然引申为取自树木的材质（木材），并衍生出描述木质属性的形容词。
family_guide.core_distinction: wood 作为名词指木材或树林，而 woody 作为形容词修饰具有木质特征、多树木或含木香的事物。

lemmas.def_zh: 有关系的, 相对的, 比较的
lemmas.def_en: estimated by comparison; not absolute or complete

examples.en: They enjoyed the relative calm of the countryside after years in the bustling city.
examples.zh: 在繁忙的城市生活多年后，他们很享受乡村相对的宁静。

lemmas.def_zh: 相对论的
lemmas.def_en: relating or subject to the special or the general theory of relativity

examples.en: Particles moving at relativistic speeds exhibit strange behaviors predicted by modern physics.
examples.zh: 以相对论速度运动的粒子展现出现代物理学所预测的奇特行为。

lemmas.def_zh: 亲戚, 关系词
lemmas.def_en: a person related by blood or marriage

examples.en: They enjoyed the relative calm of the countryside after years in the bustling city.
examples.zh: 在繁忙的城市生活多年后，他们很享受乡村相对的宁静。

lemmas.def_zh: 有关系, 相关性, 相对性
lemmas.def_en: (physics) the theory that space and time are relative concepts rather than absolute concepts

examples.en: Einstein revolutionized our understanding of space and time with his theory of relativity.
examples.zh: 爱因斯坦用他的相对论彻底改变了我们对空间和时间的理解。

lemmas.def_zh: 相对论, 相对主义
lemmas.def_en: (philosophy) the philosophical doctrine that all criteria of judgment are relative to the individuals and situations involved

examples.en: Cultural relativism suggests that no culture is inherently superior to any other.
examples.zh: 文化相对主义认为没有哪种文化天生优于其他文化。

lemmas.def_zh: 相对地, 比较地, 相当地, 相关地
lemmas.def_en: in a relative manner; by comparison to something else

examples.en: The final exam was relatively easy compared to the difficult quizzes we had earlier.
examples.zh: 与我们之前做过的难度很大的随堂测验相比，期末考试相对容易。

lemmas.def_zh: 相对论性地
lemmas.def_en: by the theory of relativity

examples.en: The electron beam was accelerated relativistically, reaching nearly the speed of light.
examples.zh: 电子束被相对论性地加速，速度几乎达到了光速。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 relatus（带回、关联），核心逻辑从“建立联系”引申为“相互比较之下的（相对的）”以及“血缘相连的人（亲属）”。
family_guide.core_distinction: relative 作形容词常强调“与参照物对比而言的”或“紧密相关的”；related 则更侧重客观上“有联系的”或“有因果/所属关系的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 赞成的；职业的；赞成理由；正面论据；专业人员，行家
lemmas.def_en: in favor of something; professional; an argument or vote in favor; a person who does something as a profession or with great skill

examples.en: We need to weigh all the pros and cons carefully before making a final decision.
examples.zh: 在做出最终决定之前，我们需要仔细权衡所有的利与弊。

examples.en: She handled the difficult interview questions like a seasoned pro.
examples.zh: 她表现得像个经验丰富的老手一样，从容应对了棘手的采访提问。

examples.en: After winning the national championship, the young golfer decided to turn pro.
examples.zh: 赢得全国锦标赛后，这位年轻的高尔夫球手决定转为职业选手。

lemmas.def_zh: 赞成的；职业的；赞成理由；正面论据；专业人员，行家
lemmas.def_en: in favor of something; professional; an argument or vote in favor; a person who does something as a profession or with great skill

examples.en: We need to weigh all the pros and cons carefully before making a final decision.
examples.zh: 在做出最终决定之前，我们需要仔细权衡所有的利与弊。

examples.en: She handled the difficult interview questions like a seasoned pro.
examples.zh: 她表现得像个经验丰富的老手一样，从容应对了棘手的采访提问。

examples.en: After winning the national championship, the young golfer decided to turn pro.
examples.zh: 赢得全国锦标赛后，这位年轻的高尔夫球手决定转为职业选手。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于拉丁语前缀/介词 pro（意为“支持、向前”），引申为“赞成”；现代英语中亦普遍作为 professional 的截短词，衍生出“职业的、行家”之意。
family_guide.core_distinction: 作为词汇时兼有双重来源：既可与 con 相对表示“赞成（的）/正面理由”，也可作为 professional 的口语简称表示“职业的/行家”。

lemmas.def_zh: 愚蠢的；傻的；笨拙的
lemmas.def_en: lacking intelligence, common sense, or reason

examples.en: It was a stupid mistake, but fortunately no one was hurt.
examples.zh: 这是一个愚蠢的错误，但幸运的是没有人受伤。

examples.en: I felt really stupid when I realized I had been wearing my shirt inside out.
examples.zh: 当意识到自己把衣服穿反了时，我觉得自己傻透了。

lemmas.def_zh: 愚蠢；愚蠢的行为；糊涂
lemmas.def_en: behavior that shows a lack of good sense or judgment

examples.en: I can't believe the sheer stupidity of driving fast in this heavy fog.
examples.zh: 我简直无法相信在这样的大雾中超速行驶的纯粹愚蠢行为。

examples.en: In a moment of stupidity, he deleted the entire database.
examples.zh: 一时的糊涂，他删掉了整个数据库。

lemmas.def_zh: 愚蠢地
lemmas.def_en: in a stupid manner

examples.en: I stupidly left my apartment keys on the kitchen counter before locking the door.
examples.zh: 我锁门前愚蠢地把公寓钥匙落在了厨房柜台上。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 stupere（发愣、发木、目瞪口呆），核心语义从“因受惊或迟钝而发呆”引申为现代的“缺乏智慧或常识、愚蠢”。
family_guide.core_distinction: stupid 为形容词，描述人、事物或行为的愚蠢；stupidity 为其抽象名词形式，指愚蠢的状态、品质或具体的蠢事。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 甜的；令人愉快的
lemmas.def_en: having the pleasant taste of sugar; pleasing or delightful; (noun) a candy, dessert, or term of endearment

examples.en: She gave me a sweet smile and offered a cup of tea.
