examples.en: The hospital provides basic emergency care even to patients who are completely uninsured.
examples.zh: 即使是对完全没有医保的患者，这家医院也提供基本急救服务。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 in-（使……）+ sure（确信、安全）+ -ance（名词后缀），字面意为“使之安全确定”，引申为防范潜在风险、提供经济补偿的保障制度。
family_guide.core_distinction: 常与 assurance 区分：insurance 通常指防范可能发生的意外/财产损失（以防万一），assurance 传统上多指必定发生事件（如人寿险）或指确信、保证。

lemmas.def_zh: 戏剧；剧本；戏剧性事件
lemmas.def_en: a play in a theater or on television; an exciting or emotional event or series of events

examples.en: She studied drama at university before pursuing an acting career.
examples.zh: 在开始演艺生涯之前，她在大学学习戏剧专业。

examples.en: The rescue operation was full of drama and kept everyone on edge.
examples.zh: 营救过程充满戏剧性，让每个人都提心吊胆。

lemmas.def_zh: 剧作家
lemmas.def_en: someone who writes plays

examples.en: The famous dramatist spent years writing historical plays for the national theater.
examples.zh: 这位著名的剧作家花了数年时间为国家剧院创作历史剧。

lemmas.def_zh: 编剧, 改编成戏剧
lemmas.def_en: conversion into dramatic form

examples.en: The television dramatization of the classic novel attracted millions of loyal viewers.
examples.zh: 这部经典小说的电视剧改编版吸引了数百万忠实观众。

lemmas.def_zh: 巨大的；引人注目的；戏剧的；戏剧性的
lemmas.def_en: sudden, very noticeable, and exciting; relating to drama or the theater

examples.en: The new policy led to a dramatic drop in unemployment rates.
examples.zh: 这项新政策导致失业率急剧下降。

examples.en: He paused for dramatic effect before delivering the punchline.
examples.zh: 他在讲出笑点前停顿了一下，以营造戏剧化效果。

lemmas.def_zh: 缺乏戏剧性的, 平淡无奇的
lemmas.def_en: lacking dramatic force and quality

examples.en: The meeting ended in an undramatic fashion with both sides agreeing to wait.
examples.zh: 会议以平淡无奇的方式结束，双方都同意等待。

lemmas.def_zh: 显著地；剧烈地；戏剧性地
lemmas.def_en: in a sudden, very noticeable, or exciting way

examples.en: The company's profits have increased dramatically over the past year.
examples.zh: 过去一年里，该公司的利润大幅增长。

examples.en: Her life changed dramatically after the novel became a bestseller.
examples.zh: 小说成为畅销书后，她的生活发生了巨大的改变。

lemmas.def_zh: 将……改编为戏剧（或影视剧）；夸张，把……戏剧化
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To adapt a story, novel, or real event into a play, film, or TV drama. 2. [I, T] To make an event or situation seem much more exciting, dramatic, or serious than it really is.

examples.en: The author plans to dramatize her best-selling memoir for a Broadway stage production.
examples.zh: 作者计划将她的畅销回忆录改编成百老汇舞台剧。

lemmas.def_zh: vi. 改编为剧本, 戏剧化, 戏剧般地假装, 装假, 具有戏剧性, 使惹人注目
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (British English spelling of dramatize) To adapt a story for stage or screen, or to exaggerate events dramatically.

examples.en: Tabloids tend to dramatise ordinary celebrity disagreements to boost their daily sales.
examples.zh: 小报往往会夸大名人的普通分歧，以提高日常销量。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 dran（行动、做），演变出舞台上的“剧作/表演”，进一步引申为现实中像戏一样扣人心弦的“剧变、轰动事件”。

lemmas.def_zh: 估计，估算
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To form a judgment or calculation about the approximate value, size, or cost of something.

examples.en: Engineers estimate that the bridge construction will take at least three more months.
examples.zh: 工程师们估计大桥的建设至少还需要三个月的时间。

lemmas.def_zh: 估计, 判断
lemmas.def_en: an approximate calculation of quantity or degree or worth

examples.en: Engineers estimate that the bridge construction will take at least three more months.
examples.zh: 工程师们估计大桥的建设至少还需要三个月的时间。

lemmas.def_zh: 判断, 估计, 尊重
lemmas.def_en: a document appraising the value of something (as for insurance or taxation)

examples.en: In my estimation, this new strategy will significantly reduce our operational costs.
examples.zh: 依我判断，这项新战略将显著降低我们的运营成本。

lemmas.def_zh: 估计者
lemmas.def_en: an expert at calculation (or at operating calculating machines)

examples.en: The cost estimator calculated the total budget needed for the residential building project.
examples.zh: 成本估算师计算出了该住宅建筑项目所需的总预算。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 aestimare（估价、评价），核心语义是基于现有信息对数量、成本、价值或规模进行大致推算与评定。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词词尾发音为 /-meɪt/，表示估算的行为；名词词尾发音为 /-mət/，指估算的结果、数值或书面报价单。

lemmas.def_zh: 安排，预定，将……列入时间表
lemmas.def_en: [T] To arrange or plan for an event or activity to happen at a particular time.

examples.en: Please schedule the client meeting for next Tuesday morning in the conference room.
examples.zh: 请把客户会议安排在下周二上午的会议室举行。

lemmas.def_zh: 时间表, 一览表, 计划表, 议事日程
lemmas.def_en: a temporally organized plan for matters to be attended to

examples.en: Please schedule the client meeting for next Tuesday morning in the conference room.
examples.zh: 请把客户会议安排在下周二上午的会议室举行。

lemmas.def_zh: 制表人, 程序机
lemmas.def_en: computer hardware that arranges jobs to be done by the computer in an appropriate order

examples.en: The operating system's task scheduler assigns CPU time to active background processes.
examples.zh: 操作系统的任务调度程序将 CPU 时间分配给活动的后台进程。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 不定期的
lemmas.def_en: not scheduled or not on a regular schedule

examples.en: The flight made an unscheduled emergency landing due to sudden mechanical issues.
examples.zh: 由于突发机械故障，该航班进行了计划外的紧急降落。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 schedula（纸片、卷标），语义从“写有信息的纸条/清单”演化为“按时间列出的任务清单”，最终确立了“日程表”及“按计划安排”的名词与动词核心义。

lemmas.def_zh: 控制，规范，管理；调节，校准
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To control or direct by a rule, principle, or law. 2. To adjust a mechanism or system to a desired speed, temperature, or level.

examples.en: The government introduced new policies to regulate the digital currency market.
examples.zh: 政府出台了新政策以规范数字货币市场。

examples.en: Our bodies use sweat to help regulate internal temperature.
examples.zh: 人体通过出汗来帮助调节体内温度。

lemmas.def_zh: 规章；规则；管理；调节
lemmas.def_en: an official rule or law; the act or process of controlling an activity or process

examples.en: All employees must comply with strict safety regulations in the lab.
examples.zh: 所有员工在实验室都必须遵守严格的安全规程。

examples.en: Public health experts called for tighter regulation of the pharmaceutical industry.
examples.zh: 公共卫生专家呼吁加强对制药行业的监管。

lemmas.def_zh: 监管机构；监管者；调节器
lemmas.def_en: a person or official body that supervises an industry; a mechanical device that controls a variable automatically

examples.en: Financial regulators are scrutinizing the bank's lending practices.
examples.zh: 金融监管机构正在仔细审查该银行的贷款业务。

examples.en: Make sure the pressure regulator on the gas tank is properly attached.
examples.zh: 确保煤气罐上的减压阀安装妥当。

lemmas.def_en: restricting according to rules or principles
lemmas.def_zh: 监管的，管理的，调整的

examples.en: The agency tightened its regulatory oversight of clinical trials.
examples.zh: 该机构加强了对临床试验的监管力度。

lemmas.def_zh: 未经调节的；未校准的
lemmas.def_en: not regulated; not subject to rule or discipline

examples.en: Critics worry that the unregulated market could lead to risky financial behavior.
examples.zh: 批评人士担心，这个不受监管的市场可能会导致高风险的金融行为。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 regula（规则、标尺），核心逻辑是“用规则或标准来约束、指导与微调事物，使其保持有序或稳定”。
family_guide.core_distinction: regulation 指抽象的“监管/调节行为”或具体的“法规/规章”；regulator 则指执行规则的主体（监管机构/监管者）或物理层面的“调节器/调压阀”。

lemmas.def_zh: 逐字的, 字面上的, 文字的, 字母的
lemmas.def_en: being or reflecting the essential or genuine character of something; ; - G.K.Chesterton

examples.en: The literal meaning of the phrase differs greatly from its common idiomatic usage.
examples.zh: 这个短语的字面意思与其常见的习惯用法大相径庭。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 非文字；批判的实在论并不拘泥字句
lemmas.def_en: (used of the meanings of words or text) not literal; using figures of speech

examples.en: Poetry often uses nonliteral expressions to evoke deep emotions and vivid images.
examples.zh: 诗歌经常使用非字面表达来唤起深刻的情感和生动的意象。

lemmas.def_zh: 逐字地, 按照字面上地, 不夸张地
lemmas.def_en: in a literal sense

examples.en: The heavy metal band's incredible performance literally blew the enthusiastic audience away.
examples.zh: 这支重金属乐队令人惊叹的表演简直让狂热的观众为之倾倒。

lemmas.def_zh: 印刷错误
lemmas.def_en: a mistake in printed matter resulting from mechanical failures of some kind

examples.en: The literal meaning of the phrase differs greatly from its common idiomatic usage.
examples.zh: 这个短语的字面意思与其常见的习惯用法大相径庭。

lemmas.def_zh: 字义上, 无修饰
lemmas.def_en: adhereing to the concrete construal of something

examples.en: The rigid literalness of the translation ruined the subtle humor of the original poem.
examples.zh: 这种刻板的直译破坏了原诗微妙的幽默感。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 litera（字母），核心逻辑由“照着每一个字母/字词本身”引申为“字面上的、非比喻的、逐字的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词 literal 表示“字面上的”，副词 literally 常用于强调“确实地、照字面意义地”，而名词 literal 多作为计算机术语“字面量”或印刷术语“错印”。

lemmas.def_zh: （某届）政府；行政机构
lemmas.def_en: the process or activity of running an organization or business; the government in power; the dispensing or application of something

examples.en: The new administration announced comprehensive reforms in foreign policy.
examples.zh: 新一届政府宣布了全面的外交政策改革。

lemmas.def_en: someone who administers a business
lemmas.def_zh: n. 管理者，行政官员；（遗产）管理人

examples.en: She was promoted to system administrator after years of technical service.
examples.zh: 经过多年的技术服务，她被提升为系统管理员。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or responsible for administration
lemmas.def_zh: 管理的, 行政的

examples.en: She spent the morning dealing with routine administrative tasks like filing reports.
examples.zh: 她整个上午都在处理整理报告等日常行政事务。

lemmas.def_en: by or for an administrator
lemmas.def_zh: 管理地；行政地

examples.en: Although geographically separated, the two departments are administratively linked under one director.
examples.zh: 尽管地理位置分隔两地，这两个部门在行政上均归同一位主管领导。

lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. to manage and organize the affairs of a business, government, or institution. 2. to implement or enforce a law, test, or justice. 3. to give or provide medicine, treatment, or aid to someone.
lemmas.def_zh: 管理，掌管；执行，实施；给予，施用（药物等）

examples.en: Trained nurses will administer the vaccine to the patients.
examples.zh: 受过培训的护士将为患者接种疫苗。

lemmas.def_zh: 管理, 支配
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (formal) To manage or direct the affairs of a business, institution, or government.

examples.en: A newly appointed committee was established to administrate the city's public transit system.
examples.zh: 新成立了一个委员会来管理该市的公共交通系统。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 administrare（ad- 向前、给 + ministrare 侍奉、照料），核心逻辑由“提供协助与服务”引申为系统性地“照管、管理、执行事务”。
family_guide.core_distinction: administration 既可指抽象的“行政管理过程”，也可具体指“某届政府/管理机构”，在医疗或法律语境中还特指“施用（药物）”或“执行（法律/遗产）”。

lemmas.def_zh: 再；不再；如今
lemmas.def_en: any longer; at the present time (typically used in negative statements or questions)

examples.en: We don't see each other very often anymore.
examples.zh: 我们如今不再经常见面了。

examples.en: Why don't you play the piano anymore?
examples.zh: 你现在怎么不再弹钢琴了？

family_guide.root_logic: 由不定代词 any（任何）与 more（更多）复合而成，主要在否定句或疑问句中充当时间副词，表示某种状态或行为“不再”持续或延续。
family_guide.core_distinction: 合写的 anymore 通常用作时间副词（相当于 any longer，意为“不再”）；而分写的 any more 则常作限定词或代词，指数量或程度上的“再有、更多”（英式英语中时间副词也常作 any more）。

lemmas.def_zh: 回答，答复；做出反应，响应
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To say, write, or do something as an answer, reaction, or reply.

examples.en: The government failed to respond effectively to the unfolding economic crisis.
examples.zh: 政府未能对不断蔓延的经济危机作出有效反应。

examples.en: She hasn't had time to respond to all the congratulations she received.
examples.zh: 她还没来得及回复收到的所有祝贺。

lemmas.def_zh: 应答者, 被告
lemmas.def_en: the codefendant (especially in a divorce proceeding) who is accused of adultery with the corespondent

examples.en: Nearly every respondent in the survey preferred working remotely at least two days weekly.
examples.zh: 调查中几乎每位受访者都更希望每周至少远程办公两天。

lemmas.def_zh: 强烈的反应
lemmas.def_en: responsive to stimulation

examples.en: Customers praised the company for its remarkable responsiveness to complaints and technical issues.
examples.zh: 客户对该公司处理投诉和技术问题的高响应度大加赞赏。

lemmas.def_zh: 回答者, 响应者, 响应器, 应答机
lemmas.def_en: someone who responds

examples.en: The emergency responder arrived at the accident scene within five minutes of the call.
examples.zh: 紧急救援人员在接到电话后五分钟内赶到了事故现场。

lemmas.def_zh: 无感应性, 无反应性
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being unresponsive; not reacting; as a quality of people, it is marked by a failure to respond quickly or with emotion to people or events

examples.en: The patient's sudden unresponsiveness worried the doctors and led to immediate medical tests.
examples.zh: 病人突然失去反应让医生感到担忧，并立即进行了医学检查。

lemmas.def_zh: 反应敏捷的；有求必应的；响应式的
lemmas.def_en: reacting quickly, positively, or sensitively to stimuli, requests, or people

examples.en: The support team was exceptionally responsive and resolved the bug within hours.
examples.zh: 支持团队反应极其迅速，在几小时内就修复了漏洞。

examples.en: The site features a responsive design that adapts smoothly to mobile screens.
examples.zh: 该网站采用响应式设计，能流畅适配手机屏幕。

lemmas.def_zh: 反应迟钝的, 感受性迟钝的, 不回答的
lemmas.def_en: not responding to some influence or stimulus

examples.en: The customer support team remained unresponsive despite multiple follow-up emails sent this week.
examples.zh: 尽管本周发了多次跟进邮件，客户支持团队仍未作出任何回复。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 respondere（re- 回 + spondere 承诺/发誓），核心意象为“给出对等的回应”，引申为对言辞、刺激或行动作出回答或产生反应。
family_guide.core_distinction: respond 是具体的动作（做出反应/回复）；responsive 是状态形容词，强调反应迅速灵敏或具有良好反馈能力。

lemmas.def_zh: 花园, 果园, 菜园
lemmas.def_en: a plot of ground where plants are cultivated

examples.en: She grows fresh herbs and bright flowers in her small backyard garden every summer.
examples.zh: 每年夏天，她都在后院的小花园里种植新鲜香草和鲜艳的花朵。

lemmas.def_zh: 园丁, 花匠, 园艺家
lemmas.def_en: someone who takes care of a garden

examples.en: The professional gardener trimmed the hedges and planted seasonal flowers in the estate.
examples.zh: 这位专业园丁修剪了树篱，并在庄园里种下了应季花卉。

lemmas.def_zh: 从事园艺，照料花园；种植花木
lemmas.def_en: [I] To work in a garden, growing plants, flowers, or vegetables.

examples.en: She grows fresh herbs and bright flowers in her small backyard garden every summer.
examples.zh: 每年夏天，她都在后院的小花园里种植新鲜香草和鲜艳的花朵。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于日耳曼语系中表示‘围起来的土地’的词根，后专指用于种植花木果蔬的围囿空间，由名词直接转类为动词表示‘从事园艺’。

lemmas.def_zh: 公民的；民事的，民用的；客气的，有礼貌的
lemmas.def_en: relating to ordinary citizens and their concerns rather than military or religious matters; polite and formal

examples.en: She fought for decades to protect basic civil rights and equality.
examples.zh: 她为捍卫基本公民权利与平等奋斗了数十年。

examples.en: Despite their bitter disagreement, they managed to remain civil to each other.
examples.zh: 尽管存在严重分歧，他们彼此之间仍努力保持基本的客气与礼貌。

lemmas.def_zh: 无礼貌的, 失礼的, 粗野的, 不文明的
lemmas.def_en: lacking civility or good manners; - Willa Cather

examples.en: His uncivil behavior during the formal dinner embarrassed all the guests and his family.
examples.zh: 他在正式晚宴上的粗鲁举止让所有宾客和他的家人感到尴尬。

lemmas.def_zh: 礼貌, 礼仪
lemmas.def_en: formal or perfunctory politeness

examples.en: They managed to treat each other with basic civility despite their strong personal disagreements.
examples.zh: 尽管存在强烈的个人分歧，他们仍尽量以基本的礼貌对待彼此。

lemmas.def_zh: 谦恭地, 根据民法
lemmas.def_en: in a civil manner

examples.en: The two rivals spoke civilly before the debate began, surprising the watching audience.
examples.zh: 辩论开始前，这两位对手礼貌地交谈，令在场的观众颇感意外。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 civis（公民），核心逻辑从“城邦公民相关的”延伸为“平民的/民事的（区别于军事或宗教）”，进而演变为“符合公共秩序与教养的、客气有礼的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 注意 civil 与 civic 的区别：civil 侧重“民用的、民事的或礼貌的”；civic 则侧重“公民责任的、市政的”（如 civic duty）。

lemmas.def_zh: 拒绝，回绝；不愿，推辞
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To state or show firmly that one is not willing to do, give, accept, or grant something.

examples.en: She politely refused his offer of help, preferring to solve the problem on her own.
examples.zh: 她礼貌地拒绝了他的帮助，更愿意独自解决这个问题。

examples.en: The bank refused to grant them a loan due to insufficient collateral.
examples.zh: 由于抵押品不足，银行拒绝向他们发放贷款。

lemmas.def_zh: 拒绝；回绝
lemmas.def_en: the act of refusing to do, accept, or allow something

examples.en: His flat refusal to cooperate surprised everyone on the team.
examples.zh: 他断然拒绝合作，这让团队中的所有人都感到意外。

examples.en: They interpreted her prolonged silence as a polite refusal.
examples.zh: 他们把她长时间的沉默理解为一种礼貌的拒绝。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语，包含“向后退回”之意，核心逻辑演化为对提议、要求或请求的“推回、不接受或不执行”。
family_guide.core_distinction: refuse 为动词（拒绝接受或去做），refusal 为其直接派生的动作名词（拒绝的行为或声明）。

lemmas.def_zh: 开始的, 最初的, 字首的
lemmas.def_en: occurring at the beginning

examples.en: Her initial reaction to the surprising news was complete disbelief and quiet shock.
examples.zh: 她对这一惊人消息的最初反应是彻底的难以置信和默默的震惊。

lemmas.def_zh: 起初；最初
lemmas.def_en: at the beginning; at first

examples.en: The campaign was initially successful, but momentum soon faded.
examples.zh: 这场宣传活动起初很成功，但势头很快便减弱了。

examples.en: Initially, we planned to stay for a week, but we ended up staying a month.
examples.zh: 我们最初打算待一周，结果却住了一个月。

lemmas.def_zh: 草签，在……上签署姓名首字母
lemmas.def_en: [T] To mark, sign, or approve a document with the first letters of one's names.

examples.en: Her initial reaction to the surprising news was complete disbelief and quiet shock.
examples.zh: 她对这一惊人消息的最初反应是彻底的难以置信和默默的震惊。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 inire（进入、开始），核心意象为“处于起点位置”，后引申为姓名开头的“首字母”及“签署首字母以确认”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词意为“最初的、开始的”；转为动词时专指在文件（尤其修改处）“签署姓名首字母缩写”以表核准。

lemmas.def_zh: 观察，注视；注意到；遵守（规则、习俗等）；评论
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To watch someone or something carefully. 2. [T] To notice or perceive something. 3. [T] To obey a rule, law, or custom. 4. [T] To make a formal remark or comment.

examples.en: Scientists carefully observed the behavior of the birds during the eclipse.
examples.zh: 日食期间，科学家们仔细观察了这些鸟类的行为。

examples.en: All visitors must strictly observe the safety regulations.
examples.zh: 所有访客都必须严格遵守安全规程。

lemmas.def_zh: 观察；监视；观察所得（资料）；言论
lemmas.def_en: the action or process of closely monitoring something; a remark or statement

examples.en: The patient was kept under close medical observation for 48 hours.
examples.zh: 该患者接受了为期48小时的严密医学观察。

examples.en: She shared a few interesting observations about the current market trends.
examples.zh: 她就当前的市场趋势发表了几点有趣的见解。

lemmas.def_zh: 观察员；目击者；旁观者
lemmas.def_en: a person who watches or notices something, especially an official delegate

examples.en: International observers were sent to ensure the fairness of the election.
examples.zh: 国际观察员被派往当地以确保选举的公平性。

examples.en: To an outside observer, the two companies appeared to be direct competitors.
examples.zh: 在外部旁观者看来，这两家公司似乎是直接的竞争对手。

lemmas.def_zh: 观察, 遵守, 仪式, 风俗习惯
lemmas.def_en: the act of observing; taking a patient look

examples.en: The strict observance of local traditions remains deeply important to the older community members.
examples.zh: 严格遵守当地传统对社区的长辈们来说依然至关重要。

lemmas.def_zh: 可遵守的, 可庆祝的, 看得见的, 可辨别的, 观测得到的, 值得注意的, 显著的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being seen or noticed

examples.en: There were clearly observable improvements in his health after he changed his daily diet.
examples.zh: 在改变日常饮食后，他的健康状况出现了明显可见的改善。

lemmas.def_zh: 严格遵守...的, 留心的, 当心的, 观察力敏锐的, 注意观察的
lemmas.def_en: paying close attention especially to details

examples.en: An observant reader quickly noticed a minor factual error in the opening paragraph.
examples.zh: 敏锐的读者很快注意到了首段中一个微小的史实错误。

lemmas.def_zh: 没有观察到的, 没有受到注意的, 未被遵守的
lemmas.def_en: not observed

examples.en: The thief managed to slip past the security guards completely unobserved by anyone.
examples.zh: 窃贼设法溜过了保安，完全没有被人察觉。

lemmas.def_zh: 难以察觉的；注意不到的；不可见的
lemmas.def_en: not accessible to direct observation

examples.en: Dark matter remains completely unobservable with traditional optical telescopes used by astronomers today.
examples.zh: 用天文学家当今使用的传统光学望远镜完全无法观测到暗物质。

lemmas.def_zh: 不注意的, 不遵守的
lemmas.def_en: not consciously observing

examples.en: He walked past his old friend because he was notoriously unobservant in crowds.
examples.zh: 他径直走过了老朋友，因为他在人群中向来心不在焉。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 observare（ob- 朝向 + servare 守护、注视），核心意象为“专注地注视”，由此引申出“观察/监测”、“遵守（规则/习俗）”和“发表看法”。
family_guide.core_distinction: observation 表示“观察行为、监测数据或评述”，而 observer 专指执行观察或监测的“人、旁观者或官方观察员”。

lemmas.def_zh: 图书馆；藏书楼；藏书；（计算机）程序库，函数库
lemmas.def_en: a building, room, or organization containing a collection of books and media; a collection of software programs or routines

examples.en: She spent the entire afternoon studying in the university library.
examples.zh: 她在大学图书馆里学习了一整个下午。

examples.en: The framework includes a comprehensive library of pre-written functions.
examples.zh: 该框架包含一个功能完备的预写函数库。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 liber（树皮，古代书写材料，引申为“书”），结合表示场所的后缀，演变为“藏书楼、图书馆”，后引申为书籍收藏及计算机中的“资料库/程序库”。

lemmas.def_zh: 进餐，用正餐；用晚餐
lemmas.def_en: [I] To eat dinner or have a formal meal.

examples.en: We decided to dine out at a quiet bistro to celebrate our anniversary.
examples.zh: 我们决定去一家安静的小酒馆用餐，庆祝我们的结婚纪念日。

lemmas.def_zh: 大声喧闹，喧嚷；反复叮嘱，絮叨灌输
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] to make a loud, unpleasant, or confusing noise. 2. [T] to instill or repeat something wearyingly into someone's head.

examples.en: The teacher tried to din the safety rules into the children's heads.
examples.zh: 老师一遍又一遍地把安全规则反复灌输给孩子们。

lemmas.def_zh: 正餐；晚餐；晚宴
lemmas.def_en: the main meal of the day, usually eaten in the evening; a formal banquet

examples.en: They hosted a formal dinner in honor of the visiting delegates.
examples.zh: 他们举办了一场正式晚宴，以款待来访的代表团。

lemmas.def_zh: 用餐者
lemmas.def_en: a person eating a meal (especially in a restaurant)

examples.en: Every diner praised the chef for the beautifully prepared five-course seafood dinner.
examples.zh: 每位用餐者都对主厨精心烹制的海鲜五道菜晚宴赞不绝口。

lemmas.def_zh: 水妖, 洗眼壶
lemmas.def_en: any of various female water spirits

examples.en: The ancient folklore describes the undine as a graceful water spirit dwelling in streams.
examples.zh: 古老的民间传说将水妖描绘成居住在溪流中的优美水精灵。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 disner（破除禁食、进餐），演化为表示“享用正餐”的核心词族；需注意形近词 din 源自古英语，属于同形异源词。
family_guide.core_distinction: dine 是动词“进正餐”，dinner 是名词“正餐/晚宴”，而 din 意为“喧闹”或“反复灌输”，词源与含义皆无关联但易拼写混淆。

lemmas.def_zh: 现金
lemmas.def_en: money in the form of bills or coins

examples.en: Please keep some cash handy because this local market does not take cards.
examples.zh: 请随身带点现金，因为这个当地集市不收刷卡。

lemmas.def_zh: 兑现，把……兑成现金
lemmas.def_en: [T] To exchange a check, bond, or money order for cash.

examples.en: Please keep some cash handy because this local market does not take cards.
examples.zh: 请随身带点现金，因为这个当地集市不收刷卡。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 caisse（钱箱，源于拉丁语 capsa“盒子”），语义由“装钱的盒子”转借指箱内的“现金”，后引申为动词“兑现”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 该词族主要为同形的名词（现金、现款）与动词（兑现、换取现金），词义高度聚焦。

lemmas.def_zh: 马, 骑兵, 脚架
lemmas.def_en: solid-hoofed herbivorous quadruped domesticated since prehistoric times

examples.en: The horse galloped gracefully across the open green pasture.
examples.zh: 那匹马优雅地在开阔的绿草地上奔驰。

lemmas.def_zh: 为……备马，给……配马
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To provide or equip someone or a carriage with a horse or horses.

examples.en: The children love to horse around in the garden until dinner is served.
examples.zh: 孩子们喜欢在花园里胡闹嬉戏，直到晚饭开席。

lemmas.def_zh: 从马上卸下来, 使摔下马来, 推翻
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To unhorse a rider means to cause them to fall or be thrown from a horse. 2. [T] (figurative) To remove someone from a position of power.

examples.en: A sudden blow from the opponent's lance threatened to unhorse the brave knight.
examples.zh: 对手长矛的猛烈一击差点将这位勇敢的骑士挑落马下。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 hors，本义指马属大型哺乳动物，后由马嬉闹跳跃的动作引申出动词短语中“胡闹、嬉戏”的用法。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词指马匹本身，动词核心用法主要结合介词构成短语 horse around（胡闹、打闹）。

lemmas.def_zh: 设备，装置；手段，策略；修辞手段
lemmas.def_en: an object, machine, or piece of equipment made for a special purpose; a method or plan used to achieve a particular result

examples.en: Passengers are requested to switch off all electronic devices during takeoff and landing.
examples.zh: 乘客被要求在起飞和降落期间关闭所有电子设备。

examples.en: Metaphor is a powerful literary device that helps readers visualize abstract ideas.
examples.zh: 隐喻是一种强大的文学手法，有助于读者将抽象概念具象化。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 dividere（分开、筹划），核心意象为‘巧妙设计出的构想或方法’，后特指为实现特定功能而设计制造的‘器械、装置’。
family_guide.core_distinction: 注意与动词 devise（设计、构想，词尾发 /z/）区分；device 为名词（装置、计谋，词尾发 /s/）。

lemmas.def_zh: 散播，扩散，蔓延；展开，铺开；涂，敷
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. To affect a larger area or group of people, or to make something do so. 2. To open out, unfold, or stretch over an area. 3. To apply a thin layer of a substance over a surface.

examples.en: She generously spread fresh strawberry jam across the warm, freshly toasted slice of bread.
examples.zh: 她在刚烤好的热面包片上厚厚地涂抹了一层新鲜草莓酱。

lemmas.def_zh: 传播, 散布, 伸展
lemmas.def_en: process or result of distributing or extending over a wide expanse of space

examples.en: She generously spread fresh strawberry jam across the warm, freshly toasted slice of bread.
examples.zh: 她在刚烤好的热面包片上厚厚地涂抹了一层新鲜草莓酱。

lemmas.def_zh: 散布者, 传播者, 涂黄油用的小刀, 撒布机, 分纱器, 分经筘
lemmas.def_en: a hand tool for spreading something

examples.en: He used a small wooden spreader to apply the soft cheese onto crackers.
examples.zh: 他用一把小木制抹刀把软奶酪涂在薄脆饼干上。

lemmas.def_zh: 双唇展开的, 伸展的
lemmas.def_en: distributed or spread over a considerable extent

examples.en: She generously spread fresh strawberry jam across the warm, freshly toasted slice of bread.
examples.zh: 她在刚烤好的热面包片上厚厚地涂抹了一层新鲜草莓酱。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 sprǣdan，核心意象为“向外延展、摊开、铺散”，由此引申出物理空间的铺展与涂抹、信息与病菌的传播扩散，以及派生出的范围、跨度与丰盛陈设等含义。
family_guide.core_distinction: 该词族属于典型的同形异性词（动、名、形同形），动词表展开、涂抹或扩散，名词表抹酱、盛宴或跨度，形容词常作表语或后置修饰语表“展开的、伸展的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 设施，场所；（做事的）天赋，熟练
lemmas.def_en: a place, amenity, or piece of equipment provided for a purpose; a natural aptitude or ease in doing something

examples.en: The university has opened a new research facility equipped with advanced laboratories.
examples.zh: 该大学启用了一座配备先进实验室的全新科研设施。

examples.en: She displayed an impressive facility for learning foreign languages at an early age.
examples.zh: 她自幼便展现出令人惊叹的外语学习天赋。

lemmas.def_zh: 容易的, 灵巧的, 温和的
lemmas.def_en: arrived at without due care or effort; lacking depth

examples.en: He offered a facile solution that completely ignored the underlying complexities of the problem.
examples.zh: 他提出了一个肤浅的解决方案，完全忽视了问题的潜在复杂性。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 facilis（容易的、易做的，派生自 facere“做”），核心语义为“使事情变得容易”，由此引申为提供便利的“设施/场所”以及做事轻松自如的“熟练/天赋”。

lemmas.def_zh: 时常发生的, 频繁的, 快速的
lemmas.def_en: coming at short intervals or habitually

examples.en: They frequent the quiet corner cafe every weekend to enjoy their favorite pastries.
examples.zh: 他们每个周末都常去那家僻静的街角咖啡馆享用最喜欢的糕点。

lemmas.def_zh: 频繁地；经常地；屡次
lemmas.def_en: regularly or often; at short intervals

examples.en: Buses run frequently during morning rush hours, usually every five minutes.
examples.zh: 早高峰期间公交车发车很频繁，通常每五分钟一班。

lemmas.def_zh: 频率；频度；发生次数
lemmas.def_en: the rate at which something occurs or is repeated over a particular period

examples.en: The frequency of extreme weather events has increased noticeably in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年来，极端天气事件的发生频率显著增加。

lemmas.def_zh: 常去，常光顾
lemmas.def_en: [T] To visit a particular place often or regularly.

examples.en: They frequent the quiet corner cafe every weekend to enjoy their favorite pastries.
examples.zh: 他们每个周末都常去那家僻静的街角咖啡馆享用最喜欢的糕点。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 frequens（密集的、拥挤的），核心由“空间上的密集”引申为“时间或次数上的密集”，进而衍生出“经常发生”（形容词/副词/名词）与“常去使某处热闹”（动词）的概念。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词 frequent（重音在前 /ˈfriːkwənt/）指事物发生得频繁；动词 frequent（重音在后 /frɪˈkwɛnt/）指人经常造访或光顾某地。

lemmas.def_zh: 斗争, 努力, 奋斗
lemmas.def_en: an energetic attempt to achieve something

examples.en: Winning the difficult championship was a long and exhausting struggle for the team.
examples.zh: 赢得这个艰难的冠军头衔对这支队伍来说是一场漫长而艰苦的奋斗。

lemmas.def_zh: 斗争者, 奋斗者, 挣扎着的人
lemmas.def_en: a person who struggles with difficulties or with great effort

examples.en: The patient tutor offered extra help to every struggler in the math class.
examples.zh: 耐心的家庭教师为数学课上的每位费力学习者提供了额外辅导。

lemmas.def_zh: 斗争，抗争；拼搏，努力奋斗；挣扎
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To fight or compete forcefully against a person, group, or opposing power. 2. [I] To make a strenuous effort to achieve something difficult.

examples.en: Winning the difficult championship was a long and exhausting struggle for the team.
examples.zh: 赢得这个艰难的冠军头衔对这支队伍来说是一场漫长而艰苦的奋斗。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 苦苦挣扎的；努力维持生计的
lemmas.def_en: engaged in a struggle to overcome adversity, especially poverty or obscurity
lemmas.usage_note: 常用于修饰经济陷入困境的企业或个人，如 struggling artist（贫困潦倒的艺术家）或 struggling business（勉强维持的企业）。

examples.en: The government announced subsidies to support struggling local families.
examples.zh: 政府宣布提供补贴以资助当地生活窘迫的家庭。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于中古英语，核心意象为“受阻时的用力扑腾与肉搏”，后引申为在内外部巨大阻力下付出的艰苦努力、搏斗或内心挣扎。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词与动词同形同源，名词侧重于具体的斗争、历程或难事，动词则强调在阻力中拼命发力（常与 with/against 或不定式连用）。

lemmas.def_zh: 重复，重说，重申；重做
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To say, state, or perform something again, especially for clarity or emphasis.

examples.en: Could you please repeat your last sentence so that everyone can hear clearly?
examples.zh: 您能重复一下刚才那句话，以便大家都能听清吗？

lemmas.def_zh: 重复, 反复
lemmas.def_en: an event that repeats

examples.en: Could you please repeat your last sentence so that everyone can hear clearly?
examples.zh: 您能重复一下刚才那句话，以便大家都能听清吗？

lemmas.def_zh: 重复, 背诵, 循环, 复制品, 副本
lemmas.def_en: an event that repeats

examples.en: Learning a new foreign language requires constant repetition and lots of daily practice.
examples.zh: 学习一门新外语需要不断的重复和大量的日常练习。

lemmas.def_zh: 重复做的人, 背诵者, 循环小数
lemmas.def_en: a person who repeats

examples.en: The coach praised the repeater who worked tirelessly to finally pass the exam.
examples.zh: 教练称赞了那位不知疲倦地努力、终于通过考试的重考生。

lemmas.def_zh: 重复性
lemmas.def_en: verboseness resulting from excessive repetitions

examples.en: The endless repetitiveness of the factory assembly line quickly bored the new workers.
examples.zh: 工厂装配线无休止的重复性让新工人们很快感到乏味。

lemmas.def_zh: 重复地, 再三地
lemmas.def_en: several time

examples.en: The teacher repeatedly warned the students not to run in the hallways.
examples.zh: 老师再三警告学生不要在走廊里奔跑。

lemmas.def_zh: 重复地
lemmas.def_en: in a repetitive manner

examples.en: He practiced the same violin passage repetitively until his fingers grew tired.
examples.zh: 他反复练习同一段小提琴乐段，直到手指发酸。

lemmas.def_zh: 重复的, 反复性的
lemmas.def_en: repetitive and persistent

examples.en: Factory workers often suffer from injuries caused by repetitive physical tasks.
examples.zh: 工厂工人经常因重复性的体力工作而受伤。

lemmas.def_zh: 多次反复的, 重复的, 反复性的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by repetition

examples.en: Factory workers often struggle with boredom caused by simple, repetitious tasks every day.
examples.zh: 工厂工人经常要与每天简单重复的任务所带来的无聊作斗争。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 repetere（re- 再次 + petere 探求/前往），核心逻辑为“再次进行或叙述同一事物”，演化为重复、重播或再现。
family_guide.core_distinction: repetitive 常含有“机械、单调乏味”的负面色彩；而 repeated / repeatedly 仅客观表示“多次发生的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 康复，恢复（健康或常态）；重新获得，找回；挽回（损失）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To return to a normal state of health, strength, or functioning. 2. [T] To regain possession or control of something lost or stolen.

examples.en: She is making steady progress and is expected to recover fully within a few weeks.
examples.zh: 她的病情正在稳步好转，预计几周内就能完全康复。

examples.en: Police managed to recover the stolen artwork following a tip-off.
examples.zh: 警方根据线报成功追回了被盗的艺术品。

lemmas.def_zh: 康复，痊愈；复苏，好转；追回，寻回
lemmas.def_en: the process of returning to a normal or healthy condition; the act of regaining something lost or stolen

examples.en: The economy is showing tentative signs of recovery after months of stagnation.
examples.zh: 经历了数月的停滞之后，经济正初现复苏迹象。

examples.en: Doctors are optimistic about his chances of making a full recovery.
examples.zh: 医生对他完全康复的希望感到乐观。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 recuperare（重新获得），核心语义为“取回失去之物”或“重返原本的健康与正常状态”。

lemmas.def_zh: 平衡, 差额
lemmas.def_en: a state of equilibrium

examples.en: Yoga helped her regain a sense of physical and emotional balance.
examples.zh: 瑜伽帮助她重新找回了身心平衡的感觉。

lemmas.def_zh: 失衡, 精神错乱
lemmas.def_en: a lack of balance or state of disequilibrium

examples.en: The sudden loss of his job threatened to unbalance his mental state.
examples.zh: 突遭失业的打击险些使他的精神状态彻底崩溃。

lemmas.def_zh: 起平衡作用的人, 平衡器, 走钢丝者
lemmas.def_en: an acrobat who balances himself in difficult positions

examples.en: She acted as a calm balancer between the two arguing team members.
examples.zh: 她在两位争执的团队成员之间充当了冷静的平衡者。

lemmas.def_zh: 使平衡，保持平衡；权衡，斟酌；相抵
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To put something into a steady position so that it does not fall, or remain in such a position. 2. [T] To compare or weigh two different things against each other.

examples.en: Yoga helped her regain a sense of physical and emotional balance.
examples.zh: 瑜伽帮助她重新找回了身心平衡的感觉。

lemmas.def_zh: 使失去平衡；使心神错乱，扰乱
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To cause someone or something to lose physical balance or stability. 2. To upset someone's mental or emotional stability.

examples.en: The sudden loss of his job threatened to unbalance his mental state.
examples.zh: 突遭失业的打击险些使他的精神状态彻底崩溃。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 平衡的；均衡的；客观公正的
lemmas.def_en: being in a state of proper equilibrium; fair and considering all sides equally
lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰饮食（a balanced diet）、报道态度（a balanced view）或情绪心智的稳定（a balanced personality）。

examples.en: A healthy lifestyle requires a balanced diet and regular exercise.
examples.zh: 健康的生活方式需要均衡的饮食和规律的运动。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 bilanx（bi- 双 + lanx 秤盘），核心意象为“双盘天平的对等状态”，由此衍生出物理平衡、心态稳定、对立要素的均等以及账面收支相抵的余额等概念。

lemmas.def_zh: 交谈，谈话
lemmas.def_en: [I] (+ with) to engage in conversation with someone.

examples.en: She enjoyed the rare opportunity to converse with leading experts in the field.
examples.zh: 她很珍惜这次能与该领域顶尖专家交谈的难得机会。

lemmas.def_zh: 谈话；交谈；会话
lemmas.def_en: an informal talk involving two or more people

examples.en: They had a long and meaningful conversation about their future career plans.
examples.zh: 他们就未来的职业规划进行了一次深入而有意义的交谈。

lemmas.def_zh: 交谈者, 健谈者
lemmas.def_en: someone skilled at conversation

examples.en: Being a witty conversationalist, she effortlessly kept the dinner guests thoroughly entertained.
examples.zh: 作为一名妙语连珠的健谈者，她轻松地让宴席上的宾客尽欢。

lemmas.def_zh: 相反地；反过来
lemmas.def_en: in an opposite way; used to introduce a statement that contrasts with a previous one

examples.en: Poor diet can cause fatigue, and conversely, constant fatigue often leads to unhealthy eating habits.
examples.zh: 不良饮食会导致疲劳，反过来，长期的疲劳也往往导致不健康的饮食习惯。

lemmas.def_zh: 会话地
lemmas.def_en: with the use of colloquial expressions

examples.en: He spoke conversationally, making everyone feel welcome and completely at ease.
examples.zh: 他以拉家常的口吻交谈，让大家感到宾至如归且十分自在。

lemmas.def_zh: 会话的, 对话的, 健谈的
lemmas.def_en: characteristic of informal spoken language or conversation

examples.en: Her natural, conversational writing style makes complex topics very easy to understand.
examples.zh: 她自然且口语化的写作风格使复杂的课题变得浅显易懂。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语词根 vers-（转向、周旋），一条语义脉络引申为‘往来周旋、交谈’，另一条脉络则引申为‘反向转动、相反’。
family_guide.core_distinction: converse (v.) 与 conversation (n.) 承接‘交谈’脉络；而 conversely (adv.) 则承接‘转向相反方向’的脉络，意为‘相反地、反之’。

lemmas.def_zh: 没有一个；没有人；毫无
lemmas.def_en: not any; no person or thing; not one

examples.en: We asked for extra copies of the report, but there were none left.
examples.zh: 我们要这份报告的多余副本，但一份也没有剩了。

examples.en: None of the solutions proposed so far have proven effective.
examples.zh: 迄今为止提出的方案中，没有一个被证明是有效的。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 ne（否定）与 ān（一，即 one）的复合，字面本义为“not one（一个也没有）”，引申指没有任何人、事物或数量。

lemmas.def_zh: 欢快的, 艳丽的, 快乐的, 放荡的
lemmas.def_en: bright and pleasant; promoting a feeling of cheer

examples.en: They actively support legal protections for the rights of gay couples.
examples.zh: 他们积极支持针对同性伴侣权益的法律保护。

lemmas.def_en: someone who practices homosexuality; having a sexual attraction to persons of the same sex

examples.en: They actively support legal protections for the rights of gay couples.
examples.zh: 他们积极支持针对同性伴侣权益的法律保护。

lemmas.def_zh: 欢乐, （尤指）同性恋
lemmas.def_en: a sexual attraction to (or sexual relations with) persons of the same sex

examples.en: He felt complete comfort and pride in expressing his own gayness openly.
examples.zh: 他公开表达自己的同性恋身份时感到完全的自在与自豪。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语，原指“欢快的、艳丽的”，20世纪中叶起核心语义演变为“同性恋的”，现指代同性恋群体及其特质。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词用法更广泛且正式（如 gay rights, gay men）；作名词时指同性恋者（多指男性），现代语境中通常更推荐使用形容词搭配（如 gay people）以示礼貌。

lemmas.def_zh: 规模；天平；等级；刻度
lemmas.def_en: an ordered reference standard

examples.en: On a scale of one to ten, how would you rate this service?
examples.zh: 从一到十的评分标准来看，你给这项服务打几分？

lemmas.def_zh: 按比例测量，按比例绘制；衡量，过秤称；攀登；刮去……的鳞片（或水垢）
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. to measure, estimate, or draw according to a scale 2. to weigh something on a scale 3. to climb up or over a steep surface 4. to remove scales or incrustations from

examples.en: On a scale of one to ten, how would you rate this service?
examples.zh: 从一到十的评分标准来看，你给这项服务打几分？

lemmas.def_zh: 数量的, 分等级的, 梯状的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a musical scale

examples.en: Speed is a scalar quantity because it only describes magnitude, not direction.
examples.zh: 速率是一个标量，因为它只描述大小，不包含方向。

lemmas.def_zh: 有鳞的, 鳞状的, 覆有鳞片的, 积垢的, 积水垢的, 介壳虫蛀的
lemmas.def_en: rough to the touch; covered with scales or scurf

examples.en: The lizard's dry, scaly skin protects it from losing moisture in the desert.
examples.zh: 蜥蜴干燥且覆有鳞片的皮肤能防止其在沙漠中流失水分。

lemmas.def_zh: 没有鳞的
lemmas.def_en: destitute of scales

examples.en: Scientists discovered a strange scaleless fish living deep in the ocean trench.
examples.zh: 科学家在深海海沟中发现了一种奇特且无鳞的鱼。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 纵向缩放；纵向缩放比例；在Y轴缩放比例
lemmas.def_en: having the body covered or partially covered with thin horny plates, as some fish and reptiles

examples.en: Set the transform parameter to adjust the scaleY value of the graphic layer.
examples.zh: 设置变换参数以调整图形图层的Y轴缩放比例。

family_guide.root_logic: 该词族融合了两大源头：源自拉丁语'梯子'引申出'刻度、比例、规模与攀登'；源自日耳曼语'薄片/盘'引申出'鱼鳞与天平秤'。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词强调衡量基准、规模范围或实物（秤/鳞片）；动词主要引申为'攀登高度'或现代商业中的'按比例缩放/扩张（scale up/down）'。

lemmas.def_zh: （宗教）信仰；信念
lemmas.def_en: complete trust or confidence in someone or something; strong belief in God or the doctrines of a religion

examples.en: Her deep Christian faith gave her comfort and strength during difficult times.
examples.zh: 她虔诚的基督教信仰在艰难时期给予了她安慰与力量。

lemmas.def_zh: 信徒；忠实支持者，拥护者（常作 the faithful）
lemmas.def_en: loyal supporters or believers, especially of a religion or a political cause

examples.en: The cathedral was filled with the faithful gathered for prayer.
examples.zh: 大教堂里聚满了前来祈祷的虔诚信徒。

examples.en: The party faithful turned out in large numbers for the campaign rally.
examples.zh: 该党的忠实拥护者大批出席了竞选集会。

lemmas.def_zh: 忠诚, 诚实, 正确
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being faithful

examples.en: The dog was known throughout the small village for its remarkable faithfulness.
examples.zh: 这只狗因其非凡的忠诚而在整个小村庄闻名。

lemmas.def_zh: 不忠实；不信守婚誓
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being unfaithful

examples.en: Rumors about his repeated unfaithfulness eventually destroyed their long-term marriage.
examples.zh: 关于他多次不忠的谣言最终摧毁了他们长久的婚姻。

lemmas.def_zh: 不贞; 无信仰; 不可信赖; 无信用
lemmas.def_en: unfaithfulness by virtue of being unreliable or treacherous

examples.en: Her bitter faithlessness toward all politicians grew after the recent corruption scandal.
examples.zh: 在最近的腐败丑闻发生后，她对所有政客都充满了不信任。

lemmas.def_zh: 忠实地, 诚心诚意地, 深信着地
lemmas.def_en: in a faithful manner

examples.en: She faithfully documented every single event in her personal journal each evening.
examples.zh: 她每天晚上都忠实地在个人日记中记录下每件事。

lemmas.def_zh: 不忠实地
lemmas.def_en: in an unfaithful undependable unreliable manner

examples.en: He acted unfaithfully by sharing confidential business details with the main competitor.
examples.zh: 他将机密商业信息泄露给主要竞争对手，表现得极其不忠。

lemmas.def_zh: 不诚实的, 不忠实的
lemmas.def_en: not true to duty or obligation or promises

examples.en: She felt devastated when she discovered that her husband had been unfaithful.
examples.zh: 当她发现丈夫不忠时，感到痛不欲生。

lemmas.def_zh: 无信的, 不忠实的
lemmas.def_en: having the character of, or characteristic of, a traitor

examples.en: The general refused to trust the faithless allies who had abandoned him.
examples.zh: 将军拒绝相信那些曾经背弃过他的背信弃义的盟友。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 fides（信任、信念），核心义始终围绕“坚定不移的信赖、忠诚或信仰”展开。
family_guide.core_distinction: faith 表示抽象的信念、信任或宗教信仰本身；名词 faithful（常作 the faithful）特指拥有这种坚定信念的信徒或忠实拥护者群体。

lemmas.def_zh: 生病的，患病的；恶心的，想吐的；厌烦的
lemmas.def_en: physically or mentally ill; affected by nausea

examples.en: She called in sick this morning because she had a high fever.
examples.zh: 她今天早上打电话请病假，因为发高烧了。

examples.en: The sudden movement of the boat made several passengers feel sick.
examples.zh: 船身的突然颠簸让几位乘客感到恶心想吐。

lemmas.def_zh: 病弱的, 令人不快的, 无精打采的
lemmas.def_en: unhealthy looking

examples.en: The sickly child missed several weeks of primary school during the winter.
examples.zh: 那个体弱多病的孩子在冬季缺了几个星期的课。

lemmas.def_zh: 疾病，不适；恶心，呕吐
lemmas.def_en: the state of being ill; a particular disease; nausea

examples.en: He missed two weeks of school due to a sudden sickness.
examples.zh: 他因突发疾病缺课了两周。

examples.en: Taking deep breaths can sometimes help reduce morning sickness.
examples.zh: 深呼吸有时有助于缓解晨吐反应。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 sēoc，核心表意为“身体不适、患病的”或“反胃欲呕的”，派生出表示疾病或恶心状态的名词形式。
family_guide.core_distinction: sick 为形容词，侧重指人处于生病或想吐的感受；sickness 为名词，既可指患病的状态，也可具体指某种疾病或恶心反胃感。

lemmas.def_zh: 宗旨，目标，目的
lemmas.def_en: a tangible and visible entity; an entity that can cast a shadow

examples.en: The primary object of this research is to improve daily energy efficiency.
examples.zh: 这项研究的主要目的是提高日常能源效率。

lemmas.def_zh: 反对；异议；反对的理由
lemmas.def_en: an expression or feeling of disapproval, disagreement, or opposition

examples.en: If no one raises any objection to the proposal, we will proceed to the vote.
examples.zh: 如果大家对该提案没有任何异议，我们就开始进行表决。

lemmas.def_zh: 客观化, 对象化
lemmas.def_en: the act of representing an abstraction as a physical thing

examples.en: Critics argued that the advertisement contributed to the harmful objectification of women in media.
examples.zh: 批评人士认为，该广告助长了媒体对女性的不良对象化现象。

lemmas.def_zh: 反对者, 提出异议的人
lemmas.def_en: a person who dissents from some established policy

examples.en: Several objectors voiced their concerns about the proposed highway expansion plan.
examples.zh: 几位反对者对拟议的高速公路扩建计划表达了担忧。

lemmas.def_zh: 反对，不赞成；提出……作为反对理由
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (+ to) To feel or express disapproval, dissatisfaction, or opposition. 2. [T] (+ that) To state something as a reason for objecting or disagreeing.

examples.en: The primary object of this research is to improve daily energy efficiency.
examples.zh: 这项研究的主要目的是提高日常能源效率。

lemmas.def_zh: 将……物化（降格相待）；使客观化，使具体化
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To treat a person as a mere object or sexual commodity without regard to their dignity or feelings. 2. [T] To express something abstract in a concrete, objective form.

examples.en: Critics argued that the advertisement tended to objectify women for commercial gain.
examples.zh: 批评人士认为该广告为了商业利益而将女性物化。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语前缀 ob-（朝向、反向）+ jacere（投掷），字面为“抛在眼前或迎面掷出”，由此分化出“置于眼前可见之物/关注的目标”（名词）与“迎面投掷言辞加以阻挡”（动词）两大脉络。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词 object 指代客观存在的“物体、对象”或抽象的“目标”，而 objection 专指由动词 object 衍生而来的“异议、反对意见”。

lemmas.def_zh: 压力, 紧迫, 强调, 重音, 重点, 应力
lemmas.def_en: the relative prominence of a syllable or musical note (especially with regard to stress or pitch)

examples.en: She manages her work-related stress by practicing yoga every single evening.
examples.zh: 她每天晚上通过练瑜伽来缓解工作压力。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 紧张性刺激; 应激物
lemmas.def_en: any agent that causes stress to an organism

examples.en: Financial instability remains a major stressor for young families starting out today.
examples.zh: 经济不稳定仍然是当今年轻家庭面临的主要压力源。

lemmas.def_zh: 强调，着重；重读；给……施加压力
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To emphasize or give special importance to a fact, point, or idea. 2. [T] To place emphasis or stress on a word or syllable. 3. [T] To subject something to mechanical or mental stress.

examples.en: She manages her work-related stress by practicing yoga every single evening.
examples.zh: 她每天晚上通过练瑜伽来缓解工作压力。

lemmas.def_zh: 着重, 强调, 重读, 使受应力
lemmas.def_en: extremely irritating to the nerves

examples.en: Moving to a new city can be a stressful experience for anyone.
examples.zh: 对任何人来说，搬到新城市都可能是一种充满压力的经历。

lemmas.def_zh: 不着重的, 不强调的, 不重读的
lemmas.def_en: not bearing a stress or accent

examples.en: In English, unstressed vowels are often pronounced as a short schwa sound.
examples.zh: 在英语中，非重读元音通常发成短弱央元音 /ə/。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 stringere（拉紧、压紧），核心意象为“施加外力使之绷紧”，由此引申出物理应力、心理上的精神压力，以及语言表达中的加重与强调。
family_guide.core_distinction: stressful 主动表特征，指事物“令人紧张的、压力大的”（修饰物或境遇）；stressed 则表被动状态，指人“感到焦虑的、不堪重负的”。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）疲倦，（使）劳累；（使）厌倦
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To become tired or make someone feel tired. 2. [I] (+ of) To become bored with or lose interest in something.

examples.en: Long commutes every day quickly tire even the most energetic commuters.
examples.zh: 每天漫长的通勤很快就会让精力最充沛的上班族感到疲劳。

lemmas.def_zh: 轮胎, 头饰
lemmas.def_en: hoop that covers a wheel

examples.en: Long commutes every day quickly tire even the most energetic commuters.
examples.zh: 每天漫长的通勤很快就会让精力最充沛的上班族感到疲劳。

lemmas.def_zh: 轮胎
lemmas.def_en: a port in southern Lebanon on the Mediterranean Sea; formerly a major Phoenician seaport famous for silks

examples.en: He checked the tyre pressure before embarking on the long road trip.
examples.zh: 在踏上长途公路旅行之前，他检查了轮胎气压。

lemmas.def_zh: 疲劳, 疲倦
lemmas.def_en: temporary loss of strength and energy resulting from hard physical or mental work

examples.en: Overwhelming tiredness forced him to take an afternoon nap after the meeting.
examples.zh: 极度的疲倦迫使他在会议结束后睡了个午觉。

lemmas.def_zh: 不知疲倦地；不屈不挠地
lemmas.def_en: with indefatigable energy

examples.en: The rescue team worked tirelessly throughout the night to find missing hikers.
examples.zh: 救援队整夜不知疲倦地搜寻失踪的徒步旅行者。

lemmas.def_zh: 疲劳地, 累地, 疲倦地
lemmas.def_en: in a weary manner

examples.en: She rubbed her eyes tiredly after staring at the computer screen for hours.
examples.zh: 在盯着电脑屏幕数小时后，她疲惫地揉了揉眼睛。

lemmas.def_zh: 不疲倦的, 不厌倦的, 不屈不挠的
lemmas.def_en: showing sustained enthusiastic action with unflagging vitality

examples.en: Thanks to her tireless efforts, the community garden was successfully established this spring.
examples.zh: 多亏了她不知疲倦的努力，社区花园今年春天成功建成了。

lemmas.def_zh: 不疲倦的, 不懈的, 不屈不挠的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by hard work and perseverance

examples.en: His untiring dedication to the charity inspired many volunteers to join.
examples.zh: 他对慈善事业的不懈奉献激励了许多志愿者加入。

family_guide.root_logic: 动词源于古英语表示“疲倦/竭尽”；名词源自 attire（装束、外罩），引申为车轮外裹的“轮胎”，美式统一拼作 tire，英式则将轮胎拼作 tyre。
family_guide.core_distinction: tire 作动词表示“疲倦/厌倦”，作名词与 tyre 均指“轮胎”；区别在于 tire 是美式拼写（动名词通用），而 tyre 仅作英式拼写的名词。

lemmas.def_zh: 邀请，约请；招致，诱发；征求
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To politely or formally ask someone to come somewhere or do something. 2. [T] To act in a way that makes something unpleasant likely to happen. 3. [T] To solicit or request suggestions, questions, or applications.

examples.en: We would like to invite you to speak at our annual conference.
examples.zh: 我们想邀请您在我们的年度大会上发表演讲。

examples.en: Leaving your front door unlocked simply invites trouble.
examples.zh: 大门不上锁纯粹是自找麻烦。

lemmas.def_zh: 邀请；请柬，邀请函；诱惑，诱因
lemmas.def_en: a written or spoken request asking someone to go somewhere or do something

examples.en: She received a formal invitation to the award ceremony.
examples.zh: 她收到了出席颁奖典礼的正式请柬。

examples.en: He politely declined the invitation due to a prior engagement.
examples.zh: 他因事先有约而礼貌地谢绝了邀请。

lemmas.def_zh: 被邀请者
lemmas.def_en: a visitor to whom hospitality is extended

examples.en: Each invitee received a personalized welcome package upon arriving at the conference.
examples.zh: 每位受邀者在抵达会议现场时都收到了专属的欢迎礼包。

lemmas.def_zh: (限于被)邀请的,怂恿
lemmas.def_en: pertaining to or characteristic of an invitation

examples.en: Top athletes gathered to compete in the prestigious annual invitational tournament.
examples.zh: 顶尖运动员齐聚一堂，参加这项负有盛名的年度邀请赛。

lemmas.def_zh: 无吸引力的, 讨厌的, 不逗人兴趣的
lemmas.def_en: neither attractive nor tempting

examples.en: The dark, abandoned alley looked cold and uninviting in the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 在大雨中，那条黑暗废弃的小巷显得阴冷且毫无人气。

lemmas.def_zh: 吸引人地, 诱人地; 动人地
lemmas.def_en: in a tantalizing manner

examples.en: The warm fireplace glowed invitingly as guests stepped out of the cold.
examples.zh: 当客人们从寒风中走进来时，温暖的壁炉正诱人地闪烁着火光。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 invitare（热情招待、招请），核心概念是通过友好或正式的态度“请求某人前来或参与”，引申出“招致、诱发某种结果”。
family_guide.core_distinction: invite 是核心动作（邀请、招致），而 invitation 是其名词形式，既可指邀请的行为，也可指具体的请柬或邀请函。

lemmas.def_zh: 多重的；众多的；复合的
lemmas.def_en: having or involving several parts, elements, or members; numerous

examples.en: The victim was rushed to the hospital with multiple fractures.
examples.zh: 受害者因多处骨折被紧急送往医院。

examples.en: She had multiple reasons for deciding to decline the job offer.
examples.zh: 她拒绝那份工作邀请有许多理由。

lemmas.def_zh: 多重的；众多的；复合的
lemmas.def_en: having or involving several parts, elements, or members; numerous

examples.en: The victim was rushed to the hospital with multiple fractures.
examples.zh: 受害者因多处骨折被紧急送往医院。

examples.en: She had multiple reasons for deciding to decline the job offer.
examples.zh: 她拒绝那份工作邀请有许多理由。

lemmas.def_zh: 相重性, 多重性, 多样
lemmas.def_en: the property of being multiple

examples.en: The internet offers a multiplicity of resources for independent language learners.
examples.zh: 互联网为自主语言学习者提供了极其多样的资源。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 multiplex（multi-“多” + plec-/plex-“折叠、层”），核心语义为“很多层的”，后引申为“多重的、许多的”及数学概念“倍数”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 同形不同词性：形容词侧重“多样的、多重的”，名词专指数学概念中的“倍数”。

lemmas.def_zh: 高兴的；乐意的；欣慰的
lemmas.def_en: feeling pleasure, joy, or satisfaction; pleased

examples.en: I'm so glad that you could make it to dinner tonight.
examples.zh: 你能来吃今晚的便饭，我真是太高兴了。

examples.en: She was glad to help her neighbor carry the heavy boxes.
examples.zh: 她很乐意帮邻居搬那些沉重的箱子。

lemmas.def_zh: 乐意地；欣然地
lemmas.def_en: willingly, happily, or with pleasure

examples.en: I would gladly lend you the book once I've finished reading it.
examples.zh: 等我读完这本书，我很乐意借给你。

examples.en: They gladly accepted the invitation to join the research project.
examples.zh: 他们欣然接受了加入该研究项目的邀请。

lemmas.def_zh: 欢乐, 欢喜, 喜悦
lemmas.def_en: experiencing joy and pleasure

examples.en: Her heart was filled with gladness upon hearing the wonderful family news.
examples.zh: 听到这个家庭喜讯，她的内心充满了喜悦。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语表示“明亮的、发光的”词根，后引申为内心明朗开阔的心理状态，即“高兴的、乐意的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: glad 作为形容词多作表语，表达对某事发生感到欣慰或乐意；gladly 是副词，侧重以心甘情愿、乐不可支的态度去执行某个动作。

lemmas.def_zh: 学会；研究院；专科院校；私立高中
lemmas.def_en: a school or specialized institution for higher learning, professional training, or the promotion of art/science

examples.en: She was elected as a member of the National Academy of Sciences.
examples.zh: 她当选为国家科学院院士。

examples.en: After high school, he enrolled in a prestigious military academy.
examples.zh: 高中毕业后，他进入了一所著名的军事院校。

lemmas.def_zh: 大学教师；学者；学术界人士
lemmas.def_en: a person who teaches or does research at a college or university

examples.en: The conference brought together leading academics and industry experts from around the world.
examples.zh: 此次研讨会汇集了来自世界各地的顶尖学者与行业专家。

examples.en: He left his career as an academic to work in the private sector.
examples.zh: 他放弃了大学学者的职业，转入私营企业工作。

lemmas.def_zh: 学术界, 学术生涯
lemmas.def_en: the academic world

examples.en: After years in the private sector, she chose to return to academia.
examples.zh: 在私营部门工作多年后，她选择重返学术界。

lemmas.def_zh: 学会会员, 院士, 学究, 大学生, 学者
lemmas.def_en: someone elected to honorary membership in an academy

examples.en: The respected academician gave an insightful lecture on quantum mechanics at the university.
examples.zh: 这位受人尊敬的院士在大学里就量子力学做了一场深刻的讲座。

lemmas.def_zh: 学术上；学业上
lemmas.def_en: in regard to academic matters

examples.en: The school offers great support for students who struggle academically during exams.
examples.zh: 该校为在考试期间学业吃力的学生提供大力支持。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于古希腊柏拉图讲学的阿卡德米（Akadēmeia）圣林，由此演变为代表学术、专业研究的高等机构及从事该事业的人员。
family_guide.core_distinction: academy 指学会、专科院校等学术机构本身；academic 作名词时指大学教师或学者等学术人员。

lemmas.def_zh: 女王；王后；（国际象棋）后；（扑克牌）Q；蜂后，蚁后；佼佼者
lemmas.def_en: a female sovereign ruler, the wife of a king, or the most powerful piece in chess

examples.en: She sacrificed her queen in a brilliant tactical move to win the chess match.
examples.zh: 她在一次绝妙的战术进攻中弃后，最终赢得了这场国际象棋比赛。

examples.en: The honeybee colony cannot survive without a fertile queen laying eggs.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂群体如果没有一只具备繁殖能力的蜂后产卵，便无法生存下去。

lemmas.def_zh: 立为女王（或王后）；（国际象棋中）使（兵）升变为后；摆谱，显威风
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (chess) To promote a pawn to a queen, or become a queen. 2. [I] (often queen it) To behave in an imperious or superior manner.

examples.en: She sacrificed her queen in a brilliant tactical move to win the chess match.
examples.zh: 她在一次绝妙的战术进攻中弃后，最终赢得了这场国际象棋比赛。

examples.en: The honeybee colony cannot survive without a fertile queen laying eggs.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂群体如果没有一只具备繁殖能力的蜂后产卵，便无法生存下去。

lemmas.def_zh: 女王的
lemmas.def_en: having the rank of or resembling or befitting a queen

examples.en: She walked across the stage with a queenly grace that captivated everyone.
examples.zh: 她以女王般的优雅穿过舞台，吸引了所有人。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 cwēn（女人、妻子），语义逐步升格专指国王的配偶或女性君主，后引申为国际象棋最强棋子、蜂后等首领角色，动词则引申出升变为后或摆首领架子之意。

lemmas.def_zh: 生病的, 邪恶的, 不吉利的, 敌意的, 不良的, 不顺利的
lemmas.def_en: affected by an impairment of normal physical or mental function

examples.en: He stayed home from school because he felt suddenly ill that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上他因为突然感到身体不适而没去上学。

lemmas.def_zh: 疾病, 坏事, 罪恶, 灾难
lemmas.def_en: an often persistent bodily disorder or disease; a cause for complaining

examples.en: He dedicated his entire life to fighting the social ills that plagued his community.
examples.zh: 他毕生致力于同困扰社区的各种社会弊病作斗争。

lemmas.def_zh: 疾病, 恶意
lemmas.def_en: impairment of normal physiological function affecting part or all of an organism

examples.en: A sudden illness prevented her from attending the international conference held in Paris last week.
examples.zh: 一场突如其来的疾病让她未能参加上周在巴黎举行的国际会议。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古诺斯语 illr（坏的、邪恶的），核心语义从“不良、有害”衍生出“生理不适”，现代英语中兼具身体生病与抽象危害两个维度的含义。
family_guide.core_distinction: ill 作名词多以复数形式（ills）指社会的“弊病、祸害”；illness 则专指生理或心理上的“疾病、患病状态”。

lemmas.def_zh: 退职，退休；引退，隐退；就寝
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. [I] To stop working, especially after reaching a certain age. 2. [I] (+ to) To withdraw to a quiet or private place; to go to bed.

examples.en: She plans to retire from teaching at the end of this academic year.
examples.zh: 她打算在本学年结束时从教师岗位上退休。

examples.en: Exhausted after the long journey, he decided to retire early for the night.
examples.zh: 长途旅行后他疲惫不堪，决定早早就寝休息。

lemmas.def_zh: 退休；退休生活；退役
lemmas.def_en: the state of having left one's job and ceased to work; the period of life after retiring

examples.en: He has been saving diligently to ensure a comfortable retirement.
examples.zh: 他一直在勤勉地存钱，以确保过上舒适的退休生活。

examples.en: Many athletes struggle with the transition into retirement after professional sports.
examples.zh: 许多运动员在告别职业体育退役后，都很难适应这种转变。

lemmas.def_zh: 退休人员, 退休者
lemmas.def_en: someone who has retired from active working

examples.en: Many retirees choose to spend their leisure time volunteering at local libraries and community centers.
examples.zh: 许多退休人员选择在当地图书馆和社区中心做志愿者来度过闲暇时光。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 退休的，退役的
lemmas.def_en: no longer active in your work or profession, typically having reached a certain age
lemmas.usage_note: 常置于职位或名词前，如 retired teacher（退休教师）、retired military officer（退役军官）。

examples.en: My grandfather is a retired physician who now enjoys gardening.
examples.zh: 我祖父是一名退休医生，现在很喜欢园艺。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自前缀 re-（向后）+ tirer（拉、拽），本义为“向后抽离、退避”，引申为从职场退隐的“退休”及退入私密空间的“就寝、退出”。
family_guide.core_distinction: retire 为动词，强调“停止工作”或“退隐”的动作；retirement 为名词，指“退休”这一状态、事件或退休后的生活阶段。

lemmas.def_zh: 极好的，令人赞叹的；令人敬畏的
lemmas.def_en: extremely impressive, serious, or difficult so that one feels great respect; extremely good

examples.en: We had an awesome view of the sunset from the top of the mountain.
examples.zh: 从山顶俯瞰日落，景色令人叹为观止。

examples.en: You did an awesome job on the presentation today.
examples.zh: 你今天的主题演讲做得太棒了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于名词 awe（敬畏、肃穆）加后缀 -some（充满……的），最初指“令人肃然起敬的”，在现代英语中语义弱化并褒义化，广泛用于表示“极好的、令人赞叹的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 与同源词 awful（演变为“极糟糕的”）形成鲜明对立，awesome 现代主要表极度积极的赞美（“太棒了”）。

lemmas.def_zh: 移动的, 易变的, 机动的
lemmas.def_en: migratory

examples.en: Our support team uses mobile workstations to assist customers quickly during busy trade show events.
examples.zh: 我们的支持团队在繁忙的展会期间使用移动工作站快速协助客户。

lemmas.def_zh: 活动物体
lemmas.def_en: a river in southwestern Alabama; flows into Mobile Bay

examples.en: Our support team uses mobile workstations to assist customers quickly during busy trade show events.
examples.zh: 我们的支持团队在繁忙的展会期间使用移动工作站快速协助客户。

lemmas.def_zh: 可动性, 流动性, 机动性
lemmas.def_en: the quality of moving freely

examples.en: Regular physical therapy helped the injured athlete regain full mobility in his left knee joint.
examples.zh: 定期的物理治疗帮助这位受伤的运动员完全恢复了左膝关节的活动能力。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 movere（移动）派生的 mobilis（易动的、灵活的），核心逻辑始终围绕“具备运动、活动或转移的能力”。
family_guide.core_distinction: mobile 可作形容词表“可移动的”，作名词常指“手机”或“悬挂饰物”；mobility 则是抽象名词，侧重“活动能力”或“社会阶层流动性”。

lemmas.def_zh: 鸟, 羽毛球
lemmas.def_en: warm-blooded egg-laying vertebrates characterized by feathers and forelimbs modified as wings

examples.en: A colorful bird landed softly on the wooden fence outside my bedroom window this morning.
examples.zh: 今天清晨，一只色彩斑斓的鸟儿轻轻落在我卧室窗外的木栅栏上。

lemmas.def_zh: 猎鸟者
lemmas.def_en: a person who identifies and studies birds in their natural habitats

examples.en: The enthusiastic birder traveled across the country just to spot an extremely rare northern owl.
examples.zh: 这位热情的观鸟者横穿全国，只为一睹极其罕见的北方猫头鹰。

lemmas.def_zh: 观鸟，户外追踪观察鸟类
lemmas.def_en: [I] To observe, track, and identify wild birds in their natural habitats as a hobby.

examples.en: A colorful bird landed softly on the wooden fence outside my bedroom window this morning.
examples.zh: 今天清晨，一只色彩斑斓的鸟儿轻轻落在我卧室窗外的木栅栏上。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语雏鸟之称，后演化为所有有羽毛、产卵的脊椎动物的统称；现代通过名词转动词引申为在野外观察、识别鸟类（即观鸟）。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词表示鸟类本身；动词等同于 birdwatch，专门指代在自然环境中观察和记录野鸟的业余爱好活动。

lemmas.def_zh: 发出轻微的咔哒声；使发出咔哒声；点击；豁然开朗
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To make or cause to make a short, sharp clicking sound. 2. [I, T] (computing) To press a mouse button. 3. [I] (informal) To suddenly become clear or understood.

examples.en: She pressed the switch and heard a distinct click, signaling that the device was on.
examples.zh: 她按下开关，听到清脆的咔哒一声，表明设备已经开启。

lemmas.def_zh: 咔哒声, 啪嗒声
lemmas.def_en: a short light metallic sound

examples.en: She pressed the switch and heard a distinct click, signaling that the device was on.
examples.zh: 她按下开关，听到清脆的咔哒一声，表明设备已经开启。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词起源，模拟短促清脆的轻击声（咔哒声），后引申为机械/鼠标按键的点击动作，以及如卡扣吻合般的抽象概念（豁然开朗、合得来）。

lemmas.def_zh: 阿拉伯数字（0至9）；手指，脚趾
lemmas.def_en: any of the numerals from 0 to 9; a finger or toe

examples.en: Please enter the last four digits of your credit card number.
examples.zh: 请输入您信用卡卡号的最后四位数字。

examples.en: The company's profits rose by double digits for the second consecutive year.
examples.zh: 该公司的利润已连续第二年实现两位数增长。

lemmas.def_zh: 数字化, 数位化, 数码化
lemmas.def_en: conversion of analog information into digital information

examples.en: The rapid digitization of public records made it much easier for citizens to access information.
examples.zh: 公共档案的快速数字化使市民获取信息变得更加容易。

lemmas.def_zh: 数字转换器
lemmas.def_en: device for converting analogue signals into digital signals

examples.en: The digital artist used a high-resolution digitizer to convert her handmade pencil drawings into files.
examples.zh: 这位数字艺术家使用高分辨率数字化仪将她的手绘铅笔画转换为文件。

lemmas.def_zh: 洋地黄
lemmas.def_en: a powerful cardiac stimulant obtained from foxglove

examples.en: The physician prescribed digitalis to help stabilize the patient's irregular heartbeat.
examples.zh: 医生开了洋地黄来帮助稳定该患者不齐的心律。

lemmas.def_zh: [药]洋地黄丸
lemmas.def_en: the administration of digitalis for the treatment of certain heart disorders

lemmas.def_zh: 数字的，数码的；数字显示的
lemmas.def_en: using or relating to computer technology, electronics, or binary code

examples.en: The transition from analog to digital television was completed last year.
examples.zh: 从模拟电视向数字电视的转变已于去年完成。

examples.en: Businesses must embrace digital transformation to remain competitive in today's market.
examples.zh: 企业必须推进数字化转型，才能在当今市场中保持竞争力。

lemmas.def_zh: 数位
lemmas.def_en: by means of the fingers

examples.en: All official documents are now stored digitally to reduce paper waste and enhance data security.
examples.zh: 所有官方文件现在都以数字化形式存储，以减少纸张浪费并提高数据安全性。

lemmas.def_zh: 使数字化，数码化
lemmas.def_en: [T] to convert pictures, sound, or information into a digital form that can be processed by a computer.

examples.en: The national library plans to digitize thousands of historical manuscripts for free public research online.
examples.zh: 国家图书馆计划将数千份历史手稿数字化，供公众免费在线研究。

lemmas.def_zh: 使数字化，数码化
lemmas.def_en: [T] (British English) to convert information, images, or sound into a digital format.

examples.en: Our department needs to digitise these old financial documents before the storage room is cleared.
examples.zh: 在清理储藏室之前，我们部门需要将这些旧财务文件进行数字化处理。

lemmas.def_zh: [医]以洋地黄治疗
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To convert data or processes into digital form. 2. [T] (medicine) To treat a patient with the heart drug digitalis.

examples.en: The medical team chose to digitalize the patient safely to treat heart failure.
examples.zh: 医疗团队选择对该患者安全使用洋地黄以治疗心力衰竭。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 digitus（手指），古人借手指计数引申为“0至9的数字”，在现代科技中进一步引申为以二进制数值为基础的“数码、数字技术”。
family_guide.core_distinction: digit 是名词，指具体的单个数字（0-9）或手指脚趾；digital 是形容词，指采用计算机数码技术的或数字显示的。

lemmas.def_zh: 利润, 赢利, 利益
lemmas.def_en: the excess of revenues over outlays in a given period of time (including depreciation and other non-cash expenses)

examples.en: The technology company reported a record profit after launching its innovative mobile phone last quarter.
examples.zh: 这家科技公司在上季度推出其创新手机后，报告了创纪录的利润。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 非营利的, 无利可图的
lemmas.def_en: an organization chartered for other than profit-making activities

examples.en: She works for an international nonprofit that provides clean drinking water to remote rural villages.
examples.zh: 她为一家向偏远农村地区提供清洁饮用水的国际非营利组织工作。

lemmas.def_zh: 获暴利的人, 奸商
lemmas.def_en: someone who makes excessive profit (especially on goods in short supply)

examples.en: Shady traders attempted to profiteer from the sudden shortage of medical supplies.
examples.zh: 不法商贩企图从医疗物资的突发短缺中谋取暴利。

lemmas.def_zh: 获利，赚钱；得益，受益；有益于
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (+ from/by) to gain a financial benefit, advantage, or profit from an activity 2. [T] to be of service, advantage, or benefit to someone

examples.en: The technology company reported a record profit after launching its innovative mobile phone last quarter.
examples.zh: 这家科技公司在上季度推出其创新手机后，报告了创纪录的利润。

lemmas.def_zh: 牟取暴利，投机倒把
lemmas.def_en: [I] (disapproving) To make an unfair or excessive profit, especially by charging exorbitant prices during a shortage, crisis, or war.

examples.en: Shady traders attempted to profiteer from the sudden shortage of medical supplies.
examples.zh: 不法商贩企图从医疗物资的突发短缺中谋取暴利。

lemmas.def_zh: 无利的, 无益的
lemmas.def_en: without profit or reward; - D.D.Eisenhower; - Shakespeare

examples.en: The board decided to abandon the profitless venture and focus resources on their core business.
examples.zh: 董事会决定放弃这项无利可图的合资项目，将资源集中在核心业务上。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 profectus（前进、增长），由 pro-（向前）+ facere（做）构成，核心语义从“向前推进”演化为“产生增量与收益”。
family_guide.core_distinction: profit 可兼作名词（利润/收益）与动词（获利/得益），nonprofit 则是带有否定前缀 non- 的派生词，专指不以营利为目的的机构。

lemmas.def_zh: 灵魂，精神；心灵，内心情感；核心，灵魂人物；人，个体
lemmas.def_en: the spiritual or immaterial part of a human being; the essence or emotional core; an individual person

examples.en: She poured her heart and soul into directing the school play.
examples.zh: 她全心全意地投入到执导这部校园话剧中。

examples.en: There wasn't a single soul in sight on the quiet country lane.
examples.zh: 寂静的乡间小道上一个人影也没有。

lemmas.def_zh: 充满感情, 深情
lemmas.def_en: deep feeling or emotion

examples.en: The incredible soulfulness of her singing voice moved the entire audience to tears that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上，她歌声中令人难以置信的深情让全场观众感动落泪。

lemmas.def_zh: 充满精神的, 感情上的, 高尚的
lemmas.def_en: full of or expressing deep emotion

examples.en: The singer delivered a soulful performance that moved the entire audience to tears.
examples.zh: 歌手深情动人的演唱让全场观众感动落泪。

lemmas.def_zh: 没有精神的, 没有灵魂的, 泄气的
lemmas.def_en: lacking sensitivity or the capacity for deep feeling

examples.en: Many critics dismissed the newly built concrete tower as cold and soulless.
examples.zh: 许多评论家批评新建的混凝土大楼冰冷且毫无生气。

lemmas.def_zh: 充满感情地, 深情地
lemmas.def_en: in a soulful manner

examples.en: He gazed soulfully into her eyes, waiting for an honest answer.
examples.zh: 他深情地注视着她的双眼，等待一个坦诚的回答。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 sāwol，核心意象为赋予生命的“灵气”与“精神核心”，后引申为人的内心情感、事物的灵魂本质以及指代“人/个体”。

lemmas.def_zh: 烦恼, 麻烦, 困难, 动乱, 故障
lemmas.def_en: a source of difficulty

examples.en: Persistent financial trouble forced the small family business to close permanently.
examples.zh: 持续不断的财务困扰迫使这家家族小企业永久倒闭。

lemmas.def_zh: 使烦恼，困扰，麻烦；费心
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To cause someone worry, distress, or physical pain; bother someone to do something.

examples.en: Persistent financial trouble forced the small family business to close permanently.
examples.zh: 持续不断的财务困扰迫使这家家族小企业永久倒闭。

lemmas.def_zh: 不烦恼的, 无忧虑的, 未被扰乱的, 未受骚扰的, 平静的
lemmas.def_en: not beset by troubles or disturbance or distress

examples.en: She slept through the loud thunderstorm, completely untroubled by the noise.
examples.zh: 她在这场喧闹的雷雨中安然入睡，丝毫未受噪音打扰。

lemmas.def_zh: 暴风雨般的, 棘手的, 动荡不安的
lemmas.def_en: full of trouble

examples.en: The nation struggled to rebuild its economy during those troublous postwar years.
examples.zh: 在战后那段动荡不安的岁月里，该国艰难地重建经济。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于拉丁语 turbulare（搅乱、扰动），与 turbulent（动荡的）同源，核心意象是“打破平静与秩序”，引申为生活、心理或机能上的困扰与麻烦。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词侧重指产生的困难、毛病或负面处境（常用于 in trouble / have trouble doing）；动词侧重扰动心神、施加负担或礼貌用语中的“劳驾”。

lemmas.def_zh: 贷款, 借出
lemmas.def_en: the temporary provision of money (usually at interest)

examples.en: The university library agreed to loan several rare manuscripts to the museum.
examples.zh: 大学图书馆同意向博物馆出借几份珍贵的手稿。

lemmas.def_zh: 借出，贷给；出借
lemmas.def_en: [T] To lend money, an object, or an artwork to someone temporarily.

examples.en: The university library agreed to loan several rare manuscripts to the museum.
examples.zh: 大学图书馆同意向博物馆出借几份珍贵的手稿。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古诺斯语，核心语义为“将财物或金钱暂时交予他人使用并附有归还之约”，现代演化出借贷行为及其具体对象（贷款）。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词表示借贷行为或所借款项（常与 bank, take out, on 搭配）；动词表示借出（美式英语中常用作 lend 的同义词）。

lemmas.def_zh: 肥的, 胖的, 油腻的
lemmas.def_en: having an (over)abundance of flesh

examples.en: Consuming too much saturated fat can significantly increase your risk of disease.
examples.zh: 摄入过多饱和脂肪会显著增加患病风险。

lemmas.def_zh: 脂肪, 脂油, 肥肉；文件分配表
lemmas.def_en: a soft greasy substance occurring in organic tissue and consisting of a mixture of lipids (mostly triglycerides)

examples.en: Consuming too much saturated fat can significantly increase your risk of disease.
examples.zh: 摄入过多饱和脂肪会显著增加患病风险。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 脂肪的
lemmas.def_en: a rotund individual

examples.en: Doctors warned him that an unhealthy diet could eventually lead to fatty liver.
examples.zh: 医生警告他，不健康的饮食最终可能导致脂肪肝。

lemmas.def_zh: 肥胖, 油腻
lemmas.def_en: excess bodily weight

examples.en: The deliberate fatness of the prize pigs surprised everyone at the fair.
examples.zh: 集市上获奖肉猪的肥硕体型令所有人都感到惊讶。

lemmas.def_zh: 脂肪, 脂肪质, 多脂肪
lemmas.def_en: having the property of containing fat

examples.en: A squeeze of fresh lemon juice helps balance the fattiness of the meat.
examples.zh: 挤上一滴新鲜柠檬汁有助于中和肉质的油腻感。

lemmas.def_zh: 使长胖，催肥，养肥
lemmas.def_en: [T] To feed an animal or person well to make them plump, fat, or ready for slaughter.

examples.en: Consuming too much saturated fat can significantly increase your risk of disease.
examples.zh: 摄入过多饱和脂肪会显著增加患病风险。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 fǣtt（受喂养的、长肥的），核心语义始终围绕“脂肪丰富、肉多丰腴”展开，后引申为动词“养肥”以及形容收益“丰厚的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: fat 作名词主要指物质层面的“脂肪、油脂”；fatty 作名词为口语/非正式用法，指“胖子”（常带戏谑或贬义）。

lemmas.def_zh: 船长, 指挥官, 海军上校, 首领
lemmas.def_en: an officer holding a rank below a major but above a lieutenant

examples.en: She was chosen to captain the national soccer team in the upcoming tournament.
examples.zh: 她被选拔在即将到来的锦标赛中率领国家足球队。

lemmas.def_zh: 首领(或队长)之职, 统率者资格
lemmas.def_en: the post of captain

examples.en: Under his inspiring captainship, the squad won their first championship in decades.
examples.zh: 在他振奋人心的领导下，这支队伍赢得了数十年来的首个冠军。

lemmas.def_zh: 统领，担任……的队长（或船长、机长）
lemmas.def_en: [T] to act as the leader or captain of a sports team, ship, or aircraft.

examples.en: She was chosen to captain the national soccer team in the upcoming tournament.
examples.zh: 她被选拔在即将到来的锦标赛中率领国家足球队。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 caput（头），核心意象为“领头人、首脑”，逐步演变为各领域的指挥官、船长、机长或团队领队，动词则表示“担任队长或指挥官”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 该词名词指不同领域的指挥者或领队；动词则直接表示担任队长/船长或统领团队，词义高度一致。

lemmas.def_zh: 伤害，创伤；损害
lemmas.def_en: physical harm or damage to someone's body; damage done to reputation, feelings, or rights

examples.en: He sustained a serious knee injury during the match and will miss the rest of the season.
examples.zh: 他在比赛中膝盖严重受伤，将缺席本赛季剩余的所有比赛。

examples.en: Wearing a helmet significantly reduces the risk of head injury.
examples.zh: 佩戴头盔能显著降低头部受伤的风险。

lemmas.def_en: not injured physically or mentally
lemmas.def_zh: 未受损害的, 未受伤害的

examples.en: Fortunately, both drivers were completely uninjured after the minor collision.
examples.zh: 幸运的是，两名司机在轻微碰撞后均未受伤。

lemmas.def_zh: 有害的, 不公正的
lemmas.def_en: harmful to living things

examples.en: Smoking cigarettes is widely known to be injurious to personal health.
examples.zh: 众所周知，吸烟对个人身体健康是有害的。

lemmas.def_zh: 伤害地, 有害地
lemmas.def_en: in an injurious manner

examples.en: The toxic chemical spill injuriously affected the local river ecosystem for months.
examples.zh: 有毒化学品泄漏事件连续数月对当地河流生态系统造成了有害影响。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To cause physical harm or bodily injury to someone; to damage or impair something.
lemmas.def_zh: 使受伤，弄伤（身体）；损害，破坏（名誉等）

examples.en: He injured his knee while playing soccer over the weekend.
examples.zh: 他周末踢足球时伤到了膝盖。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语前缀 in-（非、不）+ jus/juris（权利、正义），原义为“侵害权利的不公行为”，后引申为广义的“创伤、损害”。

lemmas.def_zh: 守卫者, 警戒, 护卫队, 防护装置
lemmas.def_en: a person who keeps watch over something or someone

examples.en: Armed police officers stood guard outside the embassy building throughout the night.
examples.zh: 全副武装的警官们整夜在使馆大楼外保持警戒。

lemmas.def_zh: 守护，保卫；看守；警惕，防范
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To protect a person, place, or object from attack or danger. 2. [I, T] To watch over prisoners to prevent escape. 3. [I] (+ against) To take precautions to prevent something bad.

examples.en: Armed police officers stood guard outside the embassy building throughout the night.
examples.zh: 全副武装的警官们整夜在使馆大楼外保持警戒。

lemmas.def_zh: 没有防卫的, 不留神的, 不小心的, 大意的
lemmas.def_en: lacking protection or a guard

examples.en: In an unguarded moment, the exhausted diplomat accidentally revealed the secret strategy.
examples.zh: 在疏忽大意的一瞬间，精疲力竭的外交官不慎泄露了秘密策略。

lemmas.def_zh: 被保卫着, 不多话, 谨慎, 安全, 被监视着, 被看守着
lemmas.def_en: in a conservative manner

examples.en: The spokesperson answered the reporter's sharp question guardedly to avoid controversy.
examples.zh: 发言人谨慎地回答了记者的尖锐提问以避免引发争议。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语系词根（与 ward 同源），核心意象为“注视并保持警惕”，由此衍生出“守卫者、防范机制”及“看守、防护”的动作。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词既可指担任看守的“人/卫兵”，也可指抽象的“警惕状态”或具体的“防护装置”；动词则涵盖“保卫”与“预防/提防 (guard against)”两种视角。

lemmas.def_zh: （某项活动的）一段时间，一场；（议会、法庭等的）会议，开庭期；学年，学期
lemmas.def_en: a period of time devoted to a specific activity, or a formal meeting of an official body

examples.en: The coach scheduled an intensive training session ahead of the championship match.
examples.zh: 教练在锦标赛前安排了一场强化训练。

examples.en: Parliament is currently in session to discuss the proposed tax reforms.
examples.zh: 议会目前正在开会，讨论提议的税收改革法案。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 sedere（坐），由名词 sessio（坐着开会、商讨）演变而来，核心义指“坐在一起进行的正式集会”，后引申为从事某项特定活动所集中的“一段时间”。

lemmas.def_zh: 冬季, 萧条期, 衰退期
lemmas.def_en: the coldest season of the year; in the northern hemisphere it extends from the winter solstice to the vernal equinox

examples.en: A harsh, freezing winter settled quickly over the remote mountain village.
examples.zh: 严酷刺骨的寒冬迅速笼罩了这座偏远的小山村。

lemmas.def_zh: 过冬，越冬；使（动植物等）过冬
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To spend the winter in a particular place. 2. [T] To keep, feed, or protect animals or plants during the winter.

examples.en: Many elderly residents choose to winter in warmer southern states to escape the cold.
examples.zh: 许多老年人选择在更温暖的南部各州过冬以躲避严寒。

lemmas.def_zh: 使准备过冬, 使防冻
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (chiefly North American) To winterize a house, vehicle, or equipment means to prepare and insulate it against cold winter weather.

examples.en: You need to winterize your outdoor pipes before the freezing temperatures arrive this weekend.
examples.zh: 在这个周末降温结冰之前，你需要为室外管道做好防冻准备。

lemmas.def_zh: 如冬的, 寒冷的, 冬的, 冷淡的
lemmas.def_en: characteristic of or occurring in winter

examples.en: A sharp and wintry wind swept through the empty streets last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚，一股刺骨的寒风席卷了空旷的街道。

lemmas.def_zh: 冬天的, 似冬天的, 寒冷的, 风雪交加的, 多雪的, 冷淡的, 无热情的, 苍老的
lemmas.def_en: characteristic of or occurring in winter

examples.en: A sudden wintery blast brought heavy snow and icy winds across the valley.
examples.zh: 一阵突如其来的寒冷风雪给整个山谷带来了大雪和刺骨的寒风。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语，核心语义指一年中降水最多、最严寒的季节（冬季），动词由名词直接转类，引申为“度过冬季”或“使越冬”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词表示“冬季”这一季节，动词表示人或动植物“度过冬天”或“使越冬”。

lemmas.def_zh: 尖端，顶端
lemmas.def_en: the extreme end of something; especially something pointed

examples.en: The tip of the needle is extremely sharp.
examples.zh: 针尖极其锋利。

lemmas.def_zh: [化] 翻斗车
lemmas.def_en: a person who leaves a tip

examples.en: The heavy tipper unloaded tons of gravel onto the newly paved road.
examples.zh: 重型翻斗车将数吨碎石卸到了新铺设的道路上。

lemmas.def_zh: 情报贩子
lemmas.def_en: one who sells advice about gambling or speculation (especially at the racetrack)

examples.en: Police arrested the suspect after receiving an anonymous call from a reliable tipster.
examples.zh: 警方在接到一名可靠情报提供者的匿名电话后逮捕了嫌疑人。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）倾斜，（使）翻倒；倒出；给小费
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To lean or slant, or cause something to fall over or onto its side. 2. [T] To empty or pour contents out of a container by turning it over. 3. [I, T] To give a small sum of money to someone for service.

examples.en: Be careful not to tip the ladder while you are painting the high ceiling.
examples.zh: 粉刷高处的天花板时，小心不要弄翻梯子。

family_guide.root_logic: 核心源于日耳曼语中表示“尖端、末梢”的概念；由“尖端”引申出“倾斜/翻倒”（顶端偏离）与“轻触点拨”，再进一步虚化为附带的琐细之物，演变出“小费”（零星酬劳）与“实用提示/秘诀”（微小而切中要害的建议）。

lemmas.def_zh: 本质，精髓
lemmas.def_en: the fundamental nature or most important quality of something; a concentrated extract

examples.en: Mutual trust is the very essence of a successful partnership.
examples.zh: 相互信任是成功合作关系的真正本质。

examples.en: In essence, the two proposals are aiming for the exact same outcome.
examples.zh: 本质上，这两份提案追求的结果完全一致。

lemmas.def_zh: 必需品；基本要素，必不可少之物
lemmas.def_en: something that is extremely important, fundamental, or necessary

examples.en: Make sure you pack travel essentials like your passport, medications, and chargers.
examples.zh: 确保带上护照、常备药和充电器等旅行必需品。

examples.en: The course covers the bare essentials of digital photography.
examples.zh: 这门课程涵盖数码摄影最核心的基本要素。

lemmas.def_zh: 不重要的人
lemmas.def_en: anything that is not essential

examples.en: During the budget crisis, the department had to eliminate several nonessentials from the payroll.
examples.zh: 在预算危机期间，该部门不得不从薪资名单中裁减几名非核心人员。

lemmas.def_zh: 根本性, 真髓, 本质
lemmas.def_en: basic importance

examples.en: The professor emphasized the essentiality of critical thinking in modern academic research.
examples.zh: 教授强调了批判性思维在现代学术研究中的本质重要性。

lemmas.def_zh: 本质上；基本上，大体上
lemmas.def_en: in fundamental nature; basically or primarily

examples.en: The two smartphone models are essentially identical beneath the casing.
examples.zh: 两款手机外壳之下本质上是完全相同的。

examples.en: What the report is essentially saying is that costs need to be reduced.
examples.zh: 该报告大体上要表达的就是需要削减成本。

lemmas.def_zh: 非本质上的, 非重要的, 非必要的
lemmas.def_en: not basic or fundamental

examples.en: Try to cut out unessential details to make your final report much clearer.
examples.zh: 尽量删去不重要的细节，使你的最终报告更加清晰。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 esse（存在、是），核心语义从“事物最根本的存在”演化为“本质、精髓”，进而派生出表示“不可或缺之物”的相关词汇。
family_guide.core_distinction: essence 指不可分割的抽象“本质、精髓”；essential 作名词时多用复数 essentials，指维持某事所必需的“具体物品或基本要素”。

lemmas.def_zh: 票, 券, 车票, 标签, 入场券, 证明书
lemmas.def_en: a commercial document showing that the holder is entitled to something (as to ride on public transportation or to enter a public entertainment)

examples.en: All items in the vintage store were neatly ticketed with their respective prices.
examples.zh: 古董店里的所有物品都整齐地贴上了标明各自价格的标签。

lemmas.def_zh: 对……开违规罚单；为……购票（或售票）
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. to issue an official notice of a traffic offense or other fine to someone. 2. to provide someone or something with a ticket.

examples.en: All items in the vintage store were neatly ticketed with their respective prices.
examples.zh: 古董店里的所有物品都整齐地贴上了标明各自价格的标签。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 étiquette（小纸条、便签），核心意象为“载有信息的小卡片/凭证”，后演变为乘车或观演的“票券”以及违规受罚的“通知单（罚单）”。

lemmas.def_zh: 候选人；求职者；应试者；适合……的人（或事物）
lemmas.def_en: a person who applies for a job or is nominated for election, or someone/something likely to receive or experience something

examples.en: She was widely regarded as the most qualified candidate for the managerial position.
examples.zh: 她被广泛认为是该管理职位最合适的人选。

examples.en: Due to severe water damage, the old bridge is a prime candidate for demolition.
examples.zh: 由于严重受损，这座老桥成了最可能被拆除的对象。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 candidus（白色的），古罗马公职竞选者身穿洁白长袍以示纯洁正直，后演变为竞选、求职或评选中的“候选人”。

lemmas.def_zh: [n.] 金属；合金；[adj.] 金属制的；[v.] 用碎石铺（路）
lemmas.def_en: [n.] a hard chemical substance that conducts heat and electricity; [adj.] made of metal; [v.] to pave or repair a road with crushed stone

examples.en: Gold and iron are among the most widely used metals in human history.
examples.zh: 黄金和铁是人类历史上使用最广泛的金属之一。

examples.en: They replaced the old wooden frame with a sturdy metal structure.
examples.zh: 他们用坚固的金属结构替换了旧木架。

examples.en: The council hired contractors to metal the worn rural road with crushed gravel.
examples.zh: 市政委员会雇佣了承包商用碎石修铺这条破损的乡村道路。

lemmas.def_zh: [n.] 金属色织物；金属质感颜料（或车漆）；金属线
lemmas.def_en: [n.] a fabric, paint, or thread that has a shiny, metal-like appearance

examples.en: The designer's latest runway collection featured futuristic dresses woven with shimmering metallics.
examples.zh: 这位设计师最新的走秀系列以闪耀的金属色面料编织的未来感礼服为主打。

examples.en: Car buyers can choose between flat enamel colors and premium metallics.
examples.zh: 购车者可以在普通漆色和高档金属漆之间进行选择。

lemmas.def_zh: 非金属
lemmas.def_en: a chemical element lacking typical metallic properties

examples.en: Sulfur is a typical nonmetal that behaves differently from ordinary metallic elements.
examples.zh: 硫是一种典型的非金属，其性质与普通金属元素截然不同。

lemmas.def_zh: [n.] 金属；合金；[adj.] 金属制的；[v.] 用碎石铺（路）
lemmas.def_en: [n.] a hard chemical substance that conducts heat and electricity; [adj.] made of metal; [v.] to pave or repair a road with crushed stone

examples.en: Gold and iron are among the most widely used metals in human history.
examples.zh: 黄金和铁是人类历史上使用最广泛的金属之一。

examples.en: They replaced the old wooden frame with a sturdy metal structure.
examples.zh: 他们用坚固的金属结构替换了旧木架。

examples.en: The council hired contractors to metal the worn rural road with crushed gravel.
examples.zh: 市政委员会雇佣了承包商用碎石修铺这条破损的乡村道路。

lemmas.def_zh: 非金属的
lemmas.def_en: not containing or resembling or characteristic of a metal

examples.en: The mechanic replaced the damaged part with a durable nonmetallic composite material.
examples.zh: 机械师用耐用的非金属复合材料替换了损坏的部件。

lemmas.def_zh: 用碎石铺（路）
lemmas.def_en: [T] To pave, surface, or repair a road with crushed stone or gravel.

examples.en: Gold and iron are among the most widely used metals in human history.
examples.zh: 黄金和铁是人类历史上使用最广泛的金属之一。

examples.en: They replaced the old wooden frame with a sturdy metal structure.
examples.zh: 他们用坚固的金属结构替换了旧木架。

examples.en: The council hired contractors to metal the worn rural road with crushed gravel.
examples.zh: 市政委员会雇佣了承包商用碎石修铺这条破损的乡村道路。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古希腊语 metallon（矿山、矿石），核心义围绕矿物精炼而成的硬质导电实体“金属”，并衍生出“碎石路料/铺路”及属性特征。
