family_guide.core_distinction: metal 本身可兼作名词、形容词（纯金属制成的）及动词；metallic 偏向具有金属的光泽、质感或成分属性，作名词时专指金属光泽织物或金属漆。

lemmas.def_zh: 行为，举止；习性；（机械等的）运转状态（美式）
lemmas.def_en: the way that someone or something acts or functions (American spelling)

examples.en: His disruptive behavior in class forced the teacher to call his parents.
examples.zh: 他在课堂上的捣乱行为迫使老师通知了他的父母。

examples.en: Researchers are studying the social behavior of African elephants in the wild.
examples.zh: 研究人员正在研究野生非洲象的群体社交习性。

lemmas.def_zh: 行为，举止；习性；（机械等的）运转状态（英式）
lemmas.def_en: the way that someone or something acts or functions (British spelling)

examples.en: The children were on their best behaviour throughout the entire visit.
examples.zh: 在整个拜访期间，孩子们表现得非常规矩体面。

examples.en: Engineers analyzed the behaviour of materials under extreme temperatures.
examples.zh: 工程师们分析了这些材料在极端温度下的性能表现。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于前缀 be-（强调）+ have（持有、举止），原指“自我管束、表现”，后演变为人或事物的“行为、举止及运行规律”。
family_guide.core_distinction: behavior 与 behaviour 语义完全相同，前者为美式拼写，后者为英式及英联邦国家拼写。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 共和政体的，共和主义的；n. 共和主义者；（大写）共和党人
lemmas.def_en: relating to or supporting a republic; a person advocating republican government or a member of a Republican party

examples.en: The nation celebrated its transition from an absolute monarchy to a republican system.
examples.zh: 该国庆祝其从君主专制向共和体制的转变。

examples.en: As a lifelong republican, he campaigned vigorously against the hereditary monarchy.
examples.zh: 作为一名坚定的共和主义者，他曾竭力奔走反对世袭君主制。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 共和政体的，共和主义的；n. 共和主义者；（大写）共和党人
lemmas.def_en: relating to or supporting a republic; a person advocating republican government or a member of a Republican party

examples.en: The nation celebrated its transition from an absolute monarchy to a republican system.
examples.zh: 该国庆祝其从君主专制向共和体制的转变。

examples.en: As a lifelong republican, he campaigned vigorously against the hereditary monarchy.
examples.zh: 作为一名坚定的共和主义者，他曾竭力奔走反对世袭君主制。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于拉丁语 res publica（公共事务、国家体制），核心逻辑始终围绕“非君主制的、人民或代表行使公权力的国家体制（共和制）”展开。
family_guide.core_distinction: 小写 republican 指普遍意义上的共和政体或共和主义者；首字母大写的 Republican 则专指特定政党（如美国共和党）及其成员。

lemmas.def_zh: 昨天；往昔，过去
lemmas.def_en: the day before today; the recent past

examples.en: Yesterday was the warmest day of the month so far.
examples.zh: 昨天是这个月迄今为止最暖和的一天。

examples.en: Don't dwell on yesterday; focus on what lies ahead.
examples.zh: 不要沉溺于过去，关注眼前和未来。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 geostran（前一天，源自印欧词根*ghes-）加 dæg（天），字面即‘今天的前一天’，后引申出泛指过去的含义。

lemmas.def_zh: 较小的, 二流的, 未成年的
lemmas.def_en: of lesser importance or stature or rank

examples.en: By law, a minor cannot purchase alcohol or sign any legal contract independently.
examples.zh: 依法，未成年人不得独立购买酒精饮料或签署任何法律合同。

lemmas.def_zh: 未成年人, 副修科目
lemmas.def_en: a young person of either sex

examples.en: By law, a minor cannot purchase alcohol or sign any legal contract independently.
examples.zh: 依法，未成年人不得独立购买酒精饮料或签署任何法律合同。

lemmas.def_zh: 少数, 未成年, 少数民族
lemmas.def_en: a group of people who differ racially or politically from a larger group of which it is a part

examples.en: Only a small minority of students supported the proposed change to the school schedule.
examples.zh: 只有极少数学生支持提议中的作息时间调整。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 comparative 形容词 minor（更小、较少），核心语义始终围绕“规模、数量、重要性或年龄上的较小/次要”展开。
family_guide.core_distinction: minor 可指个体“未成年人”或“次要/轻微的事物”，而 minority 强调集合概念中的“少数派（数量少于半数）”或社会维度的“少数族群”。

lemmas.def_zh: 表面
lemmas.def_en: the outer boundary of an artifact or a material layer constituting or resembling such a boundary

examples.en: The surface of the lake was completely frozen.
examples.zh: 湖面完全结冰了。

lemmas.def_zh: 表面的, 外观的, 肤浅的, 水面上的
lemmas.def_en: on the surface

examples.en: The submarine was forced to surface after experiencing a serious mechanical failure.
examples.zh: 潜水艇在经历严重的机械故障后被迫浮出水面。

lemmas.def_zh: 地表的, 地面的
lemmas.def_en: pertaining to or occurring on or near the earth's surface

examples.en: Geologists conducted a detailed study of surficial deposits left behind by the retreating ancient glacier.
examples.zh: 地质学家对古代冰川消退留下的地表沉积物进行了详细研究。

lemmas.def_zh: 浮出水面；露头，浮现；醒来
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] to rise to the surface of water or the ground 2. [I] to suddenly become visible, known, or available after being hidden

examples.en: The submarine was forced to surface after experiencing a serious mechanical failure.
examples.zh: 潜水艇在经历严重的机械故障后被迫浮出水面。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 sur- (在…之上) + face (脸面、外观)，字面即'最上面的面'，引申指事物的外部表象，或动作上由深处‘浮出表面’。

lemmas.def_zh: 交通, 通行, 运输, 交通量, 贸易, 交易, 交往, 通信量
lemmas.def_en: the aggregation of things (pedestrians or vehicles) coming and going in a particular locality during a specified period of time

examples.en: The criminal network was caught trying to traffic stolen luxury vehicles overseas.
examples.zh: 该犯罪网络因企图向海外倒卖被盗豪华车辆而被抓获。

lemmas.def_zh: 商人, 贩子
lemmas.def_en: someone who promotes or exchanges goods or services for money

examples.en: Border agents successfully apprehended an illegal wildlife trafficker carrying endangered species.
examples.zh: 边境特工成功逮捕了一名携带濒危物种的非法野生动物贩子。

lemmas.def_zh: 做非法买卖，贩卖（毒品、军火或人口等）；做贸易
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To buy and sell goods illegally (such as drugs or weapons) or trade in human beings; to trade or do business.

examples.en: The criminal network was caught trying to traffic stolen luxury vehicles overseas.
examples.zh: 该犯罪网络因企图向海外倒卖被盗豪华车辆而被抓获。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自意大利语 trafficare（买卖、经商），核心逻辑是“人、货或信息在通道中的往来流动”，由商品交易引申至人车通行流动，现代语境中动词专指非法的买卖贩运。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词常指中性的道路人车通行或网络数据流量；动词则几乎专用于负面语境，指非法贩运（如人口、违禁品）。

lemmas.def_zh: 湖；湖泊
lemmas.def_en: a large body of water surrounded by land

examples.en: We rented a small wooden cabin by the lake for the summer.
examples.zh: 夏天我们在湖边租了一间小木屋度假。

examples.en: The surface of the lake was perfectly calm in the early morning.
examples.zh: 清晨的湖面平静如镜。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 lacus（水池、盆地、湖泊），核心概念为被陆地包围的大型内陆静止水体。

lemmas.def_zh: 无论如何，不管怎样；尽管如此；（用于转变话题、回到原题或结束谈话）总之，反正
lemmas.def_en: despite what has been said or done; used to change the subject, return to a topic, or end a conversation

examples.en: The weather forecast was terrible, but we went ahead with the hike anyway.
examples.zh: 天气预报说情况很糟糕，但我们还是照样去徒步了。

examples.en: Anyway, it was great catching up with you, but I really have to get back to work now.
examples.zh: 总之，很高兴能跟你聚一聚，但我现在真得回去工作了。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 any（任何）与 way（方式）组合而成，原指“以任何方式”，演变为表示让步（尽管如此）或作为话语标记语引导总结、转折与话题切换（无论如何、总之）。
family_guide.core_distinction: 单字 anyway 是副词；注意与名词短语 any way（任何方式/方法）以及口语中非标准的 anyways 相区别。

lemmas.def_zh: 因此，从而；如此，像这样
lemmas.def_en: as a result of this; in this manner or way

examples.en: The new system automates routine tasks, thus freeing up staff for more creative work.
examples.zh: 新系统将常规任务自动化，从而让员工有更多精力从事创造性工作。

examples.en: Hold the scalpel thus, applying gentle and even pressure.
examples.zh: 像这样握住手术刀，施加轻柔而均匀的压力。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语指示副词，核心表意为“以这种方式”或“由此”，后引申出表示逻辑推论与结果的“因此/从而”。

lemmas.def_zh: 最终的；最后的；结局的
lemmas.def_en: happening or existing at a later time or at the end of a process

examples.en: The prolonged negotiations led to an eventual compromise.
examples.zh: 旷日持久的谈判最终达成了妥协。

examples.en: Scientists remain confident about the project's eventual success.
examples.zh: 科学家们对该项目的最终成功依然充满信心。

lemmas.def_zh: 最后；终于
lemmas.def_en: in the end, especially after a long time, a lot of effort, or many difficulties

examples.en: After months of hard work, they eventually reached an agreement.
examples.zh: 经过数月的努力，他们最终达成了协议。

examples.en: Keep practicing, and you will eventually master the skill.
examples.zh: 坚持练习，你终究会掌握这项技能。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 eventus（发生、结果，即 event 的词源），核心逻辑指由事情长期发展而必然导向的结局，引申为“最终的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 魔法，法术；魔术；神奇的魅力；[形] 有魔力的，具有神奇效果的
lemmas.def_en: supernatural power; conjuring tricks; an enchanting quality; [adj.] having or using supernatural powers

examples.en: The magician waved his magic wand and made the dove disappear.
examples.zh: 魔术师挥了挥魔杖，让那只鸽子凭空消失了。

examples.en: There is no magic solution to this complex economic crisis.
examples.zh: 解决这场复杂的经济危机并没有灵丹妙药。

lemmas.def_zh: 魔术师；变戏法者；巫师
lemmas.def_en: a person who performs magic tricks to entertain people, or who uses real magic

examples.en: The magician pulled a continuous stream of silk scarves from an empty hat.
examples.zh: 魔术师从一顶空帽子里变出了一连串连绵不绝的丝巾。

lemmas.def_zh: 魔法，法术；魔术；神奇的魅力；[形] 有魔力的，具有神奇效果的
lemmas.def_en: supernatural power; conjuring tricks; an enchanting quality; [adj.] having or using supernatural powers

examples.en: The magician waved his magic wand and made the dove disappear.
examples.zh: 魔术师挥了挥魔杖，让那只鸽子凭空消失了。

examples.en: There is no magic solution to this complex economic crisis.
examples.zh: 解决这场复杂的经济危机并没有灵丹妙药。

lemmas.def_zh: 美妙的，令人着迷的；魔法的，神异的
lemmas.def_en: wonderful, charming, or exciting; produced by or relating to magic

examples.en: Watching the northern lights dance across the sky was a truly magical experience.
examples.zh: 仰望北极光在夜空中漫舞，是一段真正美妙非凡的体验。

lemmas.def_zh: 用魔法地；如魔法般地
lemmas.def_en: in a magical manner

examples.en: All the complex technical problems magically disappeared after the engineer rebooted the system.
examples.zh: 工程师重启系统后，所有复杂的技术问题奇迹般地消失了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古希腊语 magos（古波斯祭司、学者），核心意象指掌握隐秘智慧与超自然力量，后引申为魔力、戏法及令人惊叹的魅力。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词 magic 多用于固定搭配或强调具象的法术/魔术属性（如 magic wand, magic trick）；magical 则多强调主观感受，指“奇妙的、美妙绝伦的”（如 a magical evening）。

lemmas.def_zh: 门厅，玄关；走廊，过道；大厅，礼堂
lemmas.def_en: a hallway or entrance area; a corridor; a large building or room used for public gatherings or events

examples.en: Please hang your coat on the rack in the hall.
examples.zh: 请把你的外套挂在门厅的衣架上。

examples.en: Hundreds of delegates gathered in the main conference hall for the opening speech.
examples.zh: 数百名代表齐聚主会议大厅聆听开幕演讲。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语中表示“遮蔽、隐藏”的词根，经由日耳曼语演变为“有屋顶遮蔽的宽敞处所”，现代主要指用于公共集会的大厅、礼堂，或住宅建筑内部的门厅与走廊。

lemmas.def_zh: [俚]阴茎；[澳/新/旧俚]保险箱，收银机；牢房
lemmas.def_en: a slang term for penis; (informal/slang) a safe, cash register, or prison cell

examples.en: The thieves managed to crack the peter and make off with the shop's daily earnings.
examples.zh: 窃贼设法撬开了保险箱，携店铺当天的营业款逃之夭夭。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于希腊语 petros（岩石/石头），经人名 Peter 泛化演变，在英语俚语中隐喻指代坚硬封闭之物（如保险箱、牢房）或男性生殖器，亦与矿石耗尽相关。

lemmas.def_zh: 神圣的，圣洁的，敬虔的；圣所，圣物
lemmas.def_en: dedicated or consecrated to God or a religious purpose; sacred; a sacred place or thing

examples.en: The ancient temple has been considered a holy site for centuries.
examples.zh: 几个世纪以来，这座古老的寺庙一直被视为神圣之地。

examples.en: Only the high priest was permitted to enter the inner holy of holies.
examples.zh: 只有大祭司才被允许进入最核心的至圣所。

lemmas.def_zh: 不神圣的, 不虔诚的, 邪恶的
lemmas.def_en: not hallowed or consecrated

examples.en: The two rival companies formed an unholy alliance to eliminate competition.
examples.zh: 这两家竞争对手结成了邪恶同盟，以消除竞争。

lemmas.def_zh: 神圣的，圣洁的，敬虔的；圣所，圣物
lemmas.def_en: dedicated or consecrated to God or a religious purpose; sacred; a sacred place or thing

examples.en: The ancient temple has been considered a holy site for centuries.
examples.zh: 几个世纪以来，这座古老的寺庙一直被视为神圣之地。

examples.en: Only the high priest was permitted to enter the inner holy of holies.
examples.zh: 只有大祭司才被允许进入最核心的至圣所。

lemmas.def_zh: 神圣；圣座（大写, 对教宗等的尊称）
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being holy

examples.en: The quiet ancient temple was filled with an aura of pure holiness.
examples.zh: 这座宁静的古老寺庙弥漫着纯粹的神圣气息。

lemmas.def_zh: 不神圣, 不洁净, 无信心
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being unholy

examples.en: The ancient texts warned that such greed was an act of extreme unholiness.
examples.zh: 古籍警告称，这种贪婪是极度不虔诚的行为。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语，与 whole（完整、健康）同源，本义为‘未受玷污的、健全纯洁的’，引申出‘被神选中的、神圣不可侵犯的’核心含义。

lemmas.def_zh: 村庄，乡村；（大城镇内相对独立的）小社区
lemmas.def_en: a group of houses and other buildings, larger than a hamlet and smaller than a town, situated in a rural area

examples.en: She grew up in a quiet fishing village on the west coast.
examples.zh: 她在西海岸一个宁静的渔村长大。

examples.en: The whole village gathered in the square to celebrate the harvest festival.
examples.zh: 全村人都聚集在广场上庆祝丰收节。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 villa（庄园、乡村宅邸），经古法语演变为指由乡村农舍集聚形成的小型定居点，即村庄。

lemmas.def_zh: 聪明的, 漂亮的, 刺痛的, 剧烈的, 敏捷的, 巧妙的, 伶俐的, 潇洒的
lemmas.def_en: showing mental alertness and calculation and resourcefulness

examples.en: She came up with a smart solution that solved the entire problem.
examples.zh: 她想出了一个聪明的办法，解决了整个难题。

lemmas.def_zh: 感到剧烈刺痛，灼痛；感到难过，感到屈辱
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To cause or feel a sharp, stinging, or burning pain. 2. [I] (+ from/at) To feel upset, aggrieved, or wounded by a slight or defeat.

examples.en: She came up with a smart solution that solved the entire problem.
examples.zh: 她想出了一个聪明的办法，解决了整个难题。

lemmas.def_zh: 潇洒地, 火辣辣地, 刺痛地
lemmas.def_en: in a clever manner

examples.en: He dressed smartly in a dark suit for the important job interview.
examples.zh: 他穿着一身帅气的深色西装去参加那场重要的求职面试。

lemmas.def_zh: 现代风格, 敏捷, 机灵
lemmas.def_en: a kind of pain such as that caused by a wound or a burn or a sore

examples.en: Her natural smartness and quick wit helped her advance rapidly in business.
examples.zh: 她天生的机灵和敏捷的才智助她在商界迅速晋升。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语表示“刺痛”的词根，从尖锐刺痛的刺激感引申出思维和反应的“敏锐、聪明”以及外表的“利落、光鲜”，而动词则保留了原始的“刺痛、难受”之义。

lemmas.def_zh: 典型的；具代表性的；一贯的
lemmas.def_en: having the distinctive qualities of a particular type of person or thing; characteristic

examples.en: It was a typical English summer day, cool and drizzly.
examples.zh: 那是一个典型的英国夏日，阴凉且下着细雨。

examples.en: It is typical of him to forget his wallet when the bill arrives.
examples.zh: 买单时发现没带钱包，这完全符合他一贯的作风。

lemmas.def_zh: 一般
lemmas.def_en: not representative of a group, class, or type

examples.en: Such aggressive behavior is quite untypical of his usually calm personality.
examples.zh: 这种攻击性行为完全不符合他平时平静的性格。

lemmas.def_zh: 通常；一般地；不出所料地
lemmas.def_en: in a way that is characteristic of a person or thing; usually

examples.en: A full recovery typically takes around four to six weeks.
examples.zh: 完全康复通常需要四到六周左右。

examples.en: Typically, she remained calm while everyone else panicked.
examples.zh: 不出所料，在其他人乱作一团时，她依然十分镇定。

lemmas.def_zh: 典型性, 特征
lemmas.def_en: the state of being that is typical

examples.en: The typicality of these symptoms makes the medical diagnosis relatively straightforward.
examples.zh: 这些症状的典型性使医学诊断变得相对简单直接。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 typos（印模、模型、类型），核心含义为“符合特定模型或类别的”，引申指具有代表性或一贯特性的。

lemmas.def_zh: 虚弱的；微弱的；软弱的；不充分的
lemmas.def_en: lacking physical strength, energy, power, or effectiveness

examples.en: She felt weak and dizzy after running the marathon in the heat.
examples.zh: 在酷暑中跑完马拉松后，她感到浑身无力、头晕目眩。

examples.en: The evidence against the suspect is too weak to secure a conviction.
examples.zh: 指控该嫌疑人的证据太薄弱，不足以定罪。

lemmas.def_zh: 弱的, 虚弱的
lemmas.def_en: lacking bodily or muscular strength or vitality

examples.en: The patient smiled weakly at the nurse before falling back to sleep.
examples.zh: 病人在重新入睡前，虚弱地向护士笑了笑。

lemmas.def_zh: 虚弱；弱点，短板；难以抗拒的嗜好
lemmas.def_en: the state of lacking strength; a flaw or defect; a strong liking for something

examples.en: Recognizing your own weaknesses is the first step toward self-improvement.
examples.zh: 认清自己的弱点是自我提升的第一步。

examples.en: I try to eat healthy, but chocolate has always been my biggest weakness.
examples.zh: 我努力保持健康饮食，但巧克力一直是我最大的软肋。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古日耳曼语，本义为“容易弯曲、屈服的”，引申出在体力、意志、权力或效果上“缺乏力量、脆弱微弱”的核心概念。
family_guide.core_distinction: weak 是修饰状态的形容词，weakness 是其名词形式，除表抽象的“虚弱”外，还常特指具体的“弱点、短板”或对某物的“难以抗拒的嗜好”。

lemmas.def_zh: 全部的, 全体的, 从头至尾的, 一切在内的
lemmas.def_en: involving only main features

examples.en: The overall cost of the project was significantly higher than we anticipated.
examples.zh: 该项目的总体成本大大高于我们的预期。

lemmas.def_zh: 罩衫, 工作服
lemmas.def_en: (usually plural) work clothing consisting of denim trousers (usually with a bib and shoulder straps)

examples.en: The overall cost of the project was significantly higher than we anticipated.
examples.zh: 该项目的总体成本大大高于我们的预期。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 'over'（覆盖）与 'all'（全部）复合而成，核心意象为“覆盖在所有事物之上”，引申为宏观视角的“全面的、总体的”，或物理上套在最外层的“工作罩衫、工装裤”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词表示宏观总览的“整体的、总共的”；名词指套在衣物外的防护服，在美式英语中常以复数 overalls 形式指背带工作裤。

lemmas.def_zh: 国会；代表大会；大型专业学术会议
lemmas.def_en: a national legislative body (especially of the US), or a large formal meeting of representatives

examples.en: The bill was passed by Congress and sent to the president for signature.
examples.zh: 该法案已由国会通过，并递交总统签字。

examples.en: Delegates from around the world gathered in Paris for the international medical congress.
examples.zh: 来自世界各地的代表齐聚巴黎，参加这次国际医学大会。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语“走走到一起（con- 共同 + gredi 走、迈步）”，原义为“聚集、会面”，后引申为各方代表共同召开的“正式代表大会”，在现代英语中专指“国会”或“大型专业会议”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 首字母大写（Congress）特指国家最高立法机关（尤指美国国会），小写（congress）则泛指政治、学术或行业的大型代表大会。

lemmas.def_zh: 公共汽车
lemmas.def_en: a vehicle carrying many passengers; used for public transport

examples.en: I missed the morning bus and had to walk to the office.
examples.zh: 我错过了早班公共汽车，只得步行去办公室。

lemmas.def_zh: 用公共汽车运送；乘公共汽车出行
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To transport passengers by bus, or to travel by bus.

examples.en: I missed the morning bus and had to walk to the office.
examples.zh: 我错过了早班公共汽车，只得步行去办公室。

lemmas.def_zh: 吻，接吻
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (old-fashioned or humorous) To kiss someone.

examples.en: He leaned down to buss his grandmother gently on the cheek.
examples.zh: 他弯下腰，轻轻亲吻了一下祖母的脸颊。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 omnibus（意为“为所有人服务的”），截断缩略为 bus，核心意象为“公共客运载具”，后引申出动词“用公共汽车运送”以及北美特有的“在餐馆收拾餐桌”之意。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词指公共汽车载具；动词既可表示用客车运送人员，也可在北美英语中表示清理餐盘杂物（与 busboy 同源）。

lemmas.def_zh: 干的, 无酒的, 枯燥无味的, 干燥的
lemmas.def_en: free from liquid or moisture; lacking natural or normal moisture or depleted of water; or no longer wet

examples.en: The desert air is extremely dry, causing skin to crack very easily.
examples.zh: 沙漠里的空气极度干燥，极易导致皮肤干裂。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）变干，使干燥，弄干
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To become dry, or to make something dry by removing moisture or liquid.

examples.en: The desert air is extremely dry, causing skin to crack very easily.
examples.zh: 沙漠里的空气极度干燥，极易导致皮肤干裂。

lemmas.def_zh: 干衣机, 干燥剂
lemmas.def_en: an appliance that removes moisture

examples.en: Please toss these wet towels into the dryer for twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 请把这些湿毛巾扔进干衣机里烘干二十分钟。

lemmas.def_zh: 干燥, 干燥无味, 冷淡
lemmas.def_en: the condition of not containing or being covered by a liquid (especially water)

examples.en: The extreme dryness of the soil made it difficult for seeds to sprout.
examples.zh: 土壤的极度干旱使得种子很难发芽。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 drȳge，核心本义为“缺乏水分或液体”，由此派生出“变干、烘干”的动作，并引申出“枯燥、冷淡、不甜（干性酒）”等抽象含义。
family_guide.core_distinction: dryer 主要指烘干机或吹风机（亦作 drier），同时 drier 也是 dry 的形容词比较级（更干燥的）。

lemmas.def_zh: 四分之一；一刻钟；季度
lemmas.def_en: one of four equal parts

examples.en: We spent the last quarter of an hour reviewing the final report.
examples.zh: 我们花了最后的一刻钟来复查最终报告。

lemmas.def_zh: 季刊
lemmas.def_en: a periodical that is published every quarter (or four issues per year)

examples.en: The prestigious literary quarterly publishes poetry and critical essays from around the world.
examples.zh: 这本著名文学季刊发表来自世界各地的诗歌和评论文章。

lemmas.def_zh: 安置，为……提供住处；驻扎；把……分成四等份
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To provide someone, especially military personnel, with accommodation. 2. [I] (of troops) To stay in a particular place. 3. [T] To cut or divide something into four equal parts.

examples.en: We spent the last quarter of an hour reviewing the final report.
examples.zh: 我们花了最后的一刻钟来复查最终报告。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 quartus（第四），核心语义围绕“四分之一”展开，后引申出四分之一年（季度）、城市的四分之一（街区/营房/住处）等概念。
family_guide.core_distinction: quarter 作名词指四分之一、季度或街区/驻地，作动词指四等分或驻扎；quarterly 作名词专指按季度出版的“季刊”。

lemmas.def_zh: 值得，应得，应受
lemmas.def_en: [T] To earn something or be worthy of it because of your actions, qualities, or situation.

examples.en: After months of grueling preparation, she truly deserves this promotion.
examples.zh: 经过数月艰苦的准备，她确实配得上这次晋升。

examples.en: Those who break the law deserve to face the consequences of their actions.
examples.zh: 违法者理应承担自身行为带来的后果。

lemmas.def_zh: 应得报酬地, 理所当然地
lemmas.def_en: as deserved

examples.en: After years of dedication, she deservedly won the prestigious national science award.
examples.zh: 经过多年的奉献，她当之无愧地获得了著名的国家科学奖。

lemmas.def_zh: 不应得地, 不当地
lemmas.def_en: in an unmerited manner

examples.en: The junior clerk was undeservedly blamed for mistakes made by senior management.
examples.zh: 初级职员因管理层的失误而不公地受到了责备。

lemmas.def_zh: (赏、罚等)不该受的, 不应得的
lemmas.def_en: not deserved or earned

examples.en: She felt that the harsh criticism she received online was entirely undeserved.
examples.zh: 她觉得自己在网上遭受的严厉批评完全是不应得的。

lemmas.def_zh: 不配受到的, 不值得...的
lemmas.def_en: not deserving

examples.en: He considered the corrupt politician completely undeserving of public trust and respect.
examples.zh: 他认为那个腐败的政客完全不配获得公众的信任与尊重。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 deservire（de- 表示完全、彻底 + servire 表示服务），本义为‘通过充分服役/服务而应得回报’，后引申为因行为、品质而‘值得、应受’某种待遇（褒贬皆可）。

lemmas.def_zh: 精神, 心灵, 灵魂, 态度, 志气, 人格, 情绪, 心情, 烈酒
lemmas.def_en: the vital principle or animating force within living things

examples.en: Despite facing many setbacks, the team maintained an admirable fighting spirit throughout.
examples.zh: 尽管遭遇诸多挫折，该团队自始至终都保持着令人钦佩的斗志。

lemmas.def_en: a kind of religious song originated by Blacks in the southern United States
lemmas.def_zh: 有关教会的事

examples.en: Traditional African American spiritual songs often expressed deep sorrow and a longing for freedom.
examples.zh: 传统非裔美国人的黑人灵歌常常表达深深的悲伤和对自由的渴望。

lemmas.def_en: property or income owned by a church
lemmas.def_zh: 精神性，灵性

examples.en: The retreat focuses on personal growth and spirituality.
examples.zh: 这次静修营专注于个人成长与灵性修行。

lemmas.def_zh: 有精神；活泼；勇敢
lemmas.def_en: quality of being active or spirited or alive and vigorous

examples.en: The young horse displayed remarkable spiritedness during its first training session today.
examples.zh: 这匹小马在今天的首次训练中表现出了非凡的活力。

lemmas.def_zh: 鼓舞，激励，使振作；（与 away/off 连用）暗中带走，偷偷掳走
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (often spirit up) To animate, encourage, or fill with energy and enthusiasm. 2. [T] (spirit away/off) To remove or carry off secretly and quickly.

examples.en: Despite facing many setbacks, the team maintained an admirable fighting spirit throughout.
examples.zh: 尽管遭遇诸多挫折，该团队自始至终都保持着令人钦佩的斗志。

lemmas.def_en: concerned with sacred matters or religion or the church
lemmas.def_zh: 精神上的, 神圣的, 崇高的, 高尚的, 鬼的, 招魂术的

examples.en: Traditional African American spiritual songs often expressed deep sorrow and a longing for freedom.
examples.zh: 传统非裔美国人的黑人灵歌常常表达深深的悲伤和对自由的渴望。

lemmas.def_zh: 无生气的, 沮丧的, 无生命的, 没精打采的
lemmas.def_en: lacking ardor or vigor or energy

examples.en: Exhausted from the heat, the hikers delivered a spiritless response to the guide.
examples.zh: 由于酷热难耐，徒步旅行者们无精打采地回应了向导。

lemmas.def_zh: 含酒精的, 酒精成分高的
lemmas.def_en: containing or of the nature of alcohol

examples.en: The doctor advised him to avoid spirituous liquors due to his stomach condition.
examples.zh: 由于胃部问题，医生建议他避免饮用高度烈酒。

lemmas.def_en: in a spiritual manner
lemmas.def_zh: 在精神上地

examples.en: The quiet retreat helped her grow spiritually and find peace after a difficult year.
examples.zh: 在艰难的一年后，这场静修帮助她在精神上成长并找到了平静。

lemmas.def_zh: 有精神地, 活泼地
lemmas.def_en: in a spirited or lively manner; with animation and vivacity

examples.en: The two scholars debated spiritedly about the historical accuracy of the text.
examples.zh: 两位学者就该文献的历史准确性展开了热烈的辩论。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 spiritus（呼吸、气息），原指维持生命的无形气息，引申出灵魂、活力、内在心境与事物精髓，后来亦指通过蒸馏提取的挥发性高浓度液体（烈酒）。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词 spirit 涵盖抽象的精神、灵魂及烈酒；动词 spirit 则专用于表示“迅速且秘密地运走”，通常与 away/off 构成固定搭配。

lemmas.def_zh: 电的, 导电的, 电动的
lemmas.def_en: using or providing or producing or transmitting or operated by electricity

examples.en: More drivers are switching to electric cars to reduce their daily carbon footprint.
examples.zh: 越来越多的司机改开电动汽车，以减少日常碳足迹。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 电的
lemmas.def_en: a car that is powered by electricity

examples.en: More drivers are switching to electric cars to reduce their daily carbon footprint.
examples.zh: 越来越多的司机改开电动汽车，以减少日常碳足迹。

lemmas.def_zh: 电, 电流, 电学, 热情, 电力供应
lemmas.def_en: a physical phenomenon associated with stationary or moving electrons and protons

examples.en: The heavy storm knocked down power lines, leaving thousands of homes without electricity.
examples.zh: 强风暴刮倒了电线，导致数千户家庭停电。

lemmas.def_zh: 起电, 带电, 电气化
lemmas.def_en: the activity of thrilling or markedly exciting some person or group

examples.en: Rapid electrification of public transit has significantly reduced urban carbon emissions.
examples.zh: 公共交通的快速电气化显著减少了城市碳排放。

lemmas.def_zh: 使激动，使兴奋；使电气化，使通电
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To fill someone with sudden excitement, thrill, or enthusiasm. 2. [T] To equip a system or railway to operate using electric power; to charge with electricity.

examples.en: The government plans to electrify the rural railway lines to improve public transport.
examples.zh: 政府计划将乡村铁路线路电气化，以改善公共交通。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 ēlektron（琥珀），因古希腊人摩擦琥珀起电而得名；近代引申指“电”这种物理现象及电力驱动的事物，后比喻如触电般令人极度紧张或兴奋的状态。
family_guide.core_distinction: electric 既可作形容词（电动的；极度刺激的），也可作名词指“电动车”或电气线路；electricity 则是不可数名词，专指“电、电能”这一物理能量形式。

lemmas.def_zh: 基础；根据；基准；方式
lemmas.def_en: the underlying support, foundation, or principle for an idea, system, or process

examples.en: Decisions should be made on the basis of facts rather than rumors.
examples.zh: 做决定应当以事实为依据，而不是凭空听信谣言。

examples.en: The team meets on a weekly basis to review project milestones.
examples.zh: 团队每周定期碰头，复盘项目里程碑进展。

lemmas.def_zh: 以……为基础（或根据）；将（基地、总部等）设在
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] to use an idea, fact, or situation as the foundation for something. 2. [T] to locate headquarters or operations in a particular place.

examples.en: The director decided to base the screenplay on a true story.
examples.zh: 导演决定将这个剧本建立在真实故事的基础之上。

examples.en: The tech firm is based in Silicon Valley but operates worldwide.
examples.zh: 这家科技公司的总部设在硅谷，但业务遍及全球。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 basis（底座、立足点），核心意象为‘底层支撑物’，引申出抽象的事理基础与行动依据。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词 basis 常用于抽象的‘依据、准则’（如 on the basis of, on a daily basis）；动词 base 则表示‘以……为依据’（base ... on ...）或‘将中心设在某处’（be based in）。

lemmas.def_zh: 距离, 远方, 遥远
lemmas.def_en: the property created by the space between two objects or points

examples.en: She looked out into the distance, hoping to catch a glimpse of the ship.
examples.zh: 她望向远方，希望能瞥见那艘轮船的身影。

lemmas.def_zh: 疏远，使疏离；拉开距离
lemmas.def_en: [T] (+ from) To make yourself, or cause someone to be, emotionally, socially, or physically distant from someone or something.

examples.en: She looked out into the distance, hoping to catch a glimpse of the ship.
examples.zh: 她望向远方，希望能瞥见那艘轮船的身影。

lemmas.def_en: separated in space or coming from or going to a distance
lemmas.def_zh: 遥远的；冷漠的；远亲的

examples.en: She gave me a distant smile that showed she had no interest in chatting.
examples.zh: 她礼貌而冷淡地笑了笑，表明自己并无闲聊的兴致。

lemmas.def_en: from or at a distance
lemmas.def_zh: 远, 远隔, 久远, 疏远, 稀疏, 不紧密, 冷淡, 冷漠, 隐约

examples.en: He smiled distantly, his mind clearly focused on something else far away.
examples.zh: 他心不在焉地笑了笑，心思显然早已飞到了别处。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 dis-（分开）+ stare（站立），本义为“彼此分开站立”，引申指空间、时间上的间距，再延伸至心理与人际关系上的疏远隔阂。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词表示物理间距或心理隔阂；动词则表示主动拉开距离，尤常用于反身结构中表达“撇清关系”或“抽离自身”。

lemmas.def_zh: 上诉
lemmas.def_en: earnest or urgent request

examples.en: The defense lawyer decided to file an appeal against the verdict.
examples.zh: 辩护律师决定对判决提起上诉。

lemmas.def_zh: 上诉人
lemmas.def_en: the party who appeals a decision of a lower court

examples.en: The appellant filed a brief arguing that the lower court had misinterpreted the law.
examples.zh: 上诉人提交了一份陈词，辩称下级法院对法律存在曲解。

lemmas.def_zh: 呼吁，恳求；上诉，申诉；有吸引力
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] to make a serious, urgent, or formal request for help, money, or information 2. [I, T] to ask a higher court to reconsider a legal decision 3. [I] to be attractive or interesting to someone

examples.en: The police made an urgent appeal for witnesses to step forward with information.
examples.zh: 警方发出紧急呼吁，希望目击者能挺身而出提供线索。

lemmas.def_zh: 上诉的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or taking account of appeals (usually legal appeals)

examples.en: The appellant filed a brief arguing that the lower court had misinterpreted the law.
examples.zh: 上诉人提交了一份陈词，辩称下级法院对法律存在曲解。

lemmas.def_zh: 无吸引力的
lemmas.def_en: (of characters in literature or drama) tending to evoke antipathetic feelings

examples.en: The cold and bland soup looked completely unappealing to the hungry guests.
examples.zh: 这道又冷又淡的汤对饥肠辘辘的客人来说毫无吸引力。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 可以上诉的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being appealed especially to a higher tribunal; - New Republic

examples.en: The defense lawyer reminded the court that the magistrate's ruling was legally appealable.
examples.zh: 辩护律师提醒法庭，地方法官的裁决在法律上是可以上诉的。

lemmas.def_zh: 不可上诉的
lemmas.def_en: not subject to appeal

examples.en: The supreme court issued a final and unappealable decision on the disputed election.
examples.zh: 最高法院就这场有争议的选举作出了终审且不可上诉的裁决。

lemmas.def_zh: 有感染力, 吸引人, 有趣, 哀诉似, 恳求似
lemmas.def_en: in an appealing manner

examples.en: The puppy looked appealingly at the kitchen table, begging for a tiny treat.
examples.zh: 小狗恳求似地望着厨房餐桌，乞求一点点零食。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 appellare（呼召、诉求），核心逻辑为“向外发出呼求或传达吸引力”，由此引申出法律上的“上诉”、公共层面的“呼吁/恳请”以及感官上的“吸引力”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词与动词同形且语义完全平行，均涵盖“上诉”、“呼吁”与“吸引力”，主要区别在于句式搭配（如 make an appeal to 与 appeal to）。

lemmas.def_zh: 悲伤的，难过的；令人遗憾的
lemmas.def_en: feeling or showing sorrow; unhappy; causing sorrow or regret

examples.en: She felt deeply sad after hearing the news of his departure.
examples.zh: 得知他离开的消息后，她感到非常悲伤。

examples.en: It is a sad reality that many historic buildings are falling into disrepair.
examples.zh: 令人遗憾的现实是，许多历史建筑正在逐渐破败。

lemmas.def_zh: 悲伤，忧伤；令人伤心的事
lemmas.def_en: the condition or feeling of being sad; sorrow

examples.en: A wave of sadness washed over him as he packed up his childhood room.
examples.zh: 收拾儿时的房间时，一阵悲伤涌上了他的心头。

examples.en: She tried to hide her sadness behind a polite smile.
examples.zh: 她试图用礼貌的微笑来掩盖内心的忧伤。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 sæd（原义为“饱足的、倦怠的”），语义逐渐由身心的“沉重、疲惫”演化为现代核心的“悲伤、令人难过”。

lemmas.def_zh: 轻微的, 纤细的, 脆弱的, 苗条的
lemmas.def_en: (quantifier used with mass nouns) small in quantity or degree; not much or almost none or (with `a') at least some

examples.en: There has been a slight improvement in his health over the past few days.
examples.zh: 过去几天里，他的健康状况有了轻微的改善。

lemmas.def_zh: 轻蔑, 怠慢
lemmas.def_en: a deliberate discourteous act (usually as an expression of anger or disapproval)

examples.en: There has been a slight improvement in his health over the past few days.
examples.zh: 过去几天里，他的健康状况有了轻微的改善。

lemmas.def_zh: 些微, 少许, 细长
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being unimportant and petty or frivolous

examples.en: The slightness of her frame concealed a surprising amount of physical strength.
examples.zh: 她纤细的身材掩盖了惊人的体力。

lemmas.def_zh: 稍微，略微
lemmas.def_en: a little; to a small degree or extent

examples.en: The final cost was slightly higher than originally estimated.
examples.zh: 最终成本略高于最初的预估。

lemmas.def_zh: 怠慢，轻视，冷落
lemmas.def_en: [T] To treat someone with disrespect, contempt, or deliberate indifference.

examples.en: There has been a slight improvement in his health over the past few days.
examples.zh: 过去几天里，他的健康状况有了轻微的改善。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古日耳曼语系中表示“平坦、光滑”的词根，逐渐引申为“纤细的、微小的”，再进一步由“微不足道”延伸出在人际关系中的“轻蔑、冷落”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词与副词侧重事物体积、程度的“轻微、纤细”；动词与名词则转变为社交心理层面的“怠慢、蔑视”。

lemmas.def_zh: 士兵，军人；骨干分子；坚持下去，顽强硬撑（常与 on 连用）
lemmas.def_en: a person serving in an army; to persevere doggedly through difficulty

examples.en: The wounded soldier showed remarkable courage during the rescue operation.
examples.zh: 这名负伤的士兵在救援行动中表现出了非凡的勇气。

examples.en: Despite severe fatigue and cold, the rescue workers decided to soldier on through the night.
examples.zh: 尽管极其疲惫且天气严寒，救援人员仍决定咬牙坚持搜救整夜。

lemmas.def_zh: 军事训练, 军人, 军队
lemmas.def_en: soldiers collectively

examples.en: The local soldiery patrolled the city walls to protect the citizens from bandits.
examples.zh: 当地驻军在城墙上巡逻，保护市民免遭土匪袭击。

lemmas.def_zh: 坚持下去，硬挺下去，顽强坚持（常与 on 连用）；当兵，服兵役
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] ('soldier on') To persevere and continue doing something despite difficulty, pain, or tiredness. 2. [I] To serve as a soldier.

examples.en: The wounded soldier showed remarkable courage during the rescue operation.
examples.zh: 这名负伤的士兵在救援行动中表现出了非凡的勇气。

examples.en: Despite severe fatigue and cold, the rescue workers decided to soldier on through the night.
examples.zh: 尽管极其疲惫且天气严寒，救援人员仍决定咬牙坚持搜救整夜。

lemmas.def_zh: 军人的, 像军人的, 适于军人的
lemmas.def_en: (of persons) befitting a warrior

examples.en: The young recruit stood at attention with impressive soldierly dignity and discipline.
examples.zh: 新兵立正站好，展现出令人印象深刻的军人威严与纪律。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古罗马金币 solidus（军饷），本义为“领饷服役作战的人”，引申出像士兵般顽强、迎难而上的坚持行为。

lemmas.def_zh: 铁匠；金属工匠；巧匠（常作复合词词尾）
lemmas.def_en: a person who makes or repairs metal objects; a skilled maker or craftsman

examples.en: The smith heated the iron rod in the forge until it glowed bright red.
examples.zh: 铁匠把铁棒放在锻炉中加热，直到它通红发亮。

examples.en: As a gifted wordsmith, she carefully polished every sentence of the manuscript.
examples.zh: 作为一名极富才华的语言巧匠，她仔细推敲着手稿中的每一句话。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语中表示“击打、捶打”的词根，本义为“敲打金属制造器物的人”，引申为铁匠、金属工匠，现代也常作后缀表示熟练的工匠或文字巧匠。

lemmas.def_zh: 登记，注册；挂号；记录，显示
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. To record someone's or something's name on an official list. 2. To send mail by paying an extra fee for tracking and security. 3. To show or indicate an amount or feeling.

examples.en: All new students must register online before attending classes at the local university campus.
examples.zh: 所有新生在当地大学校园上课前都必须先在网上登记注册。

lemmas.def_zh: 寄存器, 记录, 登记簿, 注册
lemmas.def_en: an official written record of names or events or transactions

examples.en: All new students must register online before attending classes at the local university campus.
examples.zh: 所有新生在当地大学校园上课前都必须先在网上登记注册。

lemmas.def_en: the act of enrolling
lemmas.def_zh: 登记；注册；挂号

examples.en: Online registration closes two days before the conference begins.
examples.zh: 在线报名将在会议开始前两天截止。

lemmas.def_en: an official written record of names or events or transactions
lemmas.def_zh: 登记处；注册处；登记簿，名册

examples.en: The couple visited the local registry office to obtain a marriage license.
examples.zh: 这对新人前往当地婚姻登记处领取结婚证。

lemmas.def_zh: 登记者
lemmas.def_en: a person who is formally entered (along with others) in a register (and who obtains certain rights thereby)

examples.en: Each conference registrant will receive an official welcome packet at the entrance.
examples.zh: 每位会议登记者都将在入口处领取一份正式的欢迎礼包。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 未登记的, 未注册的
lemmas.def_en: (of animals) not recorded with or certified by an official breed association

examples.en: The police seized several unregistered firearms during their raid on the abandoned warehouse.
examples.zh: 警方在搜查该废弃仓库时查获了数支未登记的枪支。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中世纪拉丁语 registrum（承载、记下），核心概念是“把事物记录或显现于特定载体/系统上”，由此衍生出官方登记、感官留下印象、以及语言和音乐中的归类范围。

lemmas.def_zh: 正方形, 街区, 广场, 平方, 直角尺
lemmas.def_en: (geometry) a plane rectangle with four equal sides and four right angles; a four-sided regular polygon

examples.en: Use a ruler to draw a perfect square on the paper.
examples.zh: 用尺子在纸上画一个规整的正方形。

lemmas.def_zh: 方形, 拘谨, 一丝不苟
lemmas.def_en: the property of being shaped like a square

examples.en: The carpenter carefully checked the squareness of the window frame using his tool.
examples.zh: 木匠用工具仔细检查了窗框的方正度。

lemmas.def_zh: 调正，使对齐（成直角或平正）；使挺直（双肩）；使一致，与……相符；结清（账目）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To adjust or align something so that it is level, straight, or at right angles. 2. [T] To pull back and straighten one's shoulders. 3. [I, T] To make things agree or fit together, or to be consistent with something. 4. [T] To settle or clear a debt or bill.

examples.en: The large historic square was crowded with excited tourists watching the energetic street performers.
examples.zh: 这座历史悠久的大广场上挤满了观看充满活力的街头艺人的游客。

lemmas.def_zh: 正方形的, 正直的, 公正的, 平方的, 方正的, 结清的
lemmas.def_en: having four equal sides and four right angles or forming a right angle

examples.en: The large historic square was crowded with excited tourists watching the energetic street performers.
examples.zh: 这座历史悠久的大广场上挤满了观看充满活力的街头艺人的游客。

lemmas.def_zh: 干脆地, 正好, 直角地
lemmas.def_en: directly and without evasion; not roundabout

examples.en: The blame for the project failure falls squarely on the shoulders of management.
examples.zh: 项目失败的责任完全落在了管理层的肩上。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 quadra（四边形、规整方块），核心概念为“四方、对称、规整”，由此引申出几何图形、公共广场、数学平方以及引申义“端正、核对相符、结清扯平”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 该词同形兼具名词（形状/广场/平方）、动词（弄平整/核对一致/结清）与形容词（正方的/成直角的/扯平的/公平正直的），词义均围绕“端正规范”展开。

lemmas.def_zh: （化学）元素
lemmas.def_en: an essential component or constituent of a whole; a chemical substance; weather conditions, especially harsh weather

examples.en: Hydrogen is the most abundant chemical element in the universe.
examples.zh: 氢是宇宙中最丰富的化学元素。

lemmas.def_en: easy and not involved or complicated
lemmas.def_zh: 基本的，初级的；基础的

examples.en: He made an elementary mistake that cost him the championship.
examples.zh: 他犯了一个低级的基础错误，导致他痛失冠军。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 elementum（基本原则、基础成分），核心逻辑指“构成整体的不可分割的基础组成部分”或“自然界的原生力量”。

lemmas.def_zh: 进步, 发展, 前进
lemmas.def_en: gradual improvement or growth or development

examples.en: The construction team made steady progress on the new bridge throughout the warm spring.
examples.zh: 整个温暖的春季里，施工队的新桥工程都进展顺利。

lemmas.def_zh: 前进, 连续, 级数
lemmas.def_en: a series with a definite pattern of advance

examples.en: The natural progression of the disease can be slowed down with early treatment.
examples.zh: 这种疾病的自然发展过程可以通过早期治疗得到延缓。

lemmas.def_zh: 进步，发展；进行，推进
lemmas.def_en: [I] To develop, advance, or improve gradually over time.

examples.en: The construction team made steady progress on the new bridge throughout the warm spring.
examples.zh: 整个温暖的春季里，施工队的新桥工程都进展顺利。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语前缀 pro-（向前）+ gradi/gressus（迈步、走），核心逻辑即“向前迈步”，引申为空间上的前进、时间上的推移以及水平/状态上的进步与演变。
family_guide.core_distinction: progress 常作不可数名词，强调“进步、提升或整体发展成就”；progression 强调“按步骤阶段递进的过程、次序或序列演变”。

lemmas.def_zh: 港口, 埠, 舱门, 避风港, 左舷, 炮眼, 姿势, 意义
lemmas.def_en: a place (seaport or airport) where people and merchandise can enter or leave a country

examples.en: Dozens of cargo ships waited outside the busy port to unload international goods safely.
examples.zh: 数十艘货船在繁忙的港口外等待，以便安全卸下跨国货物。

lemmas.def_zh: 大楼管理员, 门房, 搬运工人, 侍者, 服务员
lemmas.def_en: a person employed to carry luggage and supplies

examples.en: The friendly hotel porter carried the heavy luggage up to our room without hesitation.
examples.zh: 热情的酒店行李员毫不犹豫地把沉重的行李帮我们搬到了房间。

lemmas.def_zh: 陆上运输, 搬运
lemmas.def_en: the cost of carrying or transporting

examples.en: The canoe trip required a difficult two-mile portage between the two rivers.
examples.zh: 这次独木舟之旅需要在两条河流之间进行一段艰难的两英里陆上搬运。

lemmas.def_zh: 搬运业
lemmas.def_en: the charge for carrying burdens by porters

examples.en: The final bill included an extra fee for railway porterage and hotel services.
examples.zh: 最终账单中包含了一笔铁路搬运服务和酒店服务的额外费用。

lemmas.def_zh: （舵、船等）转向左舷，向左转舵；持（枪）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (nautical) To turn or steer a ship or aircraft to the left or port side. 2. [T] (military) To carry a weapon diagonally across the body.

examples.en: The captain ordered the helmsman to port the ship to avoid the reef.
examples.zh: 船长命令舵手向左转舵以避开暗礁。

lemmas.def_zh: （作为搬运工）搬运，挑运
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To carry luggage, supplies, or heavy loads, especially as a porter.

examples.en: He worked for years portering heavy luggage at the central railway station.
examples.zh: 他在中央火车站做了多年的行李搬运工作。

lemmas.def_zh: 肥胖的, 魁伟的, 庄重的
lemmas.def_en: euphemisms for `fat'

examples.en: A portly elderly gentleman entered the restaurant and took his favorite corner seat.
examples.zh: 一位身材魁伟微胖的年长绅士走进餐厅，坐到了他最喜欢的角落座位。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 portus（港口、门户）与 portare（携带、搬运），演化出“交通与数据进出枢纽”以及“物品运输或软件迁移”两大语义脉络。
family_guide.core_distinction: port 偏向系统或通道本身（港口、接口或进行系统移植），而 porter 偏向执行搬运活动的主体或行为（行李员、搬运工或从事搬运）。

lemmas.def_zh: 味道
lemmas.def_en: the sensation that results when taste buds in the tongue and throat convey information about the chemical composition of a soluble stimulus

examples.en: The chef added fresh herbs to improve the taste of the soup.
examples.zh: 厨师加了新鲜香草以改善汤的味道。

lemmas.def_zh: （葡萄酒或食品的）品鉴会，品尝活动
lemmas.def_en: a gathering or event at which food or drink is sampled and evaluated

examples.en: We attended a wine tasting event at a local vineyard.
examples.zh: 我们在当地一家葡萄园参加了一场葡萄酒品鉴会。

lemmas.def_zh: 尝味道者, 审阅人, 试味仪
lemmas.def_en: someone who samples food or drink for its quality

examples.en: The professional wine taster swirled the glass before taking a small sip.
examples.zh: 专业品酒师先摇晃了酒杯，然后轻轻抿了一小口。

lemmas.def_en: pleasant palatability
lemmas.def_zh: [医]滋味, 味道

examples.en: Slow cooking enhances the natural tastiness of the beef without adding any artificial flavorings.
examples.zh: 慢炖能提升牛肉本身的美味，而无需添加任何人工调味剂。

lemmas.def_zh: 口淡
lemmas.def_en: the property of having no flavor

examples.en: The unexpected tastelessness of the expensive soup disappointed everyone at the dinner table.
examples.zh: 这道昂贵汤品出人意料的索然无味让餐桌上的每个人都很失望。

lemmas.def_zh: 有良好判断力或鉴赏力, 举止得体
lemmas.def_en: elegance indicated by good taste

examples.en: Guests continually admired the tastefulness of the floral decorations throughout the wedding venue.
examples.zh: 宾客们对整个婚礼现场花卉布置的高雅格调赞不绝口。

lemmas.def_zh: 品尝，尝；尝出……的味道；有……味道
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To eat or drink a small amount of something to test its flavor. 2. [T] To perceive the flavor of something. 3. [I] To have a particular flavor.

examples.en: She took a tiny sip to taste the soup before serving dinner.
examples.zh: 在开饭前，她抿了一小口尝了尝汤的味道。

lemmas.def_en: pleasing to the sense of taste
lemmas.def_zh: 好吃的, 可口的

examples.en: The chef prepared a simple yet tasty soup using fresh seasonal vegetables.
examples.zh: 厨师用新鲜的时令蔬菜做了一道简单却可口的汤。

lemmas.def_zh: 没味道的, 无鉴赏力的
lemmas.def_en: lacking flavor

examples.en: Without enough salt and spices, the boiled vegetables were completely bland and tasteless.
examples.zh: 没有放足够的盐和香料，煮熟的蔬菜吃起来索然无味。

lemmas.def_zh: 有鉴赏力的, 趣味高雅的, 雅观的
lemmas.def_en: having or showing or conforming to good taste

examples.en: She decorated the living room in a tasteful style with soft neutral colors.
examples.zh: 她用柔和的中性色调将客厅装饰得十分雅致。

lemmas.def_zh: 高雅地；雅致地
lemmas.def_en: with taste; in a tasteful manner

examples.en: The old hotel has been tastefully renovated to attract modern international travelers.
examples.zh: 这家老酒店经过雅致的翻修，以吸引现代国际旅客。

lemmas.def_zh: 低调地
lemmas.def_en: without taste or in poor taste; in a tasteless manner

examples.en: The comedian joked tastelessly about the recent tragedy, offending many audience members.
examples.zh: 该喜剧演员毫无品味地拿最近的悲剧开玩笑，冒犯了许多观众。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于古法语 taster（触摸、探试、感知），由身体感官的尝味演变为生理‘味觉/味道’，进而抽象升华为审美与精神层面的‘品味、鉴赏力’。
family_guide.core_distinction: taste 指感官味道或抽象的品味与爱好；tasting 则专指针对酒水、食品的‘品鉴会’或尝味活动。

lemmas.def_zh: 执照, 许可证, 特许
lemmas.def_en: a legal document giving official permission to do something

examples.en: You must renew your driver's license before it expires at the month's end.
examples.zh: 你必须在月底驾照到期之前去办理更换。

lemmas.def_zh: 获许可的人, 领到执照的人
lemmas.def_en: someone to whom a license is granted

examples.en: The licensee is legally required to follow all local safety and health regulations.
examples.zh: 持证人依法必须遵守当地所有的安全与卫生法规。

lemmas.def_zh: 放荡；放肆
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being lewd and lascivious

lemmas.def_zh: 发许可证/执照者
lemmas.def_en: an official who can issue a license or give authoritative permission (especially one who licenses publications)

examples.en: The software licenser grants users access under strict terms and conditions.
examples.zh: 软件许可方在严格的条款和条件下向用户授予访问权。

lemmas.def_zh: 批准，许可，发许可证给
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To give official or legal permission to someone to do, use, or own something.

examples.en: You must renew your driver's license before it expires at the month's end.
examples.zh: 你必须在月底驾照到期之前去办理更换。

lemmas.def_zh: 批准，许可，发许可证给
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (British English spelling of license) To grant official permission or a formal permit to do, use, or own something.

examples.en: The authority decided to licence the new drug after extensive clinical trials.
examples.zh: 经过广泛的临床试验后，主管部门决定特许该新药上市。

lemmas.def_zh: 没有执照的, 未经当局许可的
lemmas.def_en: lacking official approval

examples.en: Police impounded the unlicensed vehicle during a routine traffic inspection this morning.
examples.zh: 警方在今早的例行交通检查中扣押了那辆无照车辆。

lemmas.def_zh: 放肆的
lemmas.def_en: lacking moral discipline; especially sexually unrestrained

examples.en: Ancient historians often criticized the fallen emperor for his extremely licentious and wasteful lifestyle.
examples.zh: 古代历史学家常批评这位倒台皇帝生活放荡无度、挥霍成性。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 获得许可；民用设备的无线电频段
lemmas.def_en: lacking official approval

examples.en: Operating an unlicenced radio transmitter can interfere with critical aviation frequencies.
examples.zh: 操作未经许可的无线电发射机可能会干扰关键的航空频段。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 licentia（自由、许可），核心逻辑由“被允许的自由”引申为官方颁发的“许可证/执照”，亦可引申指超越常规的“特权或放任”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 美式英语中名词与动词均规范拼作 license；英式英语中名词规范拼作 licence，动词规范拼作 license（licence 用作动词主要为少见的拼写变体）。

lemmas.def_zh: 解决，化解（争端或难题）；下定决心；决议
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To solve or find a satisfactory end to a problem, conflict, or dispute. 2. [I, T] To make a firm decision to do something. 3. [T] (formal) To make a formal decision or vote on a motion.

examples.en: Both sides agreed to meet again in an effort to resolve their disputes peacefully.
examples.zh: 双方同意再次会面，努力以和平方式解决争议。

examples.en: She resolved to work harder and never repeat the same mistake.
examples.zh: 她下定决心要更加努力，绝不再犯同样的错误。

lemmas.def_zh: 解决；决心；决议；分辨率
lemmas.def_en: a firm decision to do something; an official decision made by a group; the act of solving a problem; image clarity

examples.en: Making a New Year's resolution is easy, but keeping it requires self-discipline.
examples.zh: 立下新年决心很容易，但坚持下去需要自律。

examples.en: The UN Security Council passed a resolution calling for an immediate ceasefire.
examples.zh: 联合国安理会通过了一项呼吁立即停火的决议。

lemmas.def_zh: 溶剂, 解决方法
lemmas.def_en: a liquid substance capable of dissolving other substances

examples.en: Patience and open dialogue proved to be the best resolvent for their dispute.
examples.zh: 耐心和坦诚的对话被证明是解决他们纷争的最佳办法。

lemmas.def_zh: 无决断力的, 不果断的, 无决心的, 未解决的, 未澄清的, 未议决的, 未分解的
lemmas.def_en: not solved

examples.en: Several key issues remain unresolved despite hours of intensive negotiations yesterday.
examples.zh: 尽管昨天进行了数小时的紧张谈判，几个关键问题仍未解决。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 resolvere（re- 彻底 + solvere 解开、松开），核心逻辑由“解开死结”引申为“解决矛盾难题”，再延伸出“理清思绪后下定决心”。
family_guide.core_distinction: resolve 是动词（兼作不可数名词表意志力），而 resolution 是其多义派生名词，涵盖“解决方案、决心、正式决议”以及由“细节被清晰解开”引申出的“分辨率”。

lemmas.def_zh: 机场；航空站
lemmas.def_en: a place where aircraft regularly take off and land, with runways and facilities for passengers

examples.en: We should leave for the airport early to ensure we have enough time for security check.
examples.zh: 我们得早点动身去机场，确保有足够的时间安检。

examples.en: The international airport connects the city to major destinations around the globe.
examples.zh: 这座国际机场将该城市与全球各大主要目的地连接起来。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 air（空中）与 port（港口）复合而成，字面即“空中的港口”，专指供飞机起降及旅客、货物集散的航空港。

lemmas.def_zh: 推断出，得出结论；（使）结束，终止；达成，缔结
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] to decide or form an opinion after considering all the facts or information. 2. [I, T] to bring something to an end, or to come to an end. 3. [T] to arrange or agree on a formal agreement or deal

examples.en: The researchers concluded that the new drug was both safe and effective.
examples.zh: 研究人员得出结论，这种新药既安全又有效。

examples.en: She concluded her presentation with a call for urgent action.
examples.zh: 她在演讲结束时呼吁采取紧急行动。

lemmas.def_zh: 结论，推论；结尾，结束
lemmas.def_en: a judgment or decision reached by reasoning; the end or close of an event or text

examples.en: After weighing all the evidence, the committee reached a final conclusion.
examples.zh: 权衡所有证据后，委员会得出了最终结论。

examples.en: At the conclusion of the summit, leaders signed a joint declaration.
examples.zh: 峰会闭幕时，各国领导人签署了联合宣言。

lemmas.def_zh: 最后, 释疑, 确定性, 结论性
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being final or definitely settled

examples.en: The conclusiveness of the DNA evidence left no doubt about his guilt.
examples.zh: DNA证据的确凿性让他的罪行毫无疑问。

lemmas.def_zh: 决定性的, 确定性的, 最后的
lemmas.def_en: forming an end or termination; especially putting an end to doubt or question

examples.en: The laboratory test provided conclusive proof that the water supply was contaminated.
examples.zh: 实验室检测提供了水源受到污染的决定性证据。

lemmas.def_zh: 最后, 释疑, 确定性, 结论性
lemmas.def_en: in a conclusive way

examples.en: Recent archaeological findings conclusively demonstrate that humans settled here much earlier.
examples.zh: 最近的考古发现确定无疑地表明，人类在此定居的时间要早得多。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 concludere（con- 完全 + claudere 关闭），本义为“彻底合上、关闭”，引申为事件的“收尾、结束”以及思维综合所有事实后的“得出推断”。

lemmas.def_zh: 日本
lemmas.def_en: a string of more than 3,000 islands to the east of Asia extending 1,300 miles between the Sea of Japan and the western Pacific Ocean

examples.en: Craftsmen applied glossy black japan to the metal surface to prevent rusting.
examples.zh: 工匠在金属表面涂上光泽的黑漆以防止生锈。

lemmas.def_zh: 给……涂亮漆，给……上黑漆
lemmas.def_en: [T] To coat a surface with a hard, glossy black lacquer.

examples.en: Craftsmen applied glossy black japan to the metal surface to prevent rusting.
examples.zh: 工匠在金属表面涂上光泽的黑漆以防止生锈。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于国名 Japan（日本），因17至18世纪日本精美的漆器风靡西方，小写后转指模仿该工艺的“日本黑漆、漆器”（名词），进而派生出“涂黑漆/上光漆”（动词）。

lemmas.def_zh: 完全地；充分地；彻底地
lemmas.def_en: completely, entirely, or to the maximum degree

examples.en: I am fully aware of the potential risks involved in this project.
examples.zh: 我完全清楚这个项目所涉及的潜在风险。

examples.en: The hotel is fully booked for the upcoming holiday weekend.
examples.zh: 即将到来的假期周末，这家酒店的房间已全部订满。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 full（充满的、完整的），加上副词后缀 -ly，核心语义表示“达到满额、完整无缺或极致的状态”，即“完全地、充分地”。

lemmas.def_zh: 偏爱，青睐；有利于；赞同，支持
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To treat with partiality or prefer one person or thing over another. 2. To approve of, support, or be advantageous to.

examples.en: The committee tends to favor candidates with international work experience.
examples.zh: 委员会往往更青睐具有国际工作经验的候选人。

examples.en: Could you do me a favor and hold the elevator for a moment?
examples.zh: 你能帮我个忙，稍微挡一下电梯门吗？

lemmas.def_zh: 偏爱，青睐；有利于；赞同，支持（英式拼写）
lemmas.def_en: [T] (chiefly British English) 1. To treat with partiality or prefer one person or thing over another. 2. To approve of, support, or be advantageous to.

examples.en: Current economic conditions clearly favour larger corporations.
examples.zh: 当前的经济形势显然对大型企业更为有利。

lemmas.def_zh: v. 偏爱，倾向于，有利于；n. 恩惠，帮助，赞同
lemmas.def_en: v. to prefer, support, or be advantageous to; n. an act of kindness, approval, or support

examples.en: The committee tends to favor candidates with international work experience.
examples.zh: 委员会往往更青睐具有国际工作经验的候选人。

examples.en: Could you do me a favor and hold the elevator for a moment?
examples.zh: 你能帮我个忙，稍微挡一下电梯门吗？

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 受到喜爱的；享有特权的；最被看好的
lemmas.def_en: preferred above all others and treated with partiality; enjoying special advantages
lemmas.usage_note: 常用于描述竞选或赛事中胜算最大的对象（the favored candidate）或受宠的人事物（most favored nation）。

examples.en: She was the favored candidate to win the presidential nomination.
examples.zh: 她是赢得总统提名的最被看好的人选。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 favere（照顾、支持、善意对待），核心逻辑是“倾斜善意或资源”，引申出“偏爱、支持、有利于”及“恩惠、好意”。
family_guide.core_distinction: favor 与 favour 仅为美式与英式拼写差异；favor 兼具动词（偏爱、有利于）与名词（恩惠、好意、赞同）两类核心词性。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 天气，气象；v. 经受住，平安度过（困难）；（使）风化，（受风雨侵蚀）褪色变质
lemmas.def_en: n. the conditions in the air above the earth such as wind, rain, or temperature; v. to deal successfully with a difficult situation, or to change in colour or shape because of the effects of sun, wind, or rain

examples.en: The flight was delayed due to severe weather conditions.
examples.zh: 由于恶劣的天气条件，航班被延误了。

examples.en: The company managed to weather the financial crisis through strict cost-cutting measures.
examples.zh: 该公司通过严格的削减成本措施，成功度过了金融危机。

examples.en: The unpainted wooden fence had weathered to a soft silver-grey.
examples.zh: 那道没刷油漆的木栅栏经风吹雨淋，已变成淡淡的银灰色。

lemmas.def_zh: 经受住，平安度过（难关、风暴等）；（使）风化，（受风雨侵蚀）褪色变质
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To endure, survive, or come through a difficult situation or storm safely. 2. [I, T] To change in color, shape, or condition as a result of exposure to the elements.

examples.en: The flight was delayed due to severe weather conditions.
examples.zh: 由于恶劣的天气条件，航班被延误了。

examples.en: The company managed to weather the financial crisis through strict cost-cutting measures.
examples.zh: 该公司通过严格的削减成本措施，成功度过了金融危机。

examples.en: The unpainted wooden fence had weathered to a soft silver-grey.
examples.zh: 那道没刷油漆的木栅栏经风吹雨淋，已变成淡淡的银灰色。

lemmas.def_zh: [海](帆船)能驶向上风的, 能抢风航行的
lemmas.def_en: (of a sailing vessel) making very little leeway when close-hauled

examples.en: The traditional schooner proved remarkably weatherly during the heavy offshore gale.
examples.zh: 在强劲的离岸大风中，这艘传统帆船展现出了出色的抢风航行能力。

lemmas.def_zh: 未风化的, 未经风化的
lemmas.def_en: not worn by exposure to the weather

examples.en: Geologists collected samples of unweathered granite from deep inside the mountain quarry.
examples.zh: 地质学家从山间采石场深处采集了未风化的花岗岩样本。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语根，本义为“风、空气或暴风雨”。名词指“大气的状态”；通过词性转化演变为动词，原指“在露天经受风吹雨打”，进而引申为物理上的“风化/褪色”以及比喻意义上的“安然度过危机/挺过风浪”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词侧重大气现象与气候变化，动词则侧重于“经受风雨”这一动作及衍生出的“抵御风险、熬过艰难险阻”之意。

lemmas.def_zh: 引用，引述；报价，开价
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] to repeat or copy words that someone else has said or written 2. [I, T] to state the price of a job, service, or goods

examples.en: She quoted a well-known passage from Shakespeare to support her argument.
examples.zh: 她引用了莎士比亚的一段名篇来支持自己的论点。

examples.en: The contractor quoted us $3,000 to renovate the bathroom.
examples.zh: 承包商给我们的卫生间翻新报价是三千美元。

lemmas.def_zh: 错误地引用，断章取义地引述
lemmas.def_en: [T] to repeat or cite someone's words incorrectly or inaccurately

examples.en: The reporter managed to misquote the minister's statement in today's headline article.
examples.zh: 记者在今天的头条文章中竟然错误地引用了部长的声明。

lemmas.def_zh: 引文，引述；报价（单）
lemmas.def_en: a phrase or passage repeated from a speech or text; a formal statement of estimated cost

examples.en: The book opens with a brief quotation from a poem.
examples.zh: 这本书的开篇是一句简短的诗歌引文。

examples.en: We requested a detailed written quotation before signing the contract.
examples.zh: 我们在签订合同前索取了详细的书面报价单。

lemmas.def_en: an incorrect quotation

examples.en: The reporter managed to misquote the minister's statement in today's headline article.
examples.zh: 记者在今天的头条文章中竟然错误地引用了部长的声明。

lemmas.def_zh: 引用错误
lemmas.def_en: an incorrect quotation

examples.en: The author apologized for the misquotation that altered the original meaning entirely.
examples.zh: 作者为完全改变了原意的引用错误表示道歉。

lemmas.def_zh: 引用者, 报价者
lemmas.def_en: a communicator (speaker or writer) who uses quotations

examples.en: As a frequent quoter of ancient philosophy, he inspired many young students.
examples.zh: 作为古希腊哲学的频繁引用者，他启发了许多年轻学生。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 quot（多少），最初指“标明章节编号以备参考”，后演变为“引用原话”以及“开列价格（报价）”。
family_guide.core_distinction: quote 是核心动词（口语中也常作名词使用），而 quotation 是更正式的标准名词形式，指引文或书面报价。

lemmas.def_zh: 侧面, 轮廓, 传略
lemmas.def_en: an analysis (often in graphical form) representing the extent to which something exhibits various characteristics

examples.en: The magazine published an insightful profile of the award-winning young architect.
examples.zh: 该杂志刊登了一篇关于这位屡获殊荣的年轻建筑师的深刻人物特写。

lemmas.def_zh: 给……写传略（或人物简介）；描出……的轮廓
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To write or produce a short description of someone's life, character, or work. 2. [T] To outline or represent in profile.

examples.en: The magazine published an insightful profile of the award-winning young architect.
examples.zh: 该杂志刊登了一篇关于这位屡获殊荣的年轻建筑师的深刻人物特写。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自意大利语 profilare（pro-向前 + filare拉线/画线），本义指“用线条勾画侧面轮廓”，后引申为概述特征、形象简况或人物侧写。

lemmas.def_zh: 挥手；招手
lemmas.def_en: one of a series of ridges that moves across the surface of a liquid (especially across a large body of water)

examples.en: She gave a friendly wave to her neighbors as she walked past.
examples.zh: 她走过时向邻居们友好地挥了挥手。

lemmas.def_zh: 动摇, 踌躇, 挥动者
lemmas.def_en: someone who communicates by waving

examples.en: After a slight waver in his confidence, he stepped onto the main stage.
examples.zh: 在信心稍有动摇之后，他走上了主舞台。

lemmas.def_zh: 小浪, 微波
lemmas.def_en: a small wave on the surface of a liquid

examples.en: Gentle wavelets lapped quietly against the hull of the small wooden fishing boat.
examples.zh: 柔和的微波静静地拍打着这艘小木渔船的船体。

lemmas.def_zh: 波状, 波纹形
lemmas.def_en: (of hair) a tendency to curl

lemmas.def_zh: 招手致意，挥舞；（使）飘动
lemmas.def_en:
1. [I, T] to move your hand or arm as a greeting, farewell, or signal
2. [I, T] to move loosely back and forth or flutter in the wind

examples.en: He stood on the beach, watching a huge wave crash onto the shore.
examples.zh: 他站在海滩上，看着一个巨大的波浪拍打在岸边。

lemmas.def_zh: 犹豫不决，摇摆；摇晃，摇曳，颤抖
lemmas.def_en: [I] 1. To hesitate between choices or be unable to make a decision. 2. To flicker, tremble, or shake unsteadily.

examples.en: After a slight waver in his confidence, he stepped onto the main stage.
examples.zh: 在信心稍有动摇之后，他走上了主舞台。

lemmas.def_zh: 有波浪的, 多浪的, 波浪状的, 波动的, 不稳定的
lemmas.def_en: (of hair) having waves

examples.en: The actress is known for her long wavy brown hair and bright smile.
examples.zh: 这位女演员以一头深色波浪长发和灿烂的笑容而闻名。

lemmas.def_zh: 不动摇的, 坚定的
lemmas.def_en: marked by firm determination or resolution; not shakable

examples.en: She achieved her long-term goal thanks to the unwavering support of her parents.
examples.zh: 多亏了父母坚定不移的支持，她实现了自己的长期目标。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 坚定地
lemmas.def_en: with resolute determination

examples.en: The soldier remained unwaveringly loyal to his mission despite the extreme conditions.
examples.zh: 尽管条件极端恶劣，这名士兵依然坚定地忠于自己的使命。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于古英语表示'来回摆动、摇晃'的词根，核心意象为'起伏运动'，既可具体指翻腾的水浪或挥手的动作，也引申为物理波动及抽象的狂潮或趋势。

lemmas.def_zh: 擅长，善于；胜过，超越
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To be exceptionally good at doing something; to perform better than others.

examples.en: She has always excelled in foreign languages and analytical thinking.
examples.zh: 她在外语和分析思维方面一向表现突出。

examples.en: The team worked hard to excel beyond their competitors in the final round.
examples.zh: 团队奋力拼搏，在决赛中超越了竞争对手。

lemmas.def_zh: 极好的，卓越的，优秀的
lemmas.def_en: extremely good; of outstanding quality

examples.en: The hotel is renowned for its excellent service and scenic location.
examples.zh: 这家酒店以其一流的服务和优美的风景闻名。

examples.en: He did an excellent job presenting the research findings to the board.
examples.zh: 他向董事会汇报研究成果的表现非常出色。

lemmas.def_zh: 卓越，杰出，优秀
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being outstanding or extremely good

examples.en: The school has built a reputation for academic and athletic excellence.
examples.zh: 这所学校在学术与体育两方面都建立了卓越的声誉。

examples.en: Our company is committed to pursuing operational excellence in every project.
examples.zh: 我们公司致力于在每个项目中追求运营层面的精益求精。

lemmas.def_zh: 优点, 阁下
lemmas.def_en: a title used to address dignitaries (such as ambassadors or governors); usually preceded by `Your' or `His' or `Her'

examples.en: The ambassador greeted His Excellency with a respectful bow at the grand entrance.
examples.zh: 大使在大门处恭敬地鞠躬向阁下致意。

lemmas.def_zh: 极好地；优异地
lemmas.def_en: extremely well

examples.en: The entire team performed excellently, winning the championship by a wide margin.
examples.zh: 整个团队表现极其优异，以巨大优势赢得了冠军。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语前缀 ex-（出、向外）加 cellere（升起、耸立），核心逻辑是“从人群或常态中拔地而起”，引申为超越众人、表现杰出。

lemmas.def_zh: 流行, 风尚, 时样
lemmas.def_en: how something is done or how it happens

examples.en: Vintage clothing styles have suddenly come back into fashion among young people.
examples.zh: 复古服装风格突然在年轻人当中重新流行起来。

lemmas.def_zh: 手工制作，打造，塑造（使成形）
lemmas.def_en: [T] To shape, make, or form something skillfully, especially with hands or simple tools.

examples.en: Vintage clothing styles have suddenly come back into fashion among young people.
examples.zh: 复古服装风格突然在年轻人当中重新流行起来。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 facere（制作、成形），核心演变逻辑为从具体的“塑形、制作”延伸至抽象的“做事的方式/样态”，进而演化为群体普遍遵循的“风尚、潮流”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词常指流行的潮流或做事的方式；动词则保留古义，专指用手或工具“手工制作、塑形”。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）平整，（使）平坦；（使）相等，（使）平均
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. to make a surface flat, smooth, or level 2. to make amounts, scores, or conditions equal or balanced

examples.en: A late penalty allowed the team to even the score just before the final whistle.
examples.zh: 终场哨响前的一次点球让该队扳平了比分。

lemmas.def_zh: 傍晚，晚上；晚会
lemmas.def_en: the period of time at the end of the day between late afternoon and bedtime

examples.en: They spent a pleasant evening catching up with old friends over dinner.
examples.zh: 他们共进晚餐，与老友们度过了一个愉快的叙旧之夜。

family_guide.root_logic: 动词 even 源于日耳曼语“平坦”之意，指使水平或扯平；名词 evening 原由古英语 eve（黄昏）加后缀衍生而来，现代形式恰与动词 even 的动名词重合。
family_guide.core_distinction: even 作为动词表示“使平整、扯平（比分）”；evening 专指“傍晚、晚间”。

lemmas.def_zh: 自由；自主权；免除；摆脱
lemmas.def_en: the power or right to act, speak, or think as one wants without hindrance or restraint

examples.en: The new constitution guarantees freedom of speech and the press.
examples.zh: 新宪法保障言论与新闻出版自由。

examples.en: Retirement finally gave her the freedom to travel the world.
examples.zh: 退休终于让她有了周游世界的自由。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 *frēodōm*，由形容词 free（自由的、不受拘束的）加名词后缀 -dom（状态、领地）构成，核心意涵即为‘处于不受奴役或限制的自主状态’。

lemmas.def_zh: 王室的, 皇家的, 盛大的, 庄严的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or indicative of or issued or performed by a king or queen or other monarch

examples.en: The royal family appeared together on the balcony to greet the cheering crowd.
examples.zh: 王室成员一同出现在阳台上，向欢呼的人群致意。

lemmas.def_zh: 王室, 皇族
lemmas.def_en: a sail set next above the topgallant on a royal mast

examples.en: The royal family appeared together on the balcony to greet the cheering crowd.
examples.zh: 王室成员一同出现在阳台上，向欢呼的人群致意。

lemmas.def_zh: 帝王似地, 庄严地
lemmas.def_en: in a royal manner

examples.en: They were treated royally throughout their stay at the five-star luxury resort.
examples.zh: 他们在五星级豪华度假村逗留期间受到了帝王般的款待。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 regalis（rex '国王' + -alis），经由古法语演变而来，核心始终指‘国王的、王室的’，后引申为高贵盛大的，并名词化特指王室成员。

lemmas.def_zh: 一双, 一对, 一副
lemmas.def_en: a set of two similar things considered as a unit

examples.en: I bought a comfortable new pair of running shoes for the upcoming marathon.
examples.zh: 我为即将到来的马拉松买了一双舒适的新跑鞋。

lemmas.def_zh: 配对；搭配；组合
lemmas.def_en: the combination of two things or people, especially for food and wine or in a competition

examples.en: The restaurant offers a five-course tasting menu with expert wine pairings.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅提供包含专业餐酒搭配的五道菜品鉴套餐。

examples.en: The tournament pairings will be announced right after the draw.
examples.zh: 锦标赛的对阵配对结果将在抽签后立即公布。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）成对，配对；使结合，连接
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (+ with/up) To join together in pairs, or to bring two people or things together to work or form a unit.

examples.en: I bought a comfortable new pair of running shoes for the upcoming marathon.
examples.zh: 我为即将到来的马拉松买了一双舒适的新跑鞋。

lemmas.def_zh: 未配对的, 无配偶的
lemmas.def_en: of the remaining member of a pair, of socks e.g.

examples.en: After washing the laundry, he found a single unpaired sock in the dryer.
examples.zh: 洗完衣服后，他在烘干机里发现了一只未配对的袜子。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 par（对等的），核心意象为“由两个对等或互补的事物构成的一套组合”。
family_guide.core_distinction: pair 作名词指固有成套或天然结合的“一对/双”；pairing 则偏向动作产生的结果，指情境下的“搭配、配对组合”（如餐酒搭配、比赛对阵）。

lemmas.def_zh: 暖和的, 暖的, 温暖的, 热烈的, 兴奋的, 激烈的, 多情的, 色情的
lemmas.def_en: having or producing a comfortable and agreeable degree of heat or imparting or maintaining heat

examples.en: We sat together by the fireplace to stay warm on that freezing night.
examples.zh: 在那个寒冷的夜晚，我们一起坐在壁炉旁取暖。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）变暖，（使）温暖；加热（食物等，常与up连用）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To become warm or warmer, or to make someone or something warm or warmer.

examples.en: We sat together by the fireplace to stay warm on that freezing night.
examples.zh: 在那个寒冷的夜晚，我们一起坐在壁炉旁取暖。

lemmas.def_zh: 亲切地, 温暖地, 热心地
lemmas.def_en: in a hearty manner

examples.en: The host warmly welcomed all the guests as they arrived at the party.
examples.zh: 客人们到达聚会时，主人热情地欢迎了大家。

lemmas.def_zh: 进行加热的人, 取暖器
lemmas.def_en: device that heats water or supplies warmth to a room

examples.en: She bought an electric hand warmer to keep her fingers comfortable outside.
examples.zh: 她买了一个电暖手宝，以便在户外保持手指舒适。

lemmas.def_zh: 温暖；亲切
lemmas.def_en: a positive feeling of liking

examples.en: He was deeply moved by the sudden warmness in her usually stern voice.
examples.zh: 她平日严厉的语调中突然流露出的温情深深打动了他。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语表示“热、暖”的词根，从生理上的“适度温热”自然引申至心理与情感上的“亲切、热情与活跃”。
family_guide.core_distinction: warm 兼具形容词与动词功能（表状态或升温过程），而 warmer 则是名词化后缀 -er 构成的施动工具词，专指产生或保持热量的器具或保暖衣物。

lemmas.def_zh: 撕裂，扯破；撕下；飞奔
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To pull or be pulled apart or into pieces by force. 2. [I] To run or move somewhere very quickly.

examples.en: A single tear rolled slowly down her pale cheek during the sad movie.
examples.zh: 在这部悲伤的电影放映期间，一滴泪水从她苍白的脸颊滑落。

lemmas.def_zh: 撕裂，扯破；使分裂（tear的过去分词）
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] Past participle of tear; to pull apart forcefully, or to be divided between conflicting choices.

examples.en: His jacket was torn by sharp branches as he ran through the forest.
examples.zh: 他在穿过森林奔跑时，夹克被锋利的树枝挂破了。

lemmas.def_zh: 泪滴, 眼泪, 撕, 扯, 裂缝, 激怒, 飞奔
lemmas.def_en: a drop of the clear salty saline solution secreted by the lacrimal glands

examples.en: A single tear rolled slowly down her pale cheek during the sad movie.
examples.zh: 在这部悲伤的电影放映期间，一滴泪水从她苍白的脸颊滑落。

lemmas.def_zh: （建筑）柱础圆环线脚（torus 的变体）
lemmas.def_en: commonly the lowest molding at the base of a column

examples.en: She tore open the envelope eagerly to see if she had been accepted.
examples.zh: 她急切地撕开信封，看看自己是否被录取了。

lemmas.def_zh: tear的过去分词
lemmas.def_en: having edges that are jagged from injury

examples.en: He was deeply torn between accepting the promotion and staying close to his family.
examples.zh: 他在接受晋升和陪伴家人之间深感纠结。

lemmas.def_zh: 含泪的, 使人流泪的, 流泪的
lemmas.def_en: filled with or marked by tears

examples.en: She gave a tearful farewell to her friends before boarding the train.
examples.zh: 她在登上火车前含泪与朋友们道别。

lemmas.def_zh: 无泪的, 不流泪的
lemmas.def_en: free from tears

examples.en: Despite the tragic news, he remained strangely calm and tearless throughout the day.
examples.zh: 尽管听到了悲讯，他整天却出奇地平静，没有流下一滴眼泪。

lemmas.def_zh: 泪汪汪地, 流泪地
lemmas.def_en: with tears; in a tearful manner

examples.en: The child tearfully apologized after realizing he had broken his mother's favorite vase.
examples.zh: 孩子意识到自己打碎了母亲最喜欢的花瓶后，哭着道了歉。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语支，核心意象为“用力拉扯并使之破裂”，由物理层面的“撕扯、破裂”引申出心理层面的“撕裂、纠结”以及剧烈动作“疾驰（破空而行）”。
family_guide.core_distinction: tear (n.) 专指撕裂的破口；tore 为过去式（少数专业语境下用作名词表示几何圆环面）；torn 作形容词时常专指“内心左右为难的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 建议；忠告；劝告
lemmas.def_en: guidance or recommendations offered with regard to prudent future action

examples.en: She decided to follow her doctor's advice and take a few weeks off work.
examples.zh: 她决定遵从医生的建议，休假几周。

examples.en: Could you give me a piece of advice on how to prepare for the interview?
examples.zh: 关于如何准备面试，你能给我提一条建议吗？

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ad-（朝向）+ videre（看），原义为“就某事所持的看法”，后演化为指导他人行动的“意见、建议”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 注意 advice 为名词（末尾发 /s/ 音，且通常为不可数名词），而其同源动词为 advise（末尾发 /z/ 音）。

lemmas.def_zh: 工具, 机床, 傀儡
lemmas.def_en: an implement used in the practice of a vocation

examples.en: The craftsman took hours to carefully tool the leather belt with delicate patterns.
examples.zh: 手艺人花了数小时用工具在皮带上精心加工出精致的花纹。

lemmas.def_zh: （驾车）闲逛，兜风；用工具加工（或装备）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (informal) (often followed by 'around' or 'along') To drive or travel in a vehicle, especially casually or leisurely. 2. [T] To shape, ornament, or equip something with a tool.

examples.en: The craftsman took hours to carefully tool the leather belt with delicate patterns.
examples.zh: 手艺人花了数小时用工具在皮带上精心加工出精致的花纹。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 tōl，本义指辅助完成某种工作或工艺的器具，后引申为抽象手段、被利用的傀儡（工具人），动词化后表示用工具加工、装备工装设备或驾车漫游。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词侧重实体器具或抽象手段；动词多用于工业机械加工（如装配机床、雕刻皮革）或口语小品词搭配（如 tool around 兜风、tool up 武装/配备）。

lemmas.def_zh: 照料，看护，照管；往往会，倾向于
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. To care for or look after someone or something. 2. [I] To regularly or frequently behave in a particular way or be likely to do something.

examples.en: People tend to make more mistakes when they are sleep-deprived.
examples.zh: 人们在睡眠不足时往往更容易犯错。

examples.en: The shepherd carefully tended his flock through the harsh winter.
examples.zh: 牧羊人在严冬里悉心照料着他的羊群。

lemmas.def_zh: 正式提出，呈递；投标；（法官等）裁定给予
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (formal) To offer or present something formally for acceptance. 2. [I] (business) To make a formal offer to supply goods or do a job at a stated price.

examples.en: The slow-cooked meat was so soft and tender that it melted in your mouth.
examples.zh: 慢炖的肉质地非常软嫩，入口即化。

lemmas.def_zh: 使嫩化
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To tenderize meat means to make it softer and easier to chew by beating, marinating, or slow cooking.

examples.en: You should tenderize the steak with a mallet before grilling it on high heat.
examples.zh: 在高火煎烤牛排之前，你应该先用肉槌将其敲嫩。

lemmas.def_zh: 照料, 看管人, 供应船, 小船, 提出, 偿付, 投标
lemmas.def_en: something that can be used as an official medium of payment

examples.en: The slow-cooked meat was so soft and tender that it melted in your mouth.
examples.zh: 慢炖的肉质地非常软嫩，入口即化。

lemmas.def_en: an attitude of mind especially one that favors one alternative over others
lemmas.def_zh: n. 倾向，偏好；趋势

examples.en: He has a frustrating tendency to interrupt others during discussions.
examples.zh: 他在讨论中总爱打断别人，这种毛病很令人恼火。

lemmas.def_zh: 柔软, 亲切, 柔和, 敏感, 易触痛
lemmas.def_en: a tendency to express warm and affectionate feeling

examples.en: He treated the injured puppy with remarkable tenderness and round-the-clock care.
examples.zh: 他以极大的温柔和悉心的照料对待这只受伤的小狗。

lemmas.def_zh: 嫩肉粉
lemmas.def_en: a substance (as the plant enzyme papain) applied to meat to make it tender

examples.en: She sprinkled a pinch of meat tenderizer over the beef to make it juicy.
examples.zh: 她在牛肉上撒了一小撮嫩肉粉，使其口感更加多汁。

lemmas.def_zh: 温和地；体贴地；柔和地
lemmas.def_en: with tenderness; in a tender manner

examples.en: The mother smiled and tenderly kissed her sleeping baby on the forehead.
examples.zh: 母亲微笑着，温柔地亲吻了熟睡中婴儿的额头。

lemmas.def_en: in a tendentious manner
lemmas.def_zh: 宣传性地, 不公平地, 有倾向性地

examples.en: The reporter tendentiously selected facts to confirm his predetermined conclusion about the scandal.
examples.zh: 该记者带有偏见地挑选事实，以印证他对这桩丑闻的预设结论。

lemmas.def_zh: 嫩的, 柔软的, 脆弱的, 温柔的, 亲切的, 未成熟的, 微妙的, 棘手的, 审慎的
lemmas.def_en: given to sympathy or gentleness or sentimentality

examples.en: The slow-cooked meat was so soft and tender that it melted in your mouth.
examples.zh: 慢炖的肉质地非常软嫩，入口即化。

lemmas.def_en: having or marked by a strong tendency especially a controversial one
lemmas.def_zh: 有偏见的, 有倾向的, 淘气的

examples.en: The article offered a tendentious argument that clearly favored the ruling party.
examples.zh: 这篇文章提出了一个带有明显偏向执政党倾向的论点。

family_guide.root_logic: 核心源自拉丁语 tendere（伸出、延展、朝向），引申出事物发展方向上的“倾向”以及将心力延伸至某处的“照料”；商务/法律语境下延展为伸出手递交的“投标、正式提出”；而形容词 tender（柔软脆弱）源自拉丁语 tener，属于同形异源词。
family_guide.core_distinction: tend 常接 to 表示“倾向”或直连宾语表“照料”；tender 作动/名词源于同一词源，专用于“正式递交/投标”；tender 作形容词则表示“温柔的、软嫩的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 鼓励，激励；促进，促使
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To give support, confidence, or hope to someone. 2. [T] To stimulate, foster, or promote the development of something.

examples.en: My parents always encouraged me to pursue my passion for music.
examples.zh: 父母总是鼓励我追求自己对音乐的热爱。

examples.en: The government introduced tax cuts to encourage investment.
examples.zh: 政府出台了减税政策以促进投资。

lemmas.def_zh: 鼓励，激励；令人鼓舞的事物
lemmas.def_en: the action of giving someone support or confidence; words or things that inspire hope

examples.en: Her kind words were a huge source of encouragement to the whole team.
examples.zh: 她亲切的话语对整个团队而言是巨大的鼓舞。

examples.en: With a little encouragement, he managed to overcome his fear of public speaking.
examples.zh: 在一点点鼓励下，他成功克服了对公开演讲的恐惧。

lemmas.def_zh: 鼓励地, 勉励人地
lemmas.def_en: in an encouraging manner

examples.en: The teacher smiled encouragingly at the nervous student before the piano performance.
examples.zh: 钢琴演奏前，老师向紧张的学生投去鼓励的微笑。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 令人鼓舞的；带来希望的
lemmas.def_en: giving courage, confidence, or hope; promising good results
lemmas.usage_note: 常与 signs, news, results 等抽象名词搭配，表示形势向好。

examples.en: The initial clinical trials have yielded encouraging results.
examples.zh: 前期的临床试验取得了令人鼓舞的结果。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自前缀 en-（使充满、注入）+ courage（勇气），核心逻辑为“向某人注入勇气”，引申指在心理上给予支持激励，或在客观上促进发展。

lemmas.def_zh: 宇宙；天地万物；领域，体系
lemmas.def_en: all existing matter and space considered as a whole; a particular sphere of activity or experience

examples.en: Scientists believe that the universe is constantly expanding.
examples.zh: 科学家认为宇宙正在不断膨胀。

examples.en: The novel creates a rich universe populated by mythical creatures.
examples.zh: 这部小说构建了一个充满神话生物的丰富虚构世界。

lemmas.def_zh: 普遍原则；通用特征；共性
lemmas.def_en: a general principle, concept, or feature that applies to all cases or individuals

examples.en: The pursuit of happiness is considered a human universal.
examples.zh: 追求幸福被认为是全人类共通的天性。

examples.en: Philosophers have long debated whether moral universals truly exist.
examples.zh: 哲学家们长期争论是否存在真正普适的道德准则。

lemmas.def_zh: 普遍性, 一般性, 广泛性
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being universal; existing everywhere

examples.en: Great literature often achieves enduring fame through the universality of its core themes.
examples.zh: 伟大的文学作品往往因其核心主题的普遍性而享有持久的声誉。

lemmas.def_zh: 普遍地；广泛地；人人皆知地
lemmas.def_en: by everyone; in every case or without exception

examples.en: His groundbreaking research is universally accepted within the scientific community.
examples.zh: 他的突破性研究在科学界得到了普遍认可。

examples.en: The musical was universally acclaimed by critics and audiences alike.
examples.zh: 这部音乐剧受到了剧评人和观众的一致好评。

lemmas.def_zh: 使一般化, 使普遍化, 普及
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To universalize a rule, right, or concept means to make it apply to everyone or exist everywhere.

examples.en: The new policy seeks to universalize access to quality healthcare across all rural districts.
examples.zh: 这项新政策旨在使优质医疗服务在所有农村地区普及。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 unus（单一）和 vertere（转动），字面意为“合而为一的整体”，演变为包含万事万物的“宇宙”，进而引申出“普遍的、共性的”概念。
family_guide.core_distinction: universe 指有形或无形的“宇宙、整体世界”，而名词 universal 则指抽象的“普遍原则、共性”。

lemmas.def_zh: 排斥，排除在外；不包括，不予考虑
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To deliberately prevent someone or something from entering a place or taking part in an activity. 2. [T] To leave out or decide not to consider something.

examples.en: The advertised hotel rates exclude local taxes and service charges.
examples.zh: 广告中公布的酒店价格不包括当地税费和服务费。

lemmas.def_zh: 独家新闻；独家报道；独占商品
lemmas.def_en: a news story or feature published or broadcast by only one source

examples.en: The newspaper secured a major exclusive with the former president.
examples.zh: 该报获得了对前总统的重大独家专访。

lemmas.def_zh: 排斥；排除在外；不计在内
lemmas.def_en: the act of preventing someone or something from entering or participating

examples.en: Long-term unemployment can lead to poverty and social exclusion.
examples.zh: 长期失业会导致贫困以及被社会排斥。

lemmas.def_zh: 排外性；排他性；独占
lemmas.def_en: tendency to associate with only a select group

examples.en: The private club maintained an aura of exclusiveness by strictly limiting new memberships.
examples.zh: 该私人俱乐部通过严格限制新会员数量来维持其排他性。

lemmas.def_zh: 专门地；仅仅；独家地
lemmas.def_en: only; purely; without including any others

examples.en: This high-end facility is used exclusively for medical research.
examples.zh: 这个高端设施专门用于医学研究。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语前缀 ex-（向外）+ claudere（关闭），字面即“关在门外”，核心演化为阻隔在特定范围之外、排他或独占。
family_guide.core_distinction: exclusion 是动作或状态名词（排除、排斥），而 exclusive 作名词时特指“独家新闻”或“独占产品”。

lemmas.def_zh: 赞赏，欣赏，珍视；感激；理解，体谅；增值
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. [T] To recognize the good qualities or value of someone or something. 2. [T] To be grateful for something. 3. [T] To fully understand or realize a situation. 4. [I] To increase in value over time.

examples.en: I really appreciate you taking the time to discuss this proposal with me.
examples.zh: 我非常感激你抽时间与我讨论这项提案。

examples.en: Living in another country makes you appreciate the cultural differences even more.
examples.zh: 在另一个国家生活会让你更加理解并懂得欣赏文化差异。

examples.en: Historically, high-quality real estate tends to appreciate over the long term.
examples.zh: 从历史上看，优质房产长期往往会增值。

lemmas.def_zh: 有欣赏力的, 感激的
lemmas.def_en: feeling or expressive of gratitude

examples.en: The audience gave an appreciative round of applause after the violinist's brilliant solo.
examples.zh: 小提琴手精彩的独奏结束后，观众报以赞赏的掌声。

lemmas.def_zh: 不受赏识的, 未被欣赏的
lemmas.def_en: not likely to be rewarded

examples.en: She felt completely unappreciated at work despite spending countless late nights finishing reports.
examples.zh: 尽管熬夜完成了无数份报告，她仍觉得自己在外企没有得到赏识。

lemmas.def_zh: 不赏识的, 不欣赏的
lemmas.def_en: not feeling or expressing gratitude

examples.en: He was unappreciative of his friends' efforts to organize a surprise birthday party.
examples.zh: 朋友们费心为他筹办惊喜生日派对，他却毫不领情。

lemmas.def_zh: 欣赏地, 赞赏地；感激地
lemmas.def_en: with appreciation; in a grateful manner

examples.en: The critic nodded appreciatively as the young chef presented his signature dessert dish.
examples.zh: 当年轻的主厨端上招牌甜点时，评论家赞许地点了点头。

lemmas.def_zh: 欣赏者, 鉴赏者
lemmas.def_en: a person who is fully aware of something and understands it

examples.en: As a keen appreciator of fine art, she frequently visits local galleries and exhibitions.
examples.zh: 作为美术的狂热鉴赏者，她经常参观当地的画廊和展览。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ad-（朝向）+ pretium（价值、价格），核心逻辑为“评估并看见其价值”，引申出“欣赏（认可价值）”、“感激（看重人情价值）”以及“增值（实际价值上升）”。

lemmas.def_zh: 否则，要不然；在其他方面；不同地，相反地
lemmas.def_en: in a different way; in other respects; if not

examples.en: We must leave now, otherwise we will miss the last train.
examples.zh: 我们得马上动身，否则就要错过末班火车了。

examples.en: The rent is a bit high, but otherwise the apartment is perfect.
examples.zh: 租金有点贵，但在其他方面这间公寓无可挑剔。

examples.en: He claims he was at home, but all the evidence suggests otherwise.
examples.zh: 他声称自己当时在家，但所有证据都表明事实并非如此。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 other（另外的）与表示方式、方向的古英语词缀 -wise（方式）复合而成，字面即‘以其他方式’，由此引申出‘否则（若非如此）’、‘在其他方面’和‘相反地/不同地’三大核心语义。

lemmas.def_zh: 嘴, 口, 口腔, 口状物
lemmas.def_en: the opening through which food is taken in and vocalizations emerge

examples.en: He silently mouthed the words to the song while standing in the back row.
examples.zh: 他站在后排，无声地对口型跟着唱这首歌。

lemmas.def_zh: 一口, 满口
lemmas.def_en: the quantity that can be held in the mouth

examples.en: She took a large mouthful of hot soup and burned her tongue slightly.
examples.zh: 她喝了一大口热汤，舌头被微微烫到了。

lemmas.def_zh: 说出，用言辞表达；用口型不出声地说；口是心非地说
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To express or utter words, especially pompously or insincerely. 2. [T] To form words with the lips without making any sound.

examples.en: He silently mouthed the words to the song while standing in the back row.
examples.zh: 他站在后排，无声地对口型跟着唱这首歌。

lemmas.def_zh: 无口的,无孔的
lemmas.def_en: having no mouth or mouthlike opening

examples.en: The artist drew a mysterious mouthless character to symbolize enforced silence.
examples.zh: 艺术家画了一个神秘的无口角色，以象征被迫的沉默。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语核心词汇，本义为器官“嘴”，引申指河流、洞穴或容器的“开口、出入口”；转作动词后，引申为“仅动嘴唇不出声（做口型）”或“言不由衷、虚伪地空谈”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词读作 /maʊθ/，指嘴或开口处；动词读作 /maʊð/，侧重不出声地比划口型（mouth words）或流于表面的假意说辞。

lemmas.def_en: denoting a quantity consisting of one more than eight and one less than ten

examples.en: The chef prepared nine special dishes for the anniversary celebration dinner tonight.
examples.zh: 厨师为今晚的周年庆典晚宴准备了九道特色菜。

lemmas.def_en: the cardinal number that is the sum of eight and one

examples.en: The chef prepared nine special dishes for the anniversary celebration dinner tonight.
examples.zh: 厨师为今晚的周年庆典晚宴准备了九道特色菜。

lemmas.def_zh: [俚语]=nine
