lemmas.def_en: the cardinal number that is the sum of eight and one

examples.en: The radio operator clearly repeated the code word forty-niner over the noisy channel.
examples.zh: 无线电操作员在嘈杂的频道中清楚地重复了“淘金者”这一代号。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 nigon（原始印欧语 *néwn），为基础基数词，核心表示数字“九”，兼具修饰可数名词（形容词）与指代数字本身或集合（名词）的功能。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词侧重修饰复数名词表示“九个”；名词则指代数字“9”本身、时间“九点”或特定的九人组合。

lemmas.def_zh: 提醒，提示；使想起
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To tell someone something they might have forgotten or to prompt them to take action. 2. To cause someone to remember or think of something.

examples.en: Please remind me to reply to her email before noon.
examples.zh: 请提醒我在中午前回复她的邮件。

examples.en: This smell always reminds me of my grandmother's kitchen.
examples.zh: 这种气味总是让我联想起祖母的厨房。

lemmas.def_zh: 提醒物；提示信息；引起回忆的事物
lemmas.def_en: a thing that causes someone to remember something

examples.en: I set a calendar reminder on my phone so I wouldn't miss the appointment.
examples.zh: 我在手机上设了一个日历提醒，以免错过预约。

examples.en: The empty chair was a painful reminder of their loss.
examples.zh: 那把空着的椅子令人痛苦地想起他们的失去。

family_guide.root_logic: 由前缀 re-（再，重新）与 mind（心思、心智）结合而成，字面逻辑为“使再次进入脑海”，引申为使某人回忆起或留意某事。
family_guide.core_distinction: remind 为动词，表示“提醒、使想起”这一动作；reminder 为派生名词，指用来唤起记忆的提示物、备忘信息或引起联想的事物。

lemmas.def_zh: 优点, 便利, 好处, 优势
lemmas.def_en: the quality of having a superior or more favorable position

examples.en: Her fluency in multiple languages gives her a distinct advantage in international business.
examples.zh: 她流利掌握多门语言，这在国际商务中给她带来了明显优势。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of affording gain or benefit or profit
lemmas.def_zh: 盈利能力；利润率

examples.en: Rising production costs have threatened the firm's long-term profitability.
examples.zh: 不断上涨的生产成本威胁到了该公司的长期盈利能力。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being encouraging or promising of a successful outcome
lemmas.def_zh: 有益;有利

examples.en: Investors carefully evaluated the long-term profitableness of the innovative renewable energy project.
examples.zh: 投资者仔细评估了这一创新型可再生能源项目的长期盈利能力。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of affording no gain or no benefit or no profit
lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 不盈利

examples.en: Persistent unprofitability eventually forced the small neighborhood bookstore to shut its doors.
examples.zh: 持续的亏损最终迫使这家社区小书店倒闭关门。

lemmas.def_zh: 有利于，使处于有利地位；使获益
lemmas.def_en: [T] to put someone in a better, more favorable, or more successful position

examples.en: Her fluency in multiple languages gives her a distinct advantage in international business.
examples.zh: 她流利掌握多门语言，这在国际商务中给她带来了明显优势。

lemmas.def_en: yielding material gain or profit
lemmas.def_zh: 有利可图的；有益的

examples.en: The company decided to invest in more profitable renewable energy projects.
examples.zh: 该公司决定投资于利润更丰厚的可再生能源项目。

lemmas.def_zh: 有利的, 有益的
lemmas.def_en: giving an advantage

examples.en: The new trade agreement created an advantageous environment for local small businesses.
examples.zh: 新贸易协定为当地小型企业创造了十分有利的环境。

lemmas.def_en: producing little or no profit or gain
lemmas.def_zh: 无利益的, 不赚钱的, 不上算的

examples.en: The company decided to close down its unprofitable branches after two disappointing quarters.
examples.zh: 在经历了两个令人失望的季度后，公司决定关闭不盈利的分部。

lemmas.def_zh: 有利地；方便地；有助地
lemmas.def_en: in a manner affording benefit or advantage

examples.en: The modern hotel is advantageously situated just minutes away from the international airport.
examples.zh: 这家现代化酒店地理位置极其便利，离国际机场仅几分钟路程。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 avant（在前面），核心意象为“走在前面、占得先机”，引申指处于领先地位所拥有的优势或带来的益处。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词指“优势、好处”；动词为书面正式用法，指“使处于有利地位”或“对……有利”。

lemmas.def_zh: 便宜的，廉价的；劣质的，低俗的；小气的
lemmas.def_en: costing little money; of low quality; unwilling to spend money

examples.en: Public transport offers a cheap and convenient way to get around the city.
examples.zh: 公共交通为在市内出行提供了一种便宜且便捷的方式。

examples.en: Don't buy those cheap tools; they'll break after a few uses.
examples.zh: 别买那些劣质工具，用几次就会坏。

lemmas.def_zh: 便宜地
lemmas.def_en: in a stingy manner

examples.en: They managed to furnish their new apartment quite cheaply by buying secondhand goods.
examples.zh: 他们通过购买二手物品，十分便宜地布置了新公寓。

lemmas.def_zh: 廉价
lemmas.def_en: a price below the standard price

examples.en: Consumers often complain about the poor quality that accompanies the cheapness of these goods.
examples.zh: 消费者常抱怨这些商品的低劣质量往往与其低廉的价格相伴。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 cēap（买卖、交易），最初指‘好买卖、合算的交易’，后演变为指价格‘便宜的’，进而引申出‘劣质的’或‘小气的’等贬义色彩。

lemmas.def_zh: 参与，参加
lemmas.def_en: [I] (+ in) To take part in an activity or event.

examples.en: All employees are encouraged to participate in the training program.
examples.zh: 我们鼓励所有员工参与这项培训计划。

examples.en: She was too shy to participate actively in class discussions.
examples.zh: 她太害羞了，不敢积极参与课堂讨论。

lemmas.def_zh: 参与；参加；参与度
lemmas.def_en: the act or state of taking part in something

examples.en: The teacher graded students based on attendance and active participation.
examples.zh: 老师根据出勤情况和积极参与度给学生打分。

examples.en: Community participation is crucial to the success of this environmental project.
examples.zh: 公众参与对这个环保项目的成功至关重要。

lemmas.def_en: someone who takes part in an activity
lemmas.def_zh: 参与者，参加者

examples.en: Each participant was asked to complete a brief questionnaire.
examples.zh: 每位参与者都被要求填写一份简短的问卷。

lemmas.def_zh: 不参与, 不参加
lemmas.def_en: withdrawing from the activities of a group

examples.en: His complete nonparticipation in the group discussions resulted in a lower course grade.
examples.zh: 他完全不参与小组讨论，导致该门课程的成绩较低。

lemmas.def_zh: 吸引参与的, 供人分享的
lemmas.def_en: affording the opportunity for individual participation

examples.en: The workshop used participatory methods to encourage active collaboration among team members.
examples.zh: 研讨会采用了参与式方法，以鼓励团队成员之间积极协作。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 particeps（part '部分' + capere '拿、取'），字面意为‘取得一份’，引申出‘参与、分担’的核心语义。

lemmas.def_zh: 虐待；辱骂；滥用
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To treat a person or animal with cruelty or violence. 2. To speak rudely or insultingly to someone. 3. To use something improperly or excessively.

examples.en: He was accused of abusing his power to enrich his own family.
examples.zh: 他被指控滥用职权以自肥家族。

examples.en: Children who are abused often struggle with emotional trauma later in life.
examples.zh: 遭受虐待的儿童在日后的生活中往往会受心理创伤所困扰。

lemmas.def_zh: 辱骂的；虐待的；恶语相向的
lemmas.def_en: using or characterized by harsh, insulting language or physical cruelty

examples.en: The referee had to intervene when the fans started shouting abusive comments.
examples.zh: 当球迷开始叫喊辱骂性言语时，裁判不得不进行干预。

examples.en: It takes immense courage to walk away from an emotionally abusive relationship.
examples.zh: 脱离一段精神虐待的关系需要极大的勇气。

lemmas.def_zh: 滥用者
lemmas.def_en: someone who abuses

examples.en: The court issued a strict restraining order to protect the family from the abuser.
examples.zh: 法院签发了严格的限制令，以保护该家庭免受施暴者的侵害。

lemmas.def_zh: 辱骂性, 陋习性, 被滥用, 滥用, 骂人
lemmas.def_en: in an abusive manner

examples.en: The angry passenger was escorted off the flight after speaking abusively to the crew.
examples.zh: 这名愤怒的乘客在辱骂机组人员后被护送下了飞机。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自前缀 ab-（偏离、不当）+ use（使用），核心逻辑为“不当使用”，引申出“滥用（权力/药物）”以及“虐待、辱骂（对待他人不当）”。
family_guide.core_distinction: abuse 作动词或名词侧重滥用或虐待的行为本身；abusive 为形容词，常专指言语上的“辱骂性的”或人际关系中的“虐待性的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 冠军, 拥护者, 战士
lemmas.def_en: someone who has won first place in a competition

examples.en: The local politician promised to champion civil rights and protect vulnerable communities.
examples.zh: 这位当地政客承诺捍卫公民权利并保护弱势群体。

lemmas.def_zh: 支持，捍卫，声援
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To vigorously support, defend, or fight for a person, principle, or cause.

examples.en: The local politician promised to champion civil rights and protect vulnerable communities.
examples.zh: 这位当地政客承诺捍卫公民权利并保护弱势群体。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自晚期拉丁语 campio（角斗士、出战者），核心意象为‘在战场上代表他人出战的勇士’，引申出体育赛场上的‘冠军’以及为某种理念出头力挺的‘捍卫者’和‘支持’之意。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词既可指竞赛‘冠军’也可指‘拥护者’；动词则专指行动上的‘倡导、捍卫’，常接 abstract nouns（如 rights, causes）。

lemmas.def_zh: 敌人；仇敌；敌军；危害物
lemmas.def_en: a person, group, or nation actively hostile or opposed to another; something harmful

examples.en: She refused to speak to her former colleague, who had now become a bitter enemy.
examples.zh: 她拒绝同以前的同事说话，如今对方已成了她的死敌。

examples.en: Poor communication is the biggest enemy of team collaboration.
examples.zh: 沟通不良是团队协作的最大天敌。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 in-（非、不）与 amicus（朋友），字面即“非朋友”，引申指抱有敌意的人、敌对国家或具破坏性的事物。

lemmas.def_zh: （用搜索引擎）网络搜索，在网上查找
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To search for information on the internet using a search engine (especially Google).

examples.en: If you don't know the recipe, just google it on your phone.
examples.zh: 如果你不知道食谱，用手机在网上搜一下就行了。

examples.en: I googled the restaurant to check its reviews and opening hours.
examples.zh: 我上网搜了这家餐厅，查看它的评价和营业时间。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自数学词汇 googol（10的100次方）衍生的搜索引擎品牌 Google，后泛化为动词，专指使用搜索引擎在互联网上查找信息。

lemmas.def_zh: 否认，否定；拒绝给予，剥夺
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] to state that something is not true; to refuse to admit. 2. [T] to refuse to give or allow something to someone.

examples.en: The spokesman firmly denied having any knowledge of the secret negotiations.
examples.zh: 发言人坚决否认对该秘密谈判知情。

examples.en: Many low-income families are denied access to basic healthcare.
examples.zh: 许多低收入家庭被剥夺了享受基本医疗服务的机会。

lemmas.def_zh: 否认，否定；拒绝给予；（心理学上的）拒绝承认，心理防卫
lemmas.def_en: a statement saying that something is not true; a refusal to satisfy a request; a refusal to accept a painful reality

examples.en: The government issued an official denial of the corruption allegations.
examples.zh: 政府对贪腐指控发表了正式否认声明。

examples.en: He is clearly in denial about how serious his health condition actually is.
examples.zh: 他显然在逃避现实，不愿承认自己的健康状况究竟有多严重。

lemmas.def_zh: 否认者, 法国往昔银币, 一小笔钱
lemmas.def_en: a unit of measurement for the fineness of silk or nylon or rayon

examples.en: The scientist refused to debate the persistent climate change denier on live television.
examples.zh: 这位科学家拒绝在电视直播中与那位固执的气候变化否认者辩论。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 denegare（de- 强调 + negare 说不），核心逻辑是“断然说不”，引申为断然否认事实的真实性，或拒绝给予某人请求、权利与满足。

lemmas.def_zh: 受害者；罹难者；牺牲品
lemmas.def_en: a person who is harmed, injured, or killed as a result of a crime, accident, or other adversity, or something destroyed by adverse circumstances

examples.en: The organization provides legal assistance and psychological counseling to victims of violent crime.
examples.zh: 该机构为暴力犯罪的受害者提供法律援助和心理咨询。

examples.en: Many small retailers have fallen victim to the rise of e-commerce.
examples.zh: 许多小型零售商已沦为电子商务崛起的牺牲品。

lemmas.def_zh: 牺牲, 欺骗
lemmas.def_en: adversity resulting from being made a victim

examples.en: The campaign aims to reduce the unfair victimization of minority workers in the office.
examples.zh: 该运动旨在减少办公室中少数族裔员工遭受不公迫害的情况。

lemmas.def_zh: 施害者
lemmas.def_en: a person who victimizes others

examples.en: The psychological drama explores the complex, twisted relationship between a victim and his victimizer.
examples.zh: 这部心理悬疑剧探讨了受害者与其施害者之间复杂扭曲的关系。

lemmas.def_zh: 使受害，迫害，不公地对待；欺骗
lemmas.def_en: [T] To single someone out for cruel, unfair, or abusive treatment; to make a victim of.

examples.en: Fraudsters often target the elderly and victimize them through deceptive phone scams.
examples.zh: 骗子经常以老年人为目标，通过虚假电话诈骗使他们受害。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 victima（祭祀用的牺牲品），核心语义由宗教仪式中被献祭的生命引申为因犯罪、灾难、疾病或外部力量而遭受伤害、损失的受害者或牺牲品。

lemmas.def_zh: 新鲜的；清新的；崭新的；精神饱满的
lemmas.def_en: newly made, gathered, or arrived; pleasantly clean, cool, or pure

examples.en: Let's step outside for a breath of fresh air.
examples.zh: 我们去室外呼吸点新鲜空气吧。

examples.en: She woke up feeling fresh and ready for the interview.
examples.zh: 她醒来时感觉精神饱满，做好了面试的准备。

lemmas.def_zh: 刚刚；新近地
lemmas.def_en: very recently, especially used before a past participle

examples.en: The room smelled of freshly brewed coffee.
examples.zh: 房间里弥漫着现煮咖啡的香气。

lemmas.def_zh: 新, 新鲜, 精神饱满
lemmas.def_en: the property of being pure and fresh (as if newly made); not stale or deteriorated

examples.en: The cool morning breeze brought a welcome freshness into the crowded room.
examples.zh: 清凉的晨风为拥挤的房间带来了一股令人惬意的新鲜空气。

lemmas.def_zh: 大学一年级新生（英式英语）
lemmas.def_en: a student who has just started their first year at university

examples.en: During Freshers' Week, new students get familiar with campus life and join clubs.
examples.zh: 在新生迎新周期间，新生们会熟悉校园生活并加入各种社团。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语词源，核心意象为“纯净、未变质、充满生机与新颖”，由此延伸出食物新鲜、环境清新、时间新近以及新入学人员等语义。
family_guide.core_distinction: fresh 为形容词（新鲜/崭新的）；freshly 为副词（常与过去分词连用，表“刚、新近”）；fresher 为英式英语名词，专指大学一年级新生（美式常作 freshman）。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 花，花朵；精华，鼎盛期；v. 开花；繁荣，发展
lemmas.def_en: n. the seed-bearing part of a plant; the finest part; v. to produce blooms; to reach full development or prosperity

examples.en: She arranged the freshly cut flowers in a porcelain vase.
examples.zh: 她把刚剪下来的鲜花插进了一个瓷花瓶里。

examples.en: Their friendship flowered into a successful business partnership.
examples.zh: 他们的友谊开花结果，发展成了一段成功的商业合作关系。

lemmas.def_zh: 开花；繁荣，成熟，达到盛期
lemmas.def_en: [I] 1. To produce blooms or blossom. 2. To reach full development or peak prosperity.

examples.en: She arranged the freshly cut flowers in a porcelain vase.
examples.zh: 她把刚剪下来的鲜花插进了一个瓷花瓶里。

examples.en: Their friendship flowered into a successful business partnership.
examples.zh: 他们的友谊开花结果，发展成了一段成功的商业合作关系。

lemmas.def_zh: 多花的, 绚丽的, 华丽的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or suggestive of flowers

examples.en: She disliked his flowery writing style and preferred much simpler, direct language.
examples.zh: 她不喜欢他华丽的文风，更偏爱简单直白的语言。

lemmas.def_zh: 无花的
lemmas.def_en: without flower or bloom and not producing seeds

examples.en: Ferns and mosses are common examples of flowerless plants found in damp forests.
examples.zh: 蕨类和苔藓是潮湿森林中常见的无花植物代表。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 flos/florem（花），核心意象为植物的花朵，引申指生机勃勃地绽放、达到繁荣或成熟鼎盛的状态。

lemmas.def_zh: 把……藏起来，遮掩，隐瞒；躲藏，隐蔽
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. To put or keep something or someone in a place where they cannot be seen or found. 2. [T] To conceal an emotion, secret, or truth.

examples.en: The shy cat preferred to hide under the soft bed whenever guests visited.
examples.zh: 每当有客人来访时，这只害羞的猫都喜欢躲在柔软的床底下。

lemmas.def_zh: 隐藏，遮掩，隐匿
lemmas.def_en: [T] To put or keep something out of sight; to conceal from view or discovery.

examples.en: They discovered a hidden room concealed behind the wooden bookshelf in the old mansion.
examples.zh: 他们在这座老宅的木制书架后面发现了一间暗室。

lemmas.def_zh: 藏，隐藏，隐瞒（hide的过去式）
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] Past tense of hide; to put or keep someone or something out of sight, or to keep a secret.

examples.en: The frightened boy quickly hid behind the tall tree when he heard loud footsteps.
examples.zh: 听到沉重的脚步声时，那个受惊的男孩迅速躲到了大树后面。

lemmas.def_zh: 兽皮, 迹象, 躲藏处
lemmas.def_en: the dressed skin of an animal (especially a large animal)

examples.en: The hunters dried the deer hide carefully before making it into winter boots.
examples.zh: 猎人们将鹿皮仔细风干，然后将其做成冬靴。

lemmas.def_zh: 隐藏
lemmas.def_en: the state of being covert and hidden

examples.en: The deliberate hiddenness of the secret garden made it feel even more enchanting.
examples.zh: 这座秘密花园刻意的隐蔽性让它显得更加迷人。

lemmas.def_zh: 隐藏的
lemmas.def_en: not accessible to view

examples.en: She discovered a hidden compartment in the antique desk containing old family letters.
examples.zh: 她在老式书桌里发现了一个装有家庭旧信件的暗格。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于古英语，核心意象为“遮盖、掩蔽以使其脱离视线”，由此派生出动词“隐藏/隐瞒”以及名词“兽皮”（身体的天然遮盖层）与“隐蔽伪装处”。
family_guide.core_distinction: hid 为一般过去式，hidden 为过去分词且常独立用作形容词（强调隐蔽、潜在的特征）；hide 作名词时常特指动物毛皮或用于观测野生动物的掩体。

lemmas.def_zh: 忽视，不理睬，置之不理
lemmas.def_en: [T] to intentionally pay no attention to someone or something

examples.en: He decided to ignore the doctor's advice and went back to work immediately.
examples.zh: 他决定无视医生的建议，立刻返回了工作岗位。

examples.en: She tried to ignore the pain in her knee and continued the race.
examples.zh: 她试图忽视膝盖的疼痛，继续坚持比赛。

lemmas.def_zh: 无知；愚昧；不了解
lemmas.def_en: lack of knowledge, understanding, or information about something

examples.en: Ignorance of the law is never accepted as an excuse in court.
examples.zh: 在法庭上，不知晓法律绝不能作为免责的借口。

examples.en: He was kept in complete ignorance of his company's financial crisis.
examples.zh: 关于公司的财务危机，他完全被蒙在鼓里。

lemmas.def_en: uneducated in general; lacking knowledge or sophistication
lemmas.def_zh: 无知识的, 不知道的, 由无知产生的

examples.en: He admitted that he was completely ignorant of the local customs.
examples.zh: 他承认自己对当地的风俗习惯完全一无所知。

lemmas.def_en: in ignorance; in an ignorant manner
lemmas.def_zh: 无知地；不学无术地

examples.en: She ignorantly clicked the suspicious link and infected her computer.
examples.zh: 她无知地点了那个可疑链接，导致电脑中了病毒。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语前缀 in-（不）加 (g)no-（知晓），本义为“不知道”，后在动词上分化为“故意不予理睬”，在名词上保留为“无知、缺乏认知”。
family_guide.core_distinction: ignore 多指主观上“有意忽视、装作没看见”，而派生词 ignorance 则客观指“缺乏知识或信息的无知状态”。

lemmas.def_zh: 地位，身份；状态，状况；情形
lemmas.def_en: the official, legal, or social position of someone or something; the current state of affairs

examples.en: She achieved a high social status through years of hard work in the legal profession.
examples.zh: 她在法律界打拼多年，获得了极高的社会地位。

examples.en: Could you please give us an update on the current status of the project?
examples.zh: 你能向我们通报一下该项目的最新进展情况吗？

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 stare（站立），本义指“站立的姿势与位置”，后引申为个人在社会中的“地位、身份”，以及事物当前的“状态、进展”。

lemmas.def_zh: 允许，准许；使成为可能，容许
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To officially allow someone to do something or allow something to happen. 2. [T] To make something possible.

examples.en: Weather permitting, we plan to host the annual school sports day outdoors tomorrow.
examples.zh: 如果天气允许，我们打算明天在户外举办学校年度运动会。

lemmas.def_zh: 许可, 允许
lemmas.def_en: approval to do something

examples.en: Students must ask for written permission before leaving the campus during school hours.
examples.zh: 学生在上课期间离开校园必须先获得书面许可。

lemmas.def_zh: 许可证, 许可, 执照, 通行证
lemmas.def_en: a legal document giving official permission to do something

examples.en: Weather permitting, we plan to host the annual school sports day outdoors tomorrow.
examples.zh: 如果天气允许，我们打算明天在户外举办学校年度运动会。

lemmas.def_zh: 许可
lemmas.def_en: a disposition to allow freedom of choice and behavior

lemmas.def_zh: 可容许性
lemmas.def_en: admissibility as a consequence of being permitted

lemmas.def_zh: 可允许的, 可容许程度的
lemmas.def_en: that may be permitted especially as according to rule

examples.en: The chemical levels found in the drinking water were well within the permissible limits.
examples.zh: 饮用水中检测到的化学物质含量完全在允许的限度之内。

lemmas.def_zh: 许可的, 获准的, 宽容的, 放任的, 放纵的, 允许选择的, 自由的
lemmas.def_en: not preventive

examples.en: Some child psychologists argue that an overly permissive parenting style causes behavioral problems.
examples.zh: 一些儿童心理学家认为，过于放任的育儿方式会导致行为问题。

lemmas.def_zh: 许可地；自由地；娇宠地
lemmas.def_en: in a permissive manner

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 permittere（per- 穿过 + mittere 送出/放行），核心逻辑为“彻底放行、任其通过”，后引申为“允许、准许”。
family_guide.core_distinction: permit 作名词时指具体的、官方签发的“书面许可证/通行证”（可数）；permission 则指抽象的“允许、许可”这一概念或行为（通常不可数）。

lemmas.def_zh: 底部
lemmas.def_en: the lower side of anything

examples.en: Divers found fragments of an ancient shipwreck resting quietly at the ocean bottom.
examples.zh: 潜水员在洋底发现了静静停歇的古代沉船残骸。

lemmas.def_zh: 给……装底，给……配底座；到达底部
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To provide or equip something with a bottom or seat. 2. [I] (+ out) To reach the lowest point.

examples.en: Divers found fragments of an ancient shipwreck resting quietly at the ocean bottom.
examples.zh: 潜水员在洋底发现了静静停歇的古代沉船残骸。

lemmas.def_zh: 无底的, 无限的, 深不可测的, 没有根据的
lemmas.def_en: extremely deep

examples.en: The hikers marveled at what seemed like a bottomless canyon stretching into mist.
examples.zh: 徒步旅行者们对延伸至迷雾中、看似深不见底的峡谷惊叹不已。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 botm（基础、底部），核心语义始终围绕“物理或抽象层面的最低点、最深处或根本基石”展开，延伸出名词的“底部、实质”及动词的“触底、给……装底”。

lemmas.def_zh: 采纳，采用；收养，领养；正式通过（动议、提案）
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To choose to take up or follow an idea, method, or policy. 2. To legally take another's child as one's own. 3. To formally accept or approve a proposal.

examples.en: They decided to adopt a child after years of trying to conceive.
examples.zh: 努力备孕多年未果后，他们决定领养一个孩子。

examples.en: The committee agreed to adopt a more flexible approach to the problem.
examples.zh: 委员会同意对这一问题采纳更为灵活的处理方法。

lemmas.def_zh: 收养，领养；采纳，采用
lemmas.def_en: the legal act of taking another's child as one's own; the act of starting to use a new idea, plan, or system

examples.en: She was placed with a loving family shortly after her adoption was finalized.
examples.zh: 收养手续办结后不久，她就被安置到了一个充满爱的家庭中。

examples.en: The widespread adoption of cloud computing has transformed the IT industry.
examples.zh: 云计算的广泛采用彻底改变了信息技术行业。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 领养人, 收养人, 采用者
lemmas.def_en: a person who adopts a child of other parents as his or her own child

examples.en: As an early adopter, Mark bought the cutting-edge device on its release date.
examples.zh: 作为早期使用者，马克在发售当天就购买了这款前沿设备。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 被收养者
lemmas.def_en: someone (such as a child) who has been adopted

examples.en: The emotional young adoptee finally met her biological siblings after years of searching.
examples.zh: 经过多年的寻找，这位激动的被收养者终于见到了亲生手足。

lemmas.def_zh: 有收养关系的, 采用的
lemmas.def_en: of parents and children; related by adoption

examples.en: She expressed deep gratitude to her adoptive parents for their unconditional lifelong love.
examples.zh: 她对养父母多年来无条件的爱表达了深切的感激。

lemmas.def_zh: 可采用的, 可收养的
lemmas.def_en: suitable or eligible for adoption

examples.en: The animal shelter volunteers featured several adoptable puppies on their social media page.
examples.zh: 动物收容所的志愿者在社交媒体页面上推荐了几只可供领养的小狗。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 不可接受
lemmas.def_en: difficult to place in an adoptive home

examples.en: Staff refused to consider the injured dog unadoptable and provided intensive behavioral training.
examples.zh: 工作人员拒绝认定这只受伤的狗不可收养，并为其提供了密集的行为训练。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ad-（朝向）+ optare（选择），核心逻辑为“经选择后纳入己方”，引申为收养（子女）或采纳（方法、政策）。

lemmas.def_zh: 长度；时间的长短，跨度；篇幅
lemmas.def_en: the measurement or extent of something from end to end, or the amount of time that something lasts

examples.en: The bridge measures over two kilometers in length.
examples.zh: 这座桥的长度超过两公里。

examples.en: We discussed the proposal at length before making a final decision.
examples.zh: 在做出最终决定之前，我们详细深入地讨论了该提案。

lemmas.def_zh: 漫长的；冗长的
lemmas.def_en: very long, especially taking a large amount of time or being tedious

examples.en: After a lengthy legal battle, the two companies reached a settlement.
examples.zh: 经过一场漫长的法律诉讼，两家公司最终达成了和解。

examples.en: He gave a lengthy explanation that only confused the audience further.
examples.zh: 他做了一番冗长的解释，结果反而让观众更加困惑。

lemmas.def_zh: 长, 冗长地
lemmas.def_en: in a lengthy or prolix manner

examples.en: The professor spoke lengthily about classical literature before answering any student questions.
examples.zh: 教授冗长地大谈古典文学，随后才回答学生的问题。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语形容词 long（长的），核心语义贯穿空间尺寸、时间跨度及文本或过程的长短与延续。
family_guide.core_distinction: length 为指代空间、时间或篇幅客观度量的核心名词；派生形容词 lengthy 多指耗时过久、篇幅过大的‘冗长、漫长’，常带轻微贬义或不耐烦意味（区别于中性的 long）。

lemmas.def_zh: 流程, 流动, 流量, 洋溢, 泛滥, 涨潮
lemmas.def_en: the motion characteristic of fluids (liquids or gases)

examples.en: A heavy rock slide completely disrupted the steady flow of the mountain river.
examples.zh: 严重的滑坡彻底打乱了这条高山河流平稳的水流。

lemmas.def_zh: 流出, 流动, 泛滥
lemmas.def_en: gradual internal motion or deformation of a solid body (as by heat)

examples.en: Engineers monitored the sudden water flowage to prevent the nearby village from flooding.
examples.zh: 工程师监测了突发的水流泛滥，以防止邻近村庄被淹。

lemmas.def_zh: 流动，涌动；畅流，连贯流动；飘扬，飘拂
lemmas.def_en: [I] To move steadily and continuously in one direction like water or another liquid; to move along smoothly and without interruption.

examples.en: A heavy rock slide completely disrupted the steady flow of the mountain river.
examples.zh: 严重的滑坡彻底打乱了这条高山河流平稳的水流。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 flōwan，核心意象为“像水一样持续、平稳、无阻碍地移动”，后引申至人流、信息、思路乃至心理沉浸状态（心流）的连贯运转。
family_guide.core_distinction: flow 的名词与动词同形同源，名词侧重流动状态、流量或连贯性（如 traffic flow、flow of ideas），动词侧重流淌、顺畅行进的动态行为。

lemmas.def_zh: 预算
lemmas.def_en: a sum of money allocated for a particular purpose

examples.en: The marketing committee struggled to stay within its modest budget for this quarter.
examples.zh: 营销委员会努力将开支控制在本季度有限的预算之内。

lemmas.def_zh: 编制预算，把……编入预算；规划（开支、时间）
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] to plan the spending of money or use of time carefully; to allocate a specific sum for a purpose

examples.en: The marketing committee struggled to stay within its modest budget for this quarter.
examples.zh: 营销委员会努力将开支控制在本季度有限的预算之内。

lemmas.def_zh: 预算的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a budget

examples.en: Due to severe budgetary constraints, the ambitious research project had to be postponed.
examples.zh: 由于严重的预算限制，这个雄心勃勃的研究项目不得不推迟。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 bougette（小皮袋），原指英国财政大臣盛放账目清单的皮革公文包，后借指包内装载的“国家收支计划”，最终泛化为所有财务或资源上的“预算与规划”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 该词族主要为同形转化（动名同形）：名词指收支方案或额度（作定语时可表示“经济型的/廉价的”）；动词指制定预算或规划调配资源（常与 for 连用）。

lemmas.def_zh: 陈列，展出；显露，表现；（屏幕上）显示
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To put something in a place where people can see it easily. 2. [T] To show a particular feeling, quality, or skill clearly. 3. [T] (of an electronic device) To show words, pictures, or data on a screen.

examples.en: Local artists will display their contemporary paintings at the downtown gallery this weekend.
examples.zh: 当地艺术家本周末将在市中心的画廊展出他们的当代画作。

lemmas.def_zh: 显示, 陈列, 炫耀, 显示器
lemmas.def_en: something intended to communicate a particular impression

examples.en: Local artists will display their contemporary paintings at the downtown gallery this weekend.
examples.zh: 当地艺术家本周末将在市中心的画廊展出他们的当代画作。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 displicare（dis- 表‘解开’ + plicare 表‘折叠’），字面义为‘展开折叠之物’，引申为将收拢隐藏的事物摊开、公之于众，即‘展示、显露’。

lemmas.def_zh: 水流, 小河, 流出, 趋势, 人潮
lemmas.def_en: a natural body of running water flowing on or under the earth

examples.en: Cool clear water ran along the rocky stream winding through the pine forest.
examples.zh: 清凉纯净的溪水流淌在蜿蜒穿过松树林的乱石小溪中。

lemmas.def_zh: 流，流动，涌；飘动，飘扬；流出（液体）；在线流式传输（音视频）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To move or flow continuously and in large amounts, like a stream. 2. [I] To wave or float outward freely in the wind. 3. [T] To transmit or receive continuous audio or video data over the internet.

examples.en: Cool clear water ran along the rocky stream winding through the pine forest.
examples.zh: 清凉纯净的溪水流淌在蜿蜒穿过松树林的乱石小溪中。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 流淌的；（因感冒等）不停流鼻涕/眼泪的
lemmas.def_en: exuding a bodily fluid in profuse amounts; flowing freely
lemmas.usage_note: 在传统英式英语中极常用于固定搭配 a streaming cold（严重的感冒，流鼻涕流泪），也可修饰眼睛、伤口等流淌状态。

examples.en: He came down with a streaming cold and couldn't leave his bed.
examples.zh: 他患了重感冒，鼻涕眼泪流个不停，根本起不来床。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语表示“水流”的词根，核心意象为“连续不断地流动”，后延伸至人群、事物乃至数字媒体的连续传输与涌动。
family_guide.core_distinction: 作为名词指代流动态的本体（溪流、人流、数据流）；作为动词则表示流动、倾泻、飘动或以流媒体形式播放等动态过程。

lemmas.def_zh: 突然的；意料之外的；迅速的
lemmas.def_en: happening, coming, or done quickly and without warning

examples.en: His sudden change of mind caught everyone by surprise.
examples.zh: 他主意的突然改变让所有人都措手不及。

examples.en: All of a sudden, the storm broke and rain poured down.
examples.zh: 突然之间，暴风雨来袭，大雨倾盆而下。

lemmas.def_zh: 突然地；出乎意料地；猛地
lemmas.def_en: quickly and unexpectedly

examples.en: The car in front of us stopped suddenly without indicating.
examples.zh: 我们前面的车没打转向灯就突然停了下来。

examples.en: Suddenly, she remembered where she had left her keys.
examples.zh: 突然间，她想起来把钥匙落在哪儿了。

lemmas.def_zh: 意外, 突然
lemmas.def_en: the quality of happening with headlong haste or without warning

examples.en: The sheer suddenness of the summer thunderstorm caught all the beachgoers off guard.
examples.zh: 夏季雷暴来得极为突然，让海滩上的游客措手不及。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 subire（悄悄潜入、逼近），核心意象为‘未加预警便骤然降临’，演变为表示毫无防备、发生迅速的‘突然’。
family_guide.core_distinction: sudden 为形容词，常修饰名词或用于固定短语 all of a sudden；suddenly 为副词，用于修饰动词或作状语修饰全句。

lemmas.def_zh: 真正地；确实；由衷地
lemmas.def_en: in accordance with truth or fact; genuinely, sincerely, or completely

examples.en: She was truly grateful for all the support she received during the difficult time.
examples.zh: 对于在那段艰难时期所获得的一切支持，她由衷地感激。

examples.en: It was a truly remarkable performance that left the entire audience in awe.
examples.zh: 那真是一场非凡的演出，令全场观众叹为观止。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语‘true’（忠诚的、真实的）加副词后缀‘-ly’，核心语义围绕‘符合真实事实’与‘发自内心、毫无虚假’展开。
family_guide.core_distinction: truly多用于强调性质的纯粹、真实或情感的诚挚（真正地、由衷地）；而truthfully侧重于陈述事实、未说谎话（如实地）。

lemmas.def_zh: 瞄准，对准；力求，旨在；针对
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To point a weapon, camera, or hit directly at someone or something. 2. [I] (+ to do / at) To intend or strive to achieve a particular goal. 3. [T] (+ at) To direct a remark, product, or action toward a specific audience.

examples.en: Our primary aim is to complete the project before the upcoming winter holidays.
examples.zh: 我们的主要目标是在即将到来的寒假前完成该项目。

lemmas.def_zh: 目标, 瞄准, 击中目标的能力
lemmas.def_en: an anticipated outcome that is intended or that guides your planned actions

examples.en: Our primary aim is to complete the project before the upcoming winter holidays.
examples.zh: 我们的主要目标是在即将到来的寒假前完成该项目。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语中“估算、测度”之意，语义由具体的“测距并把武器对准靶心”演变为抽象的“将行动、计划导向特定意图或结果”。

lemmas.def_zh: 因此；所以
lemmas.def_en: as a result; for that reason

examples.en: The evidence is inconclusive; therefore, further investigation is required.
examples.zh: 目前的证据尚不充分，因此需要作进一步调查。

examples.en: He had no valid passport and therefore could not leave the country.
examples.zh: 他没有有效护照，因此无法出境。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语复合构词 there（那、此）+ for（为了、由于），字面即为“for that (reason)（由于那个原因）”，演化为表示因果推导的连接副词。

lemmas.def_zh: 块, 大多数, 质量, 大量, 群众, 弥撒
lemmas.def_en: the property of a body that causes it to have weight in a gravitational field

examples.en: Dark storm clouds began to mass along the horizon just before sunset.
examples.zh: 日落前夕，乌云开始在地平线上聚集。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）聚集，（使）集中，（使）集结
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To gather or bring together into a large mass, crowd, or group.

examples.en: Dark storm clouds began to mass along the horizon just before sunset.
examples.zh: 日落前夕，乌云开始在地平线上聚集。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 maza（面团），核心意象为“揉捏凝聚成的一团”，由此衍生出聚合的块状物、大量、大众以及物理学中的“质量”，动词则引申为“聚集、集结”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词侧重指聚合形成的块、巨量事物、大众或物理质量；动词侧重指人或物（如军队、乌云）向一处积聚成团的动态过程。

lemmas.def_zh: 抗议，反对；坚决声明，力辩
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To express strong disagreement, disapproval, or objection, especially publicly. 2. [T] (+ that) To state or declare something firmly and emphatically, especially when others doubt it.

examples.en: Thousands of citizens gathered in the square to protest against the proposed tax increase.
examples.zh: 数千名市民聚集在广场上，抗议拟议中的增税计划。

examples.en: The environmental group staged a peaceful protest outside the parliament building.
examples.zh: 环保组织在议会大厦外举行了一场和平抗议活动。

lemmas.def_zh: 抗议，反对；坚决声明（动词）/ 抗议，反对活动（名词）
lemmas.def_en: to express strong disagreement or disapproval publicly; a statement or action expressing objection

examples.en: Thousands of citizens gathered in the square to protest against the proposed tax increase.
examples.zh: 数千名市民聚集在广场上，抗议拟议中的增税计划。

examples.en: The environmental group staged a peaceful protest outside the parliament building.
examples.zh: 环保组织在议会大厦外举行了一场和平抗议活动。

lemmas.def_zh: （基督教）新教徒
lemmas.def_en: a member or follower of any of the Christian churches that separated from the Roman Catholic Church

examples.en: Both Catholics and Protestants attended the community memorial service.
examples.zh: 天主教徒和新教徒都参加了社区追悼会。

lemmas.def_zh: 抗议者, 持异议者, 拒付者
lemmas.def_en: a person who dissents from some established policy

examples.en: Each protester carried a colorful sign outside the city hall yesterday morning.
examples.zh: 昨天上午，每位抗议者都在市政厅外举着彩色的标语牌。

lemmas.def_zh: 声明, 断言, 反对, 抗议
lemmas.def_en: a formal and solemn declaration of objection

examples.en: Despite his loud protestations of innocence, nobody in the courtroom believed him.
examples.zh: 尽管他大声声称自己无罪，但法庭上没人相信他。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 pro-（公开、向前）+ testari（作证、声明），本义为‘公开宣布断言’，后引申为公开表达异议与‘抗议’。
family_guide.core_distinction: protest 指一般的抗议行动或声明，而首字母常大写的 Protestant 特指欧洲宗教改革时期因抗议罗马天主教廷而成立的“新教徒”。

lemmas.def_zh: 桥, 舰桥, 桥梁, 桥牌
lemmas.def_en: a structure that allows people or vehicles to cross an obstacle such as a river or canal or railway etc.

examples.en: The new mentorship program helped bridge the communication gap between generations.
examples.zh: 新的导师计划帮助消除了代际之间的沟通隔阂。

lemmas.def_zh: 在……上架桥，连接；消除（分歧、鸿沟），弥合
lemmas.def_en: [T] To build or form a bridge over something; (figurative) to connect or reduce the distance or difference between two things.

examples.en: The new mentorship program helped bridge the communication gap between generations.
examples.zh: 新的导师计划帮助消除了代际之间的沟通隔阂。

lemmas.def_zh: 不能架桥的, 不能逾越的
lemmas.def_en: not bridgeable

examples.en: The political differences between the two parties seem completely unbridgeable right now.
examples.zh: 两党之间的政治分歧目前看来完全无法弥合。

lemmas.def_zh: 可架桥的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being connected by a bridge or as if by a bridge

examples.en: With open communication, these minor cultural differences are easily bridgeable over time.
examples.zh: 通过坦诚交流，这些微小的文化差异随着时间推移很容易弥合。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 brycg，核心概念为“连接被障碍阻隔两端的横跨物”，引申指跨越鸿沟、建立联系的纽带或弥合行为。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词与动词同形，名词指物理桥梁或连接媒介，动词侧重指横跨或弥合差距、消除隔阂。

lemmas.def_zh: 幸运的；侥幸的；带来好运的
lemmas.def_en: favored by good luck; lucky or auspicious

examples.en: I consider myself extremely fortunate to have such supportive mentors throughout my career.
examples.zh: 在职业生涯中能拥有如此支持我的导师，我认为自己极其幸运。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 不幸的；占星术
lemmas.def_en: deserving or inciting pity; ; ; - Galsworthy

examples.en: A series of misfortunate events forced the family to sell their old home.
examples.zh: 一连串不幸的事件迫使这家人卖掉了他们的老宅。

lemmas.def_zh: 不幸地；遗憾的是；可惜
lemmas.def_en: used to express regret that something bad or undesirable has happened

examples.en: Unfortunately, we cannot process your refund without the original receipt.
examples.zh: 遗憾的是，没有原始收据我们无法为您办理退款。

lemmas.def_zh: 幸运地；幸亏；好在
lemmas.def_en: by good fortune; luckily

examples.en: The storm caused severe damage, but fortunately, no one was injured.
examples.zh: 暴风雨造成了严重破坏，但幸运的是，没有人受伤。

lemmas.def_zh: 不幸的人；遭厄运者
lemmas.def_en: a person who suffers from bad luck or difficult circumstances

examples.en: The local shelter provides warm food and winter coats for the city's unfortunates.
examples.zh: 当地庇护所为该市的不幸者提供温热的食物和冬衣。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 fortuna（命运、运气、财富），核心始终围绕“运势好坏”展开，通过否定前缀 un- 与副词/名词后缀衍生系列词汇。
family_guide.core_distinction: fortunate/fortunately 侧重积极的好运与庆幸；加上前缀 un- 则表示消极的不幸或遗憾；unfortunate 亦可直接名词化指“不幸的人”。

lemmas.def_zh: 正式宣布，宣告；郑重声明；申报（应纳税品等）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To announce or state something clearly, firmly, or officially. 2. [T] To formally state taxable goods, income, or possessions.

examples.en: The government declared a state of emergency following the earthquake.
examples.zh: 地震发生后，政府宣布进入紧急状态。

examples.en: Do you have any goods to declare to the customs officers?
examples.zh: 你有物品需要向海关官员申报吗？

lemmas.def_zh: 宣布；宣言；申报（单）
lemmas.def_en: an official or public announcement; a written statement of goods or income

examples.en: The leaders issued a joint declaration calling for immediate peace talks.
examples.zh: 领导人们发表了一份联合宣言，呼吁立即进行和平谈判。

examples.en: You need to complete a customs declaration form before landing.
examples.zh: 降落前你需要填写一份海关申报单。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 说明的
lemmas.def_en: a mood (grammatically unmarked) that represents the act or state as an objective fact

examples.en: The teacher asked the students to write three declarative sentences about nature.
examples.zh: 老师要求学生写出三个关于大自然的陈述句。

lemmas.def_zh: 宣言者, 申报者
lemmas.def_en: the bridge player in contract bridge who wins the bidding and can declare which suit is to be trumps

examples.en: In bridge, the declarer must carefully plan how to win enough tricks.
examples.zh: 在桥牌中，庄家必须仔细规划如何赢得足够的墩数。

lemmas.def_zh: 未申报的, 未宣布的
lemmas.def_en: not announced or openly acknowledged

examples.en: Customs officers seized a large amount of undeclared cash at the border.
examples.zh: 海关官员在边境查获了大量未申报的现金。

lemmas.def_zh: 宣言的；公布的
lemmas.def_en: relating to the use of or having the nature of a declaration

examples.en: The judge issued a declaratory ruling to clarify the legal rights of both parties.
examples.zh: 法官作出了一项宣示性判决，以澄清双方当事人的合法权利。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 declarare（de- 彻底 + clarare 使明了/变清晰），核心逻辑是“公开彻底地讲清楚”，引申为正式宣布、公开声明或依法申报。
family_guide.core_distinction: declare 为动词动作（正式宣布、申报），declaration 为其名词形式（声明、宣言或申报单文书）。

lemmas.def_zh: 野性的, 野蛮的, 野生的, 失控的, 任性的, 杂乱的, 轻率的, 狂热的, 疯狂的
lemmas.def_en: marked by extreme lack of restraint or control

examples.en: We were thrilled to spot a pack of wild wolves in the mountains.
examples.zh: 我们在山里发现了一群野狼，感到非常激动。

lemmas.def_zh: 失去控制地；狂乱地；极其；极其夸张地
lemmas.def_en: in an uncontrolled manner; to an extreme degree

examples.en: The new comedy series turned out to be wildly popular among teenagers.
examples.zh: 这部新的喜剧连续剧在青少年中大受欢迎。

examples.en: His heart was beating wildly as he waited for the test results.
examples.zh: 等待测试结果时，他的心剧烈地跳动着。

lemmas.def_zh: 荒野, 荒地
lemmas.def_en: a wild primitive state untouched by civilization

examples.en: We were thrilled to spot a pack of wild wolves in the mountains.
examples.zh: 我们在山里发现了一群野狼，感到非常激动。

lemmas.def_en: (politics) a state of disfavor
lemmas.def_zh: 荒野；荒漠

examples.en: They spent a week hiking through the Alaskan wilderness.
examples.zh: 他们在阿拉斯加的荒野中徒步旅行了一周。

lemmas.def_zh: 野生, 野蛮, 粗暴
lemmas.def_en: a feeling of extreme emotional intensity

examples.en: The untamed wildness of the northern coast attracted adventurous travelers every summer.
examples.zh: 北部海岸未被驯服的野性每年夏天都吸引着冒险者。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语，核心语义为“未受驯化、自然生长或不受约束的原始状态”，由此派生出荒野、野生、狂乱及极度失控等概念。
family_guide.core_distinction: wild 作形容词意为“野生的”或“狂热失控的”，作名词时常与 the 连用表示“自然界/荒野”；副词 wildly 则主要用来修饰动词或形容词，表示程度“极其/疯狂地”。

lemmas.def_zh: 庄园，大片地产；（尤指死者留下的）全部遗产；住宅区，工业园区
lemmas.def_en: a large area of land in the country, usually with a large house; all the money and property owned by a person, especially at death; an area planned for housing or industry

examples.en: His entire estate was divided equally among his three children.
examples.zh: 他的全部遗产由三个子女平分。

examples.en: They spent the weekend visiting a historic country estate.
examples.zh: 他们周末去参观了一座历史悠久的乡村庄园。

examples.en: The council decided to build a new housing estate on the outskirts of the city.
examples.zh: 市议会决定在市郊兴建一个新的住宅区。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 status（站立/状态/地位），从中世纪指代“社会阶层与身份”逐渐演变为与身份匹配的“大笔财产、庄园地产”及现代法律上的“个人全部遗产”。

lemmas.def_zh: 毕业；授予…学位，准予…毕业；分等级，标刻度
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To successfully complete an academic degree, course of study, or high school education. 2. [T] To grant a degree or diploma to someone; to mark divisions or scale intervals on a measuring device.

examples.en: She plans to apply for a competitive graduate program in clinical psychology.
examples.zh: 她打算申请竞争激烈的临床心理学研究生项目。

lemmas.def_zh: 毕业生, 量杯
lemmas.def_en: a person who has received a degree from a school (high school or college or university)

examples.en: She plans to apply for a competitive graduate program in clinical psychology.
examples.zh: 她打算申请竞争激烈的临床心理学研究生项目。

lemmas.def_zh: 毕业, 得学位, 分划, 刻度, 分等级
lemmas.def_en: the successful completion of a program of study

examples.en: Friends and family gathered proudly to celebrate her graduation from medical school.
examples.zh: 亲朋好友自豪地聚集在一起，庆祝她从医学院毕业。

lemmas.def_zh: 已得学位的, 研究生的, 毕业的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to studies beyond a bachelor's degree

examples.en: She plans to apply for a competitive graduate program in clinical psychology.
examples.zh: 她打算申请竞争激烈的临床心理学研究生项目。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 gradus（步子、等级、阶梯），核心逻辑为“踏上新台阶/迈入下一阶段”，引申为完成学业阶梯、获得学位或按等级划分刻度。
family_guide.core_distinction: graduate 作动词时读作 /-eɪt/，作名词（毕业生）与形容词（研究生的）时读作 /-ət/；graduation 则是抽象的名词，专指“毕业”这一事件或毕业典礼。

lemmas.def_zh: 哥们儿，老兄；家伙，男人
lemmas.def_en: an informal word for a man; buddy or fellow

examples.en: Hey dude, do you want to grab some coffee after work?
examples.zh: 嘿哥们儿，下班后想去喝杯咖啡吗？

examples.en: Who's that cool dude playing the guitar over there?
examples.zh: 在那边弹吉他的那个酷家伙是谁？

family_guide.root_logic: 源自19世纪末美国俚语，起初指极其讲究衣着与仪态的‘花花公子’，后经冲浪与青年亚文化演变为对男性的非正式泛称‘哥们儿、家伙’。

lemmas.def_zh: 咖啡（饮料）；咖啡豆；咖啡粉；咖啡色
lemmas.def_en: a hot or cold drink made from the roasted and ground seeds of a tropical shrub; the seeds or powder themselves

examples.en: She started her morning with a cup of freshly brewed black coffee.
examples.zh: 她早晨以一杯现煮的黑咖啡开始新的一天。

examples.en: Let's meet up for a coffee sometime next week to catch up.
examples.zh: 我们下周找个时间一起喝杯咖啡叙叙旧吧。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自阿拉伯语 qahwah（经土耳其语 kahve 传入欧洲），本指一种提神的植物饮品，现专指咖啡树种子（咖啡豆）、咖啡粉及以此冲泡的饮品。

lemmas.def_zh: 微笑；微笑着表示
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To form one's features into an expression of pleasure, amusement, or kindness, with the corners of the mouth turned up.

examples.en: She managed to smile warmly despite feeling exhausted after the long journey.
examples.zh: 尽管长途旅行后感到精疲力竭，她还是露出了温暖的微笑。

lemmas.def_zh: 微笑, 喜色, 笑容
lemmas.def_en: a facial expression characterized by turning up the corners of the mouth; usually shows pleasure or amusement

examples.en: Her warm smile instantly put everyone in the room completely at ease.
examples.zh: 她温暖的微笑立刻让房间里的每个人都感到轻松。

lemmas.def_zh: 微笑者
lemmas.def_en: a person who smiles

examples.en: He was known as a constant smiler, even during very difficult moments.
examples.zh: 他是个出了名的爱笑之人，即使在艰难时刻也是如此。

lemmas.def_zh: 不笑的, 面无笑容的, 严肃的
lemmas.def_en: not smiling

examples.en: The guard remained completely unsmiling while carefully checking each visitor's passport.
examples.zh: 警卫在仔细检查每位访客的护照时面无表情。

lemmas.def_zh: 微笑地, 含笑地
lemmas.def_en: with smiles; in a smiling manner

examples.en: She smilingly accepted the award and thanked her family for their support.
examples.zh: 她微笑着接过奖项，并感谢家人的支持。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语根 *smei-（发笑、微笑），核心语义为嘴角上扬、面露欣悦但通常不出声的面部神情与动作。

lemmas.def_zh: （与……）结婚，娶，嫁；结合，使紧密结合
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (formal or literary) To marry someone. 2. [T] To combine two different ideas, qualities, or things closely.

examples.en: The couple announced their intention to wed in a private ceremony next spring.
examples.zh: 这对情侣宣布打算在明年春天举行一场私人仪式完婚。

examples.en: The novel brilliantly weds historical facts with imaginative fiction.
examples.zh: 这部小说精彩地将史实与虚构想象结合在一起。

lemmas.def_zh: 婚礼；结婚庆典
lemmas.def_en: a marriage ceremony, especially including the associated festivities

examples.en: Hundreds of guests were invited to the outdoor wedding reception.
examples.zh: 数百名宾客受邀参加了这场户外婚宴。

examples.en: They celebrated their golden wedding anniversary surrounded by children and grandchildren.
examples.zh: 在儿孙的簇拥下，他们庆祝了他们的金婚纪念日。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 weddian（立誓、担保），后引申为以誓约为纽带结成夫妻，进而在现代英语中派生出指代整套结婚仪典的名词。
family_guide.core_distinction: wed 是动作（结婚/结合，书面或新闻文体多见），wedding 则是指具体的婚礼与结婚庆典。

lemmas.def_zh: 体积，容量；音量；卷，册；总量，额
lemmas.def_en: the amount of space occupied; the degree of loudness; a single book of a set; a total amount or quantity

examples.en: Could you please turn the volume down? I'm trying to concentrate.
examples.zh: 你能把音量调小一点吗？我正在努力集中注意力。

examples.en: The second volume of the historical encyclopedia will be published next spring.
examples.zh: 这套历史百科全书的第二卷将于明年春天出版。

examples.en: The sheer volume of online orders during the promotion overwhelmed the warehouse staff.
examples.zh: 促销期间庞大的线上订单量让仓库工作人员应接不暇。

lemmas.def_zh: 卷数多的, 大部头的, 著书多的, 长篇的, 庞大的, 很多的, 盘绕的
lemmas.def_en: large in volume or bulk

examples.en: The library archives contain voluminous records of the town's early colonial history.
examples.zh: 该图书馆的档案馆藏有关于该镇早期殖民历史的大部头记录。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 volvere（旋转、卷起），原指古代卷起的手抄卷轴（书卷/卷册），后引申出卷轴所占的物理空间大小（体积/容量）、声音的宏大饱满度（音量）以及抽象的总体规模（总量/额度）。

lemmas.def_zh: 周期, 循环, 自行车, 一段时间, 整套
lemmas.def_en: an interval during which a recurring sequence of events occurs

examples.en: The life cycle of a butterfly involves four distinct and fascinating stages.
examples.zh: 蝴蝶的生命周期包括四个独特而迷人的阶段。

lemmas.def_zh: 骑自行车的人；自行车运动员
lemmas.def_en: a person who rides a bicycle

examples.en: The city has added designated lanes to protect cyclists from traffic.
examples.zh: 该市增设了专用车道以保护骑行者免受车流威胁。

lemmas.def_zh: 循环性,周期性
lemmas.def_en: the quality of recurring at regular intervals

examples.en: Economists closely study the cyclicity of the market to predict future trends.
examples.zh: 经济学家密切研究市场的周期性以预测未来趋势。

lemmas.def_zh: 循环，周而复始地运转；使循环；骑自行车
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] to move, pass, or operate through a recurring series of events or a cycle; to cause to go through a cycle 2. [I] to ride a bicycle

examples.en: The life cycle of a butterfly involves four distinct and fascinating stages.
examples.zh: 蝴蝶的生命周期包括四个独特而迷人的阶段。

lemmas.def_zh: 周期的, 轮转的, 循环的, 轮列的, 轮卷的, 环状的, 环的, 组诗的, 始末的
lemmas.def_en: conforming to the Carnot cycle

examples.en: The machine performs a cyclic movement that repeats every two minutes.
examples.zh: 这台机器进行周期性运动，每两分钟重复一次。

lemmas.def_zh: 周期的, 轮转的, 循环的, 轮列的, 轮卷的, 环状的, 环的, 组诗的, 始末的
lemmas.def_en: recurring in cycles

examples.en: The company suffered heavy financial losses during the recent cyclical downturn.
examples.zh: 该公司在最近的周期性低迷期遭受了严重的财务损失。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 kyklos（圆、环、轮），核心意象为“圆环状运动”或“轮子”，引申为事物周而复始的规律过程（周期、循环），以及指代两轮脚踏车（自行车及骑行）。
family_guide.core_distinction: cycle 兼具名词（周期/自行车）与动词（骑车/循环）属性；cyclist 则是专用名词后缀 -ist 构成的施事名词，特指“骑行者”。

lemmas.def_zh: 关上，闭起；合拢；停业
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To close an entrance, container, or opening so that passage is obstructed; to cease operations.

examples.en: Please shut the bedroom door quietly so you do not wake anyone.
examples.zh: 请轻轻关上卧室门，免得吵醒大家。

lemmas.def_zh: 关闭，关停（企业或店铺）；用百叶窗关闭（窗户）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To close down a business, store, or service permanently or temporarily. 2. [T] To close windows with shutters.

examples.en: Local shop owners had to shutter their stores before the severe storm arrived.
examples.zh: 在强风暴来临之前，当地店主不得不关闭店铺。

lemmas.def_en: not open

examples.en: Please shut the bedroom door quietly so you do not wake anyone.
examples.zh: 请轻轻关上卧室门，免得吵醒大家。

lemmas.def_zh: 百叶窗, 关闭物, 照相机快门, 关闭者
lemmas.def_en: a mechanical device on a camera that opens and closes to control the time of a photographic exposure

examples.en: Local shop owners had to shutter their stores before the severe storm arrived.
examples.zh: 在强风暴来临之前，当地店主不得不关闭店铺。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 scyttan（用插销插上、封堵），核心意象是用障碍物阻断开口或通道，由此衍生出动作“关闭”及状态“闭合的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: shut 的动词与形容词同形；动词强调“关上、闭合”的动作，形容词多作表语，强调“关着的、不开放的”静止状态。

lemmas.def_zh: 责任，职责；义务；关税，税
lemmas.def_en: a moral or legal obligation; a task required by one's job; a tax on imported goods

examples.en: Doctors have a professional and moral duty to protect patient confidentiality.
examples.zh: 医生负有保护患者隐私的职业和道德责任。

examples.en: Import duties on electronic goods have been significantly reduced this year.
examples.zh: 今年电子产品的进口关税已大幅下调。

lemmas.def_zh: 忠实地；忠贞地
lemmas.def_en: out of a sense of duty; in a dutiful manner

examples.en: The assistant dutifully recorded every detail of the meeting in his notebook.
examples.zh: 助理尽职尽责地将会议的每一个细节记在笔记本上。

lemmas.def_zh: 尽职的, 忠实的, 顺从的, 守本分的
lemmas.def_en: willingly obedient out of a sense of duty and respect

examples.en: He has always been a dutiful son who regularly visits his aging parents.
examples.zh: 他一直是个孝顺的儿子，经常去探望年迈的父母。

lemmas.def_zh: 不顺从的, 不恭敬的, 未尽职的, 未尽本分的
lemmas.def_en: lacking due respect or dutifulness

examples.en: The king banished his undutiful child for refusing to obey royal orders.
examples.zh: 国王流放了不孝顺的孩子，因其拒不服从王室命令。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 deu（意为‘欠下的、应付的’，源自拉丁语 debere），核心逻辑指因道德、法律或职务而‘理所应当要做的事’，后引申出向国家缴纳的‘关税/税款’。

lemmas.def_zh: 明令禁止，取缔
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To forbid or prohibit something officially, or ban someone from doing something.

examples.en: The city council decided to ban single-use plastic bags in all supermarkets.
examples.zh: 市议会决定在所有超市禁止使用一次性塑料袋。

lemmas.def_zh: 禁令
lemmas.def_en: a decree that prohibits something

examples.en: The city council decided to ban single-use plastic bags in all supermarkets.
examples.zh: 市议会决定在所有超市禁止使用一次性塑料袋。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语中表示“公开宣告、传唤”的词根，在中世纪演变为通过官方宣告来“放逐、诅咒或禁止”，现代核心义统一为“官方或权威的明令禁止”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词与名词同形同音；动词常与介词 from 搭配（ban sb from sth），名词常与介词 on 搭配（a ban on sth）。

lemmas.def_zh: 吸，吮吸；抽取，吸取；〈非正〉糟糕，令人厌恶
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To pull liquid, air, or an object into the mouth or an enclosed space using suction. 2. [I] (informal) To be very bad, unpleasant, or disappointing.

examples.en: She used a straw to suck up the last drops of the milkshake.
examples.zh: 她用吸管吸完了最后几滴奶昔。

examples.en: It really sucks that the concert was canceled at the last minute.
examples.zh: 音乐会在最后一刻被取消了，真是太糟糕了。

lemmas.def_zh: 容易受骗的人，冤大头；对……毫无抵抗力的人；吸盘；棒棒糖
lemmas.def_en: a gullible person easily deceived; someone who cannot resist something; an organ or device for sticking by suction

examples.en: Don't be a sucker; there is no such thing as guaranteed easy money.
examples.zh: 别当冤大头了，世上根本没有包赚不赔的轻松钱。

examples.en: I'm a sucker for stray animals and always end up feeding them.
examples.zh: 我对流浪小动物毫无抵抗力，最后总会忍不住去喂它们。

lemmas.def_zh: 吸, 吸入, 吸上, 吸引, 吸力
lemmas.def_en: a force over an area produced by a pressure difference

examples.en: The vacuum cleaner uses powerful suction to lift deep dirt from carpets.
examples.zh: 这台吸尘器利用强大的吸力清除地毯深处的污垢。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声起源，本义为用嘴唇吸入液体或气息，后引申为吸收、陷入，俚语中衍生出'糟糕/令人厌恶'以及'上当受骗'等含义。
family_guide.core_distinction: suck 为核心动词（吸、吮吸，口语指糟糕透顶）；sucker 是名词，最常指'容易上当受骗的人（冤大头）'或'对某物毫无抵抗力的人'。

lemmas.def_zh: 同伴，同类；家伙，男人；（学术机构的）研究员，会士
lemmas.def_en: a person in the same position or group; an informal term for a man; an academic awarded a special post

examples.en: She earned the deep respect of her fellow researchers.
examples.zh: 她赢得了同行研究人员的由衷尊敬。

examples.en: He was elected a fellow of the Royal Society for his contributions to physics.
examples.zh: 因对物理学做出的贡献，他当选为英国皇家学会会士。

lemmas.def_zh: 伙伴关系，情谊；（学术机构的）奖学金，研究员职位；团体，团契
lemmas.def_en: a friendly association with others sharing common interests; a grant or position awarded to a researcher; a group or association

examples.en: She was awarded a two-year research fellowship at Oxford.
examples.zh: 她获得了牛津大学为期两年的研究基金。

examples.en: Working closely on the project fostered a strong sense of fellowship among the team.
examples.zh: 在项目中的密切合作增强了团队成员之间深厚的同袍情谊。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于古诺斯语“共同出资合伙的人”，核心为“共享某种状态或目标的同伴”，后引申指个体男人（家伙）以及学术共同体中的研究员或会士。
family_guide.core_distinction: fellow 指代具体的人（同伴、家伙、研究员/会士），而 fellowship 指抽象的同伴情谊、团体组织或资助研究员的“研究基金/职位”。

lemmas.def_zh: 宗教的；虔诚的；严谨的，一丝不苟的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or believing in a religion; scrupulously and conscientiously careful

examples.en: She comes from a deeply religious family and respects all traditional faiths.
examples.zh: 她来自一个非常虔诚的宗教家庭，对所有传统信仰都怀有敬意。

examples.en: He pays religious attention to detail in his daily work.
examples.zh: 他在日常工作中对细节有着极其严谨的关注。

lemmas.def_zh: 虔诚而经常地, 笃诚地
lemmas.def_en: by religion

examples.en: She exercises religiously every single morning before heading off to work.
examples.zh: 她每天早上去上班前都会雷打不动地锻炼身体。

lemmas.def_zh: 宗教；宗教信仰；极其重要之事
lemmas.def_en: the belief in and worship of a superhuman controlling power, especially a personal God or gods; a particular system of faith and worship

examples.en: The constitution strictly protects the freedom of religion and conscience.
examples.zh: 宪法严格保护宗教与良心自由。

examples.en: In this household, football is followed with the passion of a religion.
examples.zh: 在这个家里，人们对足球的热爱宛如对待宗教一般虔诚。

lemmas.def_zh: 笃信, 虚伪信仰, 虔诚, 宗教狂
lemmas.def_en: exaggerated or affected piety and religious zeal

examples.en: The survey measured how personal religiosity influences moral decision-making among young adults.
examples.zh: 该调查衡量了个人的虔诚程度如何影响年轻人的道德决策。

lemmas.def_zh: 虔敬, 笃信
lemmas.def_en: piety by virtue of being devout

examples.en: His quiet religiousness was reflected in his daily acts of profound kindness.
examples.zh: 他内敛的虔诚体现在他日常深切的善行之中。

lemmas.def_zh: 笃信宗教者, 宗教狂者
lemmas.def_en: a person addicted to religion or a religious zealot

examples.en: The strict religionist firmly rejected any scientific theory that contradicted his sacred beliefs.
examples.zh: 这位狂热的宗教信徒断然拒绝任何与他的宗教信仰相矛盾的科学理论。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 religio（敬畏、神圣约束），核心逻辑是从对神圣信仰的敬畏与崇拜，延伸至虔诚奉行的态度，进而比喻为对某事极其严谨、一丝不苟的执着。

lemmas.def_zh: 转变，改变；转换，交换；开/关（电器）
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. to change or turn from one thing to another; exchange. 2. to turn an electrical device on or off using a switch.

examples.en: She decided to switch careers after working as an accountant for ten years.
examples.zh: 做了十年会计后，她决定转变职业方向。

lemmas.def_zh: 开关, 电闸, 转换, 软枝, 鞭子, 道岔
lemmas.def_en: control consisting of a mechanical or electrical or electronic device for making or breaking or changing the connections in a circuit

examples.en: She decided to switch careers after working as an accountant for ten years.
examples.zh: 做了十年会计后，她决定转变职业方向。

lemmas.def_zh: 交换机；转换开关；调车机车
lemmas.def_en: a person who administers punishment by wielding a switch or whip

examples.en: The video switcher allowed the director to cut smoothly between multiple cameras.
examples.zh: 视频切换器让导演可以在多个机位之间平滑切换。

family_guide.root_logic: 原指柔软易弯的细枝或抽打动作，后引申为迅速转变方向、对调位置，以及用于切断或接通电流的机械装置。

lemmas.def_zh: 边缘，边沿
lemmas.def_en: the boundary of a surface

examples.en: He stood nervously near the edge of the steep cliff.
examples.zh: 他紧张地站在陡峭的悬崖边缘。

lemmas.def_zh: 刀口锐利, 急躁
lemmas.def_en: feelings of anxiety that make you tense and irritable

lemmas.def_zh: 磨边机；轧边机；刨边机
lemmas.def_en: a person who puts finishing edges on a garment

examples.en: He used a lawn edger to trim the grass along the concrete driveway neatly.
examples.zh: 他用草坪修边机把混凝土车道旁边的草修剪得很整齐。

lemmas.def_zh: 缓缓移动，徐徐挪动；给……镶边；微弱胜过
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To move slowly and carefully in a specified direction, or make something move this way. 2. [T] To give a border or edge to something.

examples.en: The nervous driver edged the car carefully into the narrow parking space.
examples.zh: 紧张的司机小心翼翼地把车缓缓挪进狭窄的车位里。

lemmas.def_zh: 刀口锐利的, 尖利的, 急躁的
lemmas.def_en: being in a tense state

examples.en: She felt extremely edgy while waiting for the crucial job interview results.
examples.zh: 在等待关键的求职面试结果时，她感到极度焦躁不安。

lemmas.def_zh: 没刀刃的, 钝的
lemmas.def_en: lacking a cutting edge

examples.en: The antique blade was completely edgeless and posed no danger to anyone.
examples.zh: 这把古董刀刃完全钝了，不会对任何人构成危险。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 ecg（刀刃、利刃），从“锋利的刃口”核心义引申出物理上的“边缘/边界”，进而衍生出竞争中的“微弱优势”以及“沿边缘缓慢挪动”的动词含义。

lemmas.def_zh: 雨, 下雨, 雨天
lemmas.def_en: water falling in drops from vapor condensed in the atmosphere

examples.en: The heavy rain forced the organizers to cancel the outdoor music festival.
examples.zh: 大雨迫使组织者取消了室外音乐节。

lemmas.def_zh: 下雨；大量落下，大量倾泻
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (impersonal, 'it rains') To fall in drops from the clouds. 2. [I, T] To fall, drop, or throw something down in large quantities.

examples.en: The heavy rain forced the organizers to cancel the outdoor music festival.
examples.zh: 大雨迫使组织者取消了室外音乐节。

lemmas.def_zh: 下雨的, 多雨的
lemmas.def_en: (of weather) wet by periods of rain

examples.en: We spent the rainy afternoon reading books and drinking warm tea indoors.
examples.zh: 我们在室内看书、喝热茶，度过了那个阴雨连绵的下午。

lemmas.def_zh: 缺少雨的, 无雨的
lemmas.def_en: lacking rain

examples.en: The prolonged rainless period severely depleted the city's main water reserves.
examples.zh: 长期的干旱无雨严重消耗了该市的主要水资源储备。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语，核心语义始终锁定在“从云层中降落的水滴”，后引申出密集倾泻、大量降下的动态。
family_guide.core_distinction: rain 作名词表示“雨水”本身，rainy 为形容词，侧重“多雨的、有雨的”气候或时间特征。

lemmas.def_zh: 否定的；消极的，负面的；（数）负的；（医）阴性的；否决，拒绝；否定
lemmas.def_en: expressing denial, refusal, or pessimism; less than zero; not showing the presence of a disease; to veto or disprove

examples.en: The test results came back negative, confirming she was completely healthy.
examples.zh: 检测结果呈阴性，证实她非常健康。

examples.en: The committee ultimately voted to negative the proposed amendments.
examples.zh: 委员会最终投票否决了拟议的修正案。

lemmas.def_zh: [数]非负的,正的,零的
lemmas.def_en: either positive or zero

examples.en: Ensure that all values entered into this formula are strictly nonnegative numbers.
examples.zh: 确保输入该公式的所有数值都严格为非负数。

lemmas.def_zh: 负面地，消极地；否定地
lemmas.def_en: in a harmful, pessimistic, or unfavorable manner

examples.en: The new regulations could negatively impact small businesses across the region.
examples.zh: 新法规可能会对该地区的小微企业造成负面影响。

lemmas.def_zh: 否定性, 消极性
lemmas.def_en: the character of the negative electric pole

examples.en: She tries to ignore workplace negativity and focus on her daily tasks.
examples.zh: 她尽量忽视职场中的负面情绪，专注于自己的日常工作。

lemmas.def_zh: 否定, 反面, 不存在
lemmas.def_en: a negative statement; a statement that is a refusal or denial of some other statement

lemmas.def_zh: 否定性, 消极性
lemmas.def_en: the character of the negative electric pole

examples.en: The persistent negativeness of his attitude made teamwork quite difficult for everyone.
examples.zh: 他态度中一贯的消极性让每个人的团队合作都十分艰难。

lemmas.def_zh: 否决，驳回；否定，证明……为假
lemmas.def_en: [T] (formal) To refuse to accept or approve; veto; to disprove or contradict.

examples.en: The test results came back negative, confirming she was completely healthy.
examples.zh: 检测结果呈阴性，证实她非常健康。

examples.en: The committee ultimately voted to negative the proposed amendments.
examples.zh: 委员会最终投票否决了拟议的修正案。

lemmas.def_zh: 抵消，消除……的作用；否定，否认
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To stop something from having any effect or value; to cancel out. 2. [T] (formal) To state or prove that something does not exist or is untrue.

examples.en: A single major mistake can negate all the hard work we put into this.
examples.zh: 一个重大失误就可能抵消我们为此付出的所有努力。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 negare（否认、说不），核心逻辑围绕“否定、缺乏、反面”展开，引申出消极的态度、负数以及医学上的阴性检测结果。
family_guide.core_distinction: negative 兼具形容词与动词词性，作动词时属正式法律或书面用语（意为“否决、推翻”）；副词 negatively 则用于修饰受到不利、负面影响的动态。

lemmas.def_zh: 边缘, 边境, 边界, 花坛
lemmas.def_en: a line that indicates a boundary

examples.en: Security officers checked every passport before letting travelers cross the national border.
examples.zh: 安保人员在允许旅客穿过国界前检查了每一本护照。

lemmas.def_zh: 与……接壤，毗邻；给……镶边；近似，接近 (border on)
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (+ on) To be next to or share a boundary with a country, area, or property. 2. [T] To form an edge along something. 3. [I] (+ on) To come close to or be almost the same as something.

examples.en: Security officers checked every passport before letting travelers cross the national border.
examples.zh: 安保人员在允许旅客穿过国界前检查了每一本护照。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 bord（边缘），核心语义指两块区域或物体之间的“外围边缘”，后引申为地理与政治上的“国界/边界”，动词化后表示“形成边界、毗邻”或抽象的“濒临/接近”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 作为名词指物理或政治边缘；作为动词常接 on/upon 表示抽象层面的“濒临、近似于”。

lemmas.def_zh: 同盟国，盟友，支持者；（使）结盟，联合
lemmas.def_en: a country, group, or person joined with another for a common purpose; to unite or form a connection with another

examples.en: The two nations have remained steadfast military allies for over half a century.
examples.zh: 半个多世纪以来，两国一直保持着坚定的军事同盟关系。

examples.en: The environmental group allied itself with local communities to protest the pipeline.
examples.zh: 该环保组织与当地社区联合起来抗议管道工程。

lemmas.def_zh: 结盟，同盟关系；联盟组织
lemmas.def_en: a formal union or agreement between countries, organizations, or people to cooperate for mutual benefit

examples.en: Several major airlines formed a strategic alliance to offer code-sharing flights.
examples.zh: 几家大型航空公司结成战略联盟，提供代码共享航班。

lemmas.def_zh: 不适当的结合, 不适当的婚姻
lemmas.def_en: an unsuitable alliance (especially with regard to marriage)

examples.en: Their brief and chaotic marriage was clearly a misalliance from the beginning.
examples.zh: 他们短暂而混乱的婚姻从一开始显然就是个错误的结合。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）结盟，（使）联合
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To join or unite with another person, group, or country for mutual support or a common purpose.

examples.en: The two nations have remained steadfast military allies for over half a century.
examples.zh: 半个多世纪以来，两国一直保持着坚定的军事同盟关系。

examples.en: The environmental group allied itself with local communities to protest the pipeline.
examples.zh: 该环保组织与当地社区联合起来抗议管道工程。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 alligare（ad- 朝向 + ligare 捆绑），核心逻辑是通过契约或利益“捆绑在一起”，引申为政治、军事或个人之间的结盟与合作。
family_guide.core_distinction: ally 侧重于结盟的具体主体（盟友、同盟国）或结盟的动作；alliance 则侧重于抽象的结盟关系或形成的联盟组织整体。

lemmas.def_zh: 反抗，抵制；忍住，克制；抗拒（疾病、外力等）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To fight against or oppose someone or something. 2. [T] To stop yourself from doing or having something you want.

examples.en: I couldn't resist the temptation to check my phone during the meeting.
examples.zh: 会议期间我忍不住看了一眼手机。

examples.en: Many elderly residents strongly resist changes to their daily routines.
examples.zh: 许多老年居民强烈抵制改变他们的日常生活作息。

lemmas.def_zh: 反抗，抵制；抵抗力；阻力；电阻
lemmas.def_en: the act of fighting against something; the physical ability not to be affected by illness; a force that opposes motion

examples.en: The government's new tax reform plan met with fierce resistance from small businesses.
examples.zh: 政府的新税改方案遭到了小微企业的强烈抵制。

examples.en: A balanced diet and regular exercise help build your body's resistance to infection.
examples.zh: 均衡的饮食和规律的运动有助于增强身体对感染的抵抗力。

lemmas.def_zh: 抵抗力, 电阻系数
lemmas.def_en: a material's opposition to the flow of electric current; measured in ohms

examples.en: Copper is widely used in electrical wiring because of its very low resistivity.
examples.zh: 铜因其极低的电阻率而广泛应用于电线中。

lemmas.def_zh: 抵抗者, 反抗者
lemmas.def_en: someone who systematically obstructs some action that others want to take

examples.en: The underground resisters smuggled vital supplies through the heavily guarded checkpoint.
examples.zh: 地下反抗者将关键物资偷偷运过了守卫森严的检查站。

lemmas.def_zh: 不主张武力抗暴者, 不抵抗主义
lemmas.def_en: group refusal to resort to violence even in defense against violence

examples.en: The philosopher advocated absolute nonresistance as the most effective path to lasting peace.
examples.zh: 这位哲学家主张绝对不抵抗，认为这是通往持久和平的最有效途径。

lemmas.def_zh: 有抵抗力的；耐……的；抵触的
lemmas.def_en: not easily harmed or affected by something; opposing or disliking something

examples.en: The overuse of antibiotics has led to strains of bacteria that are resistant to treatment.
examples.zh: 滥用抗生素导致了对治疗具有耐药性的菌株产生。

examples.en: This outdoor jacket is made of breathable, water-resistant fabric.
examples.zh: 这件户外夹克是由透气耐水的面料制成的。

lemmas.def_zh: 抗...的, 电阻的
lemmas.def_en: exhibiting or relating to electrical resistance

examples.en: Modern resistive touchscreens respond accurately to the pressure of a stylus tip.
examples.zh: 现代电阻式触摸屏对手写笔笔尖的压力响应十分灵敏。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语前缀 re-（反向、相对）+ sistere（站立、停住），核心意象为“站立在对立面相抗衡”，延伸为对抗、阻挡以及心理上的克制与耐受。
family_guide.core_distinction: resistance 为名词，指抵抗力、阻力或反抗行为；resistant 为形容词，常与 to 搭配表示“有抵抗力的”或“反抗的”，也可作复合后缀表示“耐……的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 船
lemmas.def_en: a small vessel for travel on water

examples.en: We rented a small wooden boat to explore the hidden coves today.
examples.zh: 我们今天租了一艘小木船去探索隐秘的海湾。

lemmas.def_zh: 船工, 硬草帽
lemmas.def_en: a stiff hat made of straw with a flat crown

examples.en: He wore a stylish straw boater to protect himself from the afternoon sun.
examples.zh: 他戴着一顶时髦的硬草帽以遮挡午后的阳光。

lemmas.def_zh: 乘船航行，划船；用船运载
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] to travel, sail, or row in a boat for pleasure or transport 2. [T] to carry or transport people or goods in a boat

examples.en: We rented a small wooden boat to explore the hidden coves today.
examples.zh: 我们今天租了一艘小木船去探索隐秘的海湾。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 bāt，核心指用于水上航行的小船，后由名词直接引申为乘船或泛舟游乐的动作。

lemmas.def_zh: 翅膀, 翼, 机翼, 派别
lemmas.def_en: a movable organ for flying (one of a pair)

examples.en: The wounded eagle could not fly because of a broken left wing.
examples.zh: 那只受伤的鹰因左翼折断而无法飞行。

lemmas.def_zh: 飞翔，飞行；飞越；击中（人或鸟的）侧翼或翅膀
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (literary) To travel through the air using wings; to fly. 2. [T] To wound a bird or person in the wing or arm.

examples.en: The wounded eagle could not fly because of a broken left wing.
examples.zh: 那只受伤的鹰因左翼折断而无法飞行。

lemmas.def_zh: 没有翼的, 没有翅的
lemmas.def_en: lacking wings

examples.en: Certain wingless insects rely entirely on jumping or crawling to escape predators.
examples.zh: 某些无翅昆虫完全依靠跳跃或爬行来躲避捕食者。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古诺斯语 vængr（翅膀），核心意象为鸟类的飞行器官，引申为飞机机翼、建筑侧翼及组织派系；动词化后表示飞翔、击伤侧面，或口语中引申为即兴发挥（wing it）。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词涵盖生物器官、建筑附加部分与政治派系；动词除表飞行与侧向擦伤外，最常用于口语俚语 wing it（临时应付、即兴发挥）。

lemmas.def_zh: 插座, 千斤顶, 男人
lemmas.def_en: a small worthless amount

examples.en: Always use a sturdy mechanical jack before attempting to change a flat tire.
examples.zh: 在尝试更换瘪胎之前，务必使用结实的机械千斤顶。

lemmas.def_zh: 用千斤顶托起（通常作 jack up）；抬高，大幅增加
lemmas.def_en: [T] ('jack up') to raise or lift something heavy using a jack; to raise prices or amounts sharply.

examples.en: Always use a sturdy mechanical jack before attempting to change a flat tire.
examples.zh: 在尝试更换瘪胎之前，务必使用结实的机械千斤顶。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自常见男名 Jack（中世纪泛指普通劳工或男仆），后引申指代代替人工干重活的简易机械（如千斤顶）及连接接口，动词则由工具动作引申为‘顶起’及大幅提高。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词主要指起重工具（千斤顶）、电路插孔或扑克牌中的J；动词核心指‘用千斤顶顶起’，常以短语形式引申指‘大幅哄抬（价格、租金等）’。

lemmas.def_zh: 主要的, 最初的, 根本的
lemmas.def_en: first in rank or degree

examples.en: The athlete knew he was past his physical prime after the injury.
examples.zh: 受伤后，这位运动员知道自己的身体巅峰期已过。

lemmas.def_zh: 最佳部分, 初期, 全盛期
lemmas.def_en: a number that has no factor but itself and 1

examples.en: The athlete knew he was past his physical prime after the injury.
examples.zh: 受伤后，这位运动员知道自己的身体巅峰期已过。

lemmas.def_zh: 入门书, 初级读本, 雷管, 导火线, 底漆
lemmas.def_en: an introductory textbook

examples.en: This booklet serves as a useful primer for beginners learning web design.
examples.zh: 这本小册子是初学者学习网页设计的实用入门读本。

lemmas.def_zh: 整理，使整洁；使显出一本正经的神态
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To make clothes, appearance, or hair neat and tidy. 2. [T] To compress one's face or lips into a formal, overly proper expression.

examples.en: She primmed her mouth in disapproval when he made that rude remark.
examples.zh: 当他发表那番粗鲁言论时，她一本正经地板起了脸以示反对。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 primus（第一），核心语义围绕“次序在先”，引申出“首要的、顶尖的（第一等）”以及开启认知的“初始准备”。
family_guide.core_distinction: prime 作名词指事物或人处于巅峰状态的“全盛期”，而 primer 则特指从零起步的“入门指南”或打底用的“底漆”。

lemmas.def_zh: 终极的, 根本的, 极限的, 最远的, 最后的, 最大的
lemmas.def_en: furthest or highest in degree or order; utmost or extreme

examples.en: Their ultimate goal is to expand the business into international markets.
examples.zh: 他们的最终目标是将业务扩展到国际市场。

lemmas.def_zh: 最终；归根结底；终究
lemmas.def_en: in the end, after a series of events or long consideration; fundamentally

examples.en: A manager is ultimately responsible for the performance of their team.
examples.zh: 管理者归根结底要对团队的业绩负责。

examples.en: The negotiations were tough, but ultimately successful.
examples.zh: 谈判非常艰苦，但最终取得了成功。

lemmas.def_zh: 终极, 根本, 顶点, 基本原则
lemmas.def_en: the finest or most superior quality of its kind

examples.en: Their ultimate goal is to expand the business into international markets.
examples.zh: 他们的最终目标是将业务扩展到国际市场。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ultimus（最远、最后的，系 ultra‘超越’的最高级形式），核心意象指‘走到极限或末端’，引申出‘最终的’与‘极致的’两大语义方向。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词 ultimate 强调过程的终局或程度的极限；名词 ultimate 常与 the 连用指某领域的‘极致/极品’；副词 ultimately 则侧重转折或发展后‘归根结底/最终’的结果。

lemmas.def_zh: 十年，十年期；十个一组
lemmas.def_en: a period of ten years

examples.en: Environmental awareness has grown significantly over the past decade.
examples.zh: 在过去的十年里，公众的环保意识显著增强。

examples.en: The medical breakthrough was the culmination of decades of research.
examples.zh: 这项医学突破是数十年潜心研究的结晶。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语词根 deka（十），核心概念为“十个一组”，现代英语中专指连续的“十年”时间跨度。

lemmas.def_zh: 英雄；勇士；（小说、电影等的）男主角；崇拜的偶像
lemmas.def_en: a person admired for courage, outstanding achievements, or noble qualities; the main male character in a story

examples.en: The firefighters were hailed as heroes after pulling several residents from the burning building.
examples.zh: 消防员在从起火建筑中救出数名居民后被誉为英雄。

examples.en: The novel's central hero is an ordinary clerk who inadvertently uncovers an international conspiracy.
examples.zh: 这部小说的男主角是一名偶然揭开一起国际阴谋的普通职员。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 hērōs（意为‘保护者、半人半神的勇士’），核心语义是指具备超凡勇气、高尚品德或杰出成就而受到公众敬仰的人。

lemmas.def_zh: 圆，圆形
lemmas.def_en: ellipse in which the two axes are of equal length; a plane curve generated by one point moving at a constant distance from a fixed point

examples.en: The children sat in a circle on the floor to listen to the story.
examples.zh: 孩子们在地板上围坐成一圈听故事。

lemmas.def_zh: 流通, 循环, 发行量
lemmas.def_en: the dissemination of copies of periodicals (as newspapers or magazines)

examples.en: Regular exercise improves blood circulation and boosts your overall energy levels.
examples.zh: 经常锻炼可以改善血液循环，提升整体精力水平。

lemmas.def_en: an advertisement (usually printed on a page or in a leaflet) intended for wide distribution
lemmas.def_zh: [医] 环状的, 循环的

examples.en: The hospital issued a circular detailing the emergency safety protocols to all medical staff.
examples.zh: 医院向全体医护人员分发了一份详述应急安全规程的通知。

lemmas.def_en: the roundness of a 2-dimensional figure
lemmas.def_zh: 圆, 圈状, 环状

examples.en: The circularity of her argument made it impossible to reach a meaningful conclusion.
examples.zh: 她论点的循环论证让人根本无法得出有意义的结论。

lemmas.def_en: circulating printed notices as a means of advertising
lemmas.def_zh: [经] 询证通函

examples.en: The auditing team conducted a circularization of the firm's major debtors to verify balances.
examples.zh: 审计小组向该公司的主要债务人寄发了询证函以核实余额。

lemmas.def_zh: 盘旋，绕圈移动；环绕，围绕
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To move in a circle or travel around someone or something, especially in flight. 2. [T] To draw a circle around something.

examples.en: Several vultures began to circle high above the deserted valley.
examples.zh: 几只秃鹰开始在荒芜的山谷上空盘旋。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）循环；（使）流通；（使）流传，传播
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To move continuously around a closed system or area, or cause something to do so. 2. [I, T] To pass or spread from person to person.

examples.en: Rumors began to circulate quickly through the office after the meeting.
examples.zh: 会议结束后，谣言开始在办公室里迅速传开。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To circularize a group of people means to send the same notice, questionnaire, or advertisement to all of them.
lemmas.def_zh: 将函件分发给..., 公布, 分发民意测验单, 使成圈(或环)形

examples.en: We decided to circularize our loyal clients with details of the upcoming promotion.
examples.zh: 我们决定向老客户分发包含即将开展的促销活动详情的信函。

lemmas.def_en: having a circular shape
lemmas.def_zh: 圆形的, 循环的, 间接的

examples.en: Guests gathered around a large circular dining table in the middle of the room.
examples.zh: 客人们聚集在房间中央的一张大圆餐桌旁。

lemmas.def_en: in a circular manner
lemmas.def_zh: 圆地, 圆形地, 循环地

examples.en: The dancers moved circularly around the fire as the rhythmic drumming grew louder.
examples.zh: 随着有节奏的鼓声越来越大，舞者们围着火堆绕圈移动。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 circulus（小圆圈），核心意象为“圆形”，引申出环形轨迹、封闭群体（圈子）以及周而复始的流动与流传。
family_guide.core_distinction: circle 侧重具体的“圆圈、界子”或“盘旋”动作；circulation 则特指液体、空气、货币或信息等的“循环、流通与发行”。

lemmas.def_zh: 雇佣，聘用；（短期）租用，租借
lemmas.def_en: [T] to employ someone to do a particular job for wages; to pay to use something for a short period of time

examples.en: The tech company plans to hire fifty new software engineers this quarter.
examples.zh: 这家科技公司计划在本季度招聘50名新软件工程师。

examples.en: We decided to hire a car at the airport for our road trip across Scotland.
examples.zh: 我们决定在机场租一辆车，开始我们的苏格兰公路之旅。

lemmas.def_zh: 租借者, 雇主
lemmas.def_en: a person responsible for hiring workers

examples.en: The car rental contract specifies that the hirer is liable for damages.
examples.zh: 汽车租赁合同明确规定租借人须对损坏承担责任。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 雇用的；租来的
lemmas.def_en: having services engaged for a fee; rented
lemmas.usage_note: 常见固定搭配有 a hired car（租来的车）或 a hired gun（雇佣杀手；口语中亦指雇来的专业救火队员/专家）。

examples.en: They drove around the island in a hired convertible.
examples.zh: 他们开着一辆租来的敞篷车在岛上兜风。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 hyrian，核心概念是“支付报酬以换取某人劳力或某物的暂时使用权”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 美式英语中 hire 多专指“雇佣（人）”，租用物品多用 rent；英式英语中 hire 既可指雇人，也极常指短期“租用（车辆、设备等）”。

lemmas.def_zh: 北方的；北部的；朝北的
lemmas.def_en: situated in, directed toward, or facing the north

examples.en: Winter temperatures in the northern parts of the country can drop well below freezing.
examples.zh: 该国北部地区的冬季气温可降至远低于冰点的水平。

examples.en: The northern lights are visible only on clear, dark nights.
examples.zh: 北极光只有在晴朗黑暗的夜晚才能看到。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 norðerne，由方位词 north（北）加形容词后缀 -ern（表来源或方向）构成，核心语义为“位于北方的”或“朝北的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 与 north 相比，northern 更偏向描述较大区域、气候地理或文化属性（如 northern climate, northern dialect），而 north 多作专有名词一部分或指示精确方向。

lemmas.def_zh: 谁（who的宾格形式，作动词或介词的宾语）
lemmas.def_en: used as the objective case of 'who', especially as the direct object of a verb or preposition

examples.en: She was accompanied by a senior colleague with whom she had worked for over a decade.
examples.zh: 她由一位与她共事了十多年的资深同事陪同。

examples.en: To whom should I direct my inquiries regarding the research grant?
examples.zh: 关于研究资助的咨询，我应该向谁提出？

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语疑问代词 who 的与格形式，在现代英语语法中保留为 who 的宾格形式，专门用作动词或介词的宾语。
family_guide.core_distinction: who 用作主格（句中作主语），whom 专用于宾格（作动词或介词的宾语）；现代日常口语中常被 who 替代，但在介词后或正式书面语中仍规范使用 whom。

lemmas.def_zh: 硬币
lemmas.def_en: coins collectively

examples.en: In ancient times, traders preferred payment in specie rather than paper credit.
examples.zh: 在古代，商人们更倾向于用硬币支付，而不是纸质信用凭证。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 specere（看、观察），由“外貌、形态”引申为“依据特征划分出的种类”，现代生物学中专指能互相繁育后代的“物种”。
family_guide.core_distinction: species 为基本物种单位（单复数同形）；subspecies 是其下的分类阶元“亚种”；speciation 则指物种分化与形成的生物演化过程。

lemmas.def_zh: 探索，探究；勘探，考察
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To travel through an unfamiliar area to learn about it, or to examine something systematically and thoroughly.

examples.en: We spent the afternoon exploring the narrow streets of the ancient town.
examples.zh: 我们花了一个下午的时间探索这座古镇狭窄的街道。

examples.en: The committee met to explore alternative solutions to the crisis.
examples.zh: 委员会开会探讨解决这场危机的替代方案。

lemmas.def_zh: 探险；勘探；探讨，研究
lemmas.def_en: the action of traveling in or through an unfamiliar area, or the thorough investigation of a subject

examples.en: Deep-sea exploration requires sophisticated submersibles and advanced technology.
examples.zh: 深海探测需要精密的潜水器和先进的技术。

examples.en: The novel is a poignant exploration of grief and reconciliation.
examples.zh: 这部小说对悲痛与和解进行了深刻动人的探讨。

lemmas.def_zh: 探险家；勘探者；探测器
lemmas.def_en: a person who explores unfamiliar places, or a device used to investigate unknown environments

examples.en: Early polar explorers endured unimaginable hardships in freezing temperatures.
examples.zh: 早期的极地探险家在极寒的气温下忍受了难以想象的艰辛。

examples.en: Scientists deployed a robotic explorer to collect samples from the crater.
examples.zh: 科学家部署了一个机器人探测器，从陨石坑中采集样本。

lemmas.def_zh: 探究, 探查, 探察(伤处), 探险, 探测, 勘探, 考察, 钻研, 探索
lemmas.def_en: serving in or intended for exploration or discovery

examples.en: The surgeon scheduled an exploratory operation to locate the source of the bleeding.
examples.zh: 外科医生安排了一次探查性手术，以确定出血来源。

lemmas.def_zh: 探险的, 探测的
lemmas.def_en: serving in or intended for exploration or discovery

examples.en: The scientists conducted an explorative study to identify potential environmental hazards.
examples.zh: 科学家们进行了一项探索性研究，以确定潜在的环境危害。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 explorare（ex- 向外 + plorare 呼喊，原指猎人搜寻猎物时的呼喊），引申并演化为‘深入未知领域进行搜寻、考察与探究’的核心概念。
family_guide.core_distinction: exploration 指探索或勘探的“行为、过程或研究”，而 explorer 指执行探索的“人”或“探测设备”。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 区域，地带；（特定功能的）分区；v. 将…划为特定区域；（俚语）走神，发呆（与 out 连用）
lemmas.def_en: n. an area with particular features, purposes, or rules; v. to divide land into designated areas; to lose concentration or daydream (often with 'out')

examples.en: The downtown area has been designated as a low-emission zone to improve air quality.
examples.zh: 市中心已被划为低排放区以改善空气质量。

examples.en: The vacant land behind the stadium was zoned for commercial development.
examples.zh: 体育场后面的空地已被规划用于商业开发。

examples.en: After hours of continuous coding, he began to zone out and stare blankly at the screen.
examples.zh: 连续写代码几个小时后，他开始走神，双眼茫然地盯着屏幕。

lemmas.def_zh: 将……划为特定区域，分区规划；（zone out）走神，发呆
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To divide land or an area into zones designated for specific uses or purposes. 2. [I] (zone out) (informal) To lose concentration or become unaware of one's surroundings.

examples.en: The downtown area has been designated as a low-emission zone to improve air quality.
examples.zh: 市中心已被划为低排放区以改善空气质量。

examples.en: The vacant land behind the stadium was zoned for commercial development.
examples.zh: 体育场后面的空地已被规划用于商业开发。

examples.en: After hours of continuous coding, he began to zone out and stare blankly at the screen.
examples.zh: 连续写代码几个小时后，他开始走神，双眼茫然地盯着屏幕。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 zōnē（腰带、环带），原指按纬度划分的地球带状气候区，后引申为具有特定功能、规则或特征的“区域、地带”；动词引申为“分区规划”及口语中的“走神（进入发呆状态）”。

lemmas.def_zh: 取得，获得；购得，收购；学到
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To gain possession of something, especially by buying or being given it. 2. [T] To learn, develop, or master a skill or habit.

examples.en: She has acquired a good knowledge of fluent English through daily practice.
examples.zh: 通过日常练习，她掌握了流利的英语。

examples.en: The tech giant plans to acquire the promising AI startup for $50 million.
examples.zh: 这家科技巨头计划以 5000 万美元收购这家前景广阔的人工智能初创公司。

lemmas.def_zh: 获得，习得；收购，并购；购置物，收购的企业
lemmas.def_en: the act of obtaining something; a company or asset that has been bought

examples.en: Theories of second language acquisition emphasize the importance of immersive input.
examples.zh: 第二语言习得理论强调沉浸式输入的重要性。

examples.en: The museum's latest acquisition is a rare 17th-century oil painting.
examples.zh: 该博物馆最新购藏的展品是一幅罕见的17世纪油画。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 转得人, 取得人, 受让人
lemmas.def_en: a person who acquires something (usually permanently)

examples.en: The potential acquirer reviewed all financial statements before finalizing the merger.
examples.zh: 潜在收购方在敲定合并前审查了所有财务报表。

lemmas.def_zh: 取得, 得到, 获得, 学到的东西
lemmas.def_en: an ability that has been acquired by training

examples.en: Fluency in a foreign language is a valuable acquirement for any professional.
examples.zh: 流利掌握一门外语对任何专业人士而言都是一项宝贵的技能收获。

lemmas.def_zh: 占有欲
lemmas.def_en: strong desire to acquire and possess

examples.en: Modern advertising often encourages relentless acquisitiveness and unnecessary spending among consumers.
examples.zh: 现代广告常常助长消费者无休止的占有欲和不必要的消费。

lemmas.def_zh: 渴望获得的, 贪婪的
lemmas.def_en: eager to acquire and possess things especially material possessions or ideas

examples.en: We live in an acquisitive society that often equates success with wealth.
examples.zh: 我们生活在一个物欲横流的社会，人们往往把成功与财富划等号。

lemmas.def_zh: 可得的, 可获的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being acquired

examples.en: Confidence is an acquirable skill that develops with consistent practice and experience.
examples.zh: 自信是一项可以通过持续的练习和经验积累而获得的能力。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语前缀 ad-（向、去）与 quaerere（寻求、探求），核心意象为“通过主动寻找或努力而弄到手”，引申为“获得、习得、收购”。
family_guide.core_distinction: acquire 侧重动作行为（获得、习得、购入）；acquisition 既可指获得/习得/并购的行为或过程，也可直接指代所购得的财产或被收购的公司。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 专家，行家；adj. 专家的，熟练的，内行的
lemmas.def_en: n. a person with comprehensive knowledge or skill in a particular area; adj. having or showing special skill or knowledge derived from experience

examples.en: She is widely regarded as a leading expert on international trade law.
examples.zh: 她被公认为是国际贸易法领域的顶尖专家。

examples.en: The antique clock was restored to working order through expert craftsmanship.
examples.zh: 凭借精湛的手艺，这座古董钟被修复到可以正常运转的状态。

lemmas.def_en: skillfulness by virtue of possessing special knowledge
lemmas.def_zh: (n.) 专门知识，专长，专业技能

examples.en: She has considerable expertise in international trade law.
examples.zh: 她在国际贸易法领域拥有相当丰富的专业知识。

lemmas.def_zh: 专门性
lemmas.def_en: skillfulness by virtue of possessing special knowledge

examples.en: Her sheer expertness in handling delicate negotiations impressed all the senior diplomats.
examples.zh: 她在处理棘手谈判方面的娴熟专业素养给所有资深外交官留下了深刻印象。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 专家，行家；adj. 专家的，熟练的，内行的
lemmas.def_en: n. a person with comprehensive knowledge or skill in a particular area; adj. having or showing special skill or knowledge derived from experience

examples.en: She is widely regarded as a leading expert on international trade law.
examples.zh: 她被公认为是国际贸易法领域的顶尖专家。
