examples.en: Several bottles were mislabeled in the factory and had to be recalled immediately.
examples.zh: 工厂里的几个瓶子被贴错了标签，必须立即召回。

lemmas.def_zh: 无标号的
lemmas.def_en: lacking a label or tag

examples.en: The technician refused to open the unlabeled container found in the basement.
examples.zh: 技术员拒绝打开在地下室发现的无标签容器。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语中表示“布条、系带”的词汇，演变为附着在物品上的说明条片（名词），进而引申出“贴标签”以及认知上的“归类、定性”（动词）。

lemmas.def_zh: 海湾, 狗吠声, 月桂
lemmas.def_en: an indentation of a shoreline larger than a cove but smaller than a gulf

examples.en: The luxury cruise ship dropped anchor in the quiet bay at dawn.
examples.zh: 豪华游轮在拂晓时分停泊在宁静的海湾中。

lemmas.def_zh: (Baier)人名；(德、捷、西)拜尔；(罗)巴耶尔；(英)贝尔

examples.en: Professor Baier delivered an inspiring lecture on international economics yesterday afternoon.
examples.zh: 拜尔教授昨天下午就国际经济学发表了一场鼓舞人心的演讲。

lemmas.def_zh: （尤指猎犬、狼）长嗥，引颈低吠；（人群）高声叫嚷
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (especially of large dogs or wolves) To bark or howl with deep, prolonged sounds. 2. [I] (of a crowd) To shout loudly and continuously, often demanding something violently.

examples.en: The luxury cruise ship dropped anchor in the quiet bay at dawn.
examples.zh: 豪华游轮在拂晓时分停泊在宁静的海湾中。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于古法语的多源词，主要承载两大核心脉络：一是源自弯曲与内缩空间的'海湾'及'舱位/隔间'；二是源自拟声的猎犬狂吠，引申为'困境/绝境（at bay）'与动词'怒吼索求'。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词常指自然水域的海湾、结构上的独立隔间，或用于习语 keep/hold at bay（遏制/使陷入绝境）；动词则专指（如猎犬般）长声嚎叫或咆哮着索取。

lemmas.def_zh: 盘子，碟子；金属牌，薄板；（地质）板块
lemmas.def_en: a flat dish used for eating or serving food; a flat sheet of metal or other rigid material; a large section of the earth's crust

examples.en: She piled her plate high with fresh vegetables and roasted chicken.
examples.zh: 她在盘子里堆满了新鲜蔬菜和烤鸡。

examples.en: Earthquakes frequently occur along the boundaries where tectonic plates collide.
examples.zh: 地震常发生在地质构造板块相互碰撞的交界处。

lemmas.def_zh: 电镀工, 镀匠, 金属板工, 铁甲工
lemmas.def_en: a skilled worker who coats articles with a film of metal (usually silver or gold)

examples.en: The skilled plater coated the metal components with a thin layer of chrome.
examples.zh: 这位熟练的电镀工在金属部件上镀了一层薄薄的铬。

lemmas.def_zh: 满盘, 一盘
lemmas.def_en: the quantity contained in a plate

examples.en: The hungry boy quickly devoured a whole plateful of steaming pasta.
examples.zh: 饥饿的男孩很快吃完了一整盘热气腾腾的意大利面。

lemmas.def_zh: 绘制（土地分界图、地籍图）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (chiefly US / surveying) To draw a detailed map or plan of a piece of land divided into building lots.

examples.en: The civil engineer helped plat the new suburban residential district accurately.
examples.zh: 土木工程师协助绘制了新郊区住宅区的精确规划图。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 platys（平坦、宽阔的），核心逻辑指“扁平、坚硬的薄片状物体”，由此引申为盛放食物的盘碟、各类金属/印刷薄板以及地质构造板块。

lemmas.def_zh: 发起，倡导，开始；接纳（新成员入会）；使初步了解
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To cause a process or action to begin; to launch. 2. [T] To introduce someone to an organization or activity, often with a formal ceremony.

examples.en: The government has initiated a comprehensive review of the tax system.
examples.zh: 政府已对税收制度启动了一项全面审查。

examples.en: He was initiated into the secrets of the ancient craft by his mentor.
examples.zh: 他在导师的引领下初步领悟了这门古老手艺的秘诀。

lemmas.def_zh: 倡议，新举措；主动权，积极性
lemmas.def_en: a new plan or process to achieve a goal; the power or opportunity to act before others do

examples.en: She seized the initiative and took control of the meeting.
examples.zh: 她掌握了主动权，掌控了会议的局面。

examples.en: The charity launched an initiative to help homeless youths find jobs.
examples.zh: 该慈善机构发起了一项帮助无家可归的青年找工作的倡议。

lemmas.def_zh: 发起，开始；入会（或加盟）仪式；入门，启蒙
lemmas.def_en: the act of beginning something; the ceremony or process of admitting someone into a group

examples.en: College fraternities often have secret initiation ceremonies for new members.
examples.zh: 大学兄弟会通常会为新成员举行秘密的入会仪式。

examples.en: The signing of the contract marked the formal initiation of the project.
examples.zh: 合同的签署标志着该项目的正式启动。

lemmas.def_zh: 创始者, 首倡者, 引爆药
lemmas.def_en: a person who initiates a course of action

examples.en: She was widely recognized as the main initiator of the environmental protection project.
examples.zh: 她被公认为该环保项目的主要发起人。

lemmas.def_zh: 入会的, 最初的, 初步的
lemmas.def_en: serving to set in motion

examples.en: New members must undergo a secret initiatory rite before joining the society.
examples.zh: 新成员在加入该社团之前必须经历一项神秘的入会仪式。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 initium（开始、开端），由 in-（进入）+ ire（走）构成，核心意象为“迈步踏入”，引申出“启动/发起”以及“引导新人入门”之意。
family_guide.core_distinction: initiative 侧重主观能动性、主动权或政策举措，而 initiation 侧重开始的过程、入门启蒙或入会仪式。

lemmas.def_zh: 神经
lemmas.def_en: any bundle of nerve fibers running to various organs and tissues of the body

examples.en: The sciatic nerve is the largest and longest nerve in the human body.
examples.zh: 坐骨神经是人体内最大、最长的神经。

lemmas.def_zh: 神经, 神经元, 易激动, 紧张不安, 神经过敏, 神经质, 担忧, 害怕, 简练, 刚劲
lemmas.def_en: the anxious feeling you have when you have the jitters

examples.en: Her obvious nervousness gradually faded once she started playing the classical piano.
examples.zh: 一旦开始弹奏古典钢琴，她明显的紧张感便渐渐消退了。

lemmas.def_zh: 紧张的，担心的；神经系统的
lemmas.def_en: easily agitated, anxious, or apprehensive; relating to nerves

examples.en: He always feels nervous whenever he has to give a speech.
examples.zh: 每当需要发表演讲时，他总是感到紧张不安。

examples.en: The central nervous system controls most functions of the body and mind.
examples.zh: 中枢神经系统控制着身体和心理的大部分机能。

lemmas.def_zh: 有勇气的, 易激动的
lemmas.def_en: being in a tense state

examples.en: It was a nervy performance, but the young gymnast secured a spot in the finals.
examples.zh: 虽然表现得有些紧张，但这位年轻的体操选手还是锁定了决赛席位。

lemmas.def_zh: 无力的, 无力气的, 松懈的
lemmas.def_en: marked by calm self-control (especially in trying circumstances); unemotional

examples.en: The glass slipped suddenly from his nerveless fingers and shattered on the floor.
examples.zh: 玻璃杯突然从他无力的手指间滑落，摔碎在地板上。

lemmas.def_zh: 鼓起勇气，使振作精神（尤指 nerve oneself）
lemmas.def_en: [T] (nerve oneself) To brace or encourage oneself to face something difficult or dangerous.

examples.en: It took an incredible amount of nerve to address that hostile crowd.
examples.zh: 向那群怀有敌意的人群发表演讲需要极大的勇气。

lemmas.def_zh: 使慌乱，使胆怯，使丧失勇气
lemmas.def_en: [T] To make someone lose confidence, courage, or emotional composure.

examples.en: The eerie and persistent silence in the empty house began to unnerve her.
examples.zh: 空房子里怪异而持久的寂静开始让她感到心慌意乱。

lemmas.def_zh: 焦急地；神经质地；提心吊胆地
lemmas.def_en: in an anxiously nervous manner

examples.en: The young actor waited nervously backstage before his very first Broadway audition.
examples.zh: 那位年轻演员在百老汇首场试镜前紧张地在后台等待。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语表示“筋腱、力量”的词根，后演变为生理上的“神经”，并引申出“勇气、胆量”以及神经紧绷带来的“焦虑紧张”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词 nerve 常指“勇气”或生理“神经”；形容词 nervous 则主要形容情绪上的“焦虑、忐忑”或生理的“神经系统的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 水果, 果类, 结果
lemmas.def_en: the ripened reproductive body of a seed plant

examples.en: Eating fresh fruit every day provides essential vitamins and keeps your body healthy.
examples.zh: 每天吃新鲜水果可以提供必需的维生素并保持身体健康。

lemmas.def_zh: 成就, 实现, 结果实
lemmas.def_en: the condition of bearing fruit

examples.en: After years of hard work, her dream of opening a bakery finally reached fruition.
examples.zh: 经过多年的努力，她开面包店的梦想终于实现了。

lemmas.def_zh: 丰收, 丰硕；多实, 肥沃
lemmas.def_en: the quality of something that causes or assists healthy growth

examples.en: The continuous fruitfulness of the valley's soil attracted many new farmers to the region.
examples.zh: 该山谷土壤的持续肥沃吸引了许多新农民来到该地区。

lemmas.def_zh: 无效;无益
lemmas.def_en: a lack of creative imagination

examples.en: He finally realized the fruitlessness of arguing with someone who refused to listen.
examples.zh: 他终于意识到和一个不愿倾听的人争论是徒劳的。

lemmas.def_zh: 结果实；使结果实
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To produce or bear fruit, or cause a plant to do so.

examples.en: Eating fresh fruit every day provides essential vitamins and keeps your body healthy.
examples.zh: 每天吃新鲜水果可以提供必需的维生素并保持身体健康。

lemmas.def_zh: 结果实；使结果实, 使肥沃
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (formal) To bear fruit or become productive, or to make soil or an idea fertile and fruitful.

examples.en: We hope our new investment will fructify and yield significant profits next year.
examples.zh: 我们希望这项新投资能够在明年开花结果并产生可观的利润。

lemmas.def_zh: 结果实的, 多实的, 产量多的
lemmas.def_en: productive or conducive to producing in abundance

examples.en: The committee had a fruitful discussion and agreed on several important policy changes.
examples.zh: 委员会进行了富有成效的讨论，并就几项重要政策变动达成了一致。

lemmas.def_zh: 水果的, 有果味的, 有(低级)趣味的, 圆润的
lemmas.def_en: tasting or smelling richly of or as of fruit

examples.en: This red wine has a distinctly fruity aroma with strong hints of ripe blackberries.
examples.zh: 这款红酒具有明显的果香，带有浓郁的成熟黑莓气息。

lemmas.def_zh: 不结果的, 不长果实的, 无子的
lemmas.def_en: unproductive of success

examples.en: The rescue team spent hours in a fruitless search for the missing hikers.
examples.zh: 救援队花了好几个小时徒劳地搜寻失踪的徒步旅行者。

lemmas.def_zh: 不结果实的, 无效果的, 徒然的
lemmas.def_en: not fruitful; not conducive to abundant production

examples.en: Despite their efforts, the initial negotiations proved unfruitful and ended without an agreement.
examples.zh: 尽管他们做出了努力，最初的谈判却毫无结果，最终未能达成协议。

lemmas.def_zh: 不结果实的, 徒劳的, 无益的, 无效的, 无结果的
lemmas.def_en: in an unproductive manner

examples.en: She searched fruitlessly through her cluttered bag for the lost set of car keys.
examples.zh: 她在凌乱的包里徒劳地翻找丢失的车钥匙。

lemmas.def_zh: 产量多地；肥沃地
lemmas.def_en: in a productive way

examples.en: The two research teams collaborated fruitfully to develop the groundbreaking new vaccine.
examples.zh: 两个研究团队开展了富有成效的合作，研发出了突破性的新疫苗。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 fructus（享用、产物），核心语义为‘植物产出的果实’，并自然引申为人类努力带来的‘收益、成果’。

lemmas.def_zh: 燕，毛脚燕（燕科鸟类，尾羽通常分叉较浅）
lemmas.def_en: a bird of the swallow family with long wings and usually a notched tail

examples.en: A pair of house martins built a mud nest beneath the eaves.
examples.zh: 一对毛脚燕在屋檐下筑起了一个泥巢。

examples.en: Purple martins are known for nesting in colonies across North America.
examples.zh: 紫崖燕以在北美洲各地群居筑巢而闻名。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中古英语教名 Martin（源于战神 Mars），在中世纪常作为鸟类的拟人俗名，后专门固定指代燕科中尾羽分叉较浅的一类燕子（如毛脚燕、紫崖燕等）。

lemmas.def_zh: 议会；国会
lemmas.def_en: the supreme legislative body in a country, especially one that meets to debate and make laws

examples.en: The government is planning to introduce the new environmental bill to parliament next month.
examples.zh: 政府计划下个月向议会提交这项新的环保法案。

examples.en: The prime minister decided to dissolve parliament and call a snap general election.
examples.zh: 首相决定解散议会并提前举行大选。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or having the nature of a parliament
lemmas.def_zh: 国会的, 议会的, 议会制度的

examples.en: The prime minister called a general parliamentary election to regain majority support.
examples.zh: 首相要求举行议会大选，以重新获得多数支持。

lemmas.def_en: so rude and abusive as to be unsuitable for parliament
lemmas.def_zh: 违反议会法的, 不符议会惯例的, 议会所不允许的

examples.en: The speaker ordered the politician to withdraw his unparliamentary and offensive remarks.
examples.zh: 议长命令该政客撤回其违反议会规矩的攻击性言论。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 parler（说话、交谈）及名词后缀 -ment，本义为“商讨、会谈”，后特指由民选代表聚集商讨国事并制定法律的最高立法机构（议会）。

lemmas.def_zh: 粗糙的；大致的；艰难的；粗暴的
lemmas.def_en: having an uneven surface; approximate; difficult or harsh

examples.en: I've written a rough draft of the proposal for tomorrow's meeting.
examples.zh: 我已经为明天的会议拟好了一份提案初稿。

examples.en: He's had a rough week at work after losing a major client.
examples.zh: 在失去一位大客户后，他这周的工作过得十分艰难。

lemmas.def_zh: 大约，大致地；粗暴地
lemmas.def_en: approximately; in a violent or harsh manner

examples.en: The renovation is estimated to cost roughly ten thousand dollars.
examples.zh: 这次装修预计花费大约一万美元。

examples.en: The security guards pushed the protesters roughly back behind the barrier.
examples.zh: 保安粗暴地将抗议者推回到护栏后面。

lemmas.def_zh: 粗糙, 凹凸不平, 粗糙度, 篷乱毛发
lemmas.def_en: a texture of a surface or edge that is not smooth but is irregular and uneven

examples.en: The unusual roughness of the wooden surface scratched his bare hands while working.
examples.zh: 工作时，木质表面异常的粗糙划伤了他赤裸的手。

lemmas.def_zh: 使粗糙，打毛；粗暴对待；草拟
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To make a surface uneven, coarse, or textured. 2. [T] ('rough up') To treat someone violently.

examples.en: I've written a rough draft of the proposal for tomorrow's meeting.
examples.zh: 我已经为明天的会议拟好了一份提案初稿。

examples.en: He's had a rough week at work after losing a major client.
examples.zh: 在失去一位大客户后，他这周的工作过得十分艰难。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于古英语表示“毛糙、不平整”的意象，由触觉的粗糙引申至境况的艰难、数值的粗略以及行为的粗暴。

lemmas.def_zh: 怀疑，疑有；觉得……可疑，不信任；猜想
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To think or believe that something is likely or true, especially something bad or illicit. 2. [T] To doubt the truth or honesty of someone or something; to distrust.

examples.en: The quality of the cheap materials used in this building project is highly suspect.
examples.zh: 该建筑工程中使用的廉价材料的质量非常可疑。

lemmas.def_zh: 令人怀疑的, 不可信的, 可疑的
lemmas.def_en: not as expected

examples.en: The quality of the cheap materials used in this building project is highly suspect.
examples.zh: 该建筑工程中使用的廉价材料的质量非常可疑。

lemmas.def_en: openly distrustful and unwilling to confide
lemmas.def_zh: 怀疑的；可疑的

examples.en: The neighbors grew suspicious when a strange car parked outside every night.
examples.zh: 当一辆陌生汽车每天夜里都停在外面时，邻居们起了疑心。

lemmas.def_zh: 不受怀疑的, 无嫌疑的, 未知的, 意料外的
lemmas.def_en: not suspected or believed likely

examples.en: The medical test revealed an unsuspected heart condition that required immediate medical attention.
examples.zh: 体检发现了一种此前未被察觉的心脏疾病，需要立即进行治疗。

lemmas.def_en: not suspicious
lemmas.def_zh: 无嫌疑的, 不可疑的, 无疑虑的

examples.en: The guard walked past the package, leaving the completely unsuspicious box completely untouched.
examples.zh: 警卫走过那个包裹，对那个看起来毫无可疑之处的箱子不加理会。

lemmas.def_en: with suspicion
lemmas.def_zh: 猜疑地；怀疑地

examples.en: The detective looked suspiciously at the man loitering near the jewelry store entrance.
examples.zh: 侦探怀疑地打量着那个在珠宝店门口闲逛的男子。

lemmas.def_en: an impression that something might be the case
lemmas.def_zh: n. 怀疑，嫌疑；察觉，少许

examples.en: His strange behavior aroused suspicion among his colleagues.
examples.zh: 他奇怪的行为引起了同事们的怀疑。

lemmas.def_en: being of a suspicious nature
lemmas.def_zh: [医]多疑, 可疑

examples.en: His constant suspiciousness made it very difficult for him to form genuine lasting friendships.
examples.zh: 他多疑的性格让他很难建立起真诚而持久的友谊。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 suspicere（sub- 下方/暗中 + specere 看），字面意为“从底下向上看、斜眼看”，引申为对某事心存疑虑或暗中揣测。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词读音重音在后（/səˈspekt/），表示怀疑或推测；形容词重音在前（/ˈsʌspekt/），强调事物或动机本身可疑、不可靠。

lemmas.def_zh: 你的（东西）；你们的（东西）
lemmas.def_en: the one or ones belonging to or associated with you

examples.en: Is this umbrella yours, or did someone leave it behind?
examples.zh: 这把伞是你的吗，还是谁落下的？

examples.en: My schedule is quite flexible, so I will adjust mine to suit yours.
examples.zh: 我的日程很灵活，所以我会配合你的时间来调整。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语第二人称所有格，中古英语时期加上屈折后缀 -s 演变为独立的名词性物主代词，专门指代与听话人相关的人或物。
family_guide.core_distinction: 注意与形容词性物主代词 your 区分：your 必须后接名词修饰，yours 相当于“your + 名词”独立充当句子成分，且绝对不加撇号（勿写成 your's）。

lemmas.def_zh: 援助，帮助；促进
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To provide help, support, or resources to someone; to facilitate.

examples.en: International organizations arrived quickly to deliver critical aid to the flood victims.
examples.zh: 国际组织迅速赶到，为洪灾灾民提供紧急援助。

lemmas.def_zh: 帮助, 外援, 助手
lemmas.def_en: a resource

examples.en: International organizations arrived quickly to deliver critical aid to the flood victims.
examples.zh: 国际组织迅速赶到，为洪灾灾民提供紧急援助。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 adiuvare（ad- 向 + iuvare 帮助），核心意象为“向某人施以援手”，引申为提供支持、协助，或指代用于辅助的人或物。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词表示“援助”行动或“促进”过程；名词既可指抽象的“援助/救济（常不可数）”，也可指具体的“辅助工具/教具（可数）”。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 自动的；不假思索的，习惯性的；n. 自动挡汽车；全自动武器
lemmas.def_en: operating independently; done instinctively without conscious thought; an automatic car or weapon

examples.en: The building is equipped with automatic doors for wheelchair accessibility.
examples.zh: 该大楼配备了自动门，以方便轮椅出入。

examples.en: He learned to drive in an automatic, so he finds manual transmission tricky.
examples.zh: 他是开自动挡学的车，所以觉得手动挡很难开。

lemmas.def_zh: 自动地；不自觉地，自然而然地
lemmas.def_en: by a machine or system without human control; without conscious thought or intention

examples.en: The backup system automatically saves your files every ten minutes.
examples.zh: 备用系统每十分钟会自动保存一次你的文件。

examples.en: Whenever he hears that song, he automatically starts humming along.
examples.zh: 每当听到那首歌，他都会不自觉地跟着哼唱起来。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 自动的；不假思索的，习惯性的；n. 自动挡汽车；全自动武器
lemmas.def_en: operating independently; done instinctively without conscious thought; an automatic car or weapon

examples.en: The building is equipped with automatic doors for wheelchair accessibility.
examples.zh: 该大楼配备了自动门，以方便轮椅出入。

examples.en: He learned to drive in an automatic, so he finds manual transmission tricky.
examples.zh: 他是开自动挡学的车，所以觉得手动挡很难开。

lemmas.def_zh: 自动机, 机器人
lemmas.def_en: someone who acts or responds in a mechanical or apathetic way

examples.en: Exhausted from overwork, he moved like a mindless automaton throughout the long afternoon.
examples.zh: 因过度劳累而筋疲力尽，他在整个漫长的下午就像个毫无知觉的机器人一样机械地行动。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 auto-（自己）+ matos（行动/意愿），核心概念是“自身驱动运转”，由此延伸出“机械自主运行”以及人类“下意识、不假思索的本能反应”两条语义脉络。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词既可修饰机器也可形容下意识行为；作为名词时特指“自动挡汽车”或“全自动武器”。

lemmas.def_zh: 紧急情况；突发事件；突发险情
lemmas.def_en: an unexpected and dangerous situation requiring immediate action

examples.en: In case of emergency, break the glass to sound the alarm.
examples.zh: 如遇紧急情况，请打碎玻璃启动警报。

examples.en: The government declared a state of emergency after the severe flood.
examples.zh: 暴雨洪灾过后，政府宣布进入紧急状态。

lemmas.def_en: the gradual beginning or coming forth
lemmas.def_zh: 出现, 浮现, 发生

examples.en: The rapid emergence of new technologies has transformed how we work.
examples.zh: 新技术的迅速出现改变了我们的工作方式。

lemmas.def_en: (astronomy) the reappearance of a celestial body after an eclipse
lemmas.def_zh: 出现, 脱出, 复现

examples.en: Astronomers observed the emersion of the small star from behind the moon.
examples.zh: 天文学家观察到了那颗小恒星从月球后复现的过程。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (+ from) To come out of an enclosed, dark, or hidden place into view. 2. [I] (of facts or ideas) To become known or apparent.
lemmas.def_zh: 浮现，显露，出现；（事实等）暴露

examples.en: The swimmer finally emerged from the cold water after several minutes.
examples.zh: 几分钟后，游泳者终于从冰冷的水中浮现出来。

lemmas.def_en: occurring unexpectedly and requiring urgent action
lemmas.def_zh: 紧急的, 浮现的, 出现的, 自然发生的

examples.en: The country is developing new policies to support emergent green industries.
examples.zh: 该国正在制定新政策以支持新兴的绿色产业。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 emergere（浮现、显露），字面意为‘突然冒出的情况’，引申指需要立即采取行动的意外或危险局面。
family_guide.core_distinction: 注意与同源词 emergence（出现、兴起）区分：emergency 专指危险迫切的‘突发事件/紧急情况’，而 emergence 指新事物从无到有的‘显现/崭露头角’。

lemmas.def_zh: 池, 水塘, 石油层, 联营
lemmas.def_en: an excavation that is (usually) filled with water

examples.en: The researchers decided to pool their resources to complete the study much faster.
examples.zh: 研究人员决定集中他们的资源，以便更快地完成这项研究。

lemmas.def_zh: 合伙汇集，共用（资金、资源或想法）；汇成水潭
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] to collect together money, equipment, or ideas from different people or groups for shared use 2. [I] (of liquid) to collect in a pool or puddle

examples.en: The researchers decided to pool their resources to complete the study much faster.
examples.zh: 研究人员决定集中他们的资源，以便更快地完成这项研究。

family_guide.root_logic: 本义为静止的“水塘、水坑”，引申为像水洼聚水一样将资金、物资或人力聚集在一起的“储备库、共用池”，动词则表示“集中共享资源”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词兼具具象的“水池/泳池”与抽象的“共享资源库”之意，动词则专指把分散的资源汇集到一处共同使用。

lemmas.def_zh: 物质；实质，核心内容；重要性
lemmas.def_en: a particular type of physical matter; the most essential part or quality of something

examples.en: The police seized a large quantity of an illegal substance at the border.
examples.zh: 警方在边境查获了大量违禁物质。

examples.en: His presentation sounded impressive, but it lacked real substance.
examples.zh: 他的发言听起来很吸引人，但缺乏实质内容。

lemmas.def_zh: 实质性, 实在性, 实体
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being substantial or having substance

examples.en: Critics questioned the substantiality of the evidence presented during the high-profile court trial.
examples.zh: 批评人士对这起备受瞩目的庭审中提出的证据的实质性表示怀疑。

lemmas.def_zh: 大量的，可观的；坚固的；实质性的
lemmas.def_en: large in amount, value, or importance; solidly built

examples.en: She inherited a substantial amount of money from her grandfather.
examples.zh: 她从祖父那里继承了一大笔钱。

examples.en: The two countries have made substantial progress in peace talks.
examples.zh: 两国在和平谈判中取得了实质性进展。

lemmas.def_zh: 无实体的, 不坚固的, 浅薄的
lemmas.def_en: lacking material form or substance; unreal

examples.en: His theory was criticized for relying on unsubstantial claims rather than verifiable facts.
examples.zh: 他的理论因依赖无实质根据的主张而非可验证的事实而受到批评。

lemmas.def_zh: 非常，大大地；大体上，基本上
lemmas.def_en: to a great or significant degree; largely or essentially

examples.en: Production costs have been substantially reduced this year.
examples.zh: 今年的生产成本已经大幅降低。

examples.en: The new design differs substantially from the original concept.
examples.zh: 新设计与最初的概念有实质性的不同。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 substare（在下方支撑），原指构成事物底层的“基底、实体”，引申出“客观物质”、“本质核心”以及“体量实在、巨大”的含义。
family_guide.core_distinction: substantial 常用来形容数量、规模“可观的”或结构“坚固的”；副词 substantially 则专用于修饰动词或形容词表示“大大地、显著地”。

lemmas.def_zh: 明亮的；鲜艳的；聪颖的；前景光明的
lemmas.def_en: emitting or reflecting much light; intelligent and quick-witted; promising

examples.en: The room was filled with bright morning sunlight.
examples.zh: 房间里洒满了清晨明亮的阳光。

examples.en: She is one of the brightest students in the department and has a bright future.
examples.zh: 她是系里最聪明的学生之一，拥有光明的前途。

lemmas.def_zh: 发光的, 明亮的
lemmas.def_en: softly bright or radiant

examples.en: The dark ocean water was lit by thousands of luminous jellyfish floating near the surface.
examples.zh: 成千上万在水面附近漂浮的发光水母照亮了漆黑的海水。

lemmas.def_zh: 亮度，光亮；聪敏；鲜艳
lemmas.def_en: the quality or state of emitting or reflecting light; intelligence or vividness

examples.en: You can adjust the screen brightness to reduce eye strain.
examples.zh: 你可以调节屏幕亮度来缓解眼部疲劳。

examples.en: The interviewer was impressed by her brightness and quick thinking.
examples.zh: 面试官对她的聪颖和敏捷的思维留下了深刻印象。

lemmas.def_zh: 光明, 光辉, 光度, 亮度
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being luminous; emitting or reflecting light

examples.en: Astronomers measured the luminosity of the distant star to estimate its size.
examples.zh: 天文学家通过测量这颗遥远恒星的光度来估算其大小。

lemmas.def_zh: 生辉地, 明亮地, 鲜明地
lemmas.def_en: with brightness

examples.en: The morning sun shone brightly through the window, waking the children from sleep.
examples.zh: 晨光透过窗户明亮地照进来，把孩子们从睡梦中唤醒。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 beorht，本义为“发光的、闪烁的”，后自然引申至色彩的“鲜艳”、心智的“聪颖敏捷”以及前景的“充满希望与生机”。
family_guide.core_distinction: bright 作为核心形容词描绘事物“明亮、聪慧或有前途”的属性；brightness 是其名词形态，特指物理上的“亮度、光线”或抽象意义上的“聪慧、生气”。

lemmas.def_zh: 抓住，攫取；抓住（机会）；吸引
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To take hold of something or someone suddenly and roughly. 2. To quickly take an opportunity. 3. (informal) To get someone's attention.

examples.en: She grabbed her coat and keys and rushed out the door.
examples.zh: 她一把抓起外套和钥匙，冲出了门。

examples.en: Let's grab a quick bite to eat before the movie starts.
examples.zh: 电影开场前我们随便抓紧吃点东西吧。

examples.en: The opening scene of the presentation was designed to grab the audience's attention.
examples.zh: 演示文稿的开场旨在立刻吸引观众的注意力。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中古低地德语或中古荷兰语，核心动作意象为“突然、迅速且紧紧地伸手抓取”，后引申出把握机会、吸引注意力以及匆忙吃喝等用法。

lemmas.def_zh: 信心，自信；信任，信赖
lemmas.def_en: a feeling of self-assurance or firm trust in someone or something

examples.en: She answered the interviewer's questions with calm confidence.
examples.zh: 她从容自信地回答了面试官的问题。

examples.en: The scandal severely damaged public confidence in the financial system.
examples.zh: 这桩丑闻严重削弱了公众对金融体系的信任。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 机密性
lemmas.def_en: the state of being secret

examples.en: All employees are required to sign an agreement to protect the confidentiality of client data.
examples.zh: 所有员工都必须签署一份协议，以保护客户数据的机密性。

lemmas.def_zh: 心腹朋友, 知己
lemmas.def_en: someone to whom private matters are confided
having or marked by confidence or assurance
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 有信心的；自信的；有把握的

examples.en: She walked into the interview room feeling calm and confident.
examples.zh: 她平静而自信地走进了面试室。

lemmas.def_zh: 机密的，保密的；受信任的
lemmas.def_en: intended to be kept secret; entrusted with private matters

examples.en: All medical records are strictly confidential and will not be disclosed without consent.
examples.zh: 所有医疗记录均属高度机密，未经许可不得外泄。

examples.en: She served as a confidential secretary to the ambassador for over a decade.
examples.zh: 她担任大使的机要秘书长达十余年。

lemmas.def_en: with confidence; in a confident manner
lemmas.def_zh: 自信地；安心地

examples.en: She walked up onto the stage and spoke confidently about her new research.
examples.zh: 她走上舞台，自信地谈论起自己的新研究。

lemmas.def_zh: 秘密地；作为心腹话地
lemmas.def_en: in a confidential manner

examples.en: She spoke to me confidentially about her plans to leave the company next month.
examples.zh: 她私下向我吐露了她打算下个月离开公司的计划。

lemmas.def_zh: 倾诉，吐露；托付
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To share private thoughts, feelings, or secrets with someone because you trust them.

examples.en: She decided to confide her deepest personal secrets to her closest friend.
examples.zh: 她决定向最亲近的朋友倾诉自己最深沉的秘密。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 confidere（con- 加强语气 + fidere 信任），核心逻辑是“托付与深信”，由人与人之间的“信任/托付”引申出内心的“自信”以及被私下托付的“机密”。
family_guide.core_distinction: confidence 侧重于心理上的“自信”或人际间的“信任”；confidential 则聚焦于被信任托付的“机密”信息或事务。

lemmas.def_zh: 分派，布置（任务）；指派，选派；分配；归因于
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To give someone a particular job, task, or responsibility. 2. [T] To allocate or designate something for a specific purpose. 3. [T] (+ to) To ascribe or attribute something to.

examples.en: The teacher assigned a different topic to each student.
examples.zh: 老师给每个学生都布置了不同的课题。

examples.en: She was assigned to lead the new product development team.
examples.zh: 她被指派领导这个新产品研发团队。

lemmas.def_zh: 分派的任务；（学生的）作业；指派，委派
lemmas.def_en: a specific task or piece of work allocated to someone; the act of distributing duties

examples.en: Students must submit their written assignments by Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 学生必须在周五下午之前提交书面作业。

examples.en: His first overseas assignment as a journalist was in Tokyo.
examples.zh: 作为一名记者，他的第一次海外外派任务是在东京。

lemmas.def_zh: 受让人, 受托者, 代理人
lemmas.def_en: (law) the party to whom something is assigned (e.g., someone to whom a right or property is legally transferred)

examples.en: The contract clearly states that the assignee will assume all legal obligations tomorrow.
examples.zh: 合同明确规定受让人将于明天承担所有法律义务。

lemmas.def_zh: 分配, 转让, 幽会, (美)约会, 指定, 分派
lemmas.def_en: a secret rendezvous (especially between lovers)

examples.en: He slipped away from the busy party for a secret assignation in the garden.
examples.zh: 他悄悄离开热闹的派对，前往花园进行一场秘密幽会。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 未赋值的
lemmas.def_en: not assigned

examples.en: Several tasks remained unassigned because the project manager was away on sick leave.
examples.zh: 由于项目经理请病假，有几项任务仍未分配。

lemmas.def_zh: 可分配的, 可指定的, 可归属的
lemmas.def_en: legally transferable to the ownership of another

examples.en: The rights under this agreement are fully assignable to any qualified business partner.
examples.zh: 本协议项下的权利完全可以转让给任何合格的商业伙伴。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 assignare（ad- '向/给' + signare '做标记'），原义为'通过作标记划归给某人'，引申为分配任务、指定职责或归属。

lemmas.def_zh: 说服，使信服；使确信
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To persuade someone to do something. 2. [T] To make someone believe that something is true.

examples.en: I managed to convince them of the feasibility of the proposal.
examples.zh: 我成功让他们确信了该提案的可行性。

examples.en: She tried hard to convince her parents to let her study abroad.
examples.zh: 她极力说服父母同意她出国留学。

lemmas.def_zh: 有说服力, 使人信服, 令人信服
lemmas.def_en: in a convincing manner

examples.en: She argued convincingly that reducing office hours would actually improve overall team productivity.
examples.zh: 她令人信服地辩论道，减少工作时间实际上会提高团队整体生产力。

lemmas.def_zh: 缺乏说服力地
lemmas.def_en: in an unconvincing manner

examples.en: He smiled unconvincingly and claimed that he was not nervous about the presentation.
examples.zh: 他毫无说服力地勉强笑了笑，声称自己对演讲一点都不紧张。

lemmas.def_zh: 不足以令人相信的
lemmas.def_en: not convincing

examples.en: His unconvincing excuse for being late was immediately rejected by the strict teacher.
examples.zh: 他那不足以令人信服的迟到借口立即被严厉的老师驳回了。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 不相信, 怀疑的
lemmas.def_en: lacking conviction

examples.en: Despite hearing all the evidence, the jury remained unconvinced of the defendant's guilt.
examples.zh: 尽管听取了所有证据，陪审团对被告是否有罪仍持怀疑态度。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语前缀 con-（彻底）+ vincere（战胜、征服），字面意为“彻底战胜对方的异议”，引申为通过论据说服、使人信服。

lemmas.def_zh: 人们；民间；亲属，父母（复数形式folks）；民间音乐
lemmas.def_en: people in general or of a particular group; traditional culture or music; one's parents or family (folks)

examples.en: Country folk often have a closer connection to nature than city dwellers.
examples.zh: 乡村民众通常比城市居民与大自然有着更紧密的联系。

examples.en: She learned to play traditional American folk songs on the acoustic guitar.
examples.zh: 她学会了用原声吉他演奏传统的美国民谣。

examples.en: I'm heading back to my hometown this weekend to visit my folks.
examples.zh: 我这周末要回老家看望我的父母。

lemmas.def_zh: 和气的, 有民间风味的
lemmas.def_en: characteristic of country life

examples.en: The candidate used a folksy charm to connect with ordinary voters across rural towns.
examples.zh: 该候选人利用亲切和气的魅力与乡村小镇的普通选民拉近距离。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 folc（民众、部族、军队），核心语义指“特定群体、普通人群”，进而引申为“民间的、传统的文化或习俗”。

lemmas.def_zh: 非法的；违法的；犯规的
lemmas.def_en: not allowed by law; unlawful

examples.en: It is illegal to drive without a valid driver's license.
examples.zh: 无有效驾照开车是违法的。

examples.en: The factory was heavily fined for the illegal dumping of chemical waste.
examples.zh: 该工厂因非法倾倒化学废料而被处以巨额罚款。

lemmas.def_zh: 非法地；违法地
lemmas.def_en: in a manner forbidden by law

examples.en: The border patrol detained three individuals who had entered the country illegally.
examples.zh: 边境巡逻队扣留了三名非法入境的人员。

examples.en: The copyright holders sued after their music was illegally distributed online.
examples.zh: 在音乐被非法在线传播后，版权所有者提起了诉讼。

lemmas.def_zh: 非法行为, 犯规
lemmas.def_en: unlawfulness by virtue of violating some legal statute

examples.en: The internal audit revealed the clear illegality of the firm's offshore financial transactions.
examples.zh: 内部审计揭示了该企业离岸金融交易中明显的违法行为。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 il-（表否定，同 in-）结合词根 legal（合法的），核心概念即‘违背法律或官方规定的’。

lemmas.def_zh: 巨大的；大而重的；大规模的；严重的
lemmas.def_en: exceptionally large, heavy, and solid; immense in scale, amount, or degree

examples.en: The government announced a massive investment in public healthcare infrastructure.
examples.zh: 政府宣布对公共医疗基础设施进行大规模投资。

examples.en: The castle was defended by massive stone walls that had stood for centuries.
examples.zh: 这座城堡由屹立了数个世纪的厚重石墙所守护。

lemmas.def_zh: 极其；极大地；大规模地
lemmas.def_en: to a very great degree or extent; on an enormous scale

examples.en: The new automation tools have massively improved our overall efficiency.
examples.zh: 新的自动化工具极大地提高了我们的整体效率。

examples.en: The construction project ended up being massively over budget.
examples.zh: 该建筑工程最终严重超支。

lemmas.def_zh: 沉重；巨大, 大块；大量
lemmas.def_en: an unwieldy largeness

examples.en: The sheer massiveness of the ancient stone castle took our breath completely away.
examples.zh: 古老石质城堡庞大沉重的气势让我们彻底惊叹不已。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 mass（团、块、大量），加上形容词后缀 -ive，核心逻辑由“质地坚实厚重”引申为“体积极大、规模庞大或程度极其严重”。

lemmas.def_zh: 适当的
lemmas.def_en: suitable for a particular person or place or condition etc

examples.en: The committee decided to appropriate additional public funds for the hospital expansion project.
examples.zh: 委员会决定为医院扩建项目拨出额外的公共资金。

lemmas.def_zh: 供专用的, 挪用的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or given to the act of taking for yourself

examples.en: The tribe fought fiercely against the state's appropriative water rights policies in court.
examples.zh: 该部落在法庭上坚决反对该州针对水权的专用政策。

lemmas.def_zh: 私占，侵吞；征用；拨出（专款）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To take something for one's own use, typically without permission. 2. [T] To allocate or set aside money or assets for a special purpose.

examples.en: The committee decided to appropriate additional public funds for the hospital expansion project.
examples.zh: 委员会决定为医院扩建项目拨出额外的公共资金。

lemmas.def_zh: 侵占, 霸占, 盗用
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (formal / legal) To misappropriate money or property entrusted to your care means to steal or use it dishonestly for your own benefit.

examples.en: The corrupt accountant managed to misappropriate public funds for his lavish personal vacations.
examples.zh: 这名贪腐的会计设法挪用公款用于自己奢华的私人度假。

lemmas.def_zh: 适当的, 恰如其分的, 恰当的, 合适的
lemmas.def_en: in an appropriate manner

examples.en: The supervisor handled the delicate employee dispute appropriately and resolved it without hostility.
examples.zh: 主管恰当处理了这起敏感的员工纠纷，化解了矛盾。

lemmas.def_zh: 适当；适合
lemmas.def_en: appropriate conduct; doing the right thing

examples.en: Board members questioned the appropriateness of using public funds for the luxurious dinner.
examples.zh: 董事会成员对使用公款支付豪华晚宴的适当性提出了质疑。

lemmas.def_zh: [经] 侵吞, 挪用, 滥用
lemmas.def_en: the fraudulent appropriation of funds or property entrusted to your care but actually owned by someone else

examples.en: The manager was arrested after an internal audit revealed the misappropriation of company funds.
examples.zh: 内部审计揭露挪用公司资金的行为后，该经理被捕。

lemmas.def_zh: 拨给者, 盗用者
lemmas.def_en: someone who takes for his or her own use (especially without permission)

examples.en: Critics viewed the developer as an illegal appropriator of protected public land.
examples.zh: 批评人士认为该开发商是非法占用受保护公共土地的人。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 proprius（特有的、专属性的），引申出“符合特定情境的”（形容词：恰当的）以及“使归特定人或目的所有”（动词：挪用、拨付专款）两条语义支脉。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词发音为 /-ət/，意为‘恰当的’；动词发音为 /-eɪt/，意为‘私自挪用’或‘专项拨款’，二者读音与词义差异明显。

lemmas.def_zh: 死，死亡；凋谢；消亡，平息；渴望
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To stop living and become dead. 2. [I] To fade away or disappear gradually; stop functioning.

examples.en: Without enough water and sunlight, the potted plant will quickly die.
examples.zh: 如果缺乏充足的水分和阳光，这盆植物很快就会死掉。

examples.en: Old traditions are beginning to die out in modern urban societies.
examples.zh: 古老的传统在现代都市社会中正开始逐渐消亡。

lemmas.def_zh: 染色，给……着色
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To change the color of something such as cloth or hair, especially by soaking it in a coloring liquid.

examples.en: She decided to dye her hair bright copper for the summer.
examples.zh: 她决定在这个夏天把头发染成亮铜色。

examples.en: The fabric was dyed naturally using onion skins and tea leaves.
examples.zh: 这块织物是用洋葱皮和茶叶进行天然染色的。

lemmas.def_zh: 不死的, 不灭的, 不朽的
lemmas.def_en: never dying

examples.en: He promised his undying love and loyalty before leaving for the distant front.
examples.zh: 在出发前往遥远的前线之前，他许诺了自己永恒的爱与忠诚。

lemmas.def_zh: 未染色的,天然色的
lemmas.def_en: not artificially colored or bleached

examples.en: This eco-friendly sweater is made from pure, undyed wool of local sheep.
examples.zh: 这件环保毛衣是由当地绵羊的原色纯羊毛制成的。

lemmas.def_zh: 染色工
lemmas.def_en: someone whose job is to dye cloth

examples.en: The skilled dyer mixed several natural pigments to achieve the exact blue shade.
examples.zh: 这位经验丰富的染色工混合了数种天然颜料，以调配出精准的蓝色。

family_guide.root_logic: dye 源自古英语 dēagian（浸染、染色），核心语义为借助染料改变颜色；与同音词 die（源自古诺斯语 deyja，意为死亡）词源不同，但因发音完全一致而常作为对比组呈现。
family_guide.core_distinction: dye 指“染色”，其现在分词特意保留 e 拼作 dyeing；die 指“死亡、消失”，其现在分词则变形为 dying。

lemmas.def_zh: 摇动，摇晃；颤抖，发抖；动摇
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] to move quickly back and forth, up and down, or from side to side, or to cause something to do so. 2. [I] to tremble because of cold, fear, or illness. 3. [T] to make someone or something feel less confident or secure

examples.en: Shake the bottle well before pouring the medicine.
examples.zh: 倒药水之前先将药瓶充分摇匀。

examples.en: Her hands began to shake as she opened the letter.
examples.zh: 拆信时，她的双手开始颤抖起来。

lemmas.def_zh: 摇晃，颤动；使震惊，动摇（shake的过去分词）
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] Past participle of shake; to shake or vibrate rapidly, or to deeply upset or unsettle someone.

examples.en: The violent explosion had shaken the foundations of the old house.
examples.zh: 剧烈的爆炸震动了这座老房子的地基。

lemmas.def_zh: 桶板套料；成套木箱板（一组待组装成木桶或箱子的预制板条）
lemmas.def_en: a set of staves or parts ready to be fitted together to make a barrel or wooden box

examples.en: The distillery imported oak shook to assemble aging barrels locally.
examples.zh: 这家蒸馏厂进口了成套橡木板条，以便在本地组装陈酿木桶。

lemmas.def_zh: 摇动者, 摇动器, 混和器
lemmas.def_en: a person who wields power and influence

examples.en: The bartender poured the mixed cocktail directly from the stainless steel shaker.
examples.zh: 调酒师直接把调好的鸡尾酒从不锈钢摇酒壶中倒了出来。

lemmas.def_zh: 震动, 颤抖, 动摇
lemmas.def_en: a shaky motion

examples.en: the shaking of his fingers as he lit his pipe

lemmas.def_zh: 摇动；震动（shake 的过去分词，用于完成时或被动语态）
lemmas.def_en: past participle of shake; used in perfect aspect or passive constructions

examples.en: The violent explosion had shaken the foundations of the old house.
examples.zh: 剧烈的爆炸震动了这座老房子的地基。

lemmas.def_zh: 震动的, 摇晃的, 动摇的
lemmas.def_en: inclined to shake as from weakness or defect

examples.en: Her hands were still shaky as she tried to sign the contract.
examples.zh: 她在试图签署合同时，双手仍在微微发抖。

lemmas.def_zh: 坚决的, 不动摇的, 泰然自若的
lemmas.def_en: unshaken in purpose

examples.en: Despite facing severe criticism, her faith in the project remained entirely unshaken.
examples.zh: 尽管面临严厉批评，她对该项目的信心依然毫不动摇。

lemmas.def_zh: 颤抖着, 摇动着, 不可靠地
lemmas.def_en: in an insecurely shaky manner

examples.en: this theory is rather shakily supported by some obscure data

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 sceacan，核心意象为“快速短促的往复运动”，由物理层面的晃动、震颤，引申至心理层面的震惊、动摇与不安。
family_guide.core_distinction: shook 作为古老的名词保留了特指“成套桶箱板材”的工业含义；shaken 除作动词分词外，独立固化为形容词，特指受严重惊吓或打击后“心神不宁、惊魂未定”的状态。

lemmas.def_zh: 保证，担保；肯定，必然导致
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To make a formal promise that something will happen, be done, or meet a certain standard. 2. [T] To make something certain to happen.

examples.en: The company promises to guarantee all repairs against defects for one full year.
examples.zh: 该公司承诺对所有维修提供为期一整年的缺陷保修保证。

lemmas.def_zh: 担保, 抵押品, 保证书
lemmas.def_en: a written assurance that some product or service will be provided or will meet certain specifications

examples.en: The company promises to guarantee all repairs against defects for one full year.
examples.zh: 该公司承诺对所有维修提供为期一整年的缺陷保修保证。

lemmas.def_zh: 保证人
lemmas.def_en: one who provides a warrant or guarantee to another

examples.en: Her father agreed to act as the guarantor for her student apartment lease.
examples.zh: 她的父亲同意担任她学生公寓租约的担保人。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语经古法语演变而来（与 warrant 同源），核心逻辑为“守卫、保护”，引申为确凿承担责任，提供“保证或担保”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 同形异性词：动词重在作出郑重承诺或确保结果发生，名词指具有法律或契约效力的保证书、保修期或起担保作用的事物。

lemmas.def_zh: 海军；藏青色，深蓝色
lemmas.def_en: the military organization of a country that fights at sea; a dark blue color

examples.en: He served in the navy for eight years as an engineer.
examples.zh: 他在海军服役了八年，担任工程师。

examples.en: She decided to wear a classic navy suit to the interview.
examples.zh: 她决定穿一套经典的藏青色西装去参加面试。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 纳维；纳维叶；纳维尔

examples.en: The Navier-Stokes equations describe how fluids flow in various engineering applications.
examples.zh: 纳维-斯托克斯方程描述了流体在各类工程应用中的流动方式。

lemmas.def_zh: 海军的；军舰的
lemmas.def_en: connected with or belonging to a country's navy

examples.en: The island serves as a strategic naval base in the Pacific.
examples.zh: 该岛是太平洋上一个极具战略意义的海军基地。

examples.en: The two countries were locked in an intense naval battle.
examples.zh: 两国陷入了一场激烈的海战。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 navis（船），核心语义由古代的“船只、舰队”演变并专指近现代的“海上武装力量及军舰”。
family_guide.core_distinction: navy 为名词，指代“海军”组织或“藏青色”；naval 为专职形容词，用于修饰与海军、军舰相关的事务（如 naval base, naval officer）。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 毁灭，破产；废墟，残骸；v. 破坏，彻底毁掉；使破产
lemmas.def_en: the state of being completely destroyed or bankrupted; to spoil, destroy, or severely damage something

examples.en: A series of bad investments brought the family to the brink of financial ruin.
examples.zh: 一系列糟糕的投资使这个家庭濒临破产的边缘。

examples.en: A sudden torrential downpour completely ruined our plans for a barbecue.
examples.zh: 一场突如其来的倾盆大雨彻底毁了我们的烧烤计划。

lemmas.def_zh: 毁灭, 祸因, 毁坏
lemmas.def_en: an irrecoverable state of devastation and destruction

examples.en: Gambling debts brought about the total ruination of his family's wealth.
examples.zh: 赌债导致了他家族财富的彻底毁灭。

lemmas.def_zh: 废墟；毁坏；灭亡 (ruin的变形)
lemmas.def_en: a person who destroys or ruins or lays waste to

examples.en: Bad weather proved to be the ultimate ruiner of their holiday plans.
examples.zh: 恶劣的天气最终毁掉了他们的假期计划。

lemmas.def_zh: 破坏，毁掉；使破产
lemmas.def_en: [T] To spoil or destroy something completely; to cause someone to lose all their money, power, or status.

examples.en: A series of bad investments brought the family to the brink of financial ruin.
examples.zh: 一系列糟糕的投资使这个家庭濒临破产的边缘。

examples.en: A sudden torrential downpour completely ruined our plans for a barbecue.
examples.zh: 一场突如其来的倾盆大雨彻底毁了我们的烧烤计划。

lemmas.def_zh: 破坏性的, 招致毁灭的
lemmas.def_en: extremely harmful; bringing physical or financial ruin

examples.en: The prolonged trade war had a ruinous effect on small local businesses.
examples.zh: 旷日持久的贸易战对当地小型企业造成了破坏性的影响。

lemmas.def_zh: 毁灭地, 败坏地
lemmas.def_en: in a ruinous manner or to a ruinous degree

examples.en: The company invested ruinously in a project that offered virtually no returns.
examples.zh: 该公司在一个几乎毫无回报的项目上进行了毁灭性的投资。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ruere（倒塌、坠落），核心意象为物理结构的崩塌瓦解，后引申为抽象事物（如名誉、计划、财务）的彻底破坏或陷入破产毁灭。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动名词同形：作动词表示“彻底毁坏”或“使倾家荡产”；作名词单数侧重毁灭状态或破产，复数 ruins 则特指建筑物残骸或历史废墟。

lemmas.def_zh: 使厌烦，使无聊；钻（孔），凿（洞）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To make someone feel weary, tired, or uninterested by being dull or repetitive. 2. [I, T] To make a deep, round hole in a hard substance using a drill or tool.

examples.en: His endless complaints began to bore everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 他没完没了的抱怨开始让屋里的每个人都感到厌烦。

examples.en: The machine was designed to bore holes deep into the bedrock.
examples.zh: 这台机器设计用于在基岩深处钻孔。

lemmas.def_zh: 厌烦, 厌倦, 令人厌烦的事物
lemmas.def_en: the feeling of being bored by something tedious

examples.en: She took up painting as a hobby to escape the daily boredom.
examples.zh: 她开始学习绘画这项爱好，以摆脱日常的无聊。

lemmas.def_zh: 穿孔者, 钻孔器, 钻孔虫
lemmas.def_en: a drill for penetrating rock

examples.en: The apple borer caused significant damage to the orchard trees this spring.
examples.zh: 今年春天，苹果蛀虫对果园里的树木造成了严重损害。

lemmas.def_zh: boring的变形
lemmas.def_en: extreme dullness; lacking spirit or interest

examples.en: He complained about the sheer boringness of filing paperwork all day long.
examples.zh: 他抱怨整天整理文书工作实在太过枯燥乏味。

lemmas.def_zh: 无趣地；沉闷地
lemmas.def_en: in a tedious manner

examples.en: The professor spoke boringly about tax laws for more than two hours.
examples.zh: 那位教授枯燥乏味地讲了两个多小时的税法。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 厌倦的；感到无聊的
lemmas.def_en: feeling tired and unhappy because sth is not interesting or because you have nothing to do
lemmas.usage_note: 常与介词 with 或 of 连用（如 bored with one's job），主要用于描述人。

examples.en: The children quickly got bored of staying indoors all afternoon.
examples.zh: 孩子们在室内呆了一整个下午，很快就觉得无聊了。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 乏味的；无聊的
lemmas.def_en: not interesting; dull
lemmas.usage_note: 修饰令人产生厌倦感的人或物，如 a boring lecture / book。

examples.en: It was the most boring lecture I had ever attended.
examples.zh: 那是我听过的最乏味的一次讲座。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于日耳曼语族表“刺穿、钻孔”之意，后由反复钻磨的枯燥动作引申出“使人身心消耗、令人厌倦”的心理义。

lemmas.def_zh: 保守的, 守旧的, 有保存力的
lemmas.def_en: resistant to change

examples.en: Older villagers tend to hold conservative views regarding modern social trends.
examples.zh: 年长的村民往往对现代社会潮流持保守态度。

lemmas.def_zh: [化] 防腐剂; 保存剂
lemmas.def_en: a person who is reluctant to accept changes and new ideas

examples.en: Older villagers tend to hold conservative views regarding modern social trends.
examples.zh: 年长的村民往往对现代社会潮流持保守态度。

lemmas.def_zh: 保守主义
lemmas.def_en: a political or theological orientation advocating the preservation of the best in society and opposing radical changes

examples.en: Traditional values form the core foundation of British political conservativism today.
examples.zh: 传统价值观构成了当今英国政治保守主义的核心基础。

lemmas.def_zh: 保存地; 保守地; 谨慎地
lemmas.def_en: in a conservative manner

examples.en: The financial manager conservatively estimated that profits would drop by five percent.
examples.zh: 财务经理保守地估计利润将下降百分之五。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 conservare（con- 共同/强调 + servare 保持、守护），核心意象为‘守护现状、避免变动’，引申出政治立场上的反对激进变革，以及行为、风格或估算上的稳妥、谨慎与传统。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词指‘保守的、审慎稳妥的’，名词则直接指代‘保守主义者、保守派人士’，两者词形完全相同。

lemmas.def_zh: 指责，控告，谴责
lemmas.def_en: [T] To state that someone has done something wrong, improper, or illegal.

examples.en: She was falsely accused of leaking confidential company data to a competitor.
examples.zh: 她被诬陷向竞争对手泄露了公司的机密数据。

examples.en: He accused his business partner of breaking their mutual agreement.
examples.zh: 他指责他的商业合伙人违背了双方的协议。

lemmas.def_zh: 指控；谴责，指责
lemmas.def_en: a statement saying that someone has done something morally wrong, illegal, or unkind

examples.en: The minister strongly denied the accusations of corruption leveled against him.
examples.zh: 该部长强烈否认了针对他提出的腐败指控。

examples.en: You shouldn't make such serious accusations without any concrete evidence.
examples.zh: 在没有任何确凿证据的情况下，你不应该提出如此严重的指责。

lemmas.def_zh: 控诉者, 指责者
lemmas.def_en: someone who imputes guilt or blame

examples.en: The defendant refused to look at his accuser throughout the entire trial.
examples.zh: 在整个审判过程中，被告都拒绝直视他的指控者。

lemmas.def_zh: 宾格
lemmas.def_en: the case of nouns serving as the direct object of a verb

examples.en: In German grammar, direct objects are always placed in the accusative case.
examples.zh: 在德语语法中，直接宾语总是使用宾格。

lemmas.def_zh: 责难地
lemmas.def_en: in an accusing manner

examples.en: She stared accusingly at her brother when she found her broken vase.
examples.zh: 发现花瓶被打碎后，她责备地瞪着弟弟。

lemmas.def_zh: 控诉的, 指责的
lemmas.def_en: containing or expressing accusation; ; ; - O.Henry

examples.en: She pointed an accusatory finger at her brother when the vase broke.
examples.zh: 花瓶打碎时，她用指责的手势指向了她的哥哥。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语前缀 ad-（朝向）与 causa（由头、诉讼），核心逻辑是“就某事向某人问责或提起诉讼”，演变为现今的“指责、控告”。

lemmas.def_zh: （公司或机构的）营业额，总收入；（政府的）财政收入，税收
lemmas.def_en: the total amount of money received by a company or government over a specified period

examples.en: The tech firm reported a 15% increase in annual revenue, driven by strong cloud sales.
examples.zh: 在强劲的云计算销售带动下，这家科技公司报告年营业额增长了15%。

examples.en: Tourism remains a vital source of tax revenue for the island's government.
examples.zh: 旅游业仍然是该岛政府至关重要的税收来源。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 revenir（re- 回 + venire 来），字面意为“流回来的东西”，引申为商业营运或政府征税等活动中获得的“收益、收入”。

lemmas.def_zh: 茶；茶叶；茶水；茶点便餐
lemmas.def_en: a hot beverage made by infusing dried tea leaves in boiling water; the dried leaves; a light afternoon meal

examples.en: She sat by the window, sipping a freshly brewed cup of green tea.
examples.zh: 她坐在窗边，小口啜饮着一杯刚泡好的绿茶。

examples.en: Traditional British afternoon tea is usually served with scones, jam, and clotted cream.
examples.zh: 传统的英式下午茶通常搭配司康饼、果酱和凝脂奶油。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自闽南语对“茶”的发音（tê），经荷兰海运贸易传入欧洲，核心指茶树、干茶叶及冲泡出的饮品，并延伸指代搭配饮茶的茶点或便餐时光。

lemmas.def_zh: 气候；风气，氛围，大环境
lemmas.def_en: the general weather conditions prevailing in an area over a long period; the prevailing general attitude, opinion, or condition of a group or period

examples.en: Urgent global action is required to mitigate the severe impacts of climate change.
examples.zh: 需要采取紧迫的全球行动来减缓气候变化带来的严峻影响。

examples.en: The current economic climate has forced many small businesses to cut costs.
examples.zh: 当前的经济大环境迫使许多小企业削减开支。

lemmas.def_zh: 服水土, 顺应, 适应环境
lemmas.def_en: adaptation to a new climate (a new temperature or altitude or environment)

lemmas.def_zh: 服水土, 顺应, 适应环境
lemmas.def_en: adaptation to a new climate (a new temperature or altitude or environment)

lemmas.def_zh: 气候的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a climate

examples.en: Severe climatic variations have drastically changed local farming schedules this decade.
examples.zh: 近十年来，剧烈的气候变化极大改变了当地的耕作日程。

lemmas.def_zh: 气候上, 由气候引起地
lemmas.def_en: with respect to climate

examples.en: The region is climatically suited for growing grapes and making fine wine.
examples.zh: 该地区在气候上适宜种植葡萄和酿造优质葡萄酒。

lemmas.def_zh: 使适应，使服水土；适应新环境
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (+ to) (chiefly North American) To adjust or adapt to a new climate, altitude, or unfamiliar environment.

examples.en: It took several weeks for the foreign exchange students to acclimate to the cold climate.
examples.zh: 交换生们花了几个星期才适应这里寒冷的气候。

lemmas.def_zh: 使适应新环境, 使服水土；服水土
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (+ to) To become accustomed to a new climate or set of conditions, or to help someone adapt to them.

examples.en: It took the hikers several days to acclimatize to the high mountain altitude.
examples.zh: 登山者花了几天时间才适应高山的海拔环境。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 klima（倾斜），原指地球表面相对于太阳光线的倾斜纬度，后引申指由地理纬度决定的长期天气状态（气候）及抽象的社会风气、舆论氛围。

lemmas.def_zh: 使彻底改变，使改观，转化
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] to change markedly the form, appearance, or character of something.

examples.en: The new technology has the potential to transform the healthcare industry.
examples.zh: 这项新技术有望彻底改变医疗行业的面貌。

examples.en: A fresh coat of paint transformed the dull room into a bright, welcoming space.
examples.zh: 刷上一层新油漆后，原本阴暗的房间变成了一个明亮温馨的空间。

lemmas.def_zh: 彻底转变；巨大改观；转型
lemmas.def_en: a marked change in form, nature, or appearance

examples.en: The city has undergone a remarkable transformation over the past decade.
examples.zh: 在过去的十年里，这座城市经历了令人瞩目的巨大蜕变。

examples.en: Digital transformation is now a top priority for traditional retailers.
examples.zh: 数字化转型目前是传统零售商的重中之重。

lemmas.def_zh: 变压器, 促使变化的人
lemmas.def_en: an electrical device by which alternating current of one voltage is changed to another voltage

examples.en: A lightning strike damaged the electrical transformer, cutting power to the town.
examples.zh: 雷击损坏了变压器，导致整个小镇电力中断。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 trans-（越过、改变）+ form（形态、形式），字面本义为“改变形态”，引申为外观、性质或功能的“彻底转变”。
family_guide.core_distinction: transform 是动词核心，transformation 是其名词派生形式，二者均强调深层、根本性或肉眼可见的“脱胎换骨”，而非微调。

lemmas.def_zh: adv. 在某处，到某处；大约，差不多；n. 某处，某个地方
lemmas.def_en: in, at, or to some unspecified place; approximately; an undetermined or unspecified place

examples.en: I'm sure I've seen that man somewhere before, but I can't recall his name.
examples.zh: 我肯定以前在什么地方见过那个人，但想不起他的名字了。

examples.en: The total renovation should cost somewhere between five and ten thousand dollars.
examples.zh: 整个翻修费用大概在五千到一万美元之间。

examples.en: Let's find somewhere quiet where we can sit down and talk.
examples.zh: 我们找个安静的地方坐下来谈谈吧。

lemmas.def_zh: adv. 在某处，到某处；大约，差不多；n. 某处，某个地方
lemmas.def_en: in, at, or to some unspecified place; approximately; an undetermined or unspecified place

examples.en: I'm sure I've seen that man somewhere before, but I can't recall his name.
examples.zh: 我肯定以前在什么地方见过那个人，但想不起他的名字了。

examples.en: The total renovation should cost somewhere between five and ten thousand dollars.
examples.zh: 整个翻修费用大概在五千到一万美元之间。

examples.en: Let's find somewhere quiet where we can sit down and talk.
examples.zh: 我们找个安静的地方坐下来谈谈吧。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 some（未知的、某）和 where（何处）复合而成，核心语义指向一个未具体指定、未知或抽象的地点，亦可引申表示数量或程度的近似范围。
family_guide.core_distinction: 常作副词表示“在/到某处”或“大约”；作名词时指代“某个地方”，可直接作为句子成分（如宾语、介词宾语）并接受形容词后置修饰。

lemmas.def_zh: 有用的；有益的；实用的
lemmas.def_en: able to be used for a practical purpose or helping to achieve a result

examples.en: Her practical advice proved to be extremely useful during the interview process.
examples.zh: 事实证明，她的实用建议在面试过程中极其有用。

examples.en: The mobile app is a useful tool for tracking daily expenses.
examples.zh: 这款手机应用程序是记录日常开支的实用工具。

lemmas.def_zh: 有用, 有益
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being of practical use

examples.en: The new software has proved its usefulness in managing complex data sets.
examples.zh: 这款新软件在管理复杂数据集方面证明了其功用。

lemmas.def_zh: 有效地, 有用地
lemmas.def_en: in a useful manner

examples.en: Volunteers usefully spent their afternoon sorting and distributing clothes to refugees.
examples.zh: 志愿者们有效地利用了下午的时间，为难民整理并发放衣物。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自基础词 use（使用）加上形容词后缀 -ful（充满……的），核心逻辑指“能派上用场、能产生积极作用的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 与 usable（可使用的、状态良好的）相对，useful 强调“有实际帮助或价值”。

lemmas.def_zh: 永远；极长时间；老是，不断地
lemmas.def_en: for all future time; for an extremely long time; continually

examples.en: Nothing lasts forever, so it is important to cherish every moment.
examples.zh: 没有什么是永恒的，因此珍惜每个当下非常重要。

examples.en: It took forever to get through airport security during the holiday rush.
examples.zh: 在节假日高峰期过机场安检花了极长的时间。

family_guide.root_logic: 由介词 for（在……期间）与副词 ever（任何时候/始终）组合而成，字面即‘持续到所有时间’，引申为‘永远’或夸张表达‘极长时间、总是’。

lemmas.def_zh: 亨利（国际单位制中的电感单位，符号为 H）
lemmas.def_en: the SI unit of electrical inductance, equivalent to one volt-second per ampere

examples.en: The inductance of the coil was measured to be approximately two henries.
examples.zh: 经测定，该线圈的电感大约为两亨利。

examples.en: In electronic circuits, small inductors are often rated in millihenries or microhenries rather than a full henry.
examples.zh: 在电子电路中，小型电感器通常以毫亨或微亨为单位，而非整亨利。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自美国物理学家约瑟夫·亨利（Joseph Henry）的姓氏，在国际单位制中专门用作电感的物理计量单位（符号为 H）。

lemmas.def_zh: 大量，充裕；充足，富足
lemmas.def_en: a large or sufficient amount or quantity; a situation in which there is a large supply of food or resources

examples.en: Don't rush; we still have plenty of time before the movie starts.
examples.zh: 别着急，电影开场前我们还有充足的时间。

examples.en: After years of hardship, the family finally enjoyed a period of peace and plenty.
examples.zh: 历经多年的艰辛后，这个家庭终于迎来了一段和平与富足的时光。

lemmas.def_zh: 许多的, 丰富的, 丰饶的
lemmas.def_en: existing in great number or quantity

examples.en: Fresh vegetables were plentiful at the farmers market early this morning.
examples.zh: 今天清晨农贸市场上有非常丰富的本地新鲜蔬菜。

lemmas.def_zh: 丰饶的, 丰富的
lemmas.def_en: affording an abundant supply

examples.en: The autumn harvest yielded a plenteous supply of wheat for winter.
examples.zh: 秋季的收成为冬季带来了丰饶的小麦供应。

lemmas.def_zh: 丰富地, 富裕地
lemmas.def_en: in a bountiful manner

examples.en: Wild mushrooms grew plentifully on the forest floor after the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 大雨过后，森林地面上茂密地生长着大量的野生蘑菇。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 plenus（充满的），核心语义为“数量充足、充沛且绰绰有余”。

lemmas.def_zh: 避风的, 背风的, 下风的, 保护的
lemmas.def_en: towards the side away from the wind

examples.en: The small fishing boat anchored safely on the lee side of island.
examples.zh: 小渔船在岛屿背风的一侧安全抛锚。

lemmas.def_zh: 背风处, 避风处, 下风处, 保护, 庇护
lemmas.def_en: United States filmmaker whose works explore the richness of black culture in America (born in 1957)

examples.en: The small fishing boat sheltered in the lee of the island during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨期间，那艘小渔船停泊在岛屿的背风处避风。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 hlēow（庇护、温暖），核心意象为“抵御风雨的遮蔽处”，在航海与地理语境中引申为“背风面”或“背风的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词常用于短语 in/under the lee of（在……的背风处/庇护下）；形容词则直接修饰方位（如 lee side 背风面）。

lemmas.def_zh: 方式，形式；模式，状态；风尚，流行样式
lemmas.def_en: a way or manner in which something is done or happens; a particular functioning state of a machine or system

examples.en: Rail remains the most efficient mode of transport for bulk goods.
examples.zh: 铁路仍然是大宗货物最有效的运输方式。

examples.en: Please switch your mobile devices to silent mode before the meeting begins.
examples.zh: 会议开始前，请将移动设备调至静音模式。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 模态的
lemmas.def_en: an auxiliary verb (such as `can' or `will') that is used to express modality

examples.en: Clicking the settings button will open a modal window displaying all your account options.
examples.zh: 点击设置按钮会打开一个显示所有账户选项的模态窗口。

lemmas.def_zh: 样式, 形式, 形态
lemmas.def_en: a classification of propositions on the basis of whether they claim necessity or possibility or impossibility

examples.en: The clinic offers acupuncture as an effective treatment modality for chronic back pain.
examples.zh: 该诊所提供针灸作为治疗慢性背痛的有效形式。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 modus（测量、标准、方式），核心语义指事物呈现、运作或被度量的“特定方式、样态或运作状态”。

lemmas.def_zh: 内疚，愧疚；有罪，罪责
lemmas.def_en: the fact of having committed an offense; the normal feeling of having done something wrong

examples.en: He was overwhelmed with guilt after lying to his closest friend.
examples.zh: 在对挚友撒谎后，他内心充满了强烈的愧疚感。

examples.en: The prosecution failed to prove the defendant's guilt beyond reasonable doubt.
examples.zh: 控方未能排除合理怀疑来证实被告有罪。

lemmas.def_zh: 有罪
lemmas.def_en: the state of having committed an offense

examples.en: His sudden silence and lowered eyes revealed a deep sense of guiltiness.
examples.zh: 他突然的沉默和低垂的目光显露出深深的内疚。

lemmas.def_zh: 感到内疚的，惭愧的；有罪的，负有罪责的
lemmas.def_en: responsible for a crime or misdeed; feeling worry or remorse for a wrong action

examples.en: She felt guilty about taking a day off when the team was understaffed.
examples.zh: 在团队人手不足时请了一天假，这让她感到十分愧疚。

examples.en: The jury found him guilty of fraud and tax evasion.
examples.zh: 陪审团裁定他犯有欺诈罪和逃税罪。

lemmas.def_zh: 无罪的, 无辜的, 没有...经验的, 不熟悉...的, 没有...的
lemmas.def_en: free from evil or guilt

examples.en: The newly discovered security footage proved that the young man was entirely guiltless.
examples.zh: 新发现的监控录像证明那个年轻人完全是清白的。

lemmas.def_zh: 罪地, 有罪地
lemmas.def_en: in the manner of someone who has committed an offense

examples.en: Tom smiled guiltily when his mother caught him sneaking cookies before dinner.
examples.zh: 汤姆晚饭前偷吃饼干被母亲抓个正着，心虚地笑了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 gylt（罪过、债务），核心语义始终围绕“因违反法律、规则或道德而产生的客观罪责或主观内疚感”。
family_guide.core_distinction: guilt 为名词，指“罪责”或“内疚情绪”；guilty 为形容词，指“有罪的”或“感到惭愧内疚的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 混蛋，讨厌鬼；阴茎（粗俗俚语）；侦探（旧俚语）
lemmas.def_en: an offensive term for an obnoxious or unpleasant person; a slang term for penis; (dated) a detective

examples.en: Stop acting like a dick and apologize to her.
examples.zh: 别再像个混蛋一样，去跟她道歉。

examples.en: The classic film features a hard-boiled private dick investigating a murder.
examples.zh: 这部经典电影讲述了一名硬汉风格的私家侦探调查一起谋杀案的故事。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于教名 Richard 的中世纪昵称，经民间俗化后先是指代普通男性，后演变为指代男性生殖器的粗俗俚语，并进一步引申出指责他人令人讨厌、粗鲁无礼的贬义用法（混蛋）。

lemmas.def_zh: 下午；午后
lemmas.def_en: the period of time between noon and the evening

examples.en: We spent a relaxing afternoon catching up over coffee.
examples.zh: 我们喝着咖啡聊着近况，度过了一个轻松惬意的下午。

examples.en: The meeting is scheduled for three o'clock on Tuesday afternoon.
examples.zh: 会议定在周二下午三点举行。

family_guide.root_logic: 由介词 after（在……之后）与名词 noon（正午）直接复合而成，字面本义即为“正午之后到傍晚之间的时间段”。

lemmas.def_zh: 本国的, 与生俱来的, 自然的
lemmas.def_en: characteristic of or existing by virtue of geographic origin

examples.en: She returned to her native city after spending over ten years working abroad.
examples.zh: 在国外工作了十多年后，她回到了自己的故乡城市。

lemmas.def_en: not being or composed of aborigines

examples.en: Nonnative plant species can rapidly disrupt the balance of the local forest ecosystem.
examples.zh: 非本土植物物种会迅速破坏当地森林生态系统的平衡。

lemmas.def_zh: 本地人, 土产, 当地人
lemmas.def_en: an indigenous person who was born in a particular place

examples.en: She returned to her native city after spending over ten years working abroad.
examples.zh: 在国外工作了十多年后，她回到了自己的故乡城市。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语词根 nat-（出生），核心语义始终围绕“与生俱来的”或“出生地固有的”展开。

lemmas.def_zh: 预测，预料，预言
lemmas.def_en: [T] to say that an event or action will happen in the future, often as a result of knowledge, data, or experience

examples.en: Economists predict that interest rates will continue to fall over the next few months.
examples.zh: 经济学家预测未来几个月利率将继续下降。

examples.en: It is nearly impossible to accurately predict how the market will react.
examples.zh: 要准确预测市场会作何反应几乎是不可能的。

lemmas.def_zh: 预言；预测；预示
lemmas.def_en: a statement about what you think will happen in the future

examples.en: His pessimistic prediction about the company's future proved completely wrong.
examples.zh: 他对公司前景的悲观预测被证明是完全错误的。

examples.en: The AI model makes remarkably reliable predictions based on historical data.
examples.zh: 该人工智能模型能够基于历史数据做出非常可靠的预测。

lemmas.def_zh: 预言者
lemmas.def_en: someone who makes predictions of the future (usually on the basis of special knowledge)

examples.en: Early childhood reading habits often serve as a strong predictor of academic success.
examples.zh: 童年早期的阅读习惯往往是学业成功的重要预测指标。

lemmas.def_zh: 预言性的, 成为前兆的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to prediction; having value for making predictions

examples.en: The company uses predictive analytics to anticipate future consumer trends and market demands.
examples.zh: 该公司利用预测分析技术来预判未来的消费趋势和市场需求。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语前缀 pre-（提前）+ dict（言说），字面意为“提前说出”，引申为基于依据或直觉对未来的事实进行“预言、预测”。

lemmas.def_zh: 容量，容积；能力，才能；生产力；身份，职位
lemmas.def_en: the maximum amount that something can contain or produce; the ability or power to do something; a specified role

examples.en: The theatre was filled to capacity on opening night.
examples.zh: 首演当晚剧场座无虚席。

examples.en: She has an extraordinary capacity for hard work and learning new skills.
examples.zh: 她具有极强的吃苦耐劳与学习新技能的能力。

examples.en: He attended the meeting in his capacity as a financial adviser.
examples.zh: 他以财务顾问的身份出席了会议。

lemmas.def_zh: 容积大的, 广阔的, 宽敞的
lemmas.def_en: large in capacity

examples.en: She carried a capacious leather tote bag that easily held all her travel essentials.
examples.zh: 她背着一个容量很大的皮质托特包，轻松装下了所有旅行必需品。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 capere（抓取、容纳），核心逻辑由“能装下多少空间”引申为物理上的“容量/负荷”及抽象层面的“承载能力/潜在才能/职责身份”。

lemmas.def_zh: 长条, 条状, 带, 脱衣舞
lemmas.def_en: a relatively long narrow piece of something

examples.en: He quickly wrote the secret phone number on a narrow strip of paper.
examples.zh: 他迅速把那个秘密电话号码写在了一张狭长的纸条上。

lemmas.def_zh: 剥...的人, 刮毛器, 折卸器, 剥皮器, 露天矿矿工, 低产井, 枯竭井
lemmas.def_en: a chemical compound used to remove paint or varnish

examples.en: Apply the chemical paint stripper carefully to remove the old varnish from the table.
examples.zh: 小心地涂上化学脱漆剂，以去除桌子上的旧清漆。

lemmas.def_zh: 剥夺，夺走；剥去，脱去（衣服）；拆卸
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To take away an honor, possession, or rank from someone. 2. [I, T] To take off your clothes, or remove the surface covering of something.

examples.en: He quickly wrote the secret phone number on a narrow strip of paper.
examples.zh: 他迅速把那个秘密电话号码写在了一张狭长的纸条上。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于日耳曼语族表示‘撕下、扯脱’的词根，演变出动词‘剥除、脱光’与名词‘撕下的一长条、细长地带’两大核心维度。

lemmas.def_zh: 拖, 拖绳, 拖轮
lemmas.def_en: the act of hauling something (as a vehicle) by means of a hitch or rope

examples.en: The broken-down car needed a tow after its engine completely failed on the highway.
examples.zh: 发动机在高速公路上彻底熄火后，那辆抛锚的汽车需要拖带。

lemmas.def_zh: 塔, 高楼, 堡垒
lemmas.def_en: a structure taller than its diameter; can stand alone or be attached to a larger building

examples.en: Tourists climbed the spiral staircase of the bell tower to admire the panoramic view.
examples.zh: 游客们爬上钟楼的螺旋楼梯，欣赏整座城市的全景。

lemmas.def_zh: 拖, 拉, 拖带, 拖船费
lemmas.def_en: the act of hauling something (as a vehicle) by means of a hitch or rope

examples.en: The shipping company paid standard towage fees to bring the large vessel into port.
examples.zh: 航运公司支付了标准的拖运费，以便将大船拖带进港。

lemmas.def_zh: 拖，拉，牵引
lemmas.def_en: [T] To pull a vehicle, boat, or other object along behind another using a rope, chain, or towbar.

examples.en: The broken-down car needed a tow after its engine completely failed on the highway.
examples.zh: 发动机在高速公路上彻底熄火后，那辆抛锚的汽车需要拖带。

lemmas.def_zh: 高耸，巍然屹立；远胜于
lemmas.def_en: [I] To rise to a very great height, or to be much taller, larger, or more impressive than surrounding people or things.

examples.en: Tourists climbed the spiral staircase of the bell tower to admire the panoramic view.
examples.zh: 游客们爬上钟楼的螺旋楼梯，欣赏整座城市的全景。

family_guide.root_logic: 核心源自古英语 togian（拖、拉、引导），基本语义为用绳索等工具牵引或拉动物体移动；同形的 tower（高塔）属外源混入但拼写相仿的演变。
family_guide.core_distinction: tow 聚焦于水平方向的拖曳拉拽；tower 则特指垂直高度上的存在（名词指高塔，动词常与 over 连用表示高耸或远胜）。

lemmas.def_zh: 泥垢，污物；泥土，尘土；丑闻，黑料
lemmas.def_en: unclean matter like soil, dust, or grime; loose earth; scandalous information

examples.en: Wash your hands thoroughly to remove all the dirt before eating.
examples.zh: 饭前要把手彻底洗净，洗掉所有污垢。

examples.en: The journalists were constantly digging up dirt on the presidential candidate.
examples.zh: 记者们一直在挖掘那位总统候选人的黑料。

lemmas.def_zh: 污秽, 肮脏
lemmas.def_en: the state of being unsanitary

examples.en: The sheer dirtiness of the abandoned kitchen shocked the new property inspectors.
examples.zh: 那间废弃厨房极其肮脏的状况让新来的房屋检查员大为震惊。

lemmas.def_zh: 弄脏，使变脏
lemmas.def_en: [T] To make something dirty or unclean.

examples.en: Toss your dirty clothes into the hamper instead of leaving them on the floor.
examples.zh: 把脏衣服扔进脏衣篓里，别留在地板上。

examples.en: It was a dirty trick to take all the credit for someone else's hard work.
examples.zh: 把别人辛勤工作的功劳据为己有是一种卑鄙的伎俩。

examples.en: Be careful not to dirty your white sneakers when walking through the mud.
examples.zh: 穿过泥地时小心点，别弄脏了你的白球鞋。

lemmas.def_zh: 肮脏的，不洁的；卑鄙的，不光彩的；弄脏，使变脏
lemmas.def_en: not clean or marked by grime; dishonorable or unfair; to make something unclean

examples.en: Toss your dirty clothes into the hamper instead of leaving them on the floor.
examples.zh: 把脏衣服扔进脏衣篓里，别留在地板上。

examples.en: It was a dirty trick to take all the credit for someone else's hard work.
examples.zh: 把别人辛勤工作的功劳据为己有是一种卑鄙的伎俩。

examples.en: Be careful not to dirty your white sneakers when walking through the mud.
examples.zh: 穿过泥地时小心点，别弄脏了你的白球鞋。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古诺斯语中表示“排泄物、秽物”的词根，核心始终围绕“尘垢、泥土”，进而引申为“下流的、丑闻”，形态上演变出形容词与动词形式 dirty。
family_guide.core_distinction: dirt 专作名词表示“污垢”或“泥土”；dirty 兼具形容词（肮脏的、卑劣的）与动词（弄脏、使变污）功能。

lemmas.def_zh: 过错, 故障, 毛病
lemmas.def_en: a wrong action attributable to bad judgment or ignorance or inattention

examples.en: Engineers discovered an electrical fault that caused the entire factory to lose power.
examples.zh: 工程师们发现了一处导致整座工厂断电的电气故障。

lemmas.def_zh: 挑剔，找毛病，指责
lemmas.def_en: [T] To criticize someone or find a mistake, flaw, or imperfection in something

examples.en: Engineers discovered an electrical fault that caused the entire factory to lose power.
examples.zh: 工程师们发现了一处导致整座工厂断电的电气故障。

lemmas.def_zh: 有过失的, 有缺点的, 不完美的, 应受责备的
lemmas.def_en: having a defect

examples.en: The fire was started by a faulty wire hidden behind the living room wall.
examples.zh: 火灾是由隐藏在客厅墙壁后面的一根有缺陷的电线引起的。

lemmas.def_zh: 完美的, 无缺点的
lemmas.def_en: without fault or error

examples.en: The pianist gave a faultless performance that earned a standing ovation from the audience.
examples.zh: 这位钢琴家带来了无可挑剔的演奏，赢得了全场观众的起立鼓掌。

lemmas.def_zh: 完美地, 无缺点地
lemmas.def_en: without a fault; in a faultless manner

examples.en: She performed the complex piano sonata faultlessly before a large, captivated audience.
examples.zh: 她在众多着迷的观众面前完美无瑕地演奏了这首复杂的钢琴奏鸣曲。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 fallere（欺骗、使失望、犯错），经古法语演变为现代词，核心逻辑指“未达标准或出现偏差”，从而引申出过错、缺陷或故障。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词 fault 强调“过错（责任归属）”或具体“缺陷/故障”；动词 fault 常用于否定句表示“挑不出毛病”；形容词 faulty 则指事物“有缺陷的”或逻辑“有漏洞的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 英寸, 身高, 小岛
lemmas.def_en: a unit of length equal to one twelfth of a foot

examples.en: The traffic was terrible, and our car barely moved an inch for an hour.
examples.zh: 交通糟糕透顶，我们的小车整整一小时几乎寸步未行。

lemmas.def_zh: 缓慢移动，艰难挪动；使缓慢挪动
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To move very slowly or carefully in a particular direction, or make something do this.

examples.en: The traffic was terrible, and our car barely moved an inch for an hour.
examples.zh: 交通糟糕透顶，我们的小车整整一小时几乎寸步未行。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 uncia（十二分之一，亦是 ounce 的词源），指一英尺的十二分之一（英寸），引申出“极微小的距离、极少的分量”，作动词时借指“极为缓慢且微小地移动”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词侧重指长度单位或极微小量（常见于 not give an inch 等习语）；动词则表示一步一步小心且缓慢地移动（常与 forward, along, toward 连用）。

lemmas.def_zh: 使失望，使破灭，辜负
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To fail to satisfy the hopes, wishes, or expectations of someone.

examples.en: I'm sorry to disappoint you, but the tickets are completely sold out.
examples.zh: 很抱歉让你失望了，票已经全部售罄。

examples.en: The final outcome of the project deeply disappointed the whole team.
examples.zh: 该项目的最终结果让整个团队感到非常失望。

lemmas.def_zh: 失望，沮丧；令人失望的人或事物
lemmas.def_en: the feeling of being disappointed, or a person or thing that causes this feeling

examples.en: Much to our disappointment, the outdoor concert was canceled due to heavy rain.
examples.zh: 让我们大失所望的是，户外音乐会因暴雨被取消了。

examples.en: His latest movie turned out to be a major critical and commercial disappointment.
examples.zh: 他最新拍的这部电影在口碑和商业上都被证明是一大败笔。

lemmas.def_zh: 令人失望地
lemmas.def_en: in a disappointing manner

examples.en: Sales figures for the new smartphone were disappointingly low during the first quarter.
examples.zh: 这款新智能手机第一季度的销售数据低得令人失望。

lemmas.def_zh: 感到失望的
lemmas.def_en: in disappointment; in a disappointed manner

examples.en: He stared disappointedly at the empty mailbox, hoping for an acceptance letter.
examples.zh: 他失望地盯着空荡荡的邮箱，期盼能收到一封录取通知书。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 失望的；沮丧的
lemmas.def_en: upset, unhappy, or disillusioned because sth was not as good as expected
lemmas.usage_note: 多修饰人，常后接 with, by, at 或 that 从句。

examples.en: They were bitterly disappointed with the results of the election.
examples.zh: 他们对选举结果感到极其失望。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 令人失望的；不尽如人意的
lemmas.def_en: not as good as you had hoped or expected; causing disappointment
lemmas.usage_note: 修饰带来失望的事物，如 disappointing news / performance。

examples.en: The movie received good reviews, but it was ultimately disappointing.
examples.zh: 这部电影虽获好评，但最终还是令人失望。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 dis-（否定/剥夺）结合 appoint（指定/安排），原义为'撤销任命或约定'，引申指'使期待落空，令人失望'。
family_guide.core_distinction: disappoint 强调'使人失望'的动作，disappointment 既指不可数的'失望情绪'，也可指代可数的'令人失望的人或事物'。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）分裂，（使）裂开；分开，分担；分享；断绝关系，分手
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To break, divide, or split into two or more parts. 2. [I, T] To share or divide something between two or more people. 3. [I] (informal) To end a relationship or leave.

examples.en: The board of directors decided to split the company into two independent firms.
examples.zh: 董事会决定将公司拆分为两家独立的实体企业。

lemmas.def_zh: 劈开, 裂片, 裂缝, 分裂, 派系, 派别, 柳条
lemmas.def_en: extending the legs at right angles to the trunk (one in front and the other in back)

examples.en: The board of directors decided to split the company into two independent firms.
examples.zh: 董事会决定将公司拆分为两家独立的实体企业。

lemmas.def_zh: 进行劈(切、割)的人, 劈裂机, 分离机, 分解器
lemmas.def_en: a worker who splits fish and removes the backbone

examples.en: He plugged an audio splitter into his phone so they could both listen.
examples.zh: 他在手机上插了一个音频分离器，这样他们两人就都能听了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中古低地德语/日耳曼语源，本义为“劈开、砍裂”，核心语义由物理层面的“撕裂、拆分”引申至抽象层面的“份额均摊、意见分歧与关系破裂”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词与名词同形，动词侧重“分裂、切分、分担”等动作过程，名词侧重“裂口、分歧局面、所分份额”等结果与状态。

lemmas.def_zh: 持续骚扰，不断折磨；反复袭击
lemmas.def_en: [T] To persistently harass, distress, or launch repeated attacks on someone.

examples.en: The minister was harried by reporters demanding answers about the budget deficit.
examples.zh: 部长遭到记者的围追堵截，被不断追问关于预算赤字的问题。

examples.en: Guerrilla units continued to harry the retreating army.
examples.zh: 游击部队持续袭扰撤退的敌军。

lemmas.def_zh: 越野赛马者, 抢劫者, 蹂躏者
lemmas.def_en: a persistent attacker

examples.en: A solitary marsh harrier soared gracefully over the reed beds in search of prey.
examples.zh: 一只孤独的白尾鹞在芦苇丛上空优雅滑翔，寻觅猎物。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语中表示“军队袭击、洗劫”的词汇，核心意象为军队的频繁袭扰，后引申为持续不断的骚扰、折磨与施压。

lemmas.def_zh: 动机；目的；由头
lemmas.def_en: a reason for doing something, especially one that is hidden or not obvious

examples.en: Police are still trying to establish a motive for the shooting.
examples.zh: 警方仍在努力查明这起枪击事件的动机。

examples.en: She suspected that he had an ulterior motive for offering his help.
examples.zh: 她怀疑他主动提供帮助别有用心。

lemmas.def_zh: 动力；积极性；诱因
lemmas.def_en: the enthusiasm, desire, or psychological drive that causes someone to act

examples.en: A lack of motivation is often the biggest obstacle to learning a new language.
examples.zh: 缺乏动力往往是学习一门新语言的最大障碍。

examples.en: Financial security served as the main motivation for taking the job.
examples.zh: 经济保障是促使他接受这份工作的主要动力。

lemmas.def_zh: 激起行为(或行动)的人(或事物),促进因素, 激发因素
lemmas.def_en: a positive motivational influence

examples.en: Recognition and praise from managers often serve as a powerful motivator for employees.
examples.zh: 管理者的认可与赞扬往往能成为员工的强大激励因素。

lemmas.def_zh: 激励，激发；成为……的动机，促使
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To inspire or give someone enthusiasm and determination to do something. 2. [T] To provide a reason or motive for an action.

examples.en: Effective leaders know how to motivate their team to achieve ambitious goals.
examples.zh: 高效的领导者懂得如何激励团队去实现宏伟目标。

examples.en: He was largely motivated by a deep fear of failure.
examples.zh: 在很大程度上，他是被对失败的深深恐惧所驱使的。

lemmas.def_zh: 激发性的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to motivation

examples.en: She gave an inspiring motivational speech to encourage the team before the championship.
examples.zh: 她在锦标赛前发表了振奋人心的励志演讲以鼓舞团队。

lemmas.def_zh: 动机不明的
lemmas.def_en: without motivation

examples.en: The students felt tired and unmotivated to finish their assignments after the break.
examples.zh: 假期结束后，学生们感到疲倦且缺乏完成作业的动力。

lemmas.def_zh: 无动机的
lemmas.def_en: occurring without motivation or provocation; ; - F.D.Roosevelt

examples.en: The police struggled to find any suspect behind what appeared to be a motiveless crime.
examples.zh: 面对这起看似毫无动机的犯罪，警方很难找到任何嫌疑人。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 movere（移动、促动），核心逻辑是“引发动作的内心力量”，衍生出行动的缘由、驱力与激发行为的过程。
family_guide.core_distinction: motive 侧重具体行为背后的“特定目的/由头”（常用于犯罪或隐藏意图）；motivation 侧重持续行动的“内驱力/积极性”及动机产生机制。

lemmas.def_zh: 化学的, 化学上用的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or used in chemistry

examples.en: Workers must wear protective clothing when handling dangerous chemical waste in the factory.
examples.zh: 工人在工厂处理危险化学废料时必须穿戴防护服。

lemmas.def_zh: 化学药品
lemmas.def_en: material produced by or used in a reaction involving changes in atoms or molecules

examples.en: Workers must wear protective clothing when handling dangerous chemical waste in the factory.
examples.zh: 工人在工厂处理危险化学废料时必须穿戴防护服。

lemmas.def_en: the science of matter; the branch of the natural sciences dealing with the composition of substances and their properties and reactions
lemmas.def_zh: 化学；人际间的融洽/默契

examples.en: The two actors had great on-screen chemistry.
examples.zh: 这两位演员在荧幕上极具默契。

lemmas.def_zh: 化学家, 药剂师
lemmas.def_en: a scientist who specializes in chemistry

examples.en: I need to stop by the local chemist to pick up my regular prescription medicine.
examples.zh: 我需要顺道去当地药房取我常规的处方药。

lemmas.def_zh: 用化学, 以化学方法
lemmas.def_en: with chemicals

examples.en: The water was chemically treated to remove impurities before being pumped into homes.
examples.zh: 水在输送到各家各户之前经过了化学处理以去除杂质。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于拉丁语 alchimia（炼金术）及 chemistry（化学），核心指向物质的组成、性质及分子间的反应与转化，后由表性质的形容词引申为指代具体物质的名词。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词侧重于“化学的、通过化学手段产生的”，名词则特指提纯或人工合成的“化学品、化学物质”。

lemmas.def_zh: （大）公司；法人组织；市政当局
lemmas.def_en: a large company or group of companies authorized to act as a single legal entity

examples.en: She left her stable job at a multinational corporation to launch a green tech startup.
examples.zh: 她辞去了跨国大公司的稳定工作，创办了一家绿色科技初创企业。

examples.en: The corporation is legally distinct from the individuals who own its shares.
examples.zh: 该法人公司在法律上与持有其股份的个人是相互独立的。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 corpus（身体），经由“使结成一个共同身体/整体”的法律概念，引申为依法享有独立法人资格的大型商业组织或实体。

lemmas.def_zh: 原子核的；核能的；核武器的；核心的
lemmas.def_en: relating to the nucleus of an atom, atomic energy, or nuclear weapons; also forming a central core

examples.en: Several nations are actively investing in nuclear power to meet carbon reduction goals.
examples.zh: 为了实现碳减排目标，一些国家正在积极投资核电。

examples.en: Sociologists often contrast the nuclear family with the extended family.
examples.zh: 社会学家经常将核心家庭（仅父母与子女）与大家庭进行对比。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 nucleus（果核、核心，源自 nux 坚果），核心意象指“位于中心的坚硬内核”，后在科学中专指“细胞核”与“原子核”，进而引申出核能、核武器及社会学中的“核心”之义。

lemmas.def_zh: 阶段，时期；月相；相位；分阶段实施
lemmas.def_en: a distinct stage in a process (n.); to carry out or introduce something in gradual stages (v.)

examples.en: The clinical trials have successfully entered their final phase.
examples.zh: 该临床试验已顺利进入最后阶段。

examples.en: The government plans to phase out single-use plastics over the next three years.
examples.zh: 政府计划在未来三年内逐步淘汰一次性塑料制品。

lemmas.def_zh: 分阶段实施，逐步推行
lemmas.def_en: [T] To carry out, introduce, or discontinue something in gradual, planned stages.

examples.en: The clinical trials have successfully entered their final phase.
examples.zh: 该临床试验已顺利进入最后阶段。

examples.en: The government plans to phase out single-use plastics over the next three years.
examples.zh: 政府计划在未来三年内逐步淘汰一次性塑料制品。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 phasis（外观、显现），最初指天体运行呈现的形态（如月相），后引申为事物发展演变过程中呈现的特定阶段或时期。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词侧重指过程中的某个“阶段”，动词则指“分阶段实施”，高频用于 phase in（逐步引入）和 phase out（逐步废止）。

lemmas.def_zh: 课，课程；经验，教训
lemmas.def_en: a period of time in which somebody is taught something; an experience that teaches you how to behave better in the future

examples.en: She takes weekly piano lessons to prepare for the conservatory audition.
examples.zh: 为了准备音乐学院的面试，她每周上一节钢琴课。

examples.en: The project's initial failure taught the team a valuable lesson about risk management.
examples.zh: 该项目最初的失败给团队在风险管理方面上了宝贵的一课。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 legere（阅读、诵读），原指宗教仪式中朗诵的经文，后引申为学校中的“课业”以及通过经历领悟的“教训”。

lemmas.def_zh: 地区的；区域性的；局部的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or characteristic of a particular region or area

examples.en: The multinational company decided to establish its regional headquarters in Singapore.
examples.zh: 这家跨国公司决定将其区域总部设立在新加坡。

examples.en: There are significant regional differences in the cost of living across the country.
examples.zh: 全国各地的生活成本存在显著的地区差异。

lemmas.def_zh: 在地区范围内, 地区性地
lemmas.def_en: in a regional manner

examples.en: The new economic policy was tested regionally before being implemented across the nation.
examples.zh: 这项新经济政策在全国推行之前先在部分地区进行了试点。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 regio（方向、界限、行政区，派生自 regere '统治/指引'）+ 形容词后缀 -al，核心含义为'属于或关于某个特定地理或行政区域的'。

lemmas.def_zh: 敦促，催促；力劝，大力主张
lemmas.def_en: [T] To advise or try hard to persuade someone to do something.

examples.en: Health experts consistently urge adults to exercise for at least thirty minutes daily.
examples.zh: 健康专家一贯敦促成年人每天至少进行三十分钟的锻炼。

lemmas.def_zh: 冲动, 推动力, 迫切的要求
lemmas.def_en: an instinctive motive

examples.en: Health experts consistently urge adults to exercise for at least thirty minutes daily.
examples.zh: 健康专家一贯敦促成年人每天至少进行三十分钟的锻炼。

lemmas.def_zh: 紧急，紧迫（性）；急迫感
lemmas.def_en: the quality or state of being important and requiring immediate action

examples.en: The issue must be treated as a matter of extreme urgency.
examples.zh: 该问题必须被视为极其紧迫的事项来处理。

examples.en: There was a palpable sense of urgency as the deadline approached.
examples.zh: 随着截止日期的临近，人们明显感到一种紧迫感。

lemmas.def_zh: 紧急的，急迫的；催促的
lemmas.def_en: requiring immediate action, attention, or decision

examples.en: The refugee crisis is in urgent need of humanitarian aid.
examples.zh: 难民危机急需人道主义援助。

examples.en: She received an urgent phone call and had to leave the meeting.
examples.zh: 她接到了一个紧急电话，不得不离开会议。

lemmas.def_zh: 急切地；迫切地；紧急地
lemmas.def_en: with great urgency

examples.en: The rescue team urgently needed additional medical supplies to treat the injured survivors.
examples.zh: 救援队急需额外的医疗物资来救治受伤的幸存者。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 urgere（推、驱动、催促），核心概念是“施加推力以促使行动”，外化为“敦促、催促”，内化为“冲动”，在时间/情势上则表现为“紧迫”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词 urge 指内在的“强烈冲动、欲望”，而 urgency 指外在情势或时间上的“紧急状态、紧迫性”。

lemmas.def_zh: 证据, 证明, 试验, 检验, 考验
lemmas.def_en: any factual evidence that helps to establish the truth of something

examples.en: The detective searched the crime scene thoroughly for proof of the suspect's involvement.
examples.zh: 侦探彻底搜查了犯罪现场，寻找嫌疑人涉案的证据。

lemmas.def_zh: 检验，试验；校对（文本）；对……进行防护处理
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To test or check something to verify its accuracy or quality; to read and correct printer's proofs. 2. To treat something to make it resistant to damage.

examples.en: The detective searched the crime scene thoroughly for proof of the suspect's involvement.
examples.zh: 侦探彻底搜查了犯罪现场，寻找嫌疑人涉案的证据。

lemmas.def_zh: 不能透入的, 证明用的, 防...的, 耐...的
lemmas.def_en: (used in combination or as a suffix) able to withstand

examples.en: The detective searched the crime scene thoroughly for proof of the suspect's involvement.
examples.zh: 侦探彻底搜查了犯罪现场，寻找嫌疑人涉案的证据。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于拉丁语 probare（检验、证实），核心逻辑为“经受检验”，进而延伸为名词“证据/校样”、动词“校对/防护处理/醒发”及形容词“能经受考验的/防御的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词侧重“证明物或经检验的成品”，形容词多用于表示“防……的（经受住考验）”，动词多用于专业领域指“校对文本”或烘焙中的“面团醒发”。

lemmas.def_zh: 资产，财产；有价值的人或特质，长处
