lemmas.def_en: a useful or valuable quality, person, or thing; an item of property owned by a person or company

examples.en: The company was forced to sell off its liquid assets to pay down short-term debt.
examples.zh: 为了偿还短期债务，该公司被迫变卖了部分流动资产。

examples.en: Her ability to stay calm under intense pressure is an invaluable asset to the team.
examples.zh: 她在巨大压力下保持冷静的能力是整个团队的宝贵财富。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 assez（足够，源于拉丁语 ad satis），最初在法律上指“足以清偿债务的遗产”，后引申为经济上的“资产、财产”，进而引申为任何有价值的品质、技能或人。

lemmas.def_zh: 天赋，才能；人才，有才干的人
lemmas.def_en: natural aptitude or skill; people possessing special aptitude or ability

examples.en: She displayed an extraordinary talent for music at an early age.
examples.zh: 她在很小的时候就展现出了非凡的音乐天赋。

examples.en: The tech company is actively investing to attract top global talent.
examples.zh: 这家科技公司正积极投资以吸引全球顶尖人才。

lemmas.def_zh: 无能的
lemmas.def_en: devoid of talent; not gifted

examples.en: The harsh critic dismissed the amateur band as completely talentless and unimaginative.
examples.zh: 那位严厉的批评家认为这支业余乐队毫无才华、缺乏想象力。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古希腊语 talanton（重量/货币单位），因《圣经》中按才受银的寓言，语义由“天赐财富”引申为天生赋予的“才华、天赋”。

lemmas.def_zh: 标志, 旗标, 旗子, 信号旗, 菖蒲
lemmas.def_en: emblem usually consisting of a rectangular piece of cloth of distinctive design

examples.en: A colorful national flag fluttered proudly in the wind above the government building.
examples.zh: 一面鲜艳的国旗在政府大楼上方迎风骄傲飘扬。

lemmas.def_zh: 示意，打信号（如挥手拦截车辆）；标出，标示；衰退，变弱
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. to signal someone (such as a driver) to stop or pay attention, especially by waving a hand or flag. 2. to mark or draw attention to something for special handling. 3. [I] to become tired, weaker, or less enthusiastic.

examples.en: Her energy began to flag noticeably after hiking up the steep mountain for three hours.
examples.zh: 在陡峭的山上徒步三小时后，她的体力开始明显不支。

lemmas.def_zh: 不衰的, 不屈不挠的, 不松懈的
lemmas.def_en: showing sustained enthusiastic action with unflagging vitality

examples.en: Thanks to her unflagging enthusiasm, the charity project was completed well ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 多亏了她不懈的热情，该慈善项目提前很久顺利完成了。

family_guide.root_logic: 核心意象源于“飘动的布”而发展为“旗帜”，引申出“标出、示意”之意；另一同形源头则源自“松弛下垂”，演变为动词的“衰退、疲劳”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词 flag 兼具“主动标记/示意”（如 flag an issue, flag down）与“精力/兴趣衰退”（如 interest flags）两种截然不同的语境。

lemmas.def_zh: 上面的, 较高的, 上级的, 上院的, 穿在外面的, 北部的, 地表的, 后期的
lemmas.def_en: the topmost one of two

examples.en: The flexible leather upper of these running shoes provides great comfort for long walks.
examples.zh: 这款跑鞋柔韧的皮质鞋帮为长途行走提供了极佳的舒适感。

lemmas.def_zh: 鞋帮, 上齿
lemmas.def_en: the higher of two berths

examples.en: The flexible leather upper of these running shoes provides great comfort for long walks.
examples.zh: 这款跑鞋柔韧的皮质鞋帮为长途行走提供了极佳的舒适感。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自副词 up 的比较级形式，核心语义为“位置、层级或地位相对更偏上的”，后引申作名词指鞋的上面部分或使人情绪高涨的兴奋事物。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词表示“上部的、高阶的”；名词主要指鞋帮（鞋面）或俚语中的兴奋剂、令人振奋的事物。

lemmas.def_zh: 适应，顺应；改动，改编
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (+ to) To change your behavior or ideas in order to suit a new condition or environment. 2. [T] To modify something for a new use, purpose, or medium.

examples.en: It took the new team several months to adapt to the local business culture.
examples.zh: 新团队花了几个月的时间才适应当地的商业文化。

examples.en: The award-winning novel is being adapted for television as a mini-series.
examples.zh: 这部获奖小说正在被改编成电视迷你剧。

lemmas.def_zh: 适应，顺应；改编本，改编作品
lemmas.def_en: the process of changing to suit new conditions; a film, TV drama, or play based on a book

examples.en: Natural selection drives the evolutionary adaptation of species to their environments.
examples.zh: 自然选择推动了物种对生存环境的进化适应。

examples.en: The film adaptation stayed remarkably faithful to the original book.
examples.zh: 这部改编电影非常忠实于原著。

lemmas.def_zh: 适配器，转接器；改装者
lemmas.def_en: a device that allows two different pieces of equipment to be connected together

examples.en: You will need a travel adapter to plug your laptop into European wall sockets.
examples.zh: 你需要一个旅行转换插头才能把笔记本电脑插进欧洲的墙壁插座。

examples.en: The new phone lacks a headphone jack, so you must use a USB-C adapter.
examples.zh: 这款新手机没有耳机孔，所以你必须使用 USB-C 转接头。

lemmas.def_zh: 适应性
lemmas.def_en: the ability to change (or be changed) to fit changed circumstances

examples.en: Her quick adaptability to new work environments impressed the entire management team during probation.
examples.zh: 她在试用期内对新工作环境的迅速适应让整个管理团队印象深刻。

lemmas.def_zh: 适应, 改编本, 适应性的变化, 适合
lemmas.def_en: the process of adapting to something (such as environmental conditions)

examples.en: The latest television adaption of the classic novel received glowing reviews from critics worldwide.
examples.zh: 这部经典小说的最新电视改编作品获得了全球评论家的一致好评。

lemmas.def_zh: 改编者, 插座, 转接器, 接合器, 拾音器
lemmas.def_en: device that enables something to be used in a way different from that for which it was intended or makes different pieces of apparatus compatible

examples.en: Remember to pack a travel adaptor so you can easily charge your devices abroad.
examples.zh: 记得带上旅行转接头，这样你在国外也能方便地给设备充电。

lemmas.def_zh: 适应的，有适应能力的；自适应的
lemmas.def_en: having the ability to change or be changed to suit different conditions

examples.en: Modern vehicles are often equipped with adaptive cruise control to maintain a safe distance.
examples.zh: 现代汽车通常配备自适应巡航系统以保持安全车距。

examples.en: Adaptive learning platforms adjust lesson difficulty based on individual student performance.
examples.zh: 自适应学习平台会根据每个学生的表现动态调整课程难度。

lemmas.def_zh: 能适应的, 适合的, 可修改的
lemmas.def_en: capable of adapting (of becoming or being made suitable) to a particular situation or use

examples.en: Successful entrepreneurs must remain adaptable when market conditions change rapidly without warning.
examples.zh: 当市场状况在毫无预警下快速变化时，成功的创业者必须保持灵活变通。

lemmas.def_zh: 不适应的, 未经改编的
lemmas.def_en: not changed in form or character for a purpose

examples.en: The unadapted script felt awkward and overly long when performed on a modern stage.
examples.zh: 未经改编的原剧本在现代舞台上演出时显得生硬且冗长。

lemmas.def_zh: 不能适应的, 不能改编的
lemmas.def_en: not adaptable

examples.en: Certain rigid species prove largely unadaptable to the drastic temperature shifts caused by global warming.
examples.zh: 某些僵化的物种被证明基本无法适应全球变暖导致的剧烈温差变化。

lemmas.def_zh: 可适应的
lemmas.def_en: having a capacity for adaptation

examples.en: The plant developed unique adaptative traits to survive in the arid desert conditions.
examples.zh: 这种植物演化出独特的适应性特征，以在干旱的沙漠环境中生存。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语前缀 ad-（朝向、使）+ aptus（适合的），核心逻辑是“通过调整或改变，使之契合新的环境、用途或标准”。
family_guide.core_distinction: adaptation 侧重适应的过程、结果或“改编作品”；adapter 专指起转接连接作用的物理“适配器”；adaptive 则作形容词，强调具备自我调节能力的“自适应”属性。

lemmas.def_zh: 延期，推迟；耽搁，延误；拖延
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To postpone something or cause it to happen at a later time. 2. [I, T] To slow down or make someone or something late; to procrastinate.

examples.en: Severe winter weather caused a long delay for thousands of frustrated travelers at the airport.
examples.zh: 恶劣的冬季天气导致机场数千名沮丧的旅客遭遇长时间延误。

lemmas.def_zh: 耽搁, 迟滞
lemmas.def_en: time during which some action is awaited

examples.en: Severe winter weather caused a long delay for thousands of frustrated travelers at the airport.
examples.zh: 恶劣的冬季天气导致机场数千名沮丧的旅客遭遇长时间延误。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语，核心概念为“放缓或留在原地”，演化为使事情推后发生或阻碍进程。

lemmas.def_zh: 月亮, 月球, 月光
lemmas.def_en: the natural satellite of the Earth

examples.en: Stop mooning about the house and find something productive to do with your weekend.
examples.zh: 别在家里无所事事地闲逛了，周末找点有意义的事情做吧。

lemmas.def_zh: 闲逛，发呆，虚度（光阴）；（露出光屁股）搞恶作剧
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (often 'moon about/around') To spend time in an aimless, distracted, or daydreaming state. 2. [I, T] (slang) To expose one's buttocks in public as a joke or insult.

examples.en: Stop mooning about the house and find something productive to do with your weekend.
examples.zh: 别在家里无所事事地闲逛了，周末找点有意义的事情做吧。

lemmas.def_en: without a moon or a visible moon

examples.en: We could barely see the narrow path on that pitch-black, moonless autumn night.
examples.zh: 在那个漆黑无月的秋夜，我们几乎看不清脚下狭窄的小径。

lemmas.def_zh: 月亮似的, 恍惚的, 发呆的
lemmas.def_en: lighted by moonlight

examples.en: He walked around the office with a moony smile after getting engaged that weekend.
examples.zh: 周末订婚后，他整天神情恍惚、面带傻笑地在办公室里踱步。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语根 *meh₁-（测量，古人以月相变化作为计时的标尺），本义为天体“月球/月亮”，引申指天然卫星，动词转义为虚度光阴、痴想发呆或俚语中的露臀恶作剧。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词侧重指天体或其象征意义；动词常与介词连用（如 moon around/over），表示心不在焉地游荡或暗自痴情思慕。

lemmas.def_zh: 威胁，恐吓；危及；预示（凶兆或坏事）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To state your intention to harm or punish someone. 2. [T] To be likely to cause damage or harm to something.

examples.en: The suspect threatened to call the police if they didn't leave immediately.
examples.zh: 嫌疑人威胁说，如果他们不立即离开就报警。

examples.en: Severe water shortages threaten the livelihood of millions of farmers.
examples.zh: 严重的水资源短缺危及数百万农民的生计。

lemmas.def_zh: 威胁地, 胁迫地, 危险地
lemmas.def_en: in a menacing manner

examples.en: Dark storm clouds gathered threateningly over the valley just before the heavy rain started.
examples.zh: 大雨倾盆而下之前，乌黑的暴风云在山谷上方阴森地聚集起来。

lemmas.def_zh: 不威胁的
lemmas.def_en: not unfriendly or threatening

examples.en: His gentle voice and warm smile made him seem completely unthreatening to the frightened child.
examples.zh: 他温柔的声音和温暖的微笑让受惊的孩子觉得他毫无威胁感。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于名词 threat（威胁、施压），后接动词化后缀 -en，核心语义为“施加威胁”或“呈现出危险/不良后果的征兆”。

lemmas.def_zh: 钢, 钢制品, 钢铁, 坚硬, 坚固
lemmas.def_en: an alloy of iron with small amounts of carbon; widely used in construction; mechanical properties can be varied over a wide range

examples.en: She had to steel herself to deliver the disappointing news to the expectant crowd.
examples.zh: 她不得不硬起心肠，向充满期盼的人群宣布这一令人失望的消息。

lemmas.def_zh: 使下定决心，使坚强（以面对困难，尤指 steel oneself）；钢化，给……包上钢
lemmas.def_en: [T] (steel oneself) To prepare yourself mentally to do something difficult or unpleasant.

examples.en: She had to steel herself to deliver the disappointing news to the expectant crowd.
examples.zh: 她不得不硬起心肠，向充满期盼的人群宣布这一令人失望的消息。

lemmas.def_zh: 钢的, 钢制的, 钢铁般的
lemmas.def_en: resembling steel as in hardness

examples.en: The seasoned negotiator stared back with steely determination during the intense, high-stakes meeting.
examples.zh: 在紧张且利害攸关的会议中，经验丰富的谈判专家以钢铁般的坚定目光回视。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语中表示“坚硬、稳固”的词根，本义为高韧性、高强度的合金“钢铁”，后引申出比喻义“坚毅、冷酷”，动词层面则指像钢铁般“武装/硬起心肠”以应对困难。

lemmas.def_zh: 投掷，抛，（棒球中）投球；搭（帐篷），扎（营）；竭力推销；向前倾跌；颠簸
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To throw or toss something, especially a ball in baseball; 2. [T] to set up a tent or camp; 3. [I, T] to promote an idea or product.

examples.en: The entrepreneurs worked hard to pitch their innovative product concept to potential venture capitalists.
examples.zh: 创业者们努力向潜在的风投家竭力推销他们创新的产品理念。

lemmas.def_zh: 程度, 坡度, 顶点, 前倾, 倾斜, 投掷, 音高, 螺距, 节距, 摊位, 树脂, 沥青
lemmas.def_en: the property of sound that varies with variation in the frequency of vibration

examples.en: The entrepreneurs worked hard to pitch their innovative product concept to potential venture capitalists.
examples.zh: 创业者们努力向潜在的风投家竭力推销他们创新的产品理念。

lemmas.def_zh: 有把的大罐, 瓶状体, 投手, 摊贩
lemmas.def_en: (baseball) the person who does the pitching

examples.en: She poured fresh iced tea from a large glass pitcher for her thirsty guests.
examples.zh: 她用一个大玻璃水壶为口渴的客人们倒上了新鲜的冰茶。

lemmas.def_zh: 涂沥青的, 粘的, 树脂的, 漆黑的
lemmas.def_en: of the blackest black; similar to the color of jet or coal

examples.en: We lost our way in the forest during that pitchy, moonless night.
examples.zh: 在那个漆黑无月的夜晚，我们在森林里迷了路。

family_guide.root_logic: 核心意象为“将物体用力投出或钉入定位”，引申出用力投掷、设立定点/基准（音高、倾斜度、商洽定位）以及搭建（帐篷等）。
family_guide.core_distinction: pitch 兼具动作与多重抽象/具体概念（音高、球场、推销说辞），而 pitcher 在共时英语中主要指动作执行者（投手）或同形的大水罐。

lemmas.def_zh: 游泳；游动，漂浮；（头脑）眩晕，旋转
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To move through water by moving limbs, fins, or tail. 2. [I] To feel dizzy or seem to be spinning.

examples.en: She learned to swim across the lake at an early age.
examples.zh: 她很小就学会了横渡这个湖。

examples.en: The heat was so intense that my head began to swim.
examples.zh: 天气太热了，我开始感到一阵阵头晕。

lemmas.def_zh: 游泳；游动（swim 的过去式）
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] Past tense of swim; to propel oneself through water using arms, legs, or fins.

examples.en: They swam thirty laps in the pool yesterday morning.
examples.zh: 他们昨天早上在泳池里游了三十个来回。

lemmas.def_zh: 游泳；游动（swim 的过去分词）
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] Past participle of swim; to move through water by moving limbs, fins, or tail.

examples.en: She had never swum across the wide lake before this summer.
examples.zh: 今年夏天之前，她从未横渡过这个宽阔的湖泊。

lemmas.def_zh: 游泳者
lemmas.def_en: a trained athlete who participates in swimming meets

examples.en: The rescue swimmer jumped into the rough sea to save the tourist.
examples.zh: 救援潜水员跳入汹涌的大海去营救那名游客。

lemmas.def_zh: 顺利地, 如意地
lemmas.def_en: with no problems or difficulties

examples.en: The meeting went swimmingly, and both sides agreed on the contract terms.
examples.zh: 会议进行得非常顺利，双方就合同条款达成了一致。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 眩晕的；（眼眶中）满是泪水的
lemmas.def_en: dizzy or faint; full of or brimming with tears
lemmas.usage_note: 在修饰眼睛时，指眼中噙满泪水（如 swimming eyes）；也可指头部发晕（a swimming head）。文学性较强。

examples.en: She gazed at him with swimming eyes as he bid his final farewell.
examples.zh: 当他作最后的告别时，她眼含泪水注视着他。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语，核心语义为在水中划动肢体向前移动，引申指头部因眩晕而像在水波中晃动旋转。
family_guide.core_distinction: swam 是 swim 的不规则过去式，仅用于表达过去发生的游泳或眩晕状态。

lemmas.def_zh: 女朋友，女友；（女性的）女性朋友，闺蜜
lemmas.def_en: a regular female romantic partner; a female friend of a woman

examples.en: He went away for the weekend with his girlfriend.
examples.zh: 他和女朋友一起出城度周末了。

examples.en: She went out for drinks with a few of her girlfriends.
examples.zh: 她和几个闺蜜一起出去喝了杯酒。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 girl（女孩）与 friend（朋友）构成的复合名词，原指女性朋友，现代英语中核心指恋爱关系中的“女朋友”。

lemmas.def_zh: 便帽；鸭舌帽
lemmas.def_en: a tight-fitting headdress

examples.en: He put on a baseball cap to shield his eyes from the sun.
examples.zh: 他戴上一顶棒球帽以遮挡阳光。

lemmas.def_zh: 覆盖……的顶部；盖住；给……戴帽子；限制（数量或金额）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To cover or form the top of something. 2. [T] To put a limit on the amount of money that can be charged, spent, or borrowed.

examples.en: Remember to tightly replace the plastic cap after using the medicine bottle.
examples.zh: 使用药瓶后，请记得把塑料盖拧紧。

lemmas.def_zh: 未授予队员帽的（队员）
lemmas.def_en: used especially of front teeth

examples.en: The coach decided to give the young, uncapped striker his international debut.
examples.zh: 教练决定让这位年轻且未代表国家队出战过的前锋上演首秀。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自晚期拉丁语表示头戴遮盖物的词汇，核心意象为“顶部覆盖物”，由此引申出“帽子”、“器皿盖子”以及抽象的“封顶上限”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词表示“帽子/盖子/上限”，动词则对应动作“覆盖顶部/给…设上限/为…画上句号”。

lemmas.def_zh: 问候；打招呼；问候声
lemmas.def_en: an utterance of greeting or an expression of welcome

examples.en: She gave me a warm hello as soon as I walked into the office.
examples.zh: 我一走进办公室，她就热情地向我打了个招呼。

examples.en: I just dropped by to say a quick hello before leaving.
examples.zh: 我离开前顺道过来简单打个招呼。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自早期用于引起注意或猎狐呼喊的拟声词（如 hollo/halloo），19世纪末伴随电话的普及被确立为通用的问候语。

lemmas.def_zh: 伤害, 害处
lemmas.def_en: any physical damage to the body caused by violence or accident or fracture etc.

examples.en: The doctor assured the patient that the mild treatment would do no harm.
examples.zh: 医生向病人保证，这种温和的疗法不会带来任何伤害。

lemmas.def_zh: 有害；伤害
lemmas.def_en: destructiveness that causes harm or injury

examples.en: Scientists emphasized the extreme harmfulness of dumping toxic waste into local rivers.
examples.zh: 科学家强调了将有毒废物倾倒进当地河流的极大危害性。

lemmas.def_zh: 伤害（身体）；损害，危害
lemmas.def_en: [T] To cause physical injury, illness, damage, or other bad effects to a person, living thing, or object.

examples.en: The doctor assured the patient that the mild treatment would do no harm.
examples.zh: 医生向病人保证，这种温和的疗法不会带来任何伤害。

lemmas.def_zh: 有害的；致害的
lemmas.def_en: causing or likely to cause damage, injury, or adverse effects

examples.en: Prolonged exposure to ultraviolet rays is harmful to the skin.
examples.zh: 长时间暴露于紫外线下对皮肤有害。

examples.en: The government is taking steps to reduce harmful carbon emissions.
examples.zh: 政府正在采取措施减少有害碳排放。

lemmas.def_zh: 无害的；无恶意的
lemmas.def_en: not able or likely to cause damage, injury, or offense

examples.en: Don't be afraid of the snake; it is completely harmless to humans.
examples.zh: 别怕那条蛇，它对人类完全无害。

examples.en: It was just a piece of harmless gossip, but it upset him anyway.
examples.zh: 那不过是句无恶意的闲话，但还是让他很不高兴。

lemmas.def_zh: 无害地；无恶意地
lemmas.def_en: in a harmless manner

examples.en: The stray tennis ball bounced harmlessly across the lawn without breaking anything.
examples.zh: 那颗飞落的网球穿过草坪弹开，没有造成任何损坏。

lemmas.def_zh: 有害地；伤害地
lemmas.def_en: in a detrimental manner

examples.en: Excessive screen time can harmfully affect children's sleep patterns and eyesight.
examples.zh: 过长的屏幕使用时间会对儿童的睡眠习惯和视力产生不良影响。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 hearm，核心含义始终围绕“实体损害、痛苦或破坏”，以此延伸出施加伤害（动词）及具备/缺乏致害属性（-ful/-less）的派生词。
family_guide.core_distinction: harmful（有害的，强调能产生破坏或负面后果）与 harmless（无害的/无恶意的，强调不具危险或威胁性）构成直接的反义形态对立。

lemmas.def_zh: 话题；主题
lemmas.def_en: a subject that is discussed, written about, or studied

examples.en: The rising cost of living has become a frequent topic of conversation among young families.
examples.zh: 不断上涨的生活成本已成为年轻家庭之间常聊的话题。

examples.en: Let's stick to the main topic of today's meeting and leave other issues for later.
examples.zh: 我们还是紧扣今天会议的主题，其他问题稍后再议。

lemmas.def_zh: 论题的, 题目的, 时事问题的, 局部的
lemmas.def_en: pertaining to the surface of a body part

examples.en: The comedian enjoys making sharp jokes about current topical political issues.
examples.zh: 这位喜剧演员喜欢就当下热门的时政议题开辛辣的玩笑。

lemmas.def_zh: 总论地；时事问题地
lemmas.def_en: to a restricted area of the body

examples.en: Apply this soothing cream topically to relieve the itching from mosquito bites.
examples.zh: 将这种舒缓药膏局部涂抹，以缓解蚊虫叮咬引起的瘙痒。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 topos（地点、场所），在修辞学中引申为立论的“处所”或切入点，最终演变为交谈、写作或思考所围绕的“话题、主题”。

lemmas.def_zh: 朝向，向着；对于，关于；用于，为了；将近
lemmas.def_en: in the direction of; in relation to; for the purpose of; near or close to (a time)

examples.en: She took a few hesitant steps toward the door.
examples.zh: 她有些迟疑地朝门口迈了几步。

examples.en: The company maintains a very open attitude toward remote work.
examples.zh: 公司对远程办公持非常开放的态度。

examples.en: All the funds raised will go toward building a new community clinic.
examples.zh: 筹集到的所有款项都将用于建设一座新的社区诊所。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 to（向）与方向后缀 -ward（朝向），核心逻辑是“指向或朝向某个具体的空间方向、心理态度或时间目标”。
family_guide.core_distinction: toward 多用于美式英语，英式英语更常用带词尾的 towards，两者在介词语义与用法上完全等同。

lemmas.def_zh: 补充人员, 部下, 潜水艇, 胶层, 订户, 傻子
lemmas.def_en: a large sandwich made of a long crusty roll split lengthwise and filled with meats and cheese (and tomato and onion and lettuce and condiments); different names are used in different sections of the United States

examples.en: The nuclear sub quietly patrolled the ocean depths beneath the polar ice.
examples.zh: 这艘核潜艇在极地冰层下幽暗的大洋深处悄然巡航。

lemmas.def_zh: 替补上场，代替；代课
lemmas.def_en: [I] (informal) (+ for) To act as a substitute, especially in sports or teaching.

examples.en: The nuclear sub quietly patrolled the ocean depths beneath the polar ice.
examples.zh: 这艘核潜艇在极地冰层下幽暗的大洋深处悄然巡航。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于拉丁前缀 sub-（在…之下、次级、附属），在现代日常英语中主要作为 substitute（替补/代课）或 submarine（潜艇/潜水艇三明治）等词的非正式缩略形式，核心引申为“替代者”或“代行职能”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词常指替补人员（如代课教师、替补球员），动词则表示“临时替代/充当替补”。

lemmas.def_zh: 省，行政区；（学识、活动、职责的）领域，范围
lemmas.def_en: a principal administrative division of a country; an area of special knowledge, interest, or responsibility

examples.en: British Columbia is the westernmost province of Canada.
examples.zh: 不列颠哥伦比亚省是加拿大最西部的省份。

examples.en: Such policy decisions fall strictly within the province of the board of directors.
examples.zh: 这类政策决策严格属于董事会的职责管辖范围。

lemmas.def_zh: 外省人，外地人；见识狭隘者，乡巴佬
lemmas.def_en: an inhabitant of the provinces of a country, often regarded as unsophisticated or narrow-minded

examples.en: To the sophisticated Parisians, he was merely an awkward provincial arriving in the big city.
examples.zh: 在大都市见多识广的巴黎人眼里，他不过是一个初来乍到的局促外省人。

examples.en: She resented being treated like an uncultured provincial by her cosmopolitan colleagues.
examples.zh: 她讨厌被那些具有国际视野的同事当作没见过世面的乡巴佬对待。

lemmas.def_zh: 外省地, 地方地
lemmas.def_en: by the province; through the province

examples.en: The education program is managed provincially rather than by the federal department.
examples.zh: 该教育项目由各省地方管理，而非由联邦部门直接管辖。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 provincia（管辖领地、行政区），核心意象为“管辖范围”，引申为国家的一级行政区（省）以及个人的学识或职责“领域”。
family_guide.core_distinction: province 是行政区划“省”或抽象的“职责领域”；provincial 作名词指“外省人”，常含贬义指“见识狭隘的乡下人”。

lemmas.def_zh: 浪漫主义者；多愁善感的人
lemmas.def_en: a person who holds idealized, emotional, or romantic views about life and love

examples.en: He is an incurable romantic who still writes handwritten love letters.
examples.zh: 他是一个无可救药的浪漫主义者，至今仍坚持手写情书。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 浪漫爱情，风流韵事；传奇色彩；v. 追求，向…献殷勤；拉拢；adj. (通常大写) 罗曼语族的
lemmas.def_en: n. a close relationship or feeling of love and adventure; v. to court someone or seek someone's favor; adj. relating to languages derived from Latin

examples.en: Their workplace romance soon blossomed into a lifelong partnership.
examples.zh: 他们的职场恋情很快修成正果，结为终身伴侣。

examples.en: The tech giant is romancing major suppliers to secure exclusive contracts.
examples.zh: 这家科技巨头正在拉拢主要供应商，以确保拿到独家合同。

examples.en: French, Italian, and Spanish are all Romance languages.
examples.zh: 法语、意大利语和西班牙语都属于罗曼语族。

lemmas.def_zh: 浪漫主义精神, 浪漫主义
lemmas.def_en: impractical romantic ideals and attitudes

examples.en: Nineteenth-century romanticism celebrated raw emotion and deep appreciation for untouched nature.
examples.zh: 十九世纪的浪漫主义颂扬纯粹的情感并推崇对原始自然的敬畏。

lemmas.def_zh: 浪漫主义者
lemmas.def_en: someone who indulges in excessive sentimentality

examples.en: As an idealistic romanticist, he believed that intense emotion was the true source of art.
examples.zh: 作为一个理想主义的浪漫主义者，他认为强烈的情感才是艺术的真正源泉。

lemmas.def_zh: 追求，向……求爱；讨好，拉拢；虚构
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To court someone or show romantic affection toward them. 2. [T] To try to win the favor, business, or support of someone. 3. [I] To invent or exaggerate stories.

examples.en: Their workplace romance soon blossomed into a lifelong partnership.
examples.zh: 他们的职场恋情很快修成正果，结为终身伴侣。

examples.en: The tech giant is romancing major suppliers to secure exclusive contracts.
examples.zh: 这家科技巨头正在拉拢主要供应商，以确保拿到独家合同。

examples.en: French, Italian, and Spanish are all Romance languages.
examples.zh: 法语、意大利语和西班牙语都属于罗曼语族。

lemmas.def_zh: 浪漫地, 小说般地, 空想地
lemmas.def_en: in a romantic manner

examples.en: The restaurant was romantically lit by candles for their anniversary dinner.
examples.zh: 为了他们的周年纪念晚宴，餐厅用蜡烛营造出浪漫的灯光。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 浪漫爱情，风流韵事；传奇色彩；v. 追求，向…献殷勤；拉拢；adj. (通常大写) 罗曼语族的
lemmas.def_en: n. a close relationship or feeling of love and adventure; v. to court someone or seek someone's favor; adj. relating to languages derived from Latin

examples.en: Their workplace romance soon blossomed into a lifelong partnership.
examples.zh: 他们的职场恋情很快修成正果，结为终身伴侣。

examples.en: The tech giant is romancing major suppliers to secure exclusive contracts.
examples.zh: 这家科技巨头正在拉拢主要供应商，以确保拿到独家合同。

examples.en: French, Italian, and Spanish are all Romance languages.
examples.zh: 法语、意大利语和西班牙语都属于罗曼语族。

lemmas.def_zh: 平淡无奇的, 平庸的
lemmas.def_en: neither expressive of nor exciting sexual love or romance

examples.en: Discussing household finances on Valentine's Day felt distinctly unromantic to both of them.
examples.zh: 在情人节讨论家庭财务让他们俩都觉得大煞风景、毫无浪漫可言。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于拉丁语 Romanice（意为“以罗马俗语”），最初指用罗曼方言书写的中世纪骑士冒险传奇，后演化出“浪漫情调与爱情”，并在语言学中保留“罗曼语族”之义。
family_guide.core_distinction: romance 兼具名词（浪漫爱情/传奇）、动词（追求/拉拢）及专有名词性形容词（罗曼语族的）；romantic 作名词时专指“浪漫主义者”或“多愁善感的人”。

lemmas.def_zh: 连接，系上，贴上；赋予，重视
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. (+ to) To fasten, join, or connect one thing to another. 2. (+ to) To attribute importance, value, or meaning to something.

examples.en: Please attach a recent photograph to your application form.
examples.zh: 请在申请表上附上一张近期照片。

examples.en: The company attaches great importance to customer feedback.
examples.zh: 公司高度重视客户反馈。

lemmas.def_zh: 附件；配件；依恋；深厚感情
lemmas.def_en: a computer file sent with an email; an extra part fitted to a machine; a strong feeling of affection

examples.en: I have enclosed the revised contract as an email attachment.
examples.zh: 我已将修改后的合同作为邮件附件附上。

examples.en: Children usually form a strong emotional attachment to their primary caregivers.
examples.zh: 孩子通常会对主要抚养人产生强烈的情感依恋。

lemmas.def_zh: 无关系的, 无隶属的, 独立的, 未婚的, 未被查封的, 未任命的, 不连接的
lemmas.def_en: not fastened together

examples.en: He remains unattached and enjoys traveling the world freely without family obligations.
examples.zh: 他目前单身，喜欢自由自在地环游世界而没有家庭牵绊。

lemmas.def_zh: 可连接的, 可附上的, 可扣押的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being fastened or added to something else

examples.en: This compact stroller comes with an attachable cup holder for extra convenience.
examples.zh: 这款便携式婴儿车配有一个可拆卸安装的杯架，格外方便。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语，字面本义为“用木桩固定”，核心逻辑为“使一物连接/系于另一物”，由此引申出物理上的粘贴连接、电子文档的附件，以及心理上的归属与依恋。
family_guide.core_distinction: attach 是动词（连接、附上、赋予）；attachment 是其名词形式，兼指具体的“配件/邮件附件”与抽象的“情感依恋”。

lemmas.def_zh: 假的
lemmas.def_en: fraudulent; having a misleading appearance

examples.en: The museum curator instantly realized that the ancient painting was a clever fake.
examples.zh: 博物馆馆长一眼就认出这幅古画是一件高明的仿造假货。

lemmas.def_zh: 伪造，仿造；假装，冒充
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To make an exact copy of something in order to deceive people; forge. 2. [T] To pretend to have a feeling, illness, etc.

examples.en: The museum curator instantly realized that the ancient painting was a clever fake.
examples.zh: 博物馆馆长一眼就认出这幅古画是一件高明的仿造假货。

lemmas.def_zh: 骗子, (卖滑头货的)摊贩
lemmas.def_en: a person who makes deceitful pretenses

examples.en: The psychic was exposed as a complete faker by the investigative journalist.
examples.zh: 那名通灵师被调查记者彻底揭穿为一个十足的骗子。

lemmas.def_zh: 伪造, 赝品, 假货, 伪装, 捏造
lemmas.def_en: the act of faking (or the product of faking)

examples.en: Experts quickly discovered that the ancient golden coin was nothing but clever fakery.
examples.zh: 专家很快发现这枚古金币不过是巧妙的赝品。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自19世纪初俚语，核心语义是指通过人为模仿、掩饰或做手脚来冒充真品，演变为表示“伪造、假冒、假装”的统一概念。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词用于描述事物“伪造的、不真实”的状态，动词则表示“伪造文件物品”或“假装某种情感状态”的具体欺骗行为。

lemmas.def_zh: 骨，骨头；骨质物；（动）剔去……的骨头
lemmas.def_en: any of the hard pieces forming the skeleton; to remove the bones from meat or fish

examples.en: She slipped on the icy pavement and broke a bone in her wrist.
examples.zh: 她在结冰的人行道上滑倒，手腕处骨折了。

examples.en: The chef carefully boned the chicken before stuffing it with herbs.
examples.zh: 大厨在填入香草之前，仔细地把鸡肉剔了骨。

lemmas.def_zh: 剔去（肉或鱼）的骨头
lemmas.def_en: [T] To remove the bones from meat or fish before cooking.

examples.en: She slipped on the icy pavement and broke a bone in her wrist.
examples.zh: 她在结冰的人行道上滑倒，手腕处骨折了。

examples.en: The chef carefully boned the chicken before stuffing it with herbs.
examples.zh: 大厨在填入香草之前，仔细地把鸡肉剔了骨。

lemmas.def_zh: 如骨的, 多骨的, 瘦骨嶙峋的
lemmas.def_en: very thin especially from disease or hunger or cold

examples.en: The stray dog was so skinny that its bony ribs were clearly visible.
examples.zh: 那只流浪狗瘦得连肋骨都清晰可见。

lemmas.def_zh: 无骨的
lemmas.def_en: being without a bone or bones

examples.en: She prefers to cook boneless chicken breasts because they are quick to prepare.
examples.zh: 她更喜欢煮无骨鸡胸肉，因为烹饪起来很快。

lemmas.def_zh: 瘦骨嶙峋的；多骨的
lemmas.def_en: having bones especially many or prominent bones

examples.en: The stray dog looked pitiful with its boney frame visible under thin fur.
examples.zh: 这只流浪狗瘦骨嶙峋的骨架在稀疏的皮毛下清晰可见，显得很可怜。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 bān（骨骼），核心意象为人或脊椎动物体内的坚硬支架，动词则由此派生出烹饪加工中的“剔骨/去骨”之意。

lemmas.def_zh: 宽广的, 辽阔的, 广大的, 显著的
lemmas.def_en: having great (or a certain) extent from one side to the other

examples.en: The sudden news brought a broad smile to the tired teacher's face.
examples.zh: 这个突如其来的消息让疲惫的老师脸上露出了灿烂的笑容。

lemmas.def_zh: 大体上，基本上；广泛地
lemmas.def_en: in a general way; without detailed specification; widely

examples.en: Broadly speaking, the economic reforms have been well received by investors.
examples.zh: 大体而言，经济改革受到了投资者的普遍认可。

lemmas.def_zh: 宽阔部分
lemmas.def_en: slang term for a woman

examples.en: The sudden news brought a broad smile to the tired teacher's face.
examples.zh: 这个突如其来的消息让疲惫的老师脸上露出了灿烂的笑容。

lemmas.def_zh: 阔, 明白, 粗野
lemmas.def_en: the property of being wide; having great width

examples.en: The broadness of the river made it impossible for us to swim across safely.
examples.zh: 河流的宽阔使我们无法安全游到对岸。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 brād（宽阔、开阔），核心概念由物理空间的“横向伸展”引申为范围的“涵盖广泛”，进而演变为认知上的“概括、大体”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词 broad 强调空间宽度或范围包容性；副词 broadly 常用于整体概括（如 broadly speaking）；名词 broad 在现代多为陈旧且带轻蔑意味的俚语用词。

lemmas.def_zh: 经过, 通行, 运输, 运输线, 转变
lemmas.def_en: a surveying instrument for measuring horizontal and vertical angles, consisting of a small telescope mounted on a tripod

examples.en: Public transit is the most convenient way to travel across this crowded city.
examples.zh: 公共交通是穿行这座拥挤城市最便利的方式。

lemmas.def_zh: 转变, 转换, 变迁, 过渡时期, 临时转调
lemmas.def_en: the act of passing from one state or place to the next

examples.en: The transition from high school to university life can be challenging for many students.
examples.zh: 从高中到大学生活的过渡对许多学生来说可能颇具挑战。

lemmas.def_zh: 通过，穿过；运送，转运
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To pass through or across an area; to transport people or goods.

examples.en: Public transit is the most convenient way to travel across this crowded city.
examples.zh: 公共交通是穿行这座拥挤城市最便利的方式。

lemmas.def_zh: 过渡，转型，转变
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] to change or transition from one state, condition, or style to another.

examples.en: The transition from high school to university life can be challenging for many students.
examples.zh: 从高中到大学生活的过渡对许多学生来说可能颇具挑战。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 transire（trans- 穿越 + ire 走），核心意象为“穿过、越过”，由此分化为物理空间上的“运输/经过”与状态时间上的“过渡/转变”。
family_guide.core_distinction: transit 侧重空间与实物的“运输、通行、中转”；transition 则侧重时间、状态或阶段的“转变与过渡”。

lemmas.def_zh: 逐渐演变，逐步发展；（生物）进化
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To develop gradually, especially from a simple to a more complex form; to undergo biological evolution.

examples.en: The tiny startup has evolved into a global tech powerhouse over the last decade.
examples.zh: 在过去的十年里，这家初创小公司已经逐步发展成为一家全球科技巨头。

examples.en: Scientists believe that birds evolved from a group of bipedal dinosaurs.
examples.zh: 科学家认为鸟类是从一群双足恐龙进化而来的。

lemmas.def_zh: 进化（论）；演变，渐进发展
lemmas.def_en: the gradual process of change and development, especially of living things over generations

examples.en: Darwin's theory of evolution revolutionized our understanding of the natural world.
examples.zh: 达尔文的进化论彻底改变了我们对自然界的理解。

examples.en: The museum traces the evolution of human communication from cave paintings to the internet.
examples.zh: 该博物馆追溯了人类交流方式从洞穴壁画到互联网的发展演变历程。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or produced by evolution
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 进化的；演化的；渐进的

examples.en: Language change is an evolutionary process that never stops.
examples.zh: 语言的演变是一个永不停歇的渐进过程。

lemmas.def_en: in an evolutionary way; from an evolutionary point of view
lemmas.def_zh: 演化地, 演进地(evolutionary的变形)

examples.en: Humans and chimpanzees are evolutionarily closely related through a common ancestor.
examples.zh: 人类与黑猩猩在进化上通过共同祖先紧密相连。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 evolvere（e- 向外 + volvere 卷/转），本义为‘展开卷轴’，引申指事物由简单到复杂‘逐渐展开、演化、发展’的过程。
family_guide.core_distinction: evolve 是动词，强调‘逐渐演变、发展出新形态’的动态过程；evolution 是名词，既可指生物‘进化（论）’，也可指事物宏观的‘渐进演变’。

lemmas.def_zh: 民主主义者，民主人士；（大写Democrat）民主党人
lemmas.def_en: an advocate of democracy; (capitalized) a member or supporter of the US Democratic Party

examples.en: He described himself as a lifelong democrat committed to human rights and free elections.
examples.zh: 他称自己是一位毕生致力于人权与自由选举的民主主义者。

examples.en: Several prominent Democrats have announced their opposition to the new spending bill.
examples.zh: 几位杰出的民主党人已宣布反对这项新的开支法案。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 demos（人民）与 kratos（权力、统治），核心意为“主张由人民掌权的人”，演变指民主主义者或特指（美国）民主党人。
family_guide.core_distinction: 小写 democrat 泛指支持民主政体与原则的人；首字母大写的 Democrat 特指美国民主党党员或支持者。

lemmas.def_zh: 乐器；仪器，器械；手段，工具
lemmas.def_en: a tool or implement for delicate or scientific work; a musical device; a means by which something is effected

examples.en: Optical instruments like microscopes have revolutionized medical research.
examples.zh: 显微镜等光学仪器彻底改变了医学研究。

examples.en: The United Nations was established as an instrument of international peace.
examples.zh: 联合国是作为维护国际和平的手段而建立的。

lemmas.def_zh: 乐器法, 仪器制造学, 仪表化
lemmas.def_en: an artifact (or system of artifacts) that is instrumental in accomplishing some end

examples.en: The cockpit features advanced instrumentation that helps pilots navigate through thick fog.
examples.zh: 驾驶舱配备了先进的仪表设备，帮助飞行员在浓雾中导航。

lemmas.def_zh: 工具主义者；乐器演奏家
lemmas.def_en: someone who plays a musical instrument (as a profession)

examples.en: The band hired a talented instrumentalist who could play both violin and acoustic guitar.
examples.zh: 乐队聘请了一位既能拉小提琴又能弹原声吉他的才华横溢的乐手。

lemmas.def_zh: 媒介, 手段, 机构
lemmas.def_en: a subsidiary organ of government created for a special purpose

examples.en: The peace agreement was finally reached through the instrumentality of the United Nations.
examples.zh: 和平协议最终借助联合国的斡旋得以达成。

lemmas.def_zh: 给……配备仪器（或测量仪表）；为……配器，为……谱写管弦乐曲
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To equip a machine, vehicle, or system with measuring instruments or controls. 2. [T] To orchestrate a piece of music.

examples.en: Optical instruments like microscopes have revolutionized medical research.
examples.zh: 显微镜等光学仪器彻底改变了医学研究。

examples.en: The United Nations was established as an instrument of international peace.
examples.zh: 联合国是作为维护国际和平的手段而建立的。

lemmas.def_zh: 起关键作用的；器乐的，纯音乐的
lemmas.def_en: serving as a crucial means in pursuing an aim; performed on or written for musical instruments

examples.en: Her dedicated leadership was instrumental in bringing the negotiations to a successful close.
examples.zh: 她的专注领导对谈判取得圆满成功起到了关键作用。

examples.en: The album opens with a gentle instrumental track featuring the cello.
examples.zh: 该专辑以一首由大提琴主奏的温和纯器乐曲目开篇。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 instruere（装备、构建），核心逻辑是由“装备、工具”引申为达成某种目的的“具体器具、乐器”或抽象的“手段/起促成作用的媒介”。
family_guide.core_distinction: instrument 作名词指具体的工具、仪器或抽象手段，动词指装备仪器或植入监控代码；形容词 instrumental 常见熟词生义，核心搭配 instrumental in 表示“起关键作用的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 把……奉献给，致力于（尤指 dedicate oneself/time to）；将（作品等）题献给；为（建筑物等）举行落成典礼
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (dedicate yourself/something to) To give a lot of your time, effort, or life to a particular purpose or cause. 2. [T] To address or offer a book, music, or artwork to someone as a tribute.

examples.en: She decided to dedicate her life to cancer research.
examples.zh: 她决定将一生奉献给癌症研究事业。

examples.en: The author dedicated his latest novel to his parents.
examples.zh: 作者将他的最新小说题献给了父母。

lemmas.def_zh: 奉献，专注敬业；题献词；落成典礼
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being committed to a task or purpose; words dedicating a book or piece of music; an official ceremony

examples.en: Her deep dedication to her students earned her widespread respect.
examples.zh: 她对学生的高度负责与奉献赢得了广泛的尊敬。

examples.en: The book features a heartfelt dedication on the opening page.
examples.zh: 该书的首页印有一段真挚感人的题献词。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 尽心尽力的；专注的；专用的
lemmas.def_en: working hard at sth because it is very important to you; designed for one particular purpose
lemmas.usage_note: 可表示人的敬业态度（a dedicated teacher），也可表示技术设备的专用性（dedicated server）。

examples.en: She is a dedicated doctor who puts her patients first.
examples.zh: 她是一位把病人放在第一位的尽职尽责的医生。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 de-（彻底）+ dicare（宣布、宣告），核心意向为“郑重宣告某物的归属”，后引申为将精力、时间或作品专一地倾注、奉献给某人或某项事业。
family_guide.core_distinction: dedicate 为动词，侧重“投入/题献”的动作；dedication 为名词，既指“全情投入的敬业品质”，也指具体的“题献词”或“落成典礼”。

lemmas.def_zh: 哲学；人生哲学，处世准则
lemmas.def_en: the study of the fundamental nature of knowledge, reality, and existence; a set of guiding principles for living

examples.en: Her management philosophy is centered on empowering team members.
examples.zh: 她的管理理念以向团队成员充分赋能为核心。

examples.en: He earned a master's degree in political philosophy.
examples.zh: 他获得了政治哲学硕士学位。

lemmas.def_zh: 哲学家；思想家
lemmas.def_en: a person who studies or writes about philosophy, or who thinks deeply about life

examples.en: Ancient Greek philosophers laid the foundation for Western intellectual traditions.
examples.zh: 古希腊哲学家奠定了西方学术思想传统的基础。

lemmas.def_zh: 哲学的；达观的，从容冷静的
lemmas.def_en: relating to philosophy; calm and wise when faced with problems or disappointment

examples.en: The novel raises profound philosophical questions about human nature.
examples.zh: 这部小说对人性提出了深刻的哲学思考。

examples.en: She was philosophical about the job loss, viewing it as a chance to start fresh.
examples.zh: 她对失去工作看得很开，将其视为重新开始的契机。

lemmas.def_zh: 哲学家的, 哲学的, 镇静的, 逆来顺受的, 安之若素的, 达观的, 富于哲理性的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to philosophy or philosophers

examples.en: He maintained a philosophic attitude even when his business venture ended in failure.
examples.zh: 即使商业投资以失败告终，他依然保持着豁达的心态。

lemmas.def_zh: 哲学上；贤明地
lemmas.def_en: in a philosophic manner

examples.en: She accepted her defeat philosophically and began planning her next big project.
examples.zh: 她泰然处之接受了失败，并开始规划下一个大项目。

lemmas.def_zh: 进行哲学探讨, 肤浅地谈论哲理；哲学家似地思考, 从哲理角度解释
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (+ about/on) To philosophize means to talk or think deeply—sometimes in a lengthy or overly abstract way—about the meaning of life and fundamental principles.

examples.en: They sat on the porch all evening, drinking tea and philosophizing about human destiny.
examples.zh: 他们整个傍晚都坐在门廊上，一边喝茶一边高谈人类命运。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古希腊语 philo-（爱）与 sophia（智慧），核心本义为“爱智慧”，由此延伸为对存在、知识与真理的根本探究，以及指引生活的价值体系。
family_guide.core_distinction: philosophical 除表示“哲学的”之外，日常高频引申为面对挫折时“豁达平静的、看得开的”处世态度。

lemmas.def_zh: 一排，一行；划船；公开争吵，严重分歧
lemmas.def_en: a neat line of people or things; to propel a boat with oars; a noisy quarrel or dispute

examples.en: We reserved seats in the front row to get an unobstructed view of the stage.
examples.zh: 我们预订了前排的座位，以便毫无遮挡地观看舞台。

examples.en: They decided to row across the lake before the sun began to set.
examples.zh: 他们决定在太阳落山前划船穿过湖泊。

examples.en: The neighbors had a furious row over parking spaces late last night.
examples.zh: 邻居们昨晚深夜因停车位发生了一场激烈的争吵。

lemmas.def_zh: 桨手
lemmas.def_en: someone who rows a boat

examples.en: Every rower in the team must stay in sync to win the boat race.
examples.zh: 队里的每位划手必须保持动作一致才能赢得赛艇比赛。

lemmas.def_zh: 划（船）；划船运送；争吵
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] to propel or steer a boat using oars, or convey someone in a boat by rowing 2. [I] (British informal) to quarrel noisily with someone

examples.en: We reserved seats in the front row to get an unobstructed view of the stage.
examples.zh: 我们预订了前排的座位，以便毫无遮挡地观看舞台。

examples.en: They decided to row across the lake before the sun began to set.
examples.zh: 他们决定在太阳落山前划船穿过湖泊。

examples.en: The neighbors had a furious row over parking spaces late last night.
examples.zh: 邻居们昨晚深夜因停车位发生了一场激烈的争吵。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，核心意象主要包含'直线状延伸'（排、行）与'规律摆动划桨'（划船）；另有一同形异音源指'嘈杂激烈的争吵'。
family_guide.core_distinction: 表示'一排'或'划船'时读作 /roʊ/；表示'公开争吵/口角'时读作 /raʊ/，需注意发音与语义的对应。

lemmas.def_zh: 敲，击，撞击；击倒；批评
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] to strike a surface noisily, especially to attract attention. 2. [I, T] to collide with or hit someone or something forcefully.

examples.en: Someone began to knock loudly on the front door late last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚深夜有人开始大声敲前门。

lemmas.def_zh: 敲, 敲打, 敲门
lemmas.def_en: the sound of knocking (as on a door or in an engine or bearing)

examples.en: Someone began to knock loudly on the front door late last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚深夜有人开始大声敲前门。

lemmas.def_zh: 敲击者(或物), 敲门者, 门环
lemmas.def_en: (Yiddish) a big shot who knows it and acts that way; a boastful immoderate person

examples.en: The old wooden door had a heavy brass knocker shaped like a lion's head.
examples.zh: 那扇老旧的木门上装有一个沉重的狮头形黄铜门环。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自模拟短促撞击声的拟声词，由物理层面的“敲击、碰撞”延伸至比喻层面的“挫折、打击与批评”。

lemmas.def_zh: 闻到，嗅出；散发气味，闻起来有……气味；闻，嗅
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To perceive the scent or odor of something using your nose. 2. [I] To have or emit a particular odor, or to smell bad. 3. [I, T] To sniff at something to discover its odor.

examples.en: Can you smell the delicious aroma coming from the bakery down the street?
examples.zh: 你能闻到街角面包店传来的诱人香气吗？

lemmas.def_zh: 气味；嗅觉
lemmas.def_en: the sensation that results when olfactory receptors in the nose are stimulated by particular chemicals in gaseous form

examples.en: Can you smell the delicious aroma coming from the bakery down the street?
examples.zh: 你能闻到街角面包店传来的诱人香气吗？

lemmas.def_zh: 胡瓜鱼
lemmas.def_en: small cold-water silvery fish; migrate between salt and fresh water

examples.en: The fisherman caught several small smelt that were later fried for dinner.
examples.zh: 渔夫捕到了几条小胡瓜鱼，稍后油炸当作了晚餐。

lemmas.def_zh: 熔铸工, 冶炼者, 熔炉, 冶金厂, 冶炼厂
lemmas.def_en: an industrial plant for smelting

examples.en: The newly built smelter processes thousands of tons of copper ore daily.
examples.zh: 这座新建的冶炼厂每天处理成千上万吨铜矿石。

lemmas.def_zh: 发臭的, 有臭味的
lemmas.def_en: offensively malodorous

examples.en: Please take those smelly gym shoes outside before they ruin the room's air.
examples.zh: 请把那些发臭的球鞋拿到室外去，别让它们搞臭房间空气。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中古英语，核心语义贯穿于'鼻腔感知气味'（感知动作）与'散发气味/气味本体'（刺激源属性）。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词侧重于'嗅感知动作'或'散发某种气味的状态'；名词则指'气味本身'或'嗅觉能力'。

lemmas.def_zh: 为……做广告，宣传；登广告征求；宣扬，展露
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (+ for) To publish or broadcast an advertisement for a product, service, or job vacancy. 2. [T] To make something known publicly or make a quality noticeable.

examples.en: The company plans to advertise its new skincare line on major social media platforms.
examples.zh: 该公司计划在各大社交媒体平台上为旗下的新护肤品系列做广告。

examples.en: They advertised for a qualified bilingual accountant in the local newspaper.
examples.zh: 他们在当地报纸上刊登广告，招聘一名合格的双语会计师。

lemmas.def_zh: 为……做广告，宣传（advertise 的变体）
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] A variant spelling of advertise; to promote or publish advertisements for something.

examples.en: Although the variant 'advertize' occasionally appeared in older American texts, standard style guides strictly require the '-ise' ending.
examples.zh: 尽管异体拼写 'advertize' 偶尔出现在早期的美国文本中，但标准文风指南严格要求使用 '-ise' 结尾。

lemmas.def_en: a public promotion of some product or service
lemmas.def_zh: 广告，启事

examples.en: She responded to an advertisement for a graphic designer.
examples.zh: 她应聘了一则招聘平面设计师的广告。

lemmas.def_zh: 做广告者, 广告客户
lemmas.def_en: someone whose business is advertising

examples.en: The magazine lost its biggest advertiser after publishing the controversial critical article.
examples.zh: 该杂志在发表那篇具争议性的批评文章后，失去了最大的广告客户。

lemmas.def_zh: 做广告者, 广告客户
lemmas.def_en: someone whose business is advertising

examples.en: Each local advertizer hopes to attract more customers through the new digital billboard.
examples.zh: 每位本地广告客户都希望通过新的数字广告牌吸引更多顾客。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 advertere（ad- '朝向' + vertere '转向'，意为'使注意力转向'），引申为通过公开渠道吸引公众注意以进行宣传或推销。
family_guide.core_distinction: advertise 是现代英美英语普遍通用的唯一标准拼写；advertize 是受常见 -ize 词尾类推影响产生的罕见/非规范异体字。

lemmas.def_zh: 猛冲，疾驰，奔跑；匆忙行事；催促，仓促处理
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To move, run, or go somewhere with great speed. 2. [I, T] To do something hurriedly or force someone to act too quickly.

examples.en: She had to rush to the station to catch the morning train.
examples.zh: 她不得不赶往车站去赶早班火车。

lemmas.def_zh: 匆促, 冲进, 急流, 灯心草
lemmas.def_en: the act of moving hurriedly and in a careless manner

examples.en: She had to rush to the station to catch the morning train.
examples.zh: 她不得不赶往车站去赶早班火车。

lemmas.def_zh: [体]猛攻运动员
lemmas.def_en: (football) a ball carrier who tries to gain ground by running with the ball

examples.en: The defensive rusher broke through the line and tackled the quarterback.
examples.zh: 防守端锋冲破防线并擒抱了四分卫。

lemmas.def_zh: 长满灯心草的
lemmas.def_en: abounding in rushes

examples.en: Wild ducks often hide among the rushy banks of the quiet river.
examples.zh: 野鸭常常藏在宁静河流长满灯心草的岸边。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拟声或古法语，核心概念为‘带有冲力、狂暴或仓促的高速移动’，后引申为在时间紧迫下的催促、狂潮及生理上的强烈冲击感。

lemmas.def_zh: 下降，减少，衰落；婉拒，谢绝
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To gradually become less, smaller, or weaker in number, amount, or quality. 2. [I, T] (formal) To politely refuse an offer or invitation.

examples.en: He politely declined the invitation to the party due to work commitments.
examples.zh: 由于工作原因，他礼貌地婉拒了派对邀请。

lemmas.def_zh: 衰退, 跌落, 下降
lemmas.def_en: change toward something smaller or lower

examples.en: He politely declined the invitation to the party due to work commitments.
examples.zh: 由于工作原因，他礼貌地婉拒了派对邀请。

lemmas.def_zh: 下倾, 倾斜, 衰微
lemmas.def_en: a condition inferior to an earlier condition; a gradual falling off from a better state

examples.en: Astronomers carefully measured the declination of the distant star last night.
examples.zh: 天文学家昨晚仔细测量了那颗遥远恒星的赤纬。

lemmas.def_zh: 词形变化, 变格, 倾斜, 衰退
lemmas.def_en: the inflection of nouns and pronouns and adjectives in Indo-European languages

examples.en: Students of Latin must memorize noun declension patterns to master proper grammar.
examples.zh: 拉丁语学生必须背诵名词变格模式以掌握正确的语法。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 declinare（de- 向下 + clinare 倾斜），核心意象为“向下倾斜”，由此衍生出数量或质量的“下降、衰退”，以及态度上委婉避开的“婉言谢绝”。
family_guide.core_distinction: decline 兼具动词与名词；作为动词时既可表“下降/衰退”（不及物），也可表“婉拒”（及物）；作为名词时主要指“衰落、减少”的过程或状态。

lemmas.def_zh: 财富，财产；丰富，大量
lemmas.def_en: an abundance of valuable possessions or money; a large amount of something desirable

examples.en: The industrialist used his immense wealth to fund medical research.
examples.zh: 这位实业家利用其巨额财富资助医学研究。

examples.en: The digital archive offers a wealth of information for historical scholars.
examples.zh: 该数字档案库为历史学者提供了极其丰富的资料。

lemmas.def_zh: 富有的，富裕的；充裕的
lemmas.def_en: having a large amount of money, land, or other valuable assets; rich

examples.en: He was born into a wealthy family and received an elite education.
examples.zh: 他出身于一个富裕家庭，接受了精英教育。

examples.en: The coastal waters are wealthy in marine biodiversity.
examples.zh: 这片沿海水域拥有丰富的海洋生物多样性。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中古英语 wele（福祉、安康，同 weal），仿照 health（健康）的形式派生而来，核心语义从‘幸福安康的生活状态’演变为‘能带来优裕生活的丰富财产或资源’。

lemmas.def_zh: 工业的；产业的；用于工业的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or characterized by industry, factories, or manufacturing

examples.en: The city has gradually transformed from an industrial hub into a center for technology and finance.
examples.zh: 这座城市已逐渐从一个工业中心转型为科技与金融中心。

examples.en: Strict environmental regulations were introduced to control industrial pollution.
examples.zh: 出台了严格的环保法规以控制工业污染。

lemmas.def_zh: 企业（工业）地
lemmas.def_en: by industrial means

examples.en: The region is industrially developed and produces a large share of steel.
examples.zh: 该地区工业发达，钢铁产量占很大比重。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 industry（原指“勤勉”，后引申为有组织的生产创造即“工业”），-al 为形容词后缀，核心语义为“与工业或现代产业生产相关的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 注意区分 industrial（工业的、产业的）与同源词 industrious（勤奋的、刻苦的）。

lemmas.def_zh: 门, 牌楼, 大门, 通道, 闸
lemmas.def_en: a movable barrier in a fence or wall

examples.en: Please remember to close the garden gate so the dog cannot escape.
examples.zh: 请记得关上花园大门，以免狗跑出去。

lemmas.def_zh: 给……装大门；用闸门关住，关门限制……出入
lemmas.def_en: [T] To furnish or close off with a gate; to restrict or confine within gates.

examples.en: Please remember to close the garden gate so the dog cannot escape.
examples.zh: 请记得关上花园大门，以免狗跑出去。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 geat，本义为开口或通道，后演变为用于封闭、控制进出的“大门/关卡”，引申至动词表示限制人员出入通行。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词主要表示物理意义的门、登机口或门票收入；动词主要在英式语境中表示因违纪而“禁足（限制离开校园/住处）”。

lemmas.def_zh: 取消，撤销，废除；抵消
lemmas.def_en: [T] To decide that an organized event, agreement, or order will not happen or will no longer be valid; to offset or neutralize.

examples.en: The airline had to cancel all flights due to severe weather conditions.
examples.zh: 由于恶劣的天气状况，航空公司不得不取消所有航班。

examples.en: The tax cuts and price increases will cancel each other out.
examples.zh: 减税与物价上涨两相抵消。

lemmas.def_zh: 取消，撤销；注销
lemmas.def_en: the act of deciding that an organized event, order, or service will not take place

examples.en: Please check the hotel's cancellation policy before making a reservation.
examples.zh: 请在预订前查看酒店的退订政策。

examples.en: A last-minute cancellation created an opening for an earlier appointment.
examples.zh: 因有人临时取消，多出了一个提前预约的名额。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 cancellare（用交叉的栅栏状网格划掉文本），核心逻辑为“在字面上划线作废”，后引申为所有预约、计划、约定或影响的“取消”与“作废”。

lemmas.def_zh: 参议员；（古罗马）元老院议员
lemmas.def_en: a member of a senate

examples.en: The bill passed with bipartisan support after several senators crossed party lines.
examples.zh: 在几位参议员跨越党派立场支持后，该法案获得了两党的一致通过。

examples.en: She served two terms as a state senator before launching her campaign for governor.
examples.zh: 在参选州长之前，她曾担任过两届州参议员。

lemmas.def_zh: 参议院的, 由参议员组成的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to senators

examples.en: She launched her senatorial campaign with a passionate speech yesterday morning.
examples.zh: 昨天上午，她以一场充满激情的演讲开启了参议员竞选活动。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 senex（年长者），原指古代部族或城邦中由年长智者组成的统治阶层，后演变为代指现代国家参议院（Senate）的成员。

lemmas.def_zh: 有机物；有机食品（常作复数）
lemmas.def_en: a substance derived from living matter; food produced without artificial chemicals (usually plural)

examples.en: The supermarket expanded its aisle for organics due to rising consumer demand.
examples.zh: 由于消费者需求增加，超市扩大了有机食品专区的通道。

examples.en: Microorganisms break down soil organics into nutrients that plants can absorb.
examples.zh: 微生物将土壤有机物分解为植物可以吸收的养分。

lemmas.def_zh: 器官；管风琴；机构，机关报刊
lemmas.def_en: a body part with a specific vital function; a large musical instrument with pipes; an official organization or publication

examples.en: The heart is considered the most vital organ in the human body.
examples.zh: 心脏被认为是人体最重要的器官。

examples.en: The church organist played a powerful Bach prelude on the pipe organ.
examples.zh: 教堂风琴手在管风琴上演奏了一首震撼人心的巴赫前奏曲。

lemmas.def_en: a living thing that has (or can develop) the ability to act or function independently
lemmas.def_zh: 生物, 有机体, 社会组织

examples.en: Scientists discovered a microscopic organism living deep inside the subterranean volcanic cave.
examples.zh: 科学家在地下火山洞穴深处发现了一种微小生物。

lemmas.def_zh: 风琴弹奏者
lemmas.def_en: a person who plays an organ

examples.en: The church organist played a beautiful hymn during the Sunday morning service.
examples.zh: 教堂管风琴师在周日早晨的礼拜仪式上演奏了一首优美的赞美诗。

lemmas.def_zh: 有机性地, 器官上地, 有组织地
lemmas.def_en: as an important constituent

examples.en: Our business grew organically through positive word of mouth and loyal customers.
examples.zh: 我们的业务通过良好的口碑和忠实客户实现了自然增长。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or belonging to an organism (considered as a whole)
lemmas.def_zh: 有机体的, 生物的

examples.en: The biologist studied how climate change affects diverse organismal traits across ecosystems.
examples.zh: 生物学家研究了气候变化如何影响生态系统中各种各样的生物体特征。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or belonging to an organism (considered as a whole)
lemmas.def_zh: [医]有机体的, 生物的

examples.en: Her holistic theory treats the human mind as a unified organismic process.
examples.zh: 她的整体论学说将人类心灵视为一个统一的有机体过程。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 organon（工具、器具），核心意象指“具有特定机能的组织或工具”，后引申为生物体的器官、管风琴以及具有机体特质的有机物。
family_guide.core_distinction: organ 指生物体的机能器官、机构或乐器；organic 作名词时（常作复数 organics）特指有机食品、有机肥料或有机化合物。

lemmas.def_zh: 雪, 积雪, 下雪, 雪花形干扰
lemmas.def_en: precipitation falling from clouds in the form of ice crystals

examples.en: Heavy snow began to fall, quickly covering the quiet streets in white.
examples.zh: 大雪开始落下，很快将寂静的街道覆盖上一层白雪。

lemmas.def_zh: 下雪；似雪般飘落；被雪困住
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] to fall as frozen precipitation in the form of white flakes (usually impersonal: 'it snows') 2. [I] to fall or shower down like snowflakes 3. [T] (usually passive: 'be snowed in') to cover, trap, or enclose with snow

examples.en: Heavy snow began to fall, quickly covering the quiet streets in white.
examples.zh: 大雪开始落下，很快将寂静的街道覆盖上一层白雪。

lemmas.def_zh: 多雪的, 雪的, 被雪所覆盖着的, 下雪的
lemmas.def_en: marked by the presence of snow

examples.en: We spent a cozy evening by the warm fireplace during the snowy weekend.
examples.zh: 在那个多雪的周末，我们围在温暖的壁炉旁度过了一个舒适的夜晚。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语词根 *sneygʷʰ-（降雪），核心概念始终围绕从云层落下的白色固态结晶降水，由物态（名词）直接自然转化为降落行为及相关状态（动词）。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词与动词同形；名词指降雪现象及地面积雪，动词既可表示天上下雪，也可指被大雪围困（如 be snowed in）。

lemmas.def_zh: 创伤, 伤口, 伤疤, 伤害, 痛苦
lemmas.def_en: an injury to living tissue (especially an injury involving a cut or break in the skin)

examples.en: The doctor cleaned and bandaged the deep wound on his left arm.
examples.zh: 医生清洗并包扎了他左臂上的深伤口。

lemmas.def_zh: （用武器等）使受伤，伤害；伤害（感情）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To injure someone physically, especially with a weapon. 2. [T] To hurt someone's feelings, reputation, or pride.

examples.en: The doctor cleaned and bandaged the deep wound on his left arm.
examples.zh: 医生清洗并包扎了他左臂上的深伤口。

lemmas.def_zh: wind的过去式和过去分词
lemmas.def_en: put in a coil

examples.en: The doctor cleaned and bandaged the deep wound on his left arm.
examples.zh: 医生清洗并包扎了他左臂上的深伤口。

lemmas.def_zh: 未受伤的, 完好无损的
lemmas.def_en: not wounded

examples.en: Miraculously, the driver walked away completely unwounded from the severe car crash.
examples.zh: 奇迹般的是，司机从严重的撞车事故中毫发无损地走了出来。

family_guide.root_logic: wound 作名词与动词源自古英语 wund（创伤），核心指物理或精神上的伤害；而 wound 作形容词实为动词 wind（缠绕/发条）的过去分词形态转化，两者属于同形异义现象。
family_guide.core_distinction: wound (n./v.) 聚焦于创伤与伤害；wound (adj.) 则源自 wind，表示盘绕或上紧发条的状态（受创伤的形容词通常用 wounded）。

lemmas.def_zh: 奶, 乳状物
lemmas.def_en: a white nutritious liquid secreted by mammals and used as food by human beings

examples.en: He poured fresh milk over his bowl of crunchy cereal every morning.
examples.zh: 他每天早上都将鲜牛奶倒进盛满脆麦片的碗里。

lemmas.def_zh: 挤奶，挤（奶）；榨取，勒索（钱财、利益等）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To draw milk from a cow, goat, or other female animal. 2. [T] (informal) To exploit or extract money, advantage, or information from someone in an unfair or ruthless way.

examples.en: He poured fresh milk over his bowl of crunchy cereal every morning.
examples.zh: 他每天早上都将鲜牛奶倒进盛满脆麦片的碗里。

lemmas.def_zh: 乳状的, 乳白色的, 柔和的
lemmas.def_en: resembling milk in color not clear

examples.en: The hot springs were famous for their warm, milky water and healing minerals.
examples.zh: 这些温泉以其温暖的乳白色泉水和有疗效的矿物质而闻名。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古日耳曼语，核心动作是“挤取、拭出液体”，后演化为指代乳汁名词及引申的“榨取、充分获利”动词义。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词 milk 常具引申义，指“榨取（钱财/同情）”；形容词 milky 则侧重外观（乳白色、浑浊）或成分（含乳的）。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 食盐；盐分；v. 给……加盐；撒盐于；腌制
lemmas.def_en: a white substance used to flavour or preserve food; to season, treat, or preserve with salt

examples.en: You should take his promises with a grain of salt.
examples.zh: 对他许下的诺言，你应当持保留态度。

examples.en: Workers salted the icy roads to prevent traffic accidents.
examples.zh: 工人们在结冰的道路上撒了盐以防发生交通事故。

lemmas.def_zh: 制盐人, 卖盐人, 腌制者, (非正式)矿山骗子
lemmas.def_en: someone who uses salt to preserve meat or fish or other foods

examples.en: In medieval times, the local salter was essential for preserving winter food.
examples.zh: 在中世纪，当地的制盐工对储存冬季食物至关重要。

lemmas.def_zh: 咸性
lemmas.def_en: language or humor that is down-to-earth

examples.en: The gentle saltiness of the fresh sea breeze reminded her of home.
examples.zh: 清新海风中淡淡的咸味让她想起了家乡。

lemmas.def_zh: 咸的，含盐的；（非正式）恼火的，酸溜溜的
lemmas.def_en: containing or tasting of salt; (informal) annoyed, bitter, or upset, especially over something minor

examples.en: The soup was far too salty for my taste.
examples.zh: 这汤太咸了，不合我的口味。

examples.en: He got salty after losing the video game to his younger brother.
examples.zh: 他在电子游戏里输给弟弟之后就变得气急败坏。

lemmas.def_zh: 新鲜的
lemmas.def_en: without salt or seasoning

examples.en: She prefers to bake bread using fresh, unsalted butter for a richer flavor.
examples.zh: 她更喜欢用新鲜的无盐黄油烤面包，以获得更浓郁的风味。

lemmas.def_zh: 给……加盐调味；（用盐）腌制；在……上撒盐
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] to add salt to food to improve its flavor 2. [T] to preserve food by treating it with salt 3. [T] to spread salt on a surface such as a road

examples.en: You should take his promises with a grain of salt.
examples.zh: 对他许下的诺言，你应当持保留态度。

examples.en: Workers salted the icy roads to prevent traffic accidents.
examples.zh: 工人们在结冰的道路上撒了盐以防发生交通事故。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语 *saltom（盐），核心语义围绕人类生存所必需的天然矿物质“盐”，并从“食物调味与防腐”自然引申为动作（加盐、腌制）及性质特征（咸的、有刺激性的）。
family_guide.core_distinction: salt 兼具名词与动词属性（撒盐/腌制）；salty 则专作形容词，除了本义“咸的”，在当代英语口语中极常用于比喻“恼怒的、心怀芥蒂的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 极坏的，糟糕的；严重的；令人恐惧的
lemmas.def_en: extremely bad, unpleasant, or serious; causing great shock or distress

examples.en: We had to cancel the flight because of the terrible weather.
examples.zh: 因为天气太糟糕，我们不得不取消了航班。

examples.en: He made a terrible mistake by ignoring the safety guidelines.
examples.zh: 他无视安全准则，犯下了一个严重的错误。

lemmas.def_zh: 可怕
lemmas.def_en: a quality of extreme unpleasantness

examples.en: The sheer terribleness of the storm left the entire coastal village completely devastated.
examples.zh: 这场风暴的可怕威力使整个沿海村庄彻底沦为废墟。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 terrere（使惊恐、恐吓），本义为“令人恐惧的”，后在现代英语中语义弱化并泛化为“极糟糕的、严重的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 常与同源词 terrific 混淆：terrible 沿袭消极含义表示“极糟糕的/可怕的”，而 terrific 则经历了语义反转，现代英语中多作褒义表示“极好的/绝妙的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 墓穴, 坟墓, 终结, 死亡
lemmas.def_en: death of a person

examples.en: The artist decided to grave an intricate pattern directly into the copper plate.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家决定直接在铜板上雕刻出复杂的图案。

lemmas.def_zh: 重力，引力；严重性；庄严
lemmas.def_en: the force that attracts objects toward each other; extreme importance or seriousness

examples.en: It took several days for the public to grasp the full gravity of the situation.
examples.zh: 公众花了好几天时间才充分认识到局势的严重性。

lemmas.def_zh: 引力, 重力, 沉下
lemmas.def_en: (physics) the force of attraction between all masses in the universe; especially the attraction of the earth's mass for bodies near its surface; ; ; --Albert Einstein

examples.en: Isaac Newton formulated the universal law of gravitation after observing falling apples.
examples.zh: 艾萨克·牛顿在观察苹果落地后提出了万有引力定律。

lemmas.def_zh: 重大, 严肃
lemmas.def_en: a manner that is serious and solemn

examples.en: The graveness of the doctor's tone made everyone realize the illness was serious.
examples.zh: 医生严肃的语气让每个人都意识到病情很严重。

lemmas.def_zh: 庄重的, 严肃的, 重大的, 低沉的
lemmas.def_en: dignified and somber in manner or character and committed to keeping promises

examples.en: The artist decided to grave an intricate pattern directly into the copper plate.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家决定直接在铜板上雕刻出复杂的图案。

lemmas.def_zh: 重力的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or caused by gravitation

examples.en: The spacecraft used the moon's gravitational pull to alter its trajectory toward Mars.
examples.zh: 宇宙飞船利用月球的引力改变了飞向火星的轨道。

lemmas.def_zh: 雕刻，镌刻；铭刻
lemmas.def_en: [T] To carve, sculpt, or engrave words or designs into a hard surface.

examples.en: The artist decided to grave an intricate pattern directly into the copper plate.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家决定直接在铜板上雕刻出复杂的图案。

lemmas.def_zh: 被吸引到，移向；受重力作用下沉
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (+ toward/to) To be naturally attracted to and move toward a person, place, or thing. 2. [I] (physics) To move in response to gravitational pull.

examples.en: Young people tend to gravitate toward large cities in search of better job opportunities.
examples.zh: 年轻人往往会被大城市吸引，去寻找更好的工作机会。

lemmas.def_zh: grave的过去分词
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (archaic) Past participle of grave; to carve or engrave deeply into stone, wood, or metal.

examples.en: Ancient religious laws were carefully graven upon large tablets of black stone.
examples.zh: 古老的宗教戒律被精心雕刻在巨大的黑色石碑上。

lemmas.def_zh: 重大地, 严肃地, 庄重地
lemmas.def_en: in a grave and sober manner

examples.en: The minister looked gravely at the crowd before announcing the emergency measures.
examples.zh: 部长在宣布紧急措施之前，神情庄重地看着人群。

lemmas.def_zh: gravitational（万有引力的）的变形
lemmas.def_en: with respect to gravitation

examples.en: These distant stars are gravitationally bound together to form a stable binary system.
examples.zh: 这些遥远的恒星在引力作用下相互维系，形成稳定的双星系统。

family_guide.root_logic: 该族词汇汇聚了两大源流：日耳曼词源意为'挖掘/刻凿'，演化为'坟墓'与'雕刻'；拉丁词根 grav- 意为'沉重的'，引申出'严重、庄重'及物理意义上的'重力'，整体意象皆具'深沉与凝重'之感。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词 grave 强调后果或神情的'严重、沉重'，其派生词 gravity 既指抽象的'严重性'也指物理的'重力'；而同形的名词与动词 grave 则分别代表具体的'坟墓'和较文雅的'雕刻/铭记'。

lemmas.def_zh: 内部的；体内的；国内的；内心的
lemmas.def_en: existing, occurring, or located within the limits or surface of something; inner

examples.en: The company launched an internal investigation to uncover the cause of the data breach.
examples.zh: 公司展开了内部调查，以查明数据泄露的原因。

examples.en: Doctors were concerned about potential internal bleeding after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故发生后，医生们担心可能会有内出血。

lemmas.def_zh: 在内部；向内；内心深处
lemmas.def_en: inside something, or in a way that relates to the inside of an organization, body, or mind

examples.en: The management decided to resolve the dispute internally rather than going to court.
examples.zh: 管理层决定在内部解决该纠纷，而不是诉诸法庭。

examples.en: Though she seemed calm on the outside, she was panicking internally.
examples.zh: 尽管她表面上看起来很平静，内心却十分恐慌。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 internus（内部的），核心概念始终指向物理空间、组织机构或心理身体的“内部，界限之内”。
family_guide.core_distinction: internal 直接修饰名词表内部属性或结构，internally 作副词修饰动词或形容词，说明动作或状态在内部发生。

lemmas.def_zh: 在任何地方；到任何地方；随便哪里
lemmas.def_en: in, at, or to any place

examples.en: I've searched the whole house, but I can't find my keys anywhere.
examples.zh: 我把整栋房子都找遍了，但哪儿都找不到我的钥匙。

examples.en: You can sit anywhere you like; there are plenty of empty seats.
examples.zh: 你想坐哪儿都可以，空位多得很。

examples.en: Is there anywhere quiet nearby where we can talk?
examples.zh: 附近有没有安静一点的地方供我们谈谈？

family_guide.root_logic: 由不定代词 any（任何）与表示地点的 where 复合而成，核心逻辑是指代空间位置的不确定性或泛指性。

lemmas.def_zh: 奖赏, 奖金, 奖品, 战利品, 捕获
lemmas.def_en: something given for victory or superiority in a contest or competition or for winning a lottery

examples.en: Historians prize these fragile ancient letters because they reveal critical daily details.
examples.zh: 历史学家珍视这些脆弱的古代信件，因为它们揭示了关键的日常细节。

lemmas.def_zh: 珍视，高度重视；撬动，撬开
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To value or esteem someone or something highly. 2. (usually UK) To force open or move something using leverage (pry).

examples.en: Historians prize these fragile ancient letters because they reveal critical daily details.
examples.zh: 历史学家珍视这些脆弱的古代信件，因为它们揭示了关键的日常细节。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 pretium（价值、价格），核心概念围绕“高度评价、极具价值的人事物”，名次引申为“奖赏、战利品”，动词则为“视作珍宝、珍视”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词 prize 侧重于竞赛奖励或难得的成果；动词 prize 侧重于心理上的“极度珍视”（常以 be prized for 的被动形式出现）。

lemmas.def_zh: 零售；以……价格零售；详述
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To sell goods directly to the public in small quantities. 2. [I] (+ at/for) To be sold at a specified retail price. 3. [T] (formal) To tell or recount a story or information in detail.

examples.en: The newly released smartphone will retail for $799.
examples.zh: 这款新发布的智能手机零售价将为799美元。

examples.en: The brand retails its apparel exclusively through authorized flagship stores.
examples.zh: 该品牌专门通过授权旗舰店零售其服装。

lemmas.def_zh: 零售商；零售店
lemmas.def_en: a person or business that sells goods to consumers in a store or online

examples.en: Traditional retailers are expanding their digital platforms to retain market share.
examples.zh: 传统零售商正在扩大其数字化平台以保住市场份额。

examples.en: The electronics retailer offers extended warranties on all major home appliances.
examples.zh: 该电器零售商为所有主要大型家电提供延长保修服务。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 re-（再）与 taillier（剪切），本义指大宗货物被“分切成小份”卖给个人，引申为直接面向消费者的“零售”。
family_guide.core_distinction: retail 侧重零售的动作或销售状态，retailer 则是承担该销售行为的主体（零售商/店）。

lemmas.def_zh: 家庭的, 国内的, 驯养的
lemmas.def_en: of concern to or concerning the internal affairs of a nation

examples.en: Airline companies have reported a steady decline in domestic travel over the past quarter.
examples.zh: 航空公司报告称，过去一个季度国内旅行人数持续下降。

lemmas.def_zh: 家庭式地, 国内地
lemmas.def_en: with respect to the internal affairs of a government

examples.en: The company decided to produce all essential car parts domestically to lower tariffs.
examples.zh: 该公司决定在国内生产所有关键汽车零部件以降低关税。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 家庭的, 家用的
lemmas.def_en: a servant who is paid to perform menial tasks around the household

examples.en: Airline companies have reported a steady decline in domestic travel over the past quarter.
examples.zh: 航空公司报告称，过去一个季度国内旅行人数持续下降。

lemmas.def_zh: 专心于家务, 恋家, 家庭生活
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being domestic or domesticated

examples.en: After years of constant travel, he gladly embraced the quiet comforts of domesticity.
examples.zh: 经过多年的奔波，他欣然接受了家庭生活的平静与惬意。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 domus（房屋、住所），核心概念为“属于家庭内部的”，后政治层面上引申为“属于国家内部的（国内的）”，名词则具象化为家庭内的人（佣人）或事（家事纠纷）。
family_guide.core_distinction: 二者为同形异性词：形容词侧重于“本国的”或“家庭的”属性；名词则指“家政人员”或口语中的“家庭争吵/家事纠纷”。

lemmas.def_zh: 拒绝接纳，驳回，否决；排斥，摈弃
lemmas.def_en: [T] To refuse to accept, approve, consider, or submit to something; to dismiss or turn down.

examples.en: The committee decided to reject the proposal due to severe budget constraints.
examples.zh: 由于严重的预算限制，委员会决定否决该提案。

examples.en: Doctors were relieved to find that the patient's body did not reject the transplanted organ.
examples.zh: 医生们欣慰地发现患者的身体没有排斥移植的器官。

lemmas.def_zh: 拒绝；否决；拒信；（生理）排异反应
lemmas.def_en: the act of refusing to accept something or someone, or the state of being refused

examples.en: Learning to handle rejection gracefully is an essential part of any creative career.
examples.zh: 学会从容应对拒绝是任何创意职业生涯中必不可少的一部分。

examples.en: He received a polite letter of rejection from the publishing house.
examples.zh: 他收到了出版社寄来的一封措辞委婉的拒信。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语前缀 re-（向后、回）+ jacere（投掷），核心意象为“扔回去”，引申为对提议、物品或人的“拒绝、否决、排斥”。
family_guide.core_distinction: reject 为动词原形（表拒绝或排斥的动作）；rejection 为名词形式，既可指拒绝的行为或决定（如拒信），也可指心理上的受挫感或医学上的排异反应。

lemmas.def_zh: 心理学；心理，心理机制
lemmas.def_en: the scientific study of the mind and behavior; the mental characteristics or attitude of a person or group

examples.en: She earned a master's degree in clinical psychology.
examples.zh: 她获得了临床心理学硕士学位。

examples.en: Understanding consumer psychology is essential for designing effective marketing strategies.
examples.zh: 理解消费者心理对于设计有效的营销策略至关重要。

lemmas.def_zh: 心理学家；心理咨询专家
lemmas.def_en: a professional specializing in the study or treatment of the mind and behavior

examples.en: The school psychologist offered support to students dealing with exam stress.
examples.zh: 学校心理咨询师为面临考试压力的学生提供了心理支持。

lemmas.def_zh: 心理的，精神上的；心理学的
lemmas.def_en: related to the mental and emotional state of a person, or to the field of psychology

examples.en: The disaster had a profound psychological impact on the local community.
examples.zh: 这场灾难对当地社区造成了深远的心理影响。

examples.en: Athletes often undergo psychological training to improve their focus under pressure.
examples.zh: 运动员通常接受心理训练以提高高压下的专注力。

lemmas.def_zh: 心理上, 从心理学角度
lemmas.def_en: with regard to psychology

examples.en: Prolonged isolation can be psychologically damaging to individuals who live alone.
examples.zh: 长期的隔离在心理上会对独居者造成伤害。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语词根 psych-（灵魂、心智）与 -logy（学问、研究），整个词族围绕“人类心智、心理机制及其专业研究”展开派生。
family_guide.core_distinction: psychologist 是心理学学者或心理咨询师（侧重行为与心理分析，通常无处方权），注意勿与 psychiatrist（精神病医生，医学背景有处方权）混淆。

lemmas.def_zh: 牙，牙齿；齿状物（如梳齿、齿轮齿）
lemmas.def_en: one of the hard white structures in the mouth used for biting and chewing; a cog or tooth-like projection

examples.en: The dentist advised him to have his infected wisdom tooth removed.
examples.zh: 牙医建议他拔掉那颗发炎的智齿。

examples.en: A broken tooth on the gear caused the entire machine to stop running.
examples.zh: 齿轮上断了一颗齿，导致整台机器停止了运转。

lemmas.def_zh: 牙齿（tooth的复数）；（法律、规章等的）威慑力，约束力
lemmas.def_en: plural of tooth; real power to enforce rules, laws, or decisions effectively

examples.en: Brushing your teeth twice a day helps prevent gum disease.
examples.zh: 每天刷两次牙有助于预防牙龈疾病。

examples.en: The new environmental policy lacks teeth because the fines are far too low.
examples.zh: 这项新的环保政策缺乏威慑力，因为罚款数额实在太低了。

lemmas.def_zh: 无齿的
lemmas.def_en: lacking teeth

examples.en: The baby gave his grandmother a wide, toothless grin full of pure joy.
examples.zh: 那个婴儿咧开没长牙的小嘴，给祖母露出了纯真喜悦的笑容。

lemmas.def_zh: 露齿的
lemmas.def_en: having or showing prominent teeth

examples.en: The young actor flashed a broad, toothy smile at all the waiting photographers.
examples.zh: 这位年轻演员向所有等候的摄影师露出了灿烂的露齿微笑。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 tōþ，核心指口腔中的“牙齿”，引申指工具或机械上的齿状突起；复数形式 teeth 源于古日耳曼语的历史元音音变。
family_guide.core_distinction: tooth 为单数形式（也常用于复合词修饰语如 toothbrush）；teeth 为不规则复数，且引申出法律或制度具有“威慑力、强制力”的比喻义。

lemmas.def_zh: 酒精；乙醇；酒，含酒精饮料
lemmas.def_en: a clear liquid that can make people drunk, or drinks containing this liquid

examples.en: The doctor advised him to cut down on his consumption of alcohol.
examples.zh: 医生建议他减少酒精的摄入量。

examples.en: Rubbing alcohol is commonly used to clean and disinfect minor cuts.
examples.zh: 医用酒精常用于清洁和消毒微小伤口。

lemmas.def_zh: 酗酒者；嗜酒成瘾者
lemmas.def_en: a person suffering from alcoholism who has lost control over their drinking

examples.en: As a recovering alcoholic, he has not touched a drop of wine for five years.
examples.zh: 作为一名正在康复的戒酒者，他已经五年滴酒未沾了。

examples.en: Support groups provide a safe space for alcoholics to share their struggles.
examples.zh: 互助小组为酗酒者提供了一个倾诉困境的安全空间。

lemmas.def_zh: 不含酒精的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by the absence of alcohol

examples.en: The restaurant offers a great selection of nonalcoholic cocktails for designated drivers.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅为指定驾驶员提供了丰富的无酒精鸡尾酒选择。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自阿拉伯语 al-kuḥl（原指极细的矿物粉末），后引申为通过蒸馏提炼出的“精质/精华”，最终专指蒸馏制得的“酒精、乙醇”及含酒精饮品。
family_guide.core_distinction: alcohol 指酒精物质或酒类饮品本身；alcoholic 作名词时专指对酒精产生生理依赖的“酗酒者/酒瘾患者”。

lemmas.def_zh: 警官
lemmas.def_en: uncomplimentary terms for a policeman

examples.en: The thief did not expect to cop a heavy prison sentence for shoplifting.
examples.zh: 那个小偷没想到自己会因为入店行窃而招致重刑。

lemmas.def_zh: 偷窃，顺手牵羊；抓获
lemmas.def_en: [T] (slang) 1. To steal or take something unlawfully. 2. To catch or arrest someone.

examples.en: The thief did not expect to cop a heavy prison sentence for shoplifting.
examples.zh: 那个小偷没想到自己会因为入店行窃而招致重刑。

family_guide.root_logic: 核心本义为“抓住、捕获”（可能源自古法语或拉丁语 capere），名词引申指“抓捕者/警察”，动词延伸为“逮住、拿到、承受（后果）”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词主要作为非正式用语指“警察”；动词则活跃于口语固定短语中，如 cop to（招认）、cop out（临阵退缩）。

lemmas.def_zh: 建议, 情况, 例子, 场合
lemmas.def_en: an occurrence of something

examples.en: This sudden market crash is just another instance of extreme financial volatility.
examples.zh: 这次突然的市场崩盘只是极端金融波动的又一个例子。

lemmas.def_zh: 实例化；例示
lemmas.def_en: a representation of an idea in the form of an instance of it

examples.en: The prototype was a physical instantiation of their innovative design concept.
examples.zh: 该原型是他们创新设计理念的具体化身。

lemmas.def_zh: 举例说明，引以为例
lemmas.def_en: [T] (formal) To cite or mention something as an example.

examples.en: The author instanced several historical events to support his controversial argument.
examples.zh: 作者举出几起历史事件来支持他那颇具争议的论点。

lemmas.def_zh: 例示
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (formal / computing) To represent an abstract concept by a concrete example, or to create a specific instance of a class in programming.

examples.en: We need to instantiate the class before accessing its variables and methods.
examples.zh: 在访问其变量和方法之前，我们需要先实例化该类。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 in-（在……上）与 stare（站立），原指“立于眼前、迫近的事实”，后引申为具体的“事例、实例”。

lemmas.def_zh: 糖, 糖块, 甜言蜜语
lemmas.def_en: a white crystalline carbohydrate used as a sweetener and preservative

examples.en: He did not sugar his coffee because he was on a strict diet.
examples.zh: 他严格节食，所以没有给咖啡加糖。

lemmas.def_zh: 在……中加糖，撒糖于；使甜蜜，粉饰
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] to add sugar to something or coat something with sugar 2. [T] to make something unpleasant seem more appealing or acceptable

examples.en: He did not sugar his coffee because he was on a strict diet.
examples.zh: 他严格节食，所以没有给咖啡加糖。

lemmas.def_zh: 无糖的, 不含糖的
lemmas.def_en: not containing sugar

examples.en: She prefers to chew sugarless gum to protect her teeth from decay.
examples.zh: 她更喜欢嚼无糖口香糖，以保护牙齿免受蛀蚀。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自梵语 śarkarā（砂砾、粗糖），经阿拉伯语传入欧洲，核心语义围绕'天然甜味物质'，引申指'使变甜'或'美化粉饰'。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词指食糖或天然糖分，亦可用作亲昵称呼；动词指加糖使变甜，常引申为委婉粉饰或美化令人不快的事物。

lemmas.def_zh: 奇怪的，古怪的；陌生的，不熟悉的
lemmas.def_en: unusual or surprising; not previously known or familiar

examples.en: I heard a strange noise coming from the attic late at night.
examples.zh: 深夜里我听到阁楼传来一阵奇怪的声音。

examples.en: She felt nervous arriving alone in a strange town.
examples.zh: 独自来到一个陌生的城镇，她感到有些紧张。

lemmas.def_zh: 奇怪地，古怪地；不可思议地
lemmas.def_en: in an unusual, unexpected, or mysterious way

examples.en: Strangely enough, nobody seemed to notice that he was missing.
examples.zh: 说来奇怪，似乎根本没有人注意到他失踪了。

examples.en: The usually noisy classroom was strangely quiet this morning.
examples.zh: 平时喧闹的教室今天早晨出奇地安静。

lemmas.def_zh: 奇妙, 不可思议, 陌生
lemmas.def_en: unusualness as a consequence of not being well known

examples.en: The utter strangeness of the alien landscape left the astronauts completely speechless.
examples.zh: 外星景观那无与伦比的奇特让宇航员们哑口无言。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于拉丁语 extraneus（外来的），词义演变由‘外部的、未见过的’引申为‘陌生的’以及‘不同寻常、奇怪的’。
family_guide.core_distinction: strange 修饰人或事物本身的怪异与不熟悉；strangely 作为副词修饰动词或形容词，常置于句首充当评注性状语（如 strangely enough）。

lemmas.def_zh: 害怕的，恐惧的；担心的；恐怕（用于礼貌地表达歉意或坏消息）
lemmas.def_en: feeling fear, worry, or anxiety; used politely to express regret or introduce unwelcome news

examples.en: There is no need to be afraid of asking questions when you don't understand.
examples.zh: 不懂的时候没必要害怕提问。

examples.en: I'm afraid I won't be able to attend the meeting tomorrow afternoon.
examples.zh: 恐怕我明天下午无法参加会议了。

lemmas.def_zh: 不怕的
lemmas.def_en: oblivious of dangers or perils or calmly resolute in facing them

examples.en: The young activist was unafraid to speak truth to people in power.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的活动家毫不畏惧向掌权者直言真相。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语动词 affray（扰乱、打破平静）的过去分词形式，词义由“受惊扰的”引申演变为“害怕的、担心的”，且现代英语中通常仅作表语使用。

lemmas.def_zh: 揭露，揭发；暴露，显露；使面临（危险等）；（胶片）曝光
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To reveal the hidden or true nature of something, especially something dishonest or illegal. 2. To make something visible or leave it unprotected. 3. To subject photographic film to light.

examples.en: The investigative journalist worked for months to expose the corruption within the company.
examples.zh: 这位调查记者数月潜心调查，最终揭露了该公司内部的腐败行径。

examples.en: Prolonged exposure to the sun can damage your skin.
examples.zh: 长时间暴露在阳光下会损伤皮肤。

lemmas.def_en: vulnerability to the elements; to the action of heat or cold or wind or rain;  or
lemmas.def_zh: 暴露, 揭发, 揭露

examples.en: Prolonged exposure to direct sunlight can cause serious damage to your skin.
examples.zh: 长时间暴露在直射阳光下会对皮肤造成严重损伤。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 暴露的；无遮蔽的；易受攻击的
lemmas.def_en: not protected from high winds, bad weather, or danger; bare
lemmas.usage_note: 常用来修饰处于恶劣天气或地理位置无遮掩的状态（an exposed hilltop / location）。

examples.en: The campsite was on an exposed hill and battered by the wind.
examples.zh: 营地位于一座光秃秃的山坡上，遭受着狂风的袭击。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ex-（向外）+ ponere（放置），核心逻辑为“放置在外面”，引申出显露无遗、揭露隐情以及使面临风险等义。

lemmas.def_zh: 马达, 发动机, 原动力, 汽车
lemmas.def_en: machine that converts other forms of energy into mechanical energy and so imparts motion

examples.en: We decided to motor down to the coast for the holiday weekend.
examples.zh: 我们决定在假期周末开车去海边兜风。

lemmas.def_zh: 开汽车者, 驾车旅行的人
lemmas.def_en: someone who drives (or travels in) an automobile

examples.en: Every motorist should drive with extreme caution during severe winter snowstorms.
examples.zh: 在严重的冬季暴风雪期间，每位驾驶员都应格外谨慎。

lemmas.def_zh: 动力化, 摩托化
lemmas.def_en: the act of motorizing (equiping with motors or with motor vehicles)

examples.en: Rapid motorization in the developing nation brought heavy traffic and severe smog.
examples.zh: 该发展中国家快速的机动化带来了严重的拥堵和雾霾。

lemmas.def_zh: 驾车疾行，乘汽车旅行；用车运送；迅速移动
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To travel by car, especially at a steady speed. 2. [T] To transport someone in a motor vehicle.

examples.en: We decided to motor down to the coast for the holiday weekend.
examples.zh: 我们决定在假期周末开车去海边兜风。

lemmas.def_zh: 使机动化，使摩托化；给……装上马达
lemmas.def_en: [T] To equip a vehicle, machine, or military unit with an engine, motor, or motor vehicles.

examples.en: The army plans to motorize its infantry units by the end of the year.
examples.zh: 军方计划在年底前将其步兵部队完全机动化。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语动词 movere（移动）的过去分词词干 mot-，核心含义为“产生动力的装置”或“使之运动”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词作核心指“电动机/发动机”或修饰运动神经，动词则由名词引申而来，指“乘车疾行”或比喻“快速前进”。

lemmas.def_zh: 迅速的；飞快的；急促的
lemmas.def_en: happening in a short time or at a fast pace

examples.en: The country has undergone rapid economic growth over the past decade.
examples.zh: 在过去的十年中，该国经历了飞速的经济增长。

examples.en: The patient showed signs of rapid recovery after the treatment.
examples.zh: 治疗后，患者表现出快速康复的迹象。

lemmas.def_zh: 迅速地；飞快地
lemmas.def_en: very quickly and in a short period of time

examples.en: Artificial intelligence technologies are developing rapidly worldwide.
examples.zh: 人工智能技术正在全球范围内迅速发展。

examples.en: The fire spread rapidly through the dry timber.
examples.zh: 火势在干燥的木料中迅速蔓延。

lemmas.def_zh: 迅速的；飞快的；急促的
lemmas.def_en: happening in a short time or at a fast pace

examples.en: The country has undergone rapid economic growth over the past decade.
examples.zh: 在过去的十年中，该国经历了飞速的经济增长。

examples.en: The patient showed signs of rapid recovery after the treatment.
examples.zh: 治疗后，患者表现出快速康复的迹象。

lemmas.def_zh: 迅速, 急速, 速度
lemmas.def_en: a rate that is rapid

examples.en: The disease spread through the crowded refugee camp with terrifying rapidity.
examples.zh: 该疾病以极其可怕的速度在拥挤的难民营中蔓延。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 rapidus（迅捷的、湍急的），其动词词根意为“夺取、急扯”，核心意象为“如被猛力卷走般飞速掠过”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 形容词 rapid 侧重短时间内的高速发展或剧烈变化；名词形式几乎总是以复数 rapids 出现，专指河流中的急流险滩。

lemmas.def_zh: 充满，填满；担任，充任；满足
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To make or become full; to occupy a space completely. 2. [T] To take up a job or position and do it.

examples.en: Smoke quickly began to fill the corridor, triggering the fire alarm.
examples.zh: 浓烟迅速弥漫了走廊，触发了火灾报警器。

examples.en: The company is looking for a qualified candidate to fill the vacant position.
examples.zh: 公司正在寻找合适的人选来填补这一空缺职位。

lemmas.def_zh: 未填充的, 空的
lemmas.def_en: of purchase orders that have not been filled

examples.en: Several key positions in the marketing department have remained unfilled for months.
examples.zh: 市场部的几个关键职位已经空缺了好几个月。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 fyllan（使充满、填满），核心逻辑始终围绕“使空间、容器或状态达到饱满、不再空缺”展开，引申出具体的装填动作及各种抽象的状态填补。
family_guide.core_distinction: fill 是表示填满、填充的具体动作；filled 则是其过去分词演变的形容词，表示事物已经处于‘装满的’或‘充满某种情感/物质’的状态。

lemmas.def_zh: 小块土地, 地区图, 图, 阴谋, 情节
lemmas.def_en: a secret scheme to do something (especially something underhand or illegal)

examples.en: The rebels began to plot the overthrow of the corrupt military government.
examples.zh: 叛乱分子开始密谋推翻腐败的军政府。

lemmas.def_zh: 密谋者, 策划者, 绘图员, 绘图仪
lemmas.def_en: a planner who draws up a personal scheme of action

examples.en: Security forces arrested the chief plotter before the dangerous plan was executed.
examples.zh: 安保部队在危险计划实施前逮捕了主谋。

lemmas.def_zh: 密谋，暗中策划；在地图（或图表）上标出；为（小说等）设计情节
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To secretly plan something harmful or illegal. 2. [T] To mark or draw a route, position, or points on a map or chart. 3. [T] To plan the storyline or series of events for a book or play.

examples.en: The rebels began to plot the overthrow of the corrupt military government.
examples.zh: 叛乱分子开始密谋推翻腐败的军政府。

family_guide.root_logic: 本义为“一小块土地”，后延伸至在图纸上“绘制地块轮廓/定位坐标”，进而引申出“构思情节”和“暗中谋划布局（阴谋）”。

lemmas.def_zh: 智力，理解力；情报，情报机构
lemmas.def_en: the ability to learn, understand, and make judgments; secret information collected about an enemy or competitor

examples.en: Recent advances in artificial intelligence are transforming modern medicine.
examples.zh: 人工智能领域的最新进展正在重塑现代医学。

examples.en: Military intelligence suggested that an attack was imminent.
examples.zh: 军事情报表明袭击迫在眉睫。

lemmas.def_en: having the capacity for thought and reason especially to a high degree
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 有智慧的，聪颖的；智能的

examples.en: Dolphins are known to be highly intelligent creatures.
examples.zh: 众所周知，海豚是智商极高的生物。

lemmas.def_en: lacking intelligence
lemmas.def_zh: 缺乏才智的, 无知的, 愚蠢的

examples.en: Making rash decisions without considering the consequences is an unintelligent way to act.
examples.zh: 不考虑后果就草率做决定是一种愚蠢的行为方式。

lemmas.def_en: in an intelligent manner
lemmas.def_zh: 聪明地, 明智地
