examples.en: The diplomat answered every hostile question intelligently and defused the tense situation.
examples.zh: 外交官明智地回答了每一个敌对问题，化解了紧张局势。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 inter-（在……之间）与 legere（挑选、分辨），核心意象为“在复杂事物中进行辨析与领悟的能力”，后引申出“辨识收集到的机密信息（情报）”。

lemmas.def_zh: 黄色的
lemmas.def_en: of the color intermediate between green and orange in the color spectrum; of something resembling the color of an egg yolk

examples.en: The old paper will naturally yellow if it is exposed to direct sunlight.
examples.zh: 如果暴露在直射阳光下，旧纸张自然会变黄。

lemmas.def_zh: 黄色
lemmas.def_en: yellow color or pigment; the chromatic color resembling the hue of sunflowers or ripe lemons

examples.en: The old paper will naturally yellow if it is exposed to direct sunlight.
examples.zh: 如果暴露在直射阳光下，旧纸张自然会变黄。

lemmas.def_zh: 黄色, 猜忌
lemmas.def_en: yellow color or pigment; the chromatic color resembling the hue of sunflowers or ripe lemons

examples.en: The sudden yellowness in his eyes indicated a serious problem with his liver.
examples.zh: 他眼睛突然发黄，表明肝脏出现了严重问题。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）变黄，发黄
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To become yellow, or make something turn yellow, especially because of age.

examples.en: The old paper will naturally yellow if it is exposed to direct sunlight.
examples.zh: 如果暴露在直射阳光下，旧纸张自然会变黄。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 geolu，与 gold（黄金）和 glow（发光）同源，核心意象为“明亮的阳光与金属光泽”，后固定为光谱中的黄色，现代用法中动词引申为因陈旧老化而泛黄，形容词引申为胆怯。
family_guide.core_distinction: 该词族为典型的同形词性转换：形容词表示颜色或胆怯，名词指黄色本身或黄色物体，动词专指随岁月、光照等自然泛黄。

lemmas.def_zh: 米, 公尺, 仪表, 计量器
lemmas.def_en: the basic unit of length adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites (approximately 1.094 yards)

examples.en: The utility company will meter your water usage accurately every month.
examples.zh: 公用事业公司每月都会用仪表精确计量你的用水量。

lemmas.def_en: a function of a topological space that gives, for any two points in the space, a value equal to the distance between them
lemmas.def_zh: [医] 测量的, 米制的, 公制的

examples.en: Customer satisfaction is a key metric we use to evaluate our quarterly business performance.
examples.zh: 客户满意度是我们用来评估季度业务绩效的关键衡量指标。

lemmas.def_zh: 公尺, 格律, 韵律
lemmas.def_en: the basic unit of length adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites (approximately 1.094 yards)

examples.en: The romantic poet strictly followed traditional metre throughout all his sonnets.
examples.zh: 这位浪漫主义诗人所有的十四行诗都严格遵循传统格律。

lemmas.def_zh: 用仪表计量，用仪器测量；按定量供给
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. to measure or record the amount of something using an instrument or meter 2. to release or distribute something in measured amounts

examples.en: The utility company will meter your water usage accurately every month.
examples.zh: 公用事业公司每月都会用仪表精确计量你的用水量。

lemmas.def_zh: 韵律的, 有韵律的, 测量的
lemmas.def_en: based on the meter as a standard of measurement

examples.en: The poet followed a strict metrical pattern to give the verse musical harmony.
examples.zh: 这位诗人遵循了严格的韵律模式，以赋予诗句音乐般的和谐感。

lemmas.def_zh: 韵律地; 计量地
lemmas.def_en: with regard to meter

examples.en: metrically, these poems are matched

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 metron（测量），核心义为“衡量标准”，引申为测量工具（表、计）、长度度量单位（米）及诗歌节拍（格律）。
family_guide.core_distinction: meter 在美式英语中涵盖仪器、长度单位“米”及格律；英式英语中 meter 专指仪器仪表，metre 专指长度单位“米”及诗歌格律。

lemmas.def_zh: （军队的）班，小队；（警察的）专门小组；（体育运动的）代表队，阵容
lemmas.def_en: a small group of people organized for a specific military, policing, or athletic task

examples.en: The manager named a strong 23-man squad for the upcoming tournament.
examples.zh: 主教练公布了参加即将到来的锦标赛的23人强大阵容名单。

examples.en: The bomb disposal squad was immediately dispatched to investigate the suspicious package.
examples.zh: 防爆拆弹小组立即被派往现场调查可疑包裹。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 quadrum（正方形），原指排成方形方阵的士兵队伍，后引申为执行特定任务的“小队”、“专门小组”或“运动队阵容”。

lemmas.def_zh: 浓缩，提纯；集中，全神贯注
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] to reduce a liquid or solution to a denser, stronger form by removing water 2. [I, T] to focus your attention, energy, or resources on one thing

examples.en: I find it impossible to concentrate on my reading in this noisy room.
examples.zh: 在这么吵闹的房间里，我发现自己无法专心阅读。

lemmas.def_zh: 浓缩, 精选
lemmas.def_en: the desired mineral that is left after impurities have been removed from mined ore

examples.en: Mix one part fruit juice concentrate with three parts of cold water.
examples.zh: 将一份浓缩果汁与三份凉水混合。

lemmas.def_zh: 专心，专注力；聚集，汇聚；浓度
lemmas.def_en: the ability to direct all effort and attention; a large number or amount of something in one place; the strength of a solution

examples.en: The sudden noise broke her concentration while studying.
examples.zh: 突如其来的噪音打断了她学习时的专注。

examples.en: The tests revealed an alarmingly high concentration of lead in the water.
examples.zh: 检测显示水中的铅浓度高得令人担忧。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 浓缩的；集中的；全力以赴的
lemmas.def_en: (of a liquid) made stronger by having water removed; involving great effort or concentration
lemmas.usage_note: 既可指浓度高的溶液或果汁（concentrated juice），也可指高度集中的力量或行动（a concentrated attack）。

examples.en: It took a concentrated effort by the whole team to finish the project on time.
examples.zh: 整个团队全力以赴，才按时完成了这个项目。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 com-（共同、聚集）+ centrum（中心），核心意象为“全部汇聚于中心”，引申为把心智力量聚集于一点（专心、聚集）或使物质聚集提纯（浓缩）。
family_guide.core_distinction: concentrate 作名词特指具体的“浓缩物/浓缩液”；concentration 则指“专注、集中”的状态或过程，以及理化层面的“浓度”。

lemmas.def_zh: 科学的；关于科学的；系统的，严谨的
lemmas.def_en: relating to science, or based on the methods and principles of science

examples.en: There is currently no reliable scientific evidence to support this claim.
examples.zh: 目前没有可靠的科学证据来支持这一说法。

examples.en: The team adopted a rigorous scientific approach to analyzing the collected data.
examples.zh: 该团队采用严谨的科学方法来分析所收集的数据。

lemmas.def_zh: 不科学的, 不符合科学原理的
lemmas.def_en: not consistent with the methods or principles of science

examples.en: Relying purely on superstition is an unscientific way to make critical decisions.
examples.zh: 纯粹依靠迷信是一种做出关键决定的不科学方式。

lemmas.def_zh: 合乎科学地, 学问上, 系统地
lemmas.def_en: with respect to science; in a scientific way

examples.en: The new medical treatment has been scientifically proven to be safe.
examples.zh: 这种新的医疗方法已被科学证实是安全的。

lemmas.def_zh: unscientific的变形
lemmas.def_en: in an unscientific way; not according to the principles of science

examples.en: The survey results were gathered unscientifically, making the data entirely unreliable.
examples.zh: 调查结果是以不符合科学原理的方式收集的，导致数据完全不可靠。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 scientia（知识）与 -fic（产生/致使，源自 facere），核心逻辑为“产生系统知识的”，后引申为“与科学相关的”或“符合科学严谨规范的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: scientific 指客观符合科学方法或与科学相关的；而形近词 scientistic（唯科学主义的）带有贬义，指盲目崇拜科学或在非自然科学领域滥用科学范式。

lemmas.def_zh: 神秘的事物；谜；神秘感；悬疑作品
lemmas.def_en: something that is difficult or impossible to understand or explain

examples.en: The cause of the plane crash remains a complete mystery to investigators.
examples.zh: 这起飞机坠毁的原因对调查人员来说仍是一个彻底的谜。

examples.en: She loves reading murder mystery novels in her spare time.
examples.zh: 她业余时间喜欢读谋杀悬疑小说。

lemmas.def_zh: 神秘化, 骗人的把戏, 不可思议
lemmas.def_en: confusion resulting from failure to understand

examples.en: The magician relied on clever mystification to keep the audience guessing.
examples.zh: 魔术师依靠巧妙的故弄玄虚让观众猜不透其中的奥秘。

lemmas.def_zh: 神秘的；难以捉摸的；诡秘的
lemmas.def_en: strange, not known, or not understood

examples.en: The antique shop owner died under mysterious circumstances.
examples.zh: 那位古董店老板在神秘的境况下去世了。

examples.en: He gave her a mysterious smile and refused to say anything more.
examples.zh: 他冲她神秘地笑了一下，不肯再多说什么。

lemmas.def_zh: 神秘地; 不可思议地; 诡秘地; 故弄玄虚地
lemmas.def_en: in a cryptic manner;  he said cryptically

examples.en: Her car keys mysteriously vanished from the kitchen table this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上，她的车钥匙莫名其妙地从厨房桌上消失了。

lemmas.def_zh: 使迷惑，使困惑不解；使神秘化
lemmas.def_en: [T] To confuse or puzzle someone completely, often because something is impossible to understand or explain.

examples.en: The sudden disappearance of the priceless painting continued to mystify local detectives.
examples.zh: 这幅无价名画的离奇失踪仍然让当地侦探们大惑不解。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 myein（闭合嘴或眼）衍生的 mysterion（秘仪），核心义为“不能言传、超出认知与解释的事物”。

lemmas.def_zh: （运动队）球衣；针织套头衫，毛衣
lemmas.def_en: a shirt worn by members of a sports team; a knitted garment with long sleeves worn on the upper body

examples.en: Fans packed the stadium, many proudly wearing the team's iconic red jersey.
examples.zh: 球迷们挤满了体育场，许多人自豪地穿着该队标志性的红色球衣。

examples.en: She pulled on a thick woollen jersey to keep out the autumn chill.
examples.zh: 她套上一件厚厚的羊毛针织衫来抵御秋日的寒意。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自英吉利海峡泽西岛（Jersey）的地名，因当地特产的针织毛线而得名，核心语义由“针织面料”演变为“针织套头毛衣”，现代英语中尤指“运动队的比赛球衣”。

lemmas.def_zh: 拼写，拼出；招致，意味着
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. To say, write, or form the letters of a word in the correct order. 2. [T] To have something, usually bad, as a result; to mean

examples.en: Under her spell, he forgot all about his previous doubts and worries.
examples.zh: 在她的魅力吸引下，他忘却了之前的所有疑虑与担忧。

lemmas.def_zh: 拼错，写错（词）
lemmas.def_en: [T] To spell a word with the wrong letters or in the wrong order

examples.en: Be careful not to misspell difficult foreign names on the official documents.
examples.zh: 注意不要在官方文件上拼错难记的外国名字。

lemmas.def_zh: 符咒, 魅力, 轮值, 轮班, 工作时间, 一次发作
lemmas.def_en: a psychological state induced by (or as if induced by) a magical incantation

examples.en: Under her spell, he forgot all about his previous doubts and worries.
examples.zh: 在她的魅力吸引下，他忘却了之前的所有疑虑与担忧。

lemmas.def_zh: 拼, 拼字, 拼法
lemmas.def_en: forming words with letters according to the principles underlying accepted usage

examples.en: Always check your spelling before submitting an important job application online.
examples.zh: 在线提交重要求职申请前，务必检查拼写。

lemmas.def_zh: 斯佩尔特小麦（一种耐寒硬粒小麦）
lemmas.def_en: hardy wheat grown mostly in Europe for livestock feed

examples.en: He spelt out the complex instructions so that everyone understood clearly.
examples.zh: 他详细说明了复杂的指示，以便大家都能清楚理解。

lemmas.def_zh: 拼错
lemmas.def_en: a spelling that is incorrect

examples.en: A single misspelling in the computer code caused the entire system crash.
examples.zh: 计算机代码中的一个拼写错误导致了整个系统崩溃。

lemmas.def_zh: 拼字者, 缀字课本
lemmas.def_en: someone who spells words

examples.en: She proved to be the best speller in our entire graduating class.
examples.zh: 事实证明她是全毕业班中最擅长拼写的人。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语‘讲诉、传达’，后分化为‘念出符咒（名词引申为咒语）’与‘逐字母读出（引申为拼写）’，另并入表‘替换、轮班’的同源线索演变为‘一段时间’。
family_guide.core_distinction: spelling 专指拼写这一行为或拼写法；spelt 作名词时特指古老的‘斯佩尔特小麦’，切勿仅将其视作 spell 的英式过去式/分词。

lemmas.def_zh: 嵌板, 仪表板, 专题讨论小组, 全体陪审员
lemmas.def_en: sheet that forms a distinct (usually flat and rectangular) section or component of something

examples.en: The panel of experts will review all the research proposals tomorrow.
examples.zh: 专家组将于明天审查所有的研究方案。

lemmas.def_zh: 专门小组成员, 演出小组成员, 参加电视公开讨论会的成员, 答问小组的成员
lemmas.def_en: a member of a panel

examples.en: Each panelist had three minutes to present their unique perspective on climate.
examples.zh: 每位小组成员有三分钟时间阐述对气候的独特看法。

lemmas.def_zh: 小组辩论, 猜谜参加者
lemmas.def_en: a member of a panel

examples.en: The television show invited a famous author as a guest panellist.
examples.zh: 该电视节目邀请了一位著名作家作为客座嘉宾讨论员。

lemmas.def_zh: 用嵌板装饰；给……安装饰板
lemmas.def_en: [T] To cover, line, or decorate a wall, door, or surface with flat panels.

examples.en: The panel of experts will review all the research proposals tomorrow.
examples.zh: 专家组将于明天审查所有的研究方案。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 pannus（布片），经古法语演变为小块羊皮纸（上面常写有陪审员名单，引申出‘专家小组/讨论组’），后泛指平整的长方形板片（如木嵌板、仪表板、太阳能板）。

lemmas.def_zh: 至高无上的；最高的；极度的，最大的
lemmas.def_en: highest in rank, authority, or degree; greatest

examples.en: The Supreme Court ruled that the controversial law was unconstitutional.
examples.zh: 最高法院裁定该争议性法律违宪。

examples.en: She faced the daunting challenge with supreme confidence in her team.
examples.zh: 她对自己的团队抱有极大的信心，从容面对这项艰巨的挑战。

lemmas.def_zh: 崇高地；至上地
lemmas.def_en: to the maximum degree

examples.en: The veteran athlete looked supremely confident before the final championship match began.
examples.zh: 在决赛开始前，这位老将显得信心十足。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 supremus（super 的最高级形式），核心本义为“位置或层级在最上方的”，引申为权力、地位或程度上的“至高无上”与“极度”。

lemmas.def_zh: 维持，保持；支撑，供养；遭受，蒙受（损失、伤亡）
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To support, maintain, or nourish something over time. 2. To experience or suffer damage, injury, or loss

examples.en: The ecosystem cannot sustain such high levels of resource consumption.
examples.zh: 该生态系统无法承受如此高水平的资源消耗。

examples.en: Fortunately, the driver sustained only minor injuries in the accident.
examples.zh: 幸运的是，司机在事故中只受了轻伤。

lemmas.def_zh: 可持续的；不破坏环境的
lemmas.def_en: able to be maintained at a certain level without depleting natural resources

examples.en: The company is transitioning toward more sustainable manufacturing methods.
examples.zh: 该公司正在向更具可持续性的生产方式转型。

lemmas.def_zh: 可持续性；生态平衡
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being able to continue over a period of time without depleting natural resources

examples.en: Long-term economic sustainability requires investment in clean energy.
examples.zh: 长期的经济可持续性需要对清洁能源进行投资。

lemmas.def_zh: 生活资料, 生计, 食物, 支持
lemmas.def_en: a source of materials to nourish the body

examples.en: The stranded hikers relied on berries and clean spring water for sustenance.
examples.zh: 受困的徒步旅行者依靠浆果和纯净的泉水维持生命。

lemmas.def_zh: 支持, 维持, 支持物
lemmas.def_en: the act of sustaining life by food or providing a means of subsistence

examples.en: Effective logistics are essential for the sustainment of military troops abroad.
examples.zh: 高效的后勤对于维持海外军队至关重要。

lemmas.def_zh: 支持者, 维持者
lemmas.def_en: someone who upholds or maintains

examples.en: Family support remained the main sustainer of his hope during tough times.
examples.zh: 在艰难时期，家庭的支持是他希望的主要支柱。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 sub-（从下方）+ tenere（握住、支撑），字面核心为“从底下托住”，引申为长期支撑维持、承受负荷或经受打击。
family_guide.core_distinction: sustain 是动词核心（维持/遭受）；sustainable 侧重可长期保持且不耗尽资源的性质；sustainability 为对应抽象名词。

lemmas.def_zh: 冒险, 冒险经历
lemmas.def_en: a wild and exciting undertaking (not necessarily lawful)

examples.en: Hiking through the dense rainforest was an unforgettable adventure for the tourists.
examples.zh: 徒步穿过茂密的热带雨林对游客们来说是一次难忘的冒险。

lemmas.def_zh: 冒险家, 投机者
lemmas.def_en: a person who enjoys taking risks

examples.en: The famous adventurer spent years exploring the remote wilderness of Alaska.
examples.zh: 这位著名的探险家花了数年时间探索阿拉斯加偏远的荒野。

lemmas.def_zh: 运气不佳的遭遇
lemmas.def_en: an instance of misfortune

examples.en: The hiker suffered a serious injury due to an unfortunate misadventure.
examples.zh: 由于一次不幸的事故，这名徒步者受了重伤。

lemmas.def_zh: 喜欢冒险；敢作敢为
lemmas.def_en: the trait of being adventurous

examples.en: Her adventurousness led her to try dangerous extreme sports around the world.
examples.zh: 她勇于冒险的性格促使她尝试世界各地的极限运动。

lemmas.def_zh: 冒险，涉险；拿……冒险
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. [I] To take risks or venture boldly into the unknown. 2. [T] To risk or hazard something on an uncertain outcome.

examples.en: Hiking through the dense rainforest was an unforgettable adventure for the tourists.
examples.zh: 徒步穿过茂密的热带雨林对游客们来说是一次难忘的冒险。

lemmas.def_zh: 喜欢冒险的, 有进取心的, 危险的
lemmas.def_en: willing to undertake or seeking out new and daring enterprises

examples.en: He took an adventurous road trip across the entire continent last summer.
examples.zh: 去年夏天，他踏上了一场横跨整个大陆的充满冒险的自驾游。

lemmas.def_zh: 没有危险的, 不冒险的
lemmas.def_en: lacking in boldness

examples.en: He led an unadventurous life, always preferring familiar routines to risky travels.
examples.zh: 他过着平淡无奇的生活，总是更喜欢熟悉的日常而非冒险的旅行。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 advenire（到来、发生），词面为“将要发生的事”，由“命运/机缘”引申指充满未知、危险与刺激的“冒险经历”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词（指冒险经历或奇遇）为现代核心用法；动词为文学性/较少见用法（相当于 venture，表示冒险前进或大胆尝试）。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）结冰，（使）凝结；冷冻；（使）僵住；冻结（资产等）
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. to turn into ice or become hard because of cold, or preserve food at very low temperatures. 2. to suddenly stop moving. 3. to officially stop or restrict movement or access to funds.

examples.en: Water will freeze when the temperature drops below zero.
examples.zh: 气温降至零度以下时，水就会结冰。

examples.en: The government decided to freeze the prices of basic foods.
examples.zh: 政府决定冻结基本食品的价格。

lemmas.def_zh: 呆住，僵住，停顿不动
lemmas.def_en: [I] To stop moving suddenly and become completely still, typically through fear or shock.

examples.en: We walked carefully across the frozen lake to avoid slipping on the ice.
examples.zh: 我们小心翼翼地穿过结冰的湖面，以免在冰上滑倒。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）结冰；冷冻；呆住（freeze 的过去式）
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] past tense of freeze; to turn into ice, become extremely cold, or suddenly become motionless

examples.en: He froze in terror when he heard the footsteps behind him.
examples.zh: 听到身后的脚步声时，他吓得僵在了原地。

lemmas.def_zh: 使解冻, 解除(资金)的冻结
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To unfreeze frozen food, pipes, or financial assets means to thaw them or remove official restrictions on their use.

examples.en: The bank agreed to unfreeze his assets after the investigation concluded.
examples.zh: 调查结束后，银行同意解冻他的资产。

lemmas.def_zh: unfreeze的过去分词
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] Past participle of unfreeze; thawed from ice or released from a financial or legal freeze.

examples.en: Once the meat has unfrozen completely, you can begin marinating it.
examples.zh: 肉完全解冻后，你就可以开始腌制了。

lemmas.def_zh: unfreeze的过去式
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] Past tense of unfreeze; thawed or lifted restrictions on.

examples.en: The government unfroze the disputed funds after both parties reached an agreement.
examples.zh: 双方达成协议后，政府解冻了有争议的资金。

lemmas.def_zh: 冻结的, 冰冷的, 严寒的, 冻伤的, 冷酷的
lemmas.def_en: turned into ice; affected by freezing or by long and severe cold

examples.en: We walked carefully across the frozen lake to avoid slipping on the ice.
examples.zh: 我们小心翼翼地穿过结冰的湖面，以免在冰上滑倒。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 frēosan（结冰、变冷），核心语义为‘因极度寒冷使液体凝固或使物体失去流动性’，引申出‘动作瞬间停滞、吓呆’以及‘经济上的资产或物价冻结’。
family_guide.core_distinction: froze 是 freeze 的过去式，表示过去发生的动作；frozen 既可作为过去分词（v.）构成完成时与被动语态，也高度形容词化（adj.），指‘冰冻的’或状态‘吓僵的’。

lemmas.def_zh: 景观, 视力, 眼界, 阅读, 见解, 意见
lemmas.def_en: an instance of visual perception

examples.en: Sailors climbed up to the crow's nest to sight land ahead.
examples.zh: 水手们爬上桅顶瞭望台以看清前方是否有陆地。

lemmas.def_zh: 照准；瞄准；视线
lemmas.def_en: the act of observing

examples.en: The recent sighting of a rare leopard excited wildlife researchers in the region.
examples.zh: 最近一次目击到稀有豹子的事件让该地区的野生动物研究人员非常兴奋。

lemmas.def_zh: 近视，远视
lemmas.def_en: normal use of the faculty of vision

examples.en: Her short-sightedness made it difficult to read road signs without her glasses.
examples.zh: 她的近视使她不戴眼镜就很难看清路标。

lemmas.def_zh: 看见，发现；用瞄准器对准
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] to manage to see or catch sight of something, especially from a distance. 2. [T] to aim a weapon or telescope at something.

examples.en: Sailors climbed up to the crow's nest to sight land ahead.
examples.zh: 水手们爬上桅顶瞭望台以看清前方是否有陆地。

lemmas.def_zh: 不悦目的, 不雅观的, 难看的, 丑陋的
lemmas.def_en: unpleasant to look at

examples.en: The old abandoned factory was an unsightly blot on the peaceful rural landscape.
examples.zh: 那座废弃的老工厂是宁静乡村景色中一处难看的瑕疵。

lemmas.def_zh: 盲的, 不可见的
lemmas.def_en: lacking sight

examples.en: The sightless cat navigated the unfamiliar room using its keen sense of smell.
examples.zh: 那只失明的猫凭借敏锐的嗅觉在陌生的房间里穿行。

lemmas.def_zh: 看着舒服的, 悦目的, 能望见美好景色的
lemmas.def_en: very pleasing to the eye

examples.en: They built their vacation cottage on a sightly hill overlooking the blue bay.
examples.zh: 他们把度假小屋建在一座能俯瞰蓝色海湾、景色悦人的小山丘上。

lemmas.def_zh: 未看见的, 不在视野中的, 被遮住视线的
lemmas.def_en: unable to see; --Kenneth Jernigan

examples.en: The driver was unsighted by the tall truck ahead and missed the turn.
examples.zh: 司机的视线被前方的高卡车挡住，错过了转弯处。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 sīhþ（与 see 同源），核心逻辑由动词“看”衍生为视觉能力、所见之景以及看见的具体行为。
family_guide.core_distinction: sight 作名词泛指视力、视野或所见景象，而 sighting 专指对罕见、搜寻目标或异常事物的“目击事件”。

lemmas.def_zh: 使能够，使有能力；使成为可能；激活，启用
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] to give someone the ability, authority, or means to do something. 2. [T] to make something possible. 3. [T] to activate or turn on a system or feature

examples.en: The new funding will enable the research team to continue their work.
examples.zh: 这笔新资金将使研究团队能够继续他们的工作。

examples.en: You can enable automatic updates in the device settings.
examples.zh: 你可以在设备设置中开启自动更新功能。

family_guide.root_logic: 由前缀 en-（使……，赋予……）加形容词 able（有能力的）构成，核心逻辑即“赋予能力或创造条件，使某事成为可能”。

lemmas.def_zh: 追赶，追捕，追逐；驱逐
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. To run after or follow someone or something in order to catch them. 2. [T] To drive away.

examples.en: The police gave chase when the stolen vehicle sped through the red light.
examples.zh: 当被盗车辆闯红灯疾驰而去时，警方展开了追捕。

lemmas.def_zh: 追求, 狩猎, 追逐
lemmas.def_en: the act of pursuing in an effort to overtake or capture

examples.en: The police gave chase when the stolen vehicle sped through the red light.
examples.zh: 当被盗车辆闯红灯疾驰而去时，警方展开了追捕。

lemmas.def_zh: 猎人, 驱逐舰
lemmas.def_en: a person who is pursuing and trying to overtake or capture

examples.en: The naval fleet deployed a fast chaser to pursue the suspicious vessel.
examples.zh: 海军舰队部署了一艘快速驱逐舰去追击可疑船只。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 chacier（狩猎、追赶），核心意象为“紧跟在后以图捕获或驱逐”，后引申为对梦想、目标等抽象事物的热切“追求”。

lemmas.def_zh: 捐赠，捐献（财物、器官或血液）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To give money, food, clothes, blood, or organs to help a person or organization.

examples.en: He regularly donates blood to the local red cross.
examples.zh: 他定期向当地红十字会无偿献血。

examples.en: The businessman decided to donate a million dollars to medical research.
examples.zh: 这位商人决定向医学研究捐款一百万美元。

lemmas.def_zh: 捐款；捐赠物；捐赠行为
lemmas.def_en: something (such as money or goods) that is given to a charity or organization

examples.en: The charity relies almost entirely on voluntary donations.
examples.zh: 该慈善机构几乎完全依靠自愿捐款运作。

examples.en: We would like to make a small donation in memory of our teacher.
examples.zh: 我们想作一笔小额捐赠，以纪念我们的老师。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 donare（赠与、奉献），核心语义为‘为了公益、慈善或帮助他人而无偿赠送（金钱、物资、血液或器官）’。

lemmas.def_zh: 调节，调整，微调；适应，习惯
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. [T] To change or move something slightly to achieve a desired fit, appearance, or functioning. 2. [I] (+ to) To adapt to a new situation or condition.

examples.en: He adjusted his rearview mirror before driving off.
examples.zh: 开车前他调整了后视镜。

examples.en: It took her a while to adjust to living alone.
examples.zh: 她花了一段时间才适应独自生活。

lemmas.def_zh: 调整，微调；适应
lemmas.def_en: a small change made to something, or the process of adapting

examples.en: We may need to make a few minor adjustments to the schedule.
examples.zh: 我们可能需要对时间表做一些微调。

examples.en: Starting a new school often requires a period of emotional adjustment.
examples.zh: 转入新学校通常需要一段心理适应期。

lemmas.def_zh: 调整员, 调停者, 调节器
lemmas.def_en: one who investigates insurance claims or claims for damages and recommends an effective settlement

examples.en: An insurance adjuster visited our house to inspect the damage caused by the storm.
examples.zh: 一名保险理赔调整员来到我们家，检查暴风雨造成的损失。

lemmas.def_zh: 调整者, 调停者, 调节器
lemmas.def_en: one who investigates insurance claims or claims for damages and recommends an effective settlement

examples.en: The claims adjustor reviewed the vehicle collision report before approving the compensation.
examples.zh: 理赔调节人审核了车辆碰撞报告后批准了赔偿。

lemmas.def_zh: 可调节的，可调整的
lemmas.def_en: able to be changed in size, position, or degree to suit different needs

examples.en: This ergonomic chair comes with fully adjustable armrests.
examples.zh: 这款人体工学椅配有完全可调节的扶手。

lemmas.def_zh: [经] 未调整的
lemmas.def_en: not altered to fit certain requirements

examples.en: The unadjusted figures showed a higher inflation rate before seasonal factors were removed.
examples.zh: 在剔除季节性因素之前，未调整的数据显示出更高的通胀率。

lemmas.def_zh: 调整的, 调节的
lemmas.def_en: conducive to adjustment

examples.en: The counselor suggested adjustive strategies to help the student cope with exam stress.
examples.zh: 辅导员提出了调节策略，以帮助该学生应对考试压力。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于拉丁语 ad-（朝向）+ just（恰当、正确），核心逻辑是“使事物靠近正确、恰当或舒适的状态”，引申为微调或适应。
family_guide.core_distinction: 词族派生关系规整，adjust 为核心动词（调整/适应），adjustment 为名词形式（微调动作或适应期），adjustable 为形容词（可调节的）。

lemmas.def_zh: 科技，技术；科技行业；技术员，技师
lemmas.def_en: short for technology or technician; the technology sector or a person skilled in technical work

examples.en: She decided to leave finance to pursue a career in the booming tech industry.
examples.zh: 她决定离开金融业，去蓬勃发展的科技行业谋求发展。

examples.en: If the laboratory equipment malfunctions, notify the on-duty tech right away.
examples.zh: 如果实验室设备出现故障，请立即通知值班技术员。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 tekhnē（技艺、工艺），在现代英语中作为 technology 或 technician 的口语化截断缩略词，泛指科技、科技行业或技术人员。

lemmas.def_zh: 最小的, 最低的
lemmas.def_en: the least possible

examples.en: We must keep our operating expenses to a minimum during the financial crisis.
examples.zh: 在金融危机期间，我们必须将运营支出保持在最低限度。

lemmas.def_zh: 最小值
lemmas.def_en: the smallest possible quantity

examples.en: We must keep our operating expenses to a minimum during the financial crisis.
examples.zh: 在金融危机期间，我们必须将运营支出保持在最低限度。

lemmas.def_en: the act of reducing something to the least possible amount or degree or position
lemmas.def_zh: 减到最小限度, 估到最低额, 轻视

examples.en: Cost minimization remains the primary operational goal for the manufacturing company this year.
examples.zh: 成本最小化仍然是这家制造公司今年的主要运营目标。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To reduce something to the lowest possible level, amount, or degree. 2. [T] To make something seem less important than it really is.
lemmas.def_zh: 将……减到最低程度，降低；贬低，低估

examples.en: We took several precautions during the trip to minimize the risk of accidents.
examples.zh: 我们在旅途中采取了几项预防措施，以将事故风险降到最低。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To reduce something to the lowest possible level; to make something seem less important than it really is.
lemmas.def_zh: 使减到最少，使降到最低限度；对……轻描淡写，贬低

examples.en: The government introduced strict new rules to minimise the negative impact on wildlife.
examples.zh: 政府出台了严格的新规定，以尽量减少对野生动物的不利影响。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 minimus（最小的，为 minor 的最高级），核心概念始终围绕“数量、程度或限度达到最小或最低”。
family_guide.core_distinction: minimum 作形容词表示“最低的、起码的”（置于名词前作定语）；作名词指“最低限度、最小量”（常与介词 of 或 to 搭配）。

lemmas.def_zh: 旅程, 旅行, 行程
lemmas.def_en: the act of traveling from one place to another

examples.en: The daring explorers planned to journey through the dense jungle on foot.
examples.zh: 勇敢的探险家们计划徒步穿越茂密的丛林。

lemmas.def_zh: 旅行，出行，漫游
lemmas.def_en: [I] To undertake a journey or travel somewhere, especially over a long distance.

examples.en: The daring explorers planned to journey through the dense jungle on foot.
examples.zh: 勇敢的探险家们计划徒步穿越茂密的丛林。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 jornee（一天的行程、一天的工作时间），派生自拉丁语 diurnum（每天的），核心语义从“一天的行程”演变为泛指“路途、旅程”，进而引申为人生或精神的“历程”。

lemmas.def_en: the sense organ for hearing and equilibrium
lemmas.def_zh: 耳朵；听力；谷穗

examples.en: She whispered a secret into his ear.
examples.zh: 她在他耳边低声说了一个秘密。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语，本义指听觉器官或谷物的穗状结构。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To ask God to protect someone or something. 2. [T] To praise or thank God. 3. [T] (usually passive) To endow or favor someone with something pleasant or advantageous.
lemmas.def_zh: 祝福，祈福；保佑；赞美，称颂

examples.en: May fortune bless your new venture.
examples.zh: 愿幸运眷顾你的新事业。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (archaic / poetic) Past tense and past participle of bless; to ask divine favor upon or bring happiness to.
lemmas.def_zh: bless的过去式和过去分词

examples.en: The elderly poet felt blest with good health and faithful lifelong friends.
examples.zh: 这位老诗人感到自己享有健康的体魄和忠诚的挚友，倍感幸福。

lemmas.def_en: the formal act of approving
lemmas.def_zh: 祝福；好事，福气

examples.en: The rain was a blessing for the parched crops.
examples.zh: 这场雨对久旱的庄稼来说是一场及时的恩赐。

lemmas.def_en: a state of supreme happiness
lemmas.def_zh: 幸福

examples.en: They enjoyed the quiet blessedness of living far away from the noisy city.
examples.zh: 他们享受着远离喧嚣城市的宁静与幸福。

lemmas.def_en: in a blessed manner
lemmas.def_zh: 幸福地, 神圣地

examples.en: The long summer afternoon was blessedly cool beneath the shade of the trees.
examples.zh: 在树荫的遮蔽下，漫长的夏日午后显得格外凉爽宜人。

lemmas.def_en: not provided with something desirable
lemmas.def_zh: 不受天福的, 无福的, 不受祝福的, 邪恶的, 被诅咒的, 倒霉的, 不幸的

examples.en: The ancient fortress stood on an unblessed hill shunned by all local villagers.
examples.zh: 那座古老的堡垒耸立在一座被当地所有村民避之不及的荒凉山丘上。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，本义为用血祝圣，后引申为祝福、赐福。
family_guide.core_distinction: bless为动词形式；blessing为名词，常指具体的福气或幸事。

lemmas.def_en: the officer below the master on a commercial ship
lemmas.def_zh: [n.] 伙伴；配偶；同事 [v.] 交配；结伴

examples.en: Swans typically mate for life.
examples.zh: 天鹅通常终生厮守。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (especially of animals) To engage in sex in order to produce young; to bring together to breed.
lemmas.def_zh: （使动物）交配；结为伴侣

examples.en: Swans typically mate for life.
examples.zh: 天鹅通常终生厮守。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To tangle or twist together into a thick, messy, and compact mass.
lemmas.def_zh: 缠结成团；铺垫子

examples.en: The dog's fur began to mat after days in the rain.
examples.zh: 在雨中呆了几天后，狗的毛发开始打结缠结了。

lemmas.def_en: (used colloquially) having the relationship of friends or pals
lemmas.def_zh: 易为人亲近的, 融洽的

examples.en: He adopted a matey tone to put the nervous new recruits at ease.
examples.zh: 他采取了一种亲近随和的语气，让紧张的新兵放松下来。

lemmas.def_en: not mated sexually
lemmas.def_zh: 未配对的,(鸟等)未交配的

examples.en: The unmated male swan swam alone along the quiet edge of the lake.
examples.zh: 那只未配对的公天鹅独自在宁静的湖边游弋。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中世纪低地德语，本义为一同进餐的同伴，引申为配偶、伙伴及交配。
family_guide.core_distinction: mate既可作伙伴或交配，mat作为动词意为缠结或铺垫子，两者拼写与含义均不同。

lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To make sure that a law, rule, or system is obeyed. 2. To force something to happen or be accepted.
lemmas.def_zh: 强制执行，贯彻（法律、规定）；强加，迫使

examples.en: The police will strictly enforce the new traffic regulations.
examples.zh: 警方将严格执行新的交通法规。

lemmas.def_en: the act of enforcing; ensuring observance of or obedience to
lemmas.def_zh: 执行；实施

examples.en: Strict enforcement of the law is essential for public safety.
examples.zh: 严格执法对公共安全至关重要。

lemmas.def_en: one whose job it is to execute unpleasant tasks for a superior
lemmas.def_zh: 实施者, 强制者

examples.en: The coach served as the strict enforcer of team rules throughout the season.
examples.zh: 在整个赛季中，教练一直严格执行着球队的纪律。

lemmas.def_en: not enforced; not compelled especially by legal or police action
lemmas.def_zh: [法] 未执行的, 未生效的

examples.en: The old parking regulation remained unenforced for years until complaints flooded in.
examples.zh: 这项旧的停车规定多年来一直未被执行，直到投诉纷至沓来。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 en-（使进入状态）+ force（力量、武力），引申为强制执行或加强。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To repair or renovate a building, work of art, or object to return it to its original condition. 2. [T] To bring back a former condition, feeling, or state of affairs. 3. [T] (formal) To return something lost or stolen to its owner.
lemmas.def_zh: 修复，整修（建筑物、艺术品等）；恢复，使复原；归还

examples.en: Efforts are underway to restore power to the affected areas.
examples.zh: 受灾地区的电力恢复工作正在进行中。

lemmas.def_en: the reign of Charles II in England; 1660-1685
lemmas.def_zh: 恢复；修复；整修

examples.en: The restoration of the historic castle took over five years.
examples.zh: 这座历史古堡的修复工作耗时五年多。

lemmas.def_en: a medicine that strengthens and invigorates
lemmas.def_zh: 兴奋药, 补药

examples.en: She drank a warm herbal restorative to regain her strength after the fever.
examples.zh: 退烧后，她喝了一杯温热的草药补剂以恢复体力。

lemmas.def_en: a skilled worker who is employed to restore or refinish buildings or antique furniture
lemmas.def_zh: 修补者, 修建者, 修补物, 恢复剂

examples.en: The skilled restorer spent months repairing the cracked fifteenth-century oil painting.
examples.zh: 这位技艺高超的修复师花了数月时间修复这幅开裂的十五世纪油画。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 re-（回）+ store（立起、修复），核心意象为使事物复原到原始良好状态。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To look at something closely and critically to check its condition or detect errors.
lemmas.def_zh: 检查，审视；视察，检阅

examples.en: Engineers arrived to inspect the bridge for structural damage.
examples.zh: 工程师们赶来检查大桥是否有结构性损坏。

lemmas.def_en: a high ranking police officer
lemmas.def_zh: 检查员；视察员；督察

examples.en: A health inspector closed down the unsanitary restaurant.
examples.zh: 一名卫生检查员责令关闭了这家不卫生的餐馆。

lemmas.def_en: a formal or official examination
lemmas.def_zh: 检查；检验；视察

examples.en: Regular vehicle inspection helps prevent accidents on the road.
examples.zh: 定期进行车辆检查有助于预防道路事故。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 in-（进入）+ spect（看），意为“往里面仔细看”，引申为检查和审视。
family_guide.core_distinction: inspector指执行检查的人员；inspection指具体的检查行为或过程。

lemmas.def_en: an elaborate and systematic plan of action
lemmas.def_zh: [n.] 方案；阴谋 [v.] 密谋；策划

examples.en: They uncovered a scheme to defraud elderly citizens.
examples.zh: 他们揭露了一项针对老年人的诈骗阴谋。

lemmas.def_zh: 概要, 图解, 略图
lemmas.def_en: an internal representation of the world; an organization of concepts and actions that can be revised by new information about the world

examples.en: The database administrator updated the schema to improve search performance significantly.
examples.zh: 数据库管理员更新了模式以显著提升检索性能。

lemmas.def_zh: 图表
lemmas.def_en: diagram of an electrical or mechanical system
a planner who draws up a personal scheme of action
lemmas.def_zh: 计划者, 阴谋家

examples.en: Nobody in the office trusted the ambitious schemer after his underhanded plot failed.
examples.zh: 在这位野心勃勃的阴谋家卑劣的计策失败后，办公室里没人再信任他。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To make clever, deceitful, and secret plans to achieve something, especially to gain an advantage.
lemmas.def_zh: 密谋，搞阴谋，图谋

examples.en: They uncovered a scheme to defraud elderly citizens.
examples.zh: 他们揭露了一项针对老年人的诈骗阴谋。

lemmas.def_zh: 计划性地, 按照图式
lemmas.def_en: in a schematic manner

examples.en: schematically outlined

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 schema（形态、外形），引申指深思熟虑的计划或暗中策划的阴谋。

lemmas.def_en: belonging to times long past especially of the historical period before the fall of the Western Roman Empire
lemmas.def_zh: [adj.] 古老的；古代的 [n.] 古代人

examples.en: Archaeologists discovered an ancient temple buried under the sand.
examples.zh: 考古学家发现了一座掩埋在沙土之下的古老神庙。

lemmas.def_en: a very old person
lemmas.def_zh: [adj.] 古老的；古代的 [n.] 古代人

examples.en: Archaeologists discovered an ancient temple buried under the sand.
examples.zh: 考古学家发现了一座掩埋在沙土之下的古老神庙。

lemmas.def_en: in ancient times; long ago
lemmas.def_zh: 以往, 古代

examples.en: This fertile river valley was anciently known as a center of bronze trade.
examples.zh: 这片肥沃的河谷在古代被称为青铜贸易的中心。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 antianus（在前的），核心语义指远古的历史或年代极其久远的事物。

lemmas.def_en: continuing or enduring without marked change in status or condition or place
lemmas.def_zh: 永久的；长期的

examples.en: Smoking can cause permanent damage to your lungs.
examples.zh: 吸烟会对肺部造成永久性损伤。

lemmas.def_en: for a long time without essential change
lemmas.def_zh: 永久地；长期不变地

examples.en: The museum is permanently closed for renovations.
examples.zh: 该博物馆因翻修而永久关闭。

lemmas.def_zh: 永久, 持久, 固定性
lemmas.def_en: the property of being able to exist for an indefinite duration

examples.en: The artist sought a sense of permanence in a rapidly changing modern world.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家在瞬息万变的现代世界中追寻一种永恒感。

lemmas.def_en: the property of being able to exist for an indefinite duration
lemmas.def_zh: 永久的职位

examples.en: After years of temporary contracts, she finally gained the permanency she wanted.
examples.zh: 经过多年的临时合同后，她终于获得了渴望已久的固定职位。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 per-（自始至终）+ manere（停留），意为“一直留在那里的”，引申为持久、永久。

lemmas.def_en: the flesh of a chicken used for food
lemmas.def_zh: 鸡；鸡肉；胆小鬼

examples.en: We had roast chicken with fresh vegetables for dinner.
examples.zh: 我们晚餐吃了烤鸡配新鲜蔬菜。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 cycen，指小鸡或鸡，俚语中常引申指胆小鬼。

lemmas.def_en: high in price or charging high prices
lemmas.def_zh: 昂贵的；花钱多的

examples.en: Eating out every night can become very expensive.
examples.zh: 每天晚上在外面吃可能会非常昂贵。

lemmas.def_en: in an expensive manner
lemmas.def_zh: 昂贵地；乱花钱地

examples.en: The luxury penthouse was expensively furnished with imported marble and Italian leather.
examples.zh: 这间豪华顶层公寓装潢极为昂贵，采用了进口大理石和意大利皮革。

lemmas.def_en: money paid out; an amount spent
lemmas.def_zh: n. 开支，支出；耗费

examples.en: The government pledged to increase expenditure on healthcare and education.
examples.zh: 政府承诺增加医疗和教育方面的开支。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being high-priced
lemmas.def_zh: 贵;高价;奢侈

examples.en: The sheer expensiveness of downtown housing forced many young families to relocate.
examples.zh: 市中心住房的高昂价格迫使许多年轻家庭搬迁。

lemmas.def_zh: 花费，耗费，消耗（时间、金钱、精力等）
lemmas.def_en: [T] to spend or use up resources, such as money, time, or energy, for a specific purpose

examples.en: Athletes expend a tremendous amount of physical energy during a full marathon.
examples.zh: 运动员在跑完一场全程马拉松的过程中会消耗巨大的体力。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 expense（花销），ex-（向外）+ pendere（称重、支付），形容代价高昂的。

lemmas.def_en: a mountain or tall hill
lemmas.def_zh: （苏格兰的）山峰

examples.en: Ben Nevis is the highest mountain in the British Isles.
examples.zh: 本尼维斯山是不列颠群岛的最高峰。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自盖尔语 beann，在苏格兰和爱尔兰地理中专门指代高耸的山峰。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To be almost equal to or very close to something in amount, quality, or nature.
lemmas.def_zh: 接近，近似于

examples.en: The cost of the repairs will approximate five thousand dollars.
examples.zh: 维修费用大约接近五千美元。

lemmas.def_en: not quite exact or correct
lemmas.def_zh: [adj.] 大约的；近似的 [v.] 接近；近似于

examples.en: The cost of the repairs will approximate five thousand dollars.
examples.zh: 维修费用大约接近五千美元。

lemmas.def_en: not quite exact or correct
lemmas.def_zh: 近似的

examples.en: The architect gave an approximative estimate of the total construction costs yesterday.
examples.zh: 建筑师昨天对整个建筑工程的费用给出了一个近似的估算。

lemmas.def_en: (of quantities) imprecise but fairly close to correct
lemmas.def_zh: 大约；大概

examples.en: The journey takes approximately two hours by train.
examples.zh: 坐火车这段旅程大约需要两小时。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 ad-（朝向）+ proximus（最近），表示“向最近处靠近”，引申为大致的、近似。
family_guide.core_distinction: approximate既作形容词（近似的）也作动词（接近）；approximately为修饰数量程度的副词。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To give a loud, high-pitched cry or shout, especially because of fear, pain, or excitement. 2. [I] To make a harsh, piercingly loud sound.
lemmas.def_zh: 尖叫，高声惊呼；发出尖厉呼啸声

examples.en: She let out a piercing scream when she saw the shadow.
examples.zh: 看到那个阴影时，她发出了一声刺耳的尖叫。

lemmas.def_en: sharp piercing cry
lemmas.def_zh: [v.] 尖叫；惊呼 [n.] 尖叫声

examples.en: She let out a piercing scream when she saw the shadow.
examples.zh: 看到那个阴影时，她发出了一声刺耳的尖叫。

lemmas.def_en: someone who communicates vocally in a very loud voice
lemmas.def_zh: 尖声叫喊的人；令人惊叹的事；惊叹符号；耸人听闻的标题

examples.en: The front page featured a bold screamer about the sudden stock market crash.
examples.zh: 头版刊登了一条关于股市突然崩盘的耸人听闻的大标题。

lemmas.def_en: to an extreme degree
lemmas.def_zh: 尖叫地, 令人惊愕地

examples.en: The satirical stage comedy was screamingly funny from beginning to the end.
examples.zh: 这部讽刺舞台喜剧自始至终都让人捧腹大笑。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 极其明显的；刺耳的；尖叫的
lemmas.def_en: very loud, intense, or conspicuous so as to compel attention
lemmas.usage_note: 常用于固定搭配，如 screaming headlines（醒目的大字标题）、a screaming success（巨大的成功）。

examples.en: The tabloid covered the scandal with screaming headlines.
examples.zh: 这家小报用耸人听闻的醒目大标题报道了这桩丑闻。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词演变而来，指因恐惧、痛苦或极度兴奋而发出尖锐刺耳的喊叫声。

lemmas.def_en: any place of complete bliss and delight and peace
lemmas.def_zh: 天堂；天空；极乐世界

examples.en: A cool breeze on a hot summer day feels like heaven.
examples.zh: 炎热夏日里的一阵凉风让人感到宛如置身天堂。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or inhabiting a divine heaven
lemmas.def_zh: 天上的；极好的；美妙的

examples.en: The bakery filled the street with a heavenly scent of bread.
examples.zh: 面包店散发出的美妙面包香味弥漫了整条街。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 heofon，本义指头顶上方的高空、天幕，后引申为天堂、至福之境。
family_guide.core_distinction: heaven通常指天堂或天空（名词）；heavenly为形容词，意为神圣的、极愉悦的。

lemmas.def_en: a correctional institution used to detain persons who are in the lawful custody of the government (either accused persons awaiting trial or convicted persons serving a sentence)
lemmas.def_zh: 监牢, 监狱, 拘留所

examples.en: The convicted thief spent six months in the county jail awaiting his trial.
examples.zh: 这名被定罪的窃贼在县监狱里关押了六个月等待审判。

lemmas.def_en: someone who guards prisoners
lemmas.def_zh: 看守监狱的人, 狱卒

examples.en: The weary jailer locked the heavy iron gate and pocketed the large key.
examples.zh: 疲惫的狱卒锁上了沉重的铁门，把大钥匙揣进口袋。

lemmas.def_en: someone who guards prisoners
lemmas.def_zh: 看守监狱的人, 狱卒

examples.en: The strict jailor inspected each cell every midnight without making a sound.
examples.zh: 严厉的看守每晚午夜都会悄无声息地巡查每个牢房。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To put or confine someone in prison or jail.
lemmas.def_zh: 监禁，把……关进监狱

examples.en: The convicted thief spent six months in the county jail awaiting his trial.
examples.zh: 这名被定罪的窃贼在县监狱里关押了六个月等待审判。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语，指拘留所或监狱，引申为关押监禁。

lemmas.def_en: a small hard fruit
lemmas.def_zh: 种子, 籽, 萌芽, 子孙, 精液

examples.en: The gardener placed each tiny seed carefully into the moist potting soil.
examples.zh: 园丁小心翼翼地把每一粒小种子放进湿润的盆栽土里。

lemmas.def_zh: 播种者, 播种机, 去核器
lemmas.def_en: a person who seeds clouds

examples.en: The farmer hitched the mechanical seeder to his tractor to plant the wheat.
examples.zh: 农民把机械播种机挂在拖拉机上播种小麦。

lemmas.def_en: a lack of elegance as a consequence of wearing threadbare or dirty clothing
lemmas.def_zh: 破衣烂衫, 肮脏; 多籽

examples.en: The growing seediness of the neighborhood worried long-time residents and business owners.
examples.zh: 该街区日益严重的破败肮脏令长期居民和店主们担忧。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. To plant seeds in an area of ground. 2. [I] To produce or shed seeds. 3. [T] To remove the seeds from fruit or vegetables.
lemmas.def_zh: 播种，培植；结子；去籽

examples.en: The gardener placed each tiny seed carefully into the moist potting soil.
examples.zh: 园丁小心翼翼地把每一粒小种子放进湿润的盆栽土里。

lemmas.def_en: full of seeds
lemmas.def_zh: 多种子的, 结籽的, 破烂的, 肮脏的

examples.en: He stayed in a seedy hotel near the train station overnight.
examples.zh: 他在火车站附近一家破旧邋遢的旅馆过了一夜。

lemmas.def_en: lacking seeds
lemmas.def_zh: 无核的

examples.en: She bought sweet seedless grapes for the children's afternoon snack.
examples.zh: 她买了甜甜的无籽葡萄给孩子们当下午点心。

lemmas.def_en: not seeded; used of players of lesser skill
lemmas.def_zh: [化] 未加晶种的

examples.en: The unseeded tennis player surprised everyone by reaching the tournament final.
examples.zh: 这位非种子网球选手一路杀入决赛，令所有人大吃一惊。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语，本义为播下的植物种子，引申为萌芽、起因及播种。

lemmas.def_en: an expression of regret at having caused trouble for someone
lemmas.def_zh: 道歉, 辩护

examples.en: He offered a sincere apology for arriving late to the meeting.
examples.zh: 他为开会迟到真诚地表达了歉意。

lemmas.def_en: a person who argues to defend or justify some policy or institution
lemmas.def_zh: 辩护者, 教义辩护文作者

examples.en: Critics viewed him merely as an apologist for the corrupt regime.
examples.zh: 批评家们认为他不过是那个腐败政权的辩护者。

lemmas.def_en: [I] (+ to/for) To tell someone that you are sorry for having done something wrong or causing trouble.
lemmas.def_zh: 道歉，谢罪；辩解

examples.en: You should apologize to your sister for breaking her favorite toy.
examples.zh: 你弄坏了妹妹最喜欢的玩具，应该向她道歉。

lemmas.def_en: [I] (+ to/for) (British English spelling of apologize) To say that you are sorry for doing something wrong or causing trouble.
lemmas.def_zh: 道歉，认错（apologize的英式拼写）

examples.en: I must apologise for the delay in replying to your email.
examples.zh: 未能及时回复您的邮件，我深表歉意。

lemmas.def_zh: 道歉的, 急于认错的, 辩护的
lemmas.def_en: offering or expressing apology

examples.en: The waiter gave an apologetic smile when he accidentally spilled water on the table.
examples.zh: 服务员不小心把水洒在桌上时，露出了歉意的微笑。

lemmas.def_zh: 不道歉的, 不认错的； 不辩解的
lemmas.def_en: unwilling to make or express an apology

examples.en: an unapologetic believer

lemmas.def_zh: 道歉地, 辩解地
lemmas.def_en: in an apologetic manner

examples.en: he spoke apologetically about his past

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语，原指辩护、辩解，现代主要指表达歉意、道歉。
family_guide.core_distinction: apologize 为美式拼写，apologise 为英式拼写，词义用法完全相同。

lemmas.def_en: any collection of particles (e.g., smoke or dust) or gases that is visible
lemmas.def_zh: 云, 阴暗, 烟雾, 疑团

examples.en: A dark cloud drifted across the moon, hiding its gentle light.
examples.zh: 一团乌云飘过月亮，遮住了温柔的月光。

lemmas.def_en: the state of the sky when it is covered by clouds
lemmas.def_zh: 多云, 阴暗, 光泽暗晦, 朦胧

examples.en: The sudden cloudiness spoiled their plans for an afternoon beach picnic.
examples.zh: 天色骤然阴沉，打乱了他们下午去海滩野餐的计划。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To make something less clear, distinct, or transparent, like mist or clouds. 2. [T] To make an issue, judgment, or feeling uncertain, gloomy, or confused. 3. [I] To become overcast or filled with clouds.
lemmas.def_zh: 遮蔽，蒙上阴影；使变暗，使模糊；（情绪）使变阴沉

examples.en: A dark cloud drifted across the moon, hiding its gentle light.
examples.zh: 一团乌云飘过月亮，遮住了温柔的月光。

lemmas.def_en: lacking definite form or limits; - H.T.Moore
lemmas.def_zh: 多云的, 有愁容的, 云的, 浑浊的

examples.en: The weather forecast predicts a cloudy morning followed by light rain.
examples.zh: 天气预报说早晨多云，随后会有小雨。

lemmas.def_en: free from clouds
lemmas.def_zh: 晴朗的, 无云的

examples.en: We spent the entire afternoon relaxing under a clear, cloudless sky.
examples.zh: 我们在晴朗无云的天空下放松地度过了整个下午。

lemmas.def_en: (of sound or color) free from anything that dulls or dims
lemmas.def_zh: 没有云的, 晴朗的, 明朗的

examples.en: Her unclouded happiness was evident to everyone at the wedding reception.
examples.zh: 婚宴上的每个人都能看出她那纯粹无瑕的幸福。

family_guide.root_logic: 原义为石块、土块，后借指天空中的积云，引申出模糊、遮蔽及多云之义。

lemmas.def_en: a single distinct event
lemmas.def_zh: 事件, 事变, 小事

examples.en: The police launched an investigation into the violent incident downtown.
examples.zh: 警方对市中心发生的这起暴力事件展开了调查。

lemmas.def_zh: 发生, 发生率, 影响, 负担者, 入射, 倾角
lemmas.def_en: the relative frequency of occurrence of something

examples.en: Strict safety regulations have significantly lowered the incidence of workplace injuries.
examples.zh: 严格的安全法规显著降低了工伤事故的发生率。

lemmas.def_en: falling or striking of light rays on something
lemmas.def_zh: 附带的, 易于发生的, 外来的, 入射的

examples.en: The police launched an investigation into the violent incident downtown.
examples.zh: 警方对市中心发生的这起暴力事件展开了调查。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语“降临、发生”，指附随发生的小事件，法律中引申为附带的。

lemmas.def_en: a drastic and far-reaching change in ways of thinking and behaving
lemmas.def_zh: 革命, 大变革, 旋转, 转数, 循环

examples.en: The industrial revolution transformed agricultural societies into modern urban economies.
examples.zh: 工业革命将农业社会转变成现代城市经济体。

lemmas.def_en: a radical supporter of political or social revolution
lemmas.def_zh: 革命者, 革命党人

examples.en: The company introduced a revolutionary smartphone design that changed the entire tech industry.
examples.zh: 该公司推出了一款革命性的智能手机设计，改变了整个科技行业。

lemmas.def_en: organized opposition to authority; a conflict in which one faction tries to wrest control from another
lemmas.def_zh: 叛乱, 反抗, 反感

examples.en: The citizens rose in revolt against the king's unfair new taxes.
examples.zh: 市民们揭竿而起，反抗国王不公的新税收。

lemmas.def_en: a radical supporter of political or social revolution
lemmas.def_zh: 革命家

examples.en: The young revolutionist secretly printed pamphlets calling for social equality.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的革命家秘密印刷呼吁社会平等的传单。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To take violent action against a government or authority; to rebel. 2. [I, T] To feel or cause to feel strong disgust or shock.
lemmas.def_zh: 反叛，起义，反抗；（使）反感，（使）恶心

examples.en: The citizens rose in revolt against the king's unfair new taxes.
examples.zh: 市民们揭竿而起，反抗国王不公的新税收。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. To move in a circle or orbit around a central point or axis. 2. [I] (+ around) To have someone or something as the main subject or focus.
lemmas.def_zh: 旋转，转动；围绕……旋转；以……为中心

examples.en: The Earth and other planets revolve around the Sun.
examples.zh: 地球和其他行星都围绕太阳公转。

lemmas.def_en: [T] to completely change the way that something is done, thought about, or made.
lemmas.def_zh: 彻底变革，使发生革命性剧变

examples.en: Artificial intelligence will revolutionize how doctors diagnose and treat diseases.
examples.zh: 人工智能将彻底改变医生诊断和治疗疾病的方式。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (British English) to completely change the way that something is done, thought about, or made.
lemmas.def_zh: 彻底变革，使发生革命性剧变

examples.en: New green technologies could revolutionise global energy production within decades.
examples.zh: 新型绿色技术有望在几十年内彻底变革全球能源生产。

lemmas.def_en: in a disgusting manner or to a disgusting degree
lemmas.def_zh: 背叛地, 叛乱地

examples.en: The kitchen was revoltingly dirty after days of complete neglect.
examples.zh: 由于数日无人打扫，厨房脏得令人作呕。

lemmas.def_en: markedly new or introducing radical change
lemmas.def_zh: 革命的, 革命性的

examples.en: The company introduced a revolutionary smartphone design that changed the entire tech industry.
examples.zh: 该公司推出了一款革命性的智能手机设计，改变了整个科技行业。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语“滚转、反转”，核心逻辑是推翻现有秩序。
family_guide.core_distinction: revolt 强调反叛、抗拒行动或引发厌恶；revolution 强调导致政体或社会结构巨变的革命或根本变革。

lemmas.def_en: characterized by or producing sound of great volume or intensity
lemmas.def_zh: 大声的, 不断的, 喧吵的

examples.en: A loud clap of thunder startled the sleeping dog awake.
examples.zh: 一声巨大的雷鸣惊醒了熟睡中的狗。

lemmas.def_en: with relatively high volume
lemmas.def_zh: 高声地, 大声地, 吵闹地

examples.en: The audience cheered loudly when the band walked onto the stage.
examples.zh: 当乐队走上舞台时，观众大声欢呼起来。

lemmas.def_en: the magnitude of sound (usually in a specified direction)
lemmas.def_zh: 响度, 高声, 大声, 吵闹

examples.en: You can adjust the loudness of the television with this remote.
examples.zh: 你可以用这个遥控器调节电视的音量大小。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，本义为能听见的，后指声音大、喧闹或引申为刺眼的。

lemmas.def_en: a group of soldiers
lemmas.def_zh: 军队, 一群, 一队

examples.en: A troop of monkeys moved noisily through the dense jungle trees.
examples.zh: 一群猴子喧闹地穿过茂密的丛林树木。

lemmas.def_en: [I] (+ adv./prep.) To walk or march somewhere together in a large group.
lemmas.def_zh: 成群结队地走，列队行进

examples.en: A troop of monkeys moved noisily through the dense jungle trees.
examples.zh: 一群猴子喧闹地穿过茂密的丛林树木。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语，指人群、集结的队伍，引申为行军及部队。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (+ at) To use offensive, vulgar, or obscene language. 2. [I, T] To make a solemn, formal promise or declare that something is true under oath.
lemmas.def_zh: 咒骂，说脏话；发誓，宣誓

examples.en: He had to swear to tell the truth in court yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天必须在法庭上发誓说实话。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] Past participle of swear; to make a solemn promise or oath. 2. [I] Past participle of swear; to use offensive or profane language.
lemmas.def_zh: 发誓，起誓；诅咒，说脏话（swear 的过去分词）

examples.en: The new president was sworn into office before a huge crowd.
examples.zh: 新总统在庞大的人群面前宣誓就职。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] Past tense of swear; to make a solemn promise or oath. 2. [I] Past tense of swear; to use offensive or profane language.
lemmas.def_zh: 发誓，起誓；诅咒，说脏话（swear 的过去式）

examples.en: She swore that she had never seen that mysterious man before.
examples.zh: 她发誓说自己以前从未见过那个神秘的男人。

lemmas.def_en: not bound by or stated on oath
lemmas.def_zh: unswear的过去分词

examples.en: The judge reminded the jury that unsworn statements carry less weight.
examples.zh: 法官提醒陪审团，未宣誓的陈述分量较轻。

lemmas.def_en: someone who uses profanity
lemmas.def_zh: 宣誓者, 咒骂者

examples.en: The angry swearer was quickly asked to leave the quiet library.
examples.zh: 那个愤怒的骂人者很快被要求离开安静的图书馆。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语，核心语义为郑重发誓，引申出咒骂或诅咒。
family_guide.core_distinction: swore 为一般过去时；sworn 为过去分词（也可用作定语形容词表示‘宣过誓的’）。

lemmas.def_en: feeling or showing anger
lemmas.def_zh: 生气的, 愤怒的

examples.en: My father was very angry when he discovered the broken window.
examples.zh: 父亲发现窗户破了时非常生气。

lemmas.def_en: with anger
lemmas.def_zh: 愤怒地

examples.en: She slammed the front door angrily after having a heated argument.
examples.zh: 激烈争吵后，她愤怒地摔上了前门。

lemmas.def_en: a strong emotion; a feeling that is oriented toward some real or supposed grievance
lemmas.def_zh: 忿怒

examples.en: He struggled hard to suppress his rising anger during the tense meeting.
examples.zh: 在紧张的会议中，他竭力压制住自己不断上升的怒火。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To make someone angry. 2. [I] To become angry.
lemmas.def_zh: 激怒，使发怒；发怒

examples.en: He struggled hard to suppress his rising anger during the tense meeting.
examples.zh: 在紧张的会议中，他竭力压制住自己不断上升的怒火。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古诺斯语，原指悲伤或痛苦，演变为强烈的愤怒与怨恨情绪。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To emphasize something or draw special attention to it. 2. [T] To mark text with a bright colour to make it prominent.
lemmas.def_zh: 突出，强调；用醒目颜色标出

examples.en: The report highlights the serious dangers of ongoing climate change worldwide.
examples.zh: 该报告突出了全球持续气候变化的严重危害。

lemmas.def_en: a cosmetic used to highlight the eyes or cheekbones
lemmas.def_zh: 萤光笔, 亮光笔；轮廓色

examples.en: I used a yellow highlighter to mark the most important vocabulary.
examples.zh: 我用黄色荧光笔标出了最重要的词汇。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 high（高、明亮）+ light（光）复合而成，本义为画面最亮处，引申为强调、突出。

lemmas.def_en: a midday meal
lemmas.def_zh: 午餐

examples.en: We decided to have a quick lunch at the local cafe.
examples.zh: 我们决定在当地的咖啡馆快速吃顿午餐。

lemmas.def_en: [I] To eat lunch, the midday meal.
lemmas.def_zh: 吃午餐，用午膳

examples.en: We decided to have a quick lunch at the local cafe.
examples.zh: 我们决定在当地的咖啡馆快速吃顿午餐。

family_guide.root_logic: 缩略自 luncheon，指两餐之间的一小份简单食物，现代定型为午餐。

lemmas.def_en: someone who is licensed to operate an aircraft in flight
lemmas.def_zh: 飞行员, 领航员, 航船者, 导向器, 驾驶仪, 向导, 领导人

examples.en: The experienced pilot landed the plane safely despite the thick fog.
examples.zh: 尽管大雾弥漫，经验丰富的飞行员仍安全降落了飞机。

lemmas.def_en: the guidance of ships or airplanes from place to place
lemmas.def_zh: 领航, 驾驶, 领航技术, 领航费

examples.en: The harbor master was responsible for the pilotage of large ships.
examples.zh: 港口长负责引导大型船只安全进港引航。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To act as a pilot of an aircraft or ship; to navigate or guide. 2. [T] To test a new scheme, project, or product before introducing it more widely.
lemmas.def_zh: 驾驶（飞机或船只）；领航，引导；试行，试验

examples.en: The experienced pilot landed the plane safely despite the thick fog.
examples.zh: 尽管大雾弥漫，经验丰富的飞行员仍安全降落了飞机。

lemmas.def_en: lacking a pilot
lemmas.def_zh: 无人驾驶的

examples.en: The military tested a new pilotless aircraft for reconnaissance missions yesterday.
examples.zh: 军方昨天测试了一架用于执行侦察任务的新型无人驾驶飞机。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语“舵”，指引航船只的人，引申为飞行员及试验性的试点项目。

lemmas.def_en: the act of conducting a controlled test or investigation
lemmas.def_zh: 实验, 试验, 实验仪器

examples.en: The science students conducted an exciting chemistry experiment in the laboratory.
examples.zh: 理科学生们在实验室里做了一个有趣的化学实验。

lemmas.def_en: the testing of an idea
lemmas.def_zh: 实验, 试验, 实验法

examples.en: Constant experimentation with new recipes helped the young chef develop her unique cooking style.
examples.zh: 不断尝试新菜谱帮助这位年轻厨师形成了独特的烹饪风格。

lemmas.def_en: a research worker who conducts experiments
lemmas.def_zh: 实验者, 试验者

examples.en: The experimenter carefully recorded the reaction times of each participant during the trial.
examples.zh: 实验者仔细记录了每位参与者在测试中的反应时间。

lemmas.def_en: [I] (+ on/with) To conduct scientific tests or try out new ideas to discover or verify something.
lemmas.def_zh: 进行实验，做试验；尝试

examples.en: Scientists decided to experiment with a new compound to see if it would work.
examples.zh: 科学家们决定用一种新化合物做实验，看看它是否有效。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 experiri（尝试、检验），引申为通过实际测试来获取新知。

lemmas.def_en: (Christian theology) a state of sanctification by God; the state of one who is under such divine influence
lemmas.def_zh: 优雅，优美

examples.en: She danced across the floor with effortless grace.
examples.zh: 她以毫不费力的优雅舞姿穿过舞池。

lemmas.def_en: excellence of manners or social conduct
lemmas.def_zh: 亲切, 和蔼；好心

examples.en: Her natural graciousness made all the nervous guests feel immediately welcome and relaxed.
examples.zh: 她的亲切和蔼让所有紧张的客人都立刻感到宾至如归、放松下来。

lemmas.def_en: beautiful carriage
lemmas.def_zh: 温文, 优雅；优美

examples.en: The audience was completely captivated by the effortless gracefulness of the lead dancer.
examples.zh: 观众完全被领舞者那毫不费力的优雅舞姿所吸引。

lemmas.def_en: characterized by charm, good taste, and generosity of spirit
lemmas.def_zh: 和蔼的；亲切的；高尚的

examples.en: He was gracious enough to thank everyone who helped him.
examples.zh: 他十分宽厚亲切，向所有帮助过他的人表示了感谢。

lemmas.def_en: characterized by beauty of movement, style, form, or execution
lemmas.def_zh: 优美的

examples.en: The swans glided across the misty lake with smooth, graceful movements this morning.
examples.zh: 今天清晨，天鹅迈着流畅优美的姿态在薄雾笼罩的湖面上滑行。

lemmas.def_en: lacking graciousness
lemmas.def_zh: 不知礼的, 不知耻的, 粗野的

examples.en: His graceless remarks about her appearance offended several people at the formal dinner.
examples.zh: 他在正式晚宴上对她外表发表的粗鲁言论冒犯了几个人。

lemmas.def_en: lacking charm and good taste
lemmas.def_zh: 无礼貌的, 不和蔼的, 没有吸引力的

examples.en: It was quite ungracious of him to refuse their kind offer of hospitality.
examples.zh: 他拒绝了他们热情的款待，这显得相当无礼。

lemmas.def_en: lacking grace; clumsy; ; - Sir Walter Scott
lemmas.def_zh: 不优美的, 难看的, 无风度的

examples.en: The heavy wet snow caused several ungraceful slips and falls on the sidewalk.
examples.zh: 厚重的湿雪导致人行道上出现了几起狼狈的滑倒事故。

lemmas.def_en: in a graceful manner
lemmas.def_zh: 优雅地；温文地

examples.en: She gracefully accepted the prestigious award and thanked everyone who supported her journey.
examples.zh: 她优雅地接受了这一崇高奖项，并感谢了支持她一路走来的所有人。

lemmas.def_en: in a gracious or graceful manner
lemmas.def_zh: 和蔼地；仁慈地；雅致地

examples.en: The host graciously offered to drive the stranded travelers back to their hotel.
examples.zh: 房东好心地主动提出开车将滞留的旅客送回他们的酒店。

lemmas.def_en: without grace; rigidly
lemmas.def_zh: 笨拙地, 没有风度地, 不雅地

examples.en: He scrambled ungracefully over the wooden fence to escape the neighbor's barking dog.
examples.zh: 他笨拙地翻过木栅栏，以躲避邻居家狂吠的狗。

lemmas.def_en: without grace; rigidly
lemmas.def_zh: 笨拙地；不优美地

examples.en: The inexperienced skater landed gracelessly on the hard ice during her routine.
examples.zh: 这位缺乏经验的花滑选手在表演中笨拙地摔在坚硬的冰面上。

lemmas.def_en: without grace; rigidly
lemmas.def_zh: 不礼貌地, 没教养地

examples.en: The tired clerk answered our simple questions ungraciously and walked away quickly.
examples.zh: 那位疲惫的店员没好气地回答了我们简单的问题，然后迅速走开了。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] to make something more attractive or pleasing; adorn. 2. [T] to bring honor or dignity to someone or something by being present.
lemmas.def_zh: 为……增色，使优美，装饰；使荣耀，赏光

examples.en: A stunning crystal chandelier was chosen to grace the ceiling of the grand ballroom.
examples.zh: 人们挑选了一盏华丽的水晶吊灯来装点大宴会厅的天花板。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自拉丁语 gratia（令人喜悦、优美、恩惠），涵盖举止优美、宽宏仁慈及神圣恩典等意。
family_guide.core_distinction: gracious强调举止亲切宽厚、有礼貌，graceful则更侧重形体或动作优美流畅。

lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To pass a disease or pathogen to a person, animal, or plant. 2. To affect someone with a particular feeling, idea, or harmful influence.
lemmas.def_zh: 传染，使感染；使受不良影响

examples.en: The virus can infect both humans and animals.
examples.zh: 该病毒能同时感染人类和动物。

lemmas.def_en: the pathological state resulting from the invasion of the body by pathogenic microorganisms
lemmas.def_zh: 感染；传染病

examples.en: Wash your hands frequently to prevent bacterial infection.
examples.zh: 勤洗手以预防细菌感染。

lemmas.def_en: caused by infection or capable of causing infection
lemmas.def_zh: 传染性的；有感染力的

examples.en: Her infectious enthusiasm quickly spread throughout the entire team.
examples.zh: 她那极具感染力的热情迅速带动了整个团队。

lemmas.def_en: free from sepsis or infection
lemmas.def_zh: 未感染的

examples.en: Doctors isolated the uninfected patients immediately to prevent the virus from spreading further.
examples.zh: 医生们立即隔离了未感染的患者，以防止病毒进一步传播。

lemmas.def_en: able to cause disease
lemmas.def_zh: 有传染性的, 易传染的

examples.en: Laboratory tests confirmed that the newly discovered bacterial strain was highly infective.
examples.zh: 实验室检测证实，这种新发现的细菌菌株具有高度传染性。

lemmas.def_en: not infectious
lemmas.def_zh: [医] 非传染性的

examples.en: Cardiovascular diseases are among the most common noninfectious causes of death worldwide.
examples.zh: 心血管疾病是全球最常见的非传染性死因之一。

lemmas.def_en: in a contagious manner
lemmas.def_zh: 传染地；有感染力地

examples.en: She laughed so infectiously that everyone in the conference room joined in immediately.
examples.zh: 她笑得极富感染力，会议室里的所有人立刻都跟着笑了起来。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 inficere（染污、浸染），核心语义为病原体或情绪渗入并在机体内蔓延扩散。
family_guide.core_distinction: infect强调侵入并传染病原体，contaminate强调接触杂质或毒素造成的环境污染。

lemmas.def_en: a vivid mental image
lemmas.def_zh: 视力；远见；幻象；愿景

examples.en: A successful leader must have a clear vision for the future.
examples.zh: 一个成功的领导者必须对未来有清晰的愿景。

lemmas.def_zh: 有眼力的人, 空想家, 梦想者
lemmas.def_en: a person given to fanciful speculations and enthusiasms with little regard for what is actually possible

examples.en: The company founder was a true visionary who predicted modern smartphone technology.
examples.zh: 这位公司创始人是一位真正的远见者，他预测了现代智能手机技术。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 videre（看），由肉眼所见引申为心灵所见之构想与远见。

lemmas.def_en: a period marked by distinctive character or reckoned from a fixed point or event
lemmas.def_zh: 时代；年代；纪元

examples.en: The launch of the smartphone marked a new era in communication.
examples.zh: 智能手机的推出标志着通信新时代的到来。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自晚期拉丁语 aera（计算基数），现代引申为具有显著历史特征的纪元或时代。

lemmas.def_en: the act of killing yourself
lemmas.def_zh: 自杀；自取灭亡的行为

examples.en: Cutting education funding is economic suicide for the country.
examples.zh: 削减教育经费对这个国家而言是经济上的自杀行为。

lemmas.def_en: dangerous to yourself or your interests
lemmas.def_zh: 有自杀倾向的；自我毁灭性的

examples.en: The patient showed severe suicidal tendencies and needed care.
examples.zh: 该患者表现出严重的自杀倾向，需要接受看护。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 sui（自己）+ cide（杀死）构成，核心语义即自主结束生命。

lemmas.def_en: alert carnivorous mammal with pointed muzzle and ears and a bushy tail; most are predators that do not hunt in packs
lemmas.def_zh: 狐狸, 狡猾的人

examples.en: A wild fox trotted silently through the dense forest.
examples.zh: 一只野狐在茂密的森林中悄无声息地小跑着。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (informal) To confuse, baffle, or trick someone.
lemmas.def_zh: 欺骗，哄骗；使困惑，难住

examples.en: This difficult math puzzle completely foxed the entire class for nearly an hour.
examples.zh: 这道很难的数学难题把全班同学彻底难住了一个小时。

lemmas.def_zh: 如狐的, 狡猾的, 赤褐色的
lemmas.def_en: marked by skill in deception

examples.en: The detective smiled, knowing he had finally outsmarted the foxy thief.
examples.zh: 侦探笑了笑，知道自己终于智胜了那个狡猾的小偷。

family_guide.root_logic: 日耳曼语源，指狐狸；因狐狸狡黠的习性引申出欺骗、迷惑之意。

lemmas.def_en: a United States unit of weight equivalent to 2000 pounds
lemmas.def_zh: 吨；大量

examples.en: I have a ton of emails to catch up on this afternoon.
examples.zh: 我今天下午有堆积如山的邮件要处理。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 tunne（大桶），原为度量桶容量单位，后演化为重量单位及大量泛指。

lemmas.def_en: (medicine) the act of caring for someone (as by medication or remedial training etc.)
lemmas.def_zh: 治疗；疗法；心理咨询

examples.en: Physical therapy helped him regain the use of his legs.
examples.zh: 物理治疗帮助他恢复了双腿的机能。

lemmas.def_en: a person skilled in a particular type of therapy
lemmas.def_zh: 治疗师；临床心理学家

examples.en: She consulted a therapist to help manage her anxiety.
examples.zh: 她咨询了一位心理治疗师来应对焦虑。

lemmas.def_en: a medicine or therapy that cures disease or relieve pain
lemmas.def_zh: [医] 治疗的; 治疗学的

examples.en: Swimming every morning has proven to be deeply therapeutic for her chronic back pain.
examples.zh: 事实证明，每天早晨游泳对治疗她的慢性背痛大有裨益。

lemmas.def_en: tending to cure or restore to health
lemmas.def_zh: 治疗的, 有益于健康的

examples.en: Swimming every morning has proven to be deeply therapeutic for her chronic back pain.
examples.zh: 事实证明，每天早晨游泳对治疗她的慢性背痛大有裨益。

lemmas.def_zh: 治疗的, 治疗学的, 疗法的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or involved in therapy

examples.en: Soaking in natural hot springs provides significant therapeutical benefits for joint pain.
examples.zh: 泡天然温泉对缓解关节疼痛具有显著的疗效。

lemmas.def_zh: [医]adv.在治疗上
lemmas.def_en: for therapeutic purposes

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 therapeia（照料、医治），核心语义为非手术性质的长期身心治疗。
family_guide.core_distinction: therapy指疗法或心理辅导过程，treatment是广义的医疗处理手段。

lemmas.def_en: a complex mental state involving beliefs and feelings and values and dispositions to act in certain ways
lemmas.def_zh: 态度；看法；姿态

examples.en: A positive attitude can help you overcome many obstacles.
examples.zh: 积极的态度能帮你克服诸多障碍。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自拉丁语 aptitudo（适应度、姿态），本指身体的姿态，后引申为内心的态度与立场。

lemmas.def_en: a basic generalization that is accepted as true and that can be used as a basis for reasoning or conduct
lemmas.def_zh: 原则；原理；准则

examples.en: Refusing to compromise on this issue was a matter of principle.
examples.zh: 在此问题上拒绝妥协是一个原则问题。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 principium（起点、起源、基础），指构成思想或行动基础的根本准则。
family_guide.core_distinction: principle意为原则、原理；易与principal（校长、主要的）混淆，注意拼写与词义。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To force someone to have sexual intercourse against their will; to despoil or violate.
lemmas.def_zh: 强奸，强暴；肆意蹂躏，破坏

examples.en: The soldier was convicted of committing rape during wartime.
examples.zh: 这名士兵因在战时犯下强奸罪而被定罪。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] to strike sharply and quickly, producing a knocking sound. 2. [T] to criticize sharply. 3. [I, T] to perform rap music.
lemmas.def_zh: 急敲，急击；严厉斥责；说唱

examples.en: He gave a sharp rap on the window to get her attention.
examples.zh: 他急促地敲了敲窗户以引起她的注意。

lemmas.def_en: someone who forces another to have sexual intercourse
lemmas.def_zh: [法] 强奸犯

examples.en: The convicted raper was sentenced to life in prison without parole yesterday.
examples.zh: 这名被定罪的强奸犯昨天被判处终身监禁且不得假释。

family_guide.root_logic: 词根源于拉丁语 rapere（夺取、抢掠），后演化出性暴力侵犯及其他语源意义（如敲击）。
family_guide.core_distinction: rape主指强奸暴行；rap源自拟声词，指急促敲击或说唱，两者在现代英语中词源不同。

lemmas.def_en: lacking any definite plan or order or purpose; governed by or depending on chance
lemmas.def_zh: 随机的；任意的

examples.en: The computer selected a random sample of registered voters.
examples.zh: 计算机随机抽取了注册选民的样本。

lemmas.def_en: not random
lemmas.def_zh: 非随机的

examples.en: The researchers detected a clearly nonrandom distribution of trees in the ancient forest.
examples.zh: 研究人员在原始森林中发现了明显的非随机性树木分布。

lemmas.def_en: in a random manner
lemmas.def_zh: 随机地；任意地

examples.en: Names were chosen randomly from a hat for the raffle.
examples.zh: 用于抽奖的名字是从帽子里随机抽取出来的。

lemmas.def_en: (thermodynamics) a thermodynamic quantity representing the amount of energy in a system that is no longer available for doing mechanical work
lemmas.def_zh: [计] 随机性

examples.en: Computer algorithms simulate true randomness to ensure fair results in digital gaming.
examples.zh: 计算机算法模拟真正的随机性，以确保数字游戏中的公平结果。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 randon（奔流、冲劲），最初表示不受拘束的飞驰，引申为无固定规律与计划的随性状态。

lemmas.def_en: closely constrained or constricted or constricting
lemmas.def_zh: 紧的；牢固的；紧迫的

examples.en: We are working under an extremely tight deadline.
examples.zh: 我们正在极度紧迫的截止日期下工作。

lemmas.def_en: in a tight or constricted manner
lemmas.def_zh: 紧紧地；牢固地

examples.en: She held the child's hand tightly while crossing the busy street.
examples.zh: 穿过繁忙的街道时，她紧紧抓着孩子的手。

lemmas.def_en: a state occasioned by scarcity of money and a shortage of credit
lemmas.def_zh: 坚固, 紧密

examples.en: He felt an uncomfortable tightness in his chest after running up the hill.
examples.zh: 跑上山坡后，他感到胸口一阵不舒服的发紧。

family_guide.root_logic: 日耳曼语源，核心意义为紧密压合、牢固，引申为牢固的、紧迫的及紧张的状态。

lemmas.def_en: [I] (rely on/upon) to depend on or trust someone or something to provide support, help, or a particular result
lemmas.def_zh: 依赖，依靠（rely on/upon）；指望，信任

examples.en: You can always rely on him to give an honest opinion.
examples.zh: 你完全可以相信他会给出诚实的意见。

lemmas.def_en: certainty based on past experience
lemmas.def_zh: 依靠，依赖；信任

examples.en: The country is trying to reduce its reliance on imported oil.
examples.zh: 该国正试图减少对进口石油的依赖。

lemmas.def_en: relying on another for support
lemmas.def_zh: 依赖的, 信赖的

examples.en: Many remote island communities are heavily reliant on imported food and medical supplies.
examples.zh: 许多偏远的海岛社区严重依赖进口的食品和医疗用品。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语，核心语义为“紧密绑定、依靠”，引申为信任或依赖某人某物。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To notice, discover, or identify the presence or existence of something, especially something subtle.
lemmas.def_zh: 发觉，察觉；检测，探测

examples.en: The tests are designed to detect early signs of the disease.
examples.zh: 这些检查旨在发现该疾病的早期迹象。

lemmas.def_en: the perception that something has occurred or some state exists
lemmas.def_zh: 侦查，察觉，探测

examples.en: Early detection of the virus greatly increases the chance of recovery.
examples.zh: 尽早发现该病毒能大大增加康复的机会。

lemmas.def_en: any device that receives a signal or stimulus (as heat or pressure or light or motion etc.) and responds to it in a distinctive manner
lemmas.def_zh: 探测器，检测器

examples.en: Every home should have a working smoke detector.
examples.zh: 每个家庭都应该安装一个正常工作的烟雾报警器。

lemmas.def_en: not perceived or discerned
lemmas.def_zh: 未被发现的

examples.en: The subtle security flaw remained completely undetected by the engineers for several months.
examples.zh: 这个细微的安全漏洞几个月来完全没有被工程师发现。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 de-（去除）+ tect（遮盖），字面即“揭开盖子”，引申为察觉、发觉隐藏之物。
family_guide.core_distinction: detection 指察觉、侦测的动作或过程；detector 指用于探测的仪器或设备。

lemmas.def_en: something that remunerates
lemmas.def_zh: 工资, 报应, 报偿

examples.en: The local workers demanded a higher minimum wage to cope with inflation.
examples.zh: 当地工人要求提高最低工资以应对通货膨胀。

lemmas.def_en: [T] to begin and continue a war, battle, or campaign.
lemmas.def_zh: 发动（战争），开展，进行（斗争等）

examples.en: The local workers demanded a higher minimum wage to cope with inflation.
examples.zh: 当地工人要求提高最低工资以应对通货膨胀。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To move rapidly back and forth or up and down, especially of an animal's tail or a finger.
lemmas.def_zh: 摇摆，摇动（尾巴或手指等）

examples.en: The excited puppy began to wag its tail when its owner arrived.
examples.zh: 当主人到来时，兴奋的小狗开始摇尾巴。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语，核心为“抵押、承诺”，作名词指雇佣契约支付的酬金，作动词指发起（战争、运动等承诺行动）。

lemmas.def_en: a person trained to compete in sports
lemmas.def_zh: 运动员，体育健儿

examples.en: She trained for years to become an Olympic athlete.
examples.zh: 她训练了多年才成为一名奥运运动员。

lemmas.def_en: an active diversion requiring physical exertion and competition
lemmas.def_zh: 田径运动；体育运动

examples.en: She has always excelled in athletics, particularly in sprinting.
examples.zh: 她一直擅长体育运动，尤其是在短跑方面。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or befitting athletics or athletes
lemmas.def_zh: 健壮的；运动的，体育的

examples.en: He has a naturally athletic build suited for basketball.
examples.zh: 他天生体格健壮，很适合打篮球。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 athlos（竞争、竞赛），核心指“参加体育竞技的人”。

lemmas.def_en: well known or easily recognized
lemmas.def_zh: 熟悉的, 常见的, 亲密的

examples.en: Her face looks remarkably familiar, but I cannot recall her name right now.
examples.zh: 她的面孔看起来非常眼熟，但我现在想不起她的名字。

lemmas.def_en: not known or well known
lemmas.def_zh: 不熟悉的，陌生的

examples.en: Driving in an unfamiliar city can be quite stressful.
examples.zh: 在陌生的城市开车可能会让人十分紧张。

lemmas.def_en: a person attached to the household of a high official (as a pope or bishop) who renders service in return for support
lemmas.def_zh: 熟友, 常客

examples.en: Her face looks remarkably familiar, but I cannot recall her name right now.
examples.zh: 她的面孔看起来非常眼熟，但我现在想不起她的名字。

lemmas.def_en: personal knowledge or information about someone or something
lemmas.def_zh: 熟悉, 精通, 亲密

examples.en: His deep familiarity with local customs helped him adapt quickly to the environment.
examples.zh: 他对当地习俗的深度熟悉帮助他迅速适应了环境。

lemmas.def_en: unusualness as a consequence of not being well known
lemmas.def_zh: 陌生

examples.en: Her initial hesitation was caused entirely by unfamiliarity with the new software interface.
examples.zh: 她最初的犹豫完全是因为对新软件界面的陌生。

lemmas.def_en: in an intimately familiar manner
lemmas.def_zh: 不拘礼地, 亲密地, 随意地

examples.en: He greeted the foreign guests familiarly, as if they were lifelong companions.
examples.zh: 他亲切地问候外宾，仿佛他们是一辈子的伙伴。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 familia（家庭），核心逻辑为“像家人一样为人们所熟知、亲近”。

lemmas.def_en: spiritual being attendant upon God
lemmas.def_zh: 天使；仁慈可爱的人

examples.en: Thank you for helping me with the chores, you're an absolute angel.
examples.zh: 谢谢你帮我做家务，你真是个大好人。

lemmas.def_en: marked by utter benignity; resembling or befitting an angel or saint
lemmas.def_zh: 天使的, 天使般的

examples.en: The little choir girl possessed an angelic singing voice that moved the audience.
examples.zh: 合唱团的小女孩拥有天使般的动人歌喉，感动了观众。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to angels
lemmas.def_zh: 天使的, 天使般的

examples.en: She had an angelical smile that immediately comforted everyone in the emergency room.
examples.zh: 她天使般的微笑瞬间安慰了急诊室里的每一个人。

lemmas.def_en: like an angel
lemmas.def_zh: 天使般地

examples.en: The sleeping baby smiled angelically while wrapped warmly in her soft cotton blanket.
examples.zh: 熟睡的婴儿裹在柔软的棉毯里，天使般地微笑着。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 angelos（信使、传递信息者），后专指神圣的“天神传讯者/天使”，引申指极好的人。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To make someone suffer a penalty or hardship for a crime, fault, or wrongdoing. 2. [T] To treat roughly or inflict severe damage upon.
lemmas.def_zh: 惩罚，处罚；折磨

examples.en: The law must strictly punish those who break environmental regulations.
examples.zh: 法律必须严厉惩罚违反环保法规的人。

lemmas.def_en: the act of punishing
lemmas.def_zh: 惩罚，刑罚

examples.en: The court decided that the punishment should fit the crime.
examples.zh: 法院裁定罚当其罪。

lemmas.def_zh: 刑罚的, 惩罚性的
lemmas.def_en: inflicting punishment

examples.en: The government imposed punitive economic tariffs on imported luxury goods last month.
examples.zh: 政府上个月对进口奢侈品征收了惩罚性经济关税。

lemmas.def_en: not punished
lemmas.def_zh: 不受处罚的, 免去刑法的

examples.en: The strict judge vowed that such serious misconduct would never go unpunished.
examples.zh: 严厉的法官誓言绝不放过这种严重的严重不当行为。

lemmas.def_zh: 惩罚地；刑罚的
lemmas.def_en: in a punishing manner
in a punishing manner
lemmas.def_zh: punishing（繁重费力的, 艰难的）的变形

examples.en: The mountain athletes endured a punishingly difficult training routine before the big marathon.
examples.zh: 山地运动员在盛大马拉松赛前忍受了极其艰苦的训练。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 poena（惩罚、赔偿），核心指“对过错进行惩处以示戒备”。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To explain or understand the meaning of something. 2. [I, T] To translate spoken words from one language into another. 3. [T] To perform a piece of music, a role, etc., in a way that conveys one's own understanding of it.
lemmas.def_zh: 理解，阐释；口译；演绎（艺术作品）

examples.en: It can be difficult to interpret the results of this complex study.
examples.zh: 要解释这项复杂研究的结果可能很困难。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To understand, explain, or translate something wrongly.
lemmas.def_zh: 曲解，误解

examples.en: Please listen carefully so you do not misinterpret the true intent of my message.
examples.zh: 请仔细听，以免曲解我信息的真实意图。

lemmas.def_en: a mental representation of the meaning or significance of something
lemmas.def_zh: 解释，理解，阐释

examples.en: His poems are open to many different interpretations.
examples.zh: 他的诗歌可以有多种不同的解读。

lemmas.def_en: someone who mediates between speakers of different languages
lemmas.def_zh: 口译员；解释程序

examples.en: She worked as an interpreter for the delegation during the summit.
examples.zh: 峰会期间，她担任代表团的口译员。

lemmas.def_en: putting the wrong interpretation on
lemmas.def_zh: [计] 错误判断

examples.en: A simple misinterpretation of the contract terms caused an unnecessary conflict between partners.
examples.zh: 对合同条款的简单误解导致了合伙人间不必要的冲突。

lemmas.def_en: that provides interpretation
lemmas.def_zh: [计] 解释的, 翻译的

examples.en: The museum added interactive interpretive signs to explain ancient artifacts to modern visitors.
examples.zh: 博物馆增设了互动解释标识，向现代游客阐释古代文物。

lemmas.def_en: that provides interpretation
lemmas.def_zh: 作为说明的, 解释的

examples.en: His bold interpretative reading brought a modern feminist perspective to the classic play.
examples.zh: 他大胆的阐释性解读为这部经典剧目带来了现代女性主义视角。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 inter-（在……之间）+ pret（买卖媒介、解释），核心语义为“充当媒介来阐明或翻译”。
family_guide.core_distinction: interpretation 指阐释、理解或翻译的行为及结果；interpreter 专指从事口译的人或代码解释器。

lemmas.def_en: an informal conversation
lemmas.def_zh: 闲谈

examples.en: Let us have a brief chat over coffee before the afternoon meeting begins.
examples.zh: 下午会议开始前，我们喝杯咖啡简单聊聊吧。

lemmas.def_en: [I] To talk in a friendly, informal, and relaxed manner.
lemmas.def_zh: 闲聊，聊天；闲谈商讨

examples.en: Let us have a brief chat over coffee before the afternoon meeting begins.
examples.zh: 下午会议开始前，我们喝杯咖啡简单聊聊吧。

lemmas.def_en: full of trivial conversation
lemmas.def_zh: 饶舌的, 爱讲闲话的

examples.en: The chatty taxi driver told entertaining personal stories throughout the long morning commute.
examples.zh: 爱聊天的出租车司机在整个早高峰通勤途中讲着有趣的轶事。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词 chatter（喋喋不休）的缩略形式，核心语义为“轻松随意的交谈”。

lemmas.def_en: denoting a quantity consisting of 20 items or units

examples.en: About twenty enthusiastic students joined the newly founded campus robotics club this semester.
examples.zh: 本学期大约有二十名热情的学生加入了新成立的校园机器人社团。

lemmas.def_en: the cardinal number that is the sum of nineteen and one

examples.en: About twenty enthusiastic students joined the newly founded campus robotics club this semester.
examples.zh: 本学期大约有二十名热情的学生加入了新成立的校园机器人社团。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 twēntig，由 twā（二）+ -tig（十的倍数）构成，字面即“两个十”。

lemmas.def_en: the vertical dimension of extension; distance from the base of something to the top
lemmas.def_zh: 高度，身高；顶点，高潮

examples.en: The plane was flying at a height of 30,000 feet.
examples.zh: 飞机正在三万英尺的高空飞行。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 hēah（高），后接名词后缀 -th（转为抽象名词），表“高的高度或状态”。

lemmas.def_en: a defense of some offensive behavior or some failure to keep a promise etc.
lemmas.def_zh: 借口；托词

examples.en: He offered a clumsy excuse for arriving late to the crucial board meeting.
examples.zh: 他为自己在关键董事会会议上的迟到提供了一个拙劣的借口。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To forgive someone for a fault or minor mistake, or to justify an action.
lemmas.def_zh: 原谅，宽恕；为……辩解

examples.en: He offered a clumsy excuse for arriving late to the crucial board meeting.
examples.zh: 他为自己在关键董事会会议上的迟到提供了一个拙劣的借口。

lemmas.def_en: not excused
lemmas.def_zh: 未经允许的；不能原谅的

examples.en: He faced serious penalties at school for three unexcused absences this month.
examples.zh: 他因本月三次无故缺勤而面临学校的严厉处罚。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 ex-（去除）+ cuse（指控、罪名），核心逻辑为“免除指责”，引申为借口或原谅。

lemmas.def_en: the part of the body between the neck and the upper arm
lemmas.def_zh: 肩, 肩膀, 衣肩

examples.en: She carried her heavy travel bag over her left shoulder all afternoon.
examples.zh: 她整个下午都把沉重的旅行包挎在左肩上。

lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To accept or take on responsibility, blame, or burden. 2. To push or move past someone using your shoulders.
lemmas.def_zh: 担负，承担（责任、费用等）；用肩推挤

examples.en: She carried her heavy travel bag over her left shoulder all afternoon.
examples.zh: 她整个下午都把沉重的旅行包挎在左肩上。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语，本义为身体部位“肩膀”，引申为用肩“扛起、承担”责任。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To hang something from a high place. 2. [T] To officially stop something for a period of time. 3. [T] To temporarily prevent someone from working or attending school.
lemmas.def_zh: 悬挂，吊；暂停，中止；使停职（或停学）

examples.en: The ferry service was suspended due to severe weather conditions.
examples.zh: 渡轮服务因恶劣天气而暂停。

lemmas.def_en: a mixture in which fine particles are suspended in a fluid where they are supported by buoyancy
lemmas.def_zh: 暂停，中止；停职；悬浮液；（汽车）悬挂系统

examples.en: The athlete received a two-year suspension after failing a drug test.
examples.zh: 该运动员在药检未过关后被处以两年禁赛。

lemmas.def_en: elastic straps that hold trousers up (usually used in the plural)
lemmas.def_zh: 悬挂者(物), 袜吊, 吊裤带

examples.en: He wore a pair of striped suspenders to keep his trousers up.
examples.zh: 他戴着一副条纹吊裤带来提住长裤。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 悬浮的；暂停的；延缓的
lemmas.def_en: floating or supported in a fluid without sinking; temporarily inactive or halted
lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰科学语境中的微粒（suspended particles），也用于法律/医学（suspended sentence 缓刑；suspended animation 假死）。

examples.en: The filter removes suspended particles from the water.
examples.zh: 该过滤器可清除水中悬浮的微粒。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 sub-/sus-（在……下面）+ pend（悬挂），字面为“挂在下方”，引申为使悬挂、暂停或停职。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To combine two or more things to make them work together effectively, or to become part of a group or system.
lemmas.def_zh: （使）结合，（使）成为一体；融入

examples.en: The software is designed to integrate seamlessly with existing systems.
examples.zh: 该软件旨在与现有系统实现无缝整合。

lemmas.def_en: the action of incorporating a racial or religious group into a community
lemmas.def_zh: 结合，整合；融入

examples.en: The economic integration of the region has boosted trade significantly.
examples.zh: 该地区的经济一体化极大促进了贸易往来。

lemmas.def_en: the result of a mathematical integration; F(x) is the integral of f(x) if dF/dx = f(x)
lemmas.def_zh: 整体, 积分, 整数

examples.en: Practical experience is an integral part of this comprehensive training program.
examples.zh: 实践经验是这个综合培训项目中不可或缺的组成部分。

lemmas.def_en: a measuring instrument for measuring the area of an irregular plane figure
lemmas.def_zh: 综合之人, 积分电路, 积分器
