examples.en: The company hired a systems integrator to connect all their internal software.
examples.zh: 公司聘请了一位系统集成商来连接他们所有的内部软件。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being total and complete
lemmas.def_zh: 完整性

examples.en: The team must preserve the integrality of the ancient manuscript during restoration.
examples.zh: 团队在修复过程中必须保持该古代手稿的完整性。

lemmas.def_en: existing as an essential constituent or characteristic
lemmas.def_zh: 固有的, 整体的, 整数的, 积分的

examples.en: Practical experience is an integral part of this comprehensive training program.
examples.zh: 实践经验是这个综合培训项目中不可或缺的组成部分。

lemmas.def_en: combining and coordinating diverse elements into a whole
lemmas.def_zh: 综合的, 一体化的

examples.en: The clinic uses an integrative medicine approach to treat chronic pain effectively.
examples.zh: 该诊所采用综合医学疗法来有效治疗慢性疼痛。

lemmas.def_en: in an integral manner
lemmas.def_zh: 完整地, 固有地

examples.en: Ethics should be integrally woven into the fabric of modern scientific research.
examples.zh: 伦理道德应该完整地融入现代科学研究的体系之中。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 integer（完整的），字面即“使成为一体”，引申为融合、结合。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To mend or fix something broken, damaged, or torn. 2. [T] To remedy or put right an unwelcome situation or damaged relationship. 3. [I] (formal) (+ to) To go to a particular place.
lemmas.def_zh: 修理，修补；补救，修复（关系、名誉等）；（formal）前往，去往（repair to）

examples.en: A local mechanic managed to repair the broken engine within two hours.
examples.zh: 一位当地机械师在两小时内修好了出故障的发动机。

lemmas.def_en: the act of putting something in working order again
lemmas.def_zh: 修理, 补救, 修复

examples.en: A local mechanic managed to repair the broken engine within two hours.
examples.zh: 一位当地机械师在两小时内修好了出故障的发动机。

lemmas.def_zh: 补偿, 赔偿, 弥补, 修复, 修理
lemmas.def_en: compensation (given or received) for an insult or injury

examples.en: The defeated nation was required to pay huge reparations for war damages.
examples.zh: 战败国被要求为战争造成的损害支付巨额赔偿金。

lemmas.def_en: a skilled worker who mends or repairs things
lemmas.def_zh: 修补者, 修理者

examples.en: We took the antique clock to a certified repairer in the city.
examples.zh: 我们把那台古董钟送到了城里一位有资质的修理工那里。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 reparare（重新准备、修整），核心语义为使损坏之物恢复完好状态。

lemmas.def_en: a painful emotion resulting from an awareness of inadequacy or guilt
lemmas.def_zh: 羞耻, 羞愧, 耻辱

examples.en: He felt deep shame after realizing how badly he had treated her.
examples.zh: 在意识到自己对她有多糟糕后，他感到深深的羞愧。

lemmas.def_en: behavior marked by a bold defiance of the proprieties and lack of shame
lemmas.def_zh: 无耻

examples.en: Her sheer shamelessness shocked everyone who attended the tense family meeting yesterday.
examples.zh: 在昨天紧张的家庭会议上，她彻头彻尾的厚颜无耻震惊了所有人。

lemmas.def_en: (used of conduct or character) deserving or bringing disgrace or shame; - Rachel Carson
lemmas.def_zh: 可耻的, 丢脸的, 不道德的, 淫猥的, 猥亵的, 不体面的

examples.en: Cheating on the final exam was a shameful act that ruined his reputation.
examples.zh: 期末考试作弊是一种可耻的行为，毁掉了他的声誉。

lemmas.def_en: feeling no shame
lemmas.def_zh: 不知羞耻的

examples.en: The politician told a shameless lie during the live television broadcast yesterday.
examples.zh: 这位政客在昨天的电视直播中撒了一个厚颜无耻的谎。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To pretend to have or feel something in order to deceive others.
lemmas.def_zh: 假装，装出，冒充

examples.en: He shammed illness so that he would not have to attend the meeting.
examples.zh: 他装病以便不必去参加会议。

lemmas.def_en: without shame
lemmas.def_zh: 不知羞耻地

examples.en: She shamelessly took credit for a brilliant project her colleague had completed.
examples.zh: 她不知羞耻地将同事完成的出色项目归功于自己。

lemmas.def_en: in a dishonorable manner or to a dishonorable degree
lemmas.def_zh: 不体面地；可耻地

examples.en: The company shamefully neglected worker safety standards for many years to save money.
examples.zh: 多年来，该公司为了省钱可耻地忽视了工人安全标准。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语，核心语义为因感到不光彩、有缺陷或做了错事而产生的痛苦羞耻感。
family_guide.core_distinction: shameful 指事物本身“可耻的、丢脸的”；shameless 指人“不知羞耻的、厚颜无耻的”。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] to mention or quote something as an example, proof, or authority 2. [T] (law) to officially summon someone to appear in court 3. [T] to praise someone publicly for their brave actions or meritorious work
lemmas.def_zh: 引用，引证；传唤，传讯；嘉奖，表彰

examples.en: Be sure to cite all academic sources properly in your final research paper.
examples.zh: 请务必在期末研究论文中正确引用所有学术来源。

lemmas.def_en: an official award (as for bravery or service) usually given as formal public statement
lemmas.def_zh: 引用, 引证, 引用文

examples.en: The officer issued a traffic citation for driving well over the speed limit.
examples.zh: 警官因其严重超速驾驶开出了一张交通罚单。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 citare（传唤、唤起、促动），引申为正式提及、引述某人言论或事实作为依据。

lemmas.def_en: a room equipped for preparing meals
lemmas.def_zh: 厨房, 全套炊具

examples.en: Delicious cooking aromas drifted from the kitchen as dinner was being prepared.
examples.zh: 准备晚饭时，厨房里飘出了诱人的饭菜香味。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 coquina（烹饪之所），指专门用于烹调食物的房间或区域。

lemmas.def_en: a device in which something (usually an animal) can be caught and penned
lemmas.def_zh: 圈套, 陷阱, 诡计, 存水弯

examples.en: The hikers set a small trap to catch rabbits in the dense forest.
examples.zh: 徒步旅行者在茂密的森林里设了一个小陷阱来抓兔子。

lemmas.def_en: stable gear consisting of a decorated covering for a horse, especially (formerly) for a warhorse
lemmas.def_zh: [计] 设陷, 陷入, 俘获

examples.en: Winter trapping of fur animals was once a vital industry in this region.
examples.zh: 冬季设陷诱捕毛皮动物曾是该地区的重要产业。

lemmas.def_en: someone who sets traps for animals (usually to obtain their furs)
lemmas.def_zh: 设陷阱捕兽者, 设陷阱猎兽者, 看门工

examples.en: An experienced trapper guided the researchers safely through the snowy wilderness.
examples.zh: 一位经验丰富的捕兽者带领研究人员安全穿过了白雪覆盖的荒野。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To catch an animal using a trap. 2. [T] To keep someone in a dangerous, confined, or difficult place from which they cannot escape.
lemmas.def_zh: 设陷阱捕捉，诱捕；困住，使陷入困境

examples.en: The hikers set a small trap to catch rabbits in the dense forest.
examples.zh: 徒步旅行者在茂密的森林里设了一个小陷阱来抓兔子。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语，核心语义为用以诱捕野兽的装置，引申为捕捉、围困或使陷入圈套。
family_guide.core_distinction: trap 为单数陷阱或圈套；trapping（常复数 trappings）指“附带物、装饰物、传统标志”，已虚化为外在修饰。

lemmas.def_en: not in accordance with the fact or reality or actuality
lemmas.def_zh: 错误的, 虚伪的, 假的, 不老实的

examples.en: Spreading false rumors about innocent colleagues will result in severe disciplinary action.
examples.zh: 散布关于无辜同事的虚假谣言将导致严厉的纪律处分。

lemmas.def_en: in an insincerely false manner
lemmas.def_zh: 虚伪地, 错误地, 不实地

examples.en: The innocent man was falsely accused of a crime he did not commit.
examples.zh: 这名无辜男子被诬告犯下了他并未做过的罪行。

lemmas.def_zh: 伪造, 歪曲
lemmas.def_en: any evidence that helps to establish the falsity of something

examples.en: The researcher was dismissed after an investigation revealed the deliberate falsification of clinical data.
examples.zh: 调查发现该研究人员故意伪造临床数据后，他被解雇了。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being false or untrue
lemmas.def_zh: 虚伪, 错误, 不忠实, 谎言

examples.en: The lawyer quickly exposed the falsity of the witness's claims in court.
examples.zh: 律师在法庭上迅速揭露了证人证言的虚假性。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being false or untrue
lemmas.def_zh: 虚伪, 不正确, 不忠实

examples.en: She could detect the falseness in his overly polite apology immediately.
examples.zh: 她立刻察觉到了他那过分礼貌的道歉中的虚伪。

lemmas.def_zh: 伪造，篡改；证明……不属实
lemmas.def_en: [T] to alter, forge, or misrepresent records, documents, or data dishonestly in order to deceive people

examples.en: The corrupt accountant was arrested after trying to falsify official corporate financial records.
examples.zh: 这名贪腐的会计因企图伪造公司官方财务记录而被捕。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 fallere（欺骗、误导），核心语义为与事实不符的、虚假造作的。

lemmas.def_en: the flesh of animals (including fishes and birds and snails) used as food
lemmas.def_zh: 肉, 餐, 食物

examples.en: He decided to cut down on red meat to improve his health.
examples.zh: 为了改善健康，他决定减少红肉的摄入量。

lemmas.def_en: like or containing meat
lemmas.def_zh: 肉的, 似肉的, 多肉的

examples.en: The professor gave a meaty lecture filled with valuable insights today.
examples.zh: 教授今天做了一场内容充实、见解深刻的讲座。

lemmas.def_en: lacking meat
lemmas.def_zh: 无肉的, 无内容的

examples.en: Many families choose to have meatless meals on Mondays for environmental reasons.
examples.zh: 出于环保原因，许多家庭选择在周一吃无肉餐。

family_guide.root_logic: 古英语中原指泛称的“食物”，后词义缩小专指动物的肌肉组织或可食部分。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To break or act against a law, rule, or agreement. 2. [T] To infringe upon someone's rights or privacy; disrespect or desecrate something sacred.
lemmas.def_zh: 违反，违犯（法律、协议）；侵犯；亵渎

examples.en: Companies that violate safety regulations will face severe financial penalties.
examples.zh: 违反安全规程的公司将面临严厉的经济处罚。

lemmas.def_en: a crime less serious than a felony
lemmas.def_zh: 违反, 违背, 妨碍

examples.en: Parking in front of a fire hydrant is a serious traffic violation.
examples.zh: 在消防栓前停车是严重的交通违章行为。

lemmas.def_en: someone who violates the law
lemmas.def_zh: 违反者, 违背者, 妨碍者

examples.en: The park rangers warned that any violator of the rules would be fined.
examples.zh: 公园管理员警告说，任何违规者都将被处以罚款。

lemmas.def_en: violating or tending to violate or offend against
lemmas.def_zh: [法] 违犯的, 违反的, 妨害的

examples.en: The court ruled that the new law was violative of constitutional rights.
examples.zh: 法院裁定新法律侵犯了宪法赋予的权利。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 violare（使用暴力侵犯、亵渎），核心语义为以强力或违规手段破坏法则、权利或神圣性。

lemmas.def_en: conforming exactly or almost exactly to fact or to a standard or performing with total accuracy
lemmas.def_zh: 正确的, 精确的

examples.en: The weather forecast turned out to be remarkably accurate this whole week.
examples.zh: 这整整一周的天气预报结果都非常准确。

lemmas.def_en: with few mistakes
lemmas.def_zh: 正确地, 精确地

examples.en: The sensor can accurately measure temperature changes in a fraction of a second.
examples.zh: 该传感器能在刹那间精确测量温度变化。

family_guide.root_logic: 由前缀 ad-（去）+ cura（照料、关心）构成，字面指“精心照料完成的”，引申为极少差错、精确的。

lemmas.def_en: an occasion on which a winner is selected from among two or more contestants
lemmas.def_zh: 竞赛, 争论

examples.en: She won first prize in the national piano contest last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚她在全国钢琴比赛中获得了一等奖。

lemmas.def_en: a contentious speech act; a dispute where there is strong disagreement
lemmas.def_zh: 争论, 竞赛

examples.en: The new land policy has become a subject of fierce political contestation.
examples.zh: 这项新土地政策已成为激烈政治争论的焦点。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To compete or fight for power, control, or victory. 2. [T] To formally argue against or challenge the validity of a decision or result.
lemmas.def_zh: 角逐，争夺；质疑，对……提出异议

examples.en: She won first prize in the national piano contest last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚她在全国钢琴比赛中获得了一等奖。

lemmas.def_en: not disputed and not made the object of contention or competition
lemmas.def_zh: 没有人争的, 无竞争的, 明显的

examples.en: He won an uncontested victory after his main opponent suddenly withdrew.
examples.zh: 在主要对手突然退出后，他毫无争议地赢得了胜利。

lemmas.def_en: capable of being contested
lemmas.def_zh: 可争的, 争论的

examples.en: The validity of the contract remains contestable due to missing signatures.
examples.zh: 由于缺少签名，该合同的有效性仍存在争议。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 contestari（一同作证、当众争辩），引申为竞争、对抗或对某事提出质疑。

lemmas.def_en: a round fastener sewn to shirts and coats etc to fit through buttonholes
lemmas.def_zh: 钮扣, 按钮

examples.en: Press the red button on the wall to stop the machine immediately.
examples.zh: 按下墙上的红色按钮可立即停止机器。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (+ up) To fasten a garment with buttons.
lemmas.def_zh: 扣上纽扣，系紧纽扣；用纽扣扣住

examples.en: Press the red button on the wall to stop the machine immediately.
examples.zh: 按下墙上的红色按钮可立即停止机器。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To undo the buttons of an item of clothing.
lemmas.def_zh: 解开（……的）纽扣

examples.en: He had to unbutton his collar because the room was too hot.
examples.zh: 因为房间太热，他不得不解开衣领的纽扣。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 boton（芽、小圆凸起），指衣服上的小扣子或设备的控制按键。

lemmas.def_en: the best people or things in a group
lemmas.def_zh: 奶油

examples.en: She served the warm pie with a generous scoop of whipped cream.
examples.zh: 她在热馅饼上配了一大勺打发奶油。

lemmas.def_en: the property of having the thickness of heavy cream
lemmas.def_zh: 乳脂状, 含乳脂, 乳脂色

examples.en: The slow cooking process gives the soup its rich texture and creaminess.
examples.zh: 慢炖的过程赋予了这道汤浓郁的口感和丝滑度。

lemmas.def_en: of the color of cream
lemmas.def_zh: 含乳脂的, 乳脂状的, 奶油色的

examples.en: The chef served pasta coated in a rich and creamy garlic sauce.
examples.zh: 主厨端上了裹着浓郁奶香大蒜酱的意面。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To mix or beat ingredients (such as butter and sugar) together until they form a smooth, soft, creamy mixture.
lemmas.def_zh: 搅打成奶油状；把（黄油和糖）搅成乳霜状

examples.en: She applied a soothing face cream before going to bed last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚睡前，她涂抹了具有舒缓效果的面霜。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自晚期拉丁语 cramum（奶油），核心语义为乳脂状物，引申为浓稠乳霜或事物最精华的部分。

lemmas.def_en: a hollow device made of metal that makes a ringing sound when struck
lemmas.def_zh: 铃, 钟

examples.en: The church bell rings loudly every morning to wake up the small village.
examples.zh: 教堂的钟声每天清晨敲响，唤醒了整座小村庄。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To attach a bell to an animal or object.
lemmas.def_zh: 给……系上铃铛；给……装铃

examples.en: The church bell rings loudly every morning to wake up the small village.
examples.zh: 教堂的钟声每天清晨敲响，唤醒了整座小村庄。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语模拟金属敲击声的拟声词，指钟、铃等发声器具。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To think of, consider, or evaluate someone or something in a particular way. 2. [T] (formal) To look closely or steadily at someone or something.
lemmas.def_zh: 视作，把……看作；注视

examples.en: Many critics regard his latest novel as the best work of his entire career.
examples.zh: 许多评论家认为他的最新小说是他整个职业生涯中最优秀的作品。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 regarder（注视、关注），核心语义为把目光投向某事，引申为关于、至于。

lemmas.def_en: having the deep slightly brownish color of gold
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 金黄色的；金质的；美好的，宝贵的

examples.en: This is a golden opportunity to expand your business overseas.
examples.zh: 这是向海外拓展业务的绝佳机会。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 gold（黄金）加形容词后缀 -en 构成，本义为金质的，引申指金黄色的或极好的。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. To discuss something formally in order to reach an agreement. 2. To successfully deal with or get past a difficult obstacle or route.
lemmas.def_zh: 谈判，协商；商定；顺利通过（障碍）

examples.en: The government refuses to negotiate with terrorists.
examples.zh: 政府拒绝与恐怖分子谈判。

lemmas.def_en: a discussion intended to produce an agreement
lemmas.def_zh: n. 谈判，协商

examples.en: The contract is still under negotiation between the two parties.
examples.zh: 双方仍在就合同进行协商。

lemmas.def_en: someone who negotiates (confers with others in order to reach a settlement)
lemmas.def_zh: 磋商者, 交涉者, 议定者

examples.en: The lead negotiator worked tirelessly through the night to reach a peaceful agreement.
examples.zh: 首席谈判代表整夜不懈努力，最终达成了一项和平协议。

lemmas.def_zh: 可磋商的, 可转让的, 可通行的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being passed or negotiated

examples.en: The starting salary is negotiable depending on your previous relevant work experience.
examples.zh: 起薪可根据你以往的相关工作经验进行商议。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 negotiari（经营商务），核心语义为“通过沟通交涉以达成协议”。

lemmas.def_en: a performance of music by players or singers not involving theatrical staging
lemmas.def_zh: n. 音乐会，演奏会；协同，一致

examples.en: They attended a classical music concert at the city hall.
examples.zh: 他们去市政厅听了一场古典音乐会。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (formal) To plan, arrange, or settle something by mutual agreement or cooperation.
lemmas.def_zh: 商定，协同安排，协力策划

examples.en: They attended a classical music concert at the city hall.
examples.zh: 他们去市政厅听了一场古典音乐会。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 con-（共同）+ cert（竞争/争辩），演变为“协同行动、谐调一致”，现多指音乐上的协奏与音乐会。

lemmas.def_en: religious ministers collectively (especially Presbyterian)
lemmas.def_zh: n. （政府的）部；（宗教的）神职，牧师工作

examples.en: He was appointed as the head of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
examples.zh: 他被任命为外交部部长。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自 minister（仆人/大臣），核心意指提供服务或执行职能的机构或职责。

lemmas.def_en: first in rank or degree
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 首要的，第一的；n. 总理，首相

examples.en: The Premier addressed the nation during the broadcast.
examples.zh: 总理在电视广播中向全国发表了讲话。

lemmas.def_en: the office of premier
lemmas.def_zh: n. 首相（或总理）的职位及任期

examples.en: His premiership was marked by significant economic reforms.
examples.zh: 他在任首相期间进行了重大的经济改革。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To have a first public performance or showing, or to present a show or film for the first time.
lemmas.def_zh: 首演，首次公映；使……首映（或首演）

examples.en: The Premier addressed the nation during the broadcast.
examples.zh: 总理在电视广播中向全国发表了讲话。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 primus（第一），指地位、时间或重要性处于最首位。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] to keep something in its original state or in good condition; to prevent something from being damaged or destroyed. 2. [T] to treat food to prevent it from decaying.
lemmas.def_zh: 保护，维护；保存，保留；腌制（食物）

examples.en: Efforts are being made to preserve the historic district.
examples.zh: 人们正在努力保护这一历史街区。

lemmas.def_en: the activity of protecting something from loss or danger
lemmas.def_zh: n. 保护，维护；储藏

examples.en: The historic building is in a good state of preservation.
examples.zh: 这座历史建筑保存完好。

lemmas.def_en: a chemical compound that is added to protect against decay or decomposition
lemmas.def_zh: 预防药, 防腐剂

examples.en: This organic bread contains no artificial preservative, so you should eat it quickly.
examples.zh: 这种有机面包不含人工防腐剂，所以你应该尽快吃完。

lemmas.def_en: a skilled worker who is employed to restore or refinish buildings or antique furniture
lemmas.def_zh: 保护者, 保存者, 防腐物, 防护物

examples.en: She dedicated her whole life to being an active preserver of ancient folk traditions.
examples.zh: 她毕生致力于成为一名积极保护古代民间传统的人。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. （食物）腌制的，防腐的；保存完好的
lemmas.def_en: kept from decay or decomposition, especially by being canned, frozen, or pickled; maintained in its original state
lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰加工以供长期储存的食物（preserved fruit / meat）或古遗迹。

examples.en: The museum exhibits perfectly preserved specimens of ancient flora.
examples.zh: 博物馆展出了保存完好的古代植物标本。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 pre-（预先）+ serve（守护、保留），本义为“预先保护以免变质或损坏”。

lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To explain or clarify something by using examples, diagrams, or pictures. 2. To provide pictures, drawings, or photographs for a book or article.
lemmas.def_zh: （用例子、数据等）阐明，说明；给……加插图

examples.en: She used a simple diagram to illustrate her point.
examples.zh: 她用一张简单的图表来说明自己的观点。

lemmas.def_en: artwork that helps make something clear or attractive
lemmas.def_zh: n. 插图；例证，说明

examples.en: The book contains dozens of colorful illustrations.
examples.zh: 这本书包含了数十张彩色插图。

lemmas.def_en: an artist who makes illustrations (for books or magazines or advertisements etc.)
lemmas.def_zh: 插画家, 图解者, 说明者

examples.en: The talented illustrator spent months drawing colorful pictures for the new children's book.
examples.zh: 这位才华横溢的插画家花了数月时间为这本新童书绘制全彩插图。

lemmas.def_en: clarifying by use of examples
lemmas.def_zh: 说明的, 解说的, 作例证的

examples.en: The professor provided an illustrative example to help students understand the complex theory.
examples.zh: 教授提供了一个说明性的例子，帮助学生们理解这个复杂的理论。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 il-（使）+ lustr（光亮）+ -ate，本义为“照亮”，引申为使清晰明白、用图画解释。

lemmas.def_en: a narrow way or road
lemmas.def_zh: n. （乡间）小路，巷；车道；泳道

examples.en: Stay in your lane while driving on the highway.
examples.zh: 在高速公路上行驶时请保持在自己的车道内。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，本义为狭长的通道，现指窄巷或被标画出的车道、泳道。

lemmas.def_en: a visual display of information
lemmas.def_zh: n. 图表；航海图；排行榜

examples.en: The sales chart shows a steady upward trend this year.
examples.zh: 销售图表显示今年呈现稳步上升的趋势。

lemmas.def_en: a 19th century English reformer who advocated better social and economic conditions for working people
lemmas.def_zh: 宪章派, 宪章运动者

examples.en: The dedicated Chartist campaigned tirelessly across Britain for universal male voting rights.
examples.zh: 这位坚定的宪章派人士在全英国奔走，争取普遍的男性选举权。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To record or track the development, progress, or change of something over time. 2. [T] To make a map or chart of an area.
lemmas.def_zh: 记录，跟踪记录（进展或变化）；绘制……的图表（或地图）

examples.en: The sales chart shows a steady upward trend this year.
examples.zh: 销售图表显示今年呈现稳步上升的趋势。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 chartes（纸莎草纸），引申为记载信息或方位的图纸、表格。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To make someone feel unhappy, worried, or angry. 2. [T] To disturb the normal order, balance, or progress of something. 3. [T] To knock something over accidentally.
lemmas.def_zh: 使心烦意乱，使苦恼；扰乱，打乱；打翻

examples.en: The unexpected bad news upset all our travel plans.
examples.zh: 这则突如其来的坏消息打乱了我们所有的旅行计划。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 混乱；烦恼；（意外的）失败，爆冷门
lemmas.def_en: an unexpected defeat of a favorite competitor; an emotional or physical disturbance
lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，常指体育比赛中的爆冷、令人意外的输赢，也指胃部不适（stomach upset）或情绪紊乱。

examples.en: The victory was regarded as one of the biggest upsets in tennis history.
examples.zh: 这场胜利被视为网球史上最大的爆冷之一。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 up（向上/翻）+ set（放置）构成，字面意为“从底部掀翻”，引申为打乱计划或使情绪翻腾不安。

lemmas.def_en: any of a large group of nitrogenous organic compounds that are essential constituents of living cells; consist of polymers of amino acids; essential in the diet of animals for growth and for repair of tissues; can be obtained from meat and eggs and milk and legumes
lemmas.def_zh: n. 蛋白质

examples.en: Eggs and fish are excellent sources of protein.
examples.zh: 鸡蛋和鱼肉是蛋白质的极佳来源。

lemmas.def_zh: 朊的, 蛋白质的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or of the nature of protein

examples.en: The laboratory analyzed the proteinaceous residue left on the surface of the ancient pottery.
examples.zh: 实验室分析了残留在古代陶器表面的蛋白质残留物。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 proteios（首要的、基本的），因其被视为生命体中不可或缺的基础物质。

lemmas.def_en: discourse that surrounds a language unit and helps to determine its interpretation
lemmas.def_zh: n. （事情发生的）背景，环境；上下文

examples.en: It is important to analyze the speech within its historical context.
examples.zh: 在历史背景下分析这篇演讲至关重要。

lemmas.def_zh: 上下文的, 前后关系的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or determined by or in context

examples.en: Understanding a word often requires analyzing its specific contextual usage in sentences.
examples.zh: 理解一个词通常需要分析它在句子中的特定语境用法。

lemmas.def_zh: 根据上下文
lemmas.def_en: in a manner dependent on context

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 con-（共同）+ text（编织），原指“织在一起的语言环境”，引申为背景、上下文。

lemmas.def_en: a large structure for open-air sports or entertainments
lemmas.def_zh: n. 露天大型体育场

examples.en: Thousands of fans gathered outside the stadium before the match.
examples.zh: 数千名球迷在比赛前聚集在体育场外。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊度量单位 stadion（约180米跑道长），演变为古代及现代供公众观赛的体育场。

lemmas.def_en: attractive especially by means of smallness or prettiness or quaintness
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 可爱的，迷人的；机巧的

examples.en: She adopted a cute puppy from the animal shelter.
examples.zh: 她从动物收容所领养了一只可爱的小狗。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being appealing in a delicate or graceful way (of a girl or young woman)
lemmas.def_zh: 可爱; 娇小可爱

examples.en: The sheer cuteness of the newborn kitten brought smiles to everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 刚出生的小猫无比可爱，让房间里的每个人都露出了笑容。

lemmas.def_en: in an attractive manner
lemmas.def_zh: 精明地, 伶俐地

examples.en: The little puppy tilted its head cutely whenever it heard someone say its name.
examples.zh: 每当听到有人叫自己的名字，那只小狗就会可爱地歪着头。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 acute（敏锐的，机灵的）的口语缩写，原指机敏，后演变为讨人喜欢、小巧可爱的。

lemmas.def_en: the part of an organism (human or animal) that connects the head to the rest of the body
lemmas.def_zh: 脖子, 衣领, 颈

examples.en: She wore a beautiful gold necklace gracefully around her slender neck during the gala.
examples.zh: 在晚会上，她优雅地将一条漂亮的黄金项链戴在纤细的颈项上。

lemmas.def_en: a lover who necks
lemmas.def_zh: 内克尔（姓氏）；内克尔岛（英属维京群岛）

examples.en: The adventurous travelers took a private boat to visit the scenic shores of Necker Island.
examples.zh: 富有冒险精神的旅行者乘私人游艇游览了内克尔岛秀美的海岸。

lemmas.def_en: [I] (informal) to kiss and caress passionately.
lemmas.def_zh: （亲昵地）接吻抚弄，拥吻

examples.en: She wore a beautiful gold necklace gracefully around her slender neck during the gala.
examples.zh: 在晚会上，她优雅地将一条漂亮的黄金项链戴在纤细的颈项上。

lemmas.def_en: lacking or apparently lacking a neck
lemmas.def_zh: neck的变形

examples.en: The stylized cartoon character was designed completely neckless to make it look much rounder.
examples.zh: 这个风格化的卡通角色被设计成完全没有脖子，显得更加圆润。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，本义指连接头部与躯干的细长部分，引申指狭长结构或拥抱亲吻等动作。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] to offer to do something without being forced or paid 2. [T] to offer information, opinions, or assistance willingly 3. [I] to enlist for military or social service willingly
lemmas.def_zh: 自愿做，主动提供；自愿服役

examples.en: Several enthusiastic students decided to volunteer at the local animal shelter this weekend.
examples.zh: 几名热心的学生决定这个周末自愿去当地的动物收容所帮忙。

lemmas.def_en: (military) a person who freely enlists for service
lemmas.def_zh: 志愿者

examples.en: Several enthusiastic students decided to volunteer at the local animal shelter this weekend.
examples.zh: 几名热心的学生决定这个周末自愿去当地的动物收容所帮忙。

lemmas.def_en: of your own free will or design; done by choice; not forced or compelled
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 自愿的，无偿的

examples.en: Attendance at the extra workshop is purely voluntary.
examples.zh: 参加额外讲习班纯属自愿。

lemmas.def_en: out of your own free will
lemmas.def_zh: adv. 自愿地，自动地

examples.en: He voluntarily surrendered his passport to the police.
examples.zh: 他自愿向警方交出了护照。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 voluntas（意愿、自愿），指主动承担责任或无偿提供服务的人与行为。

lemmas.def_en: the head of a city government
lemmas.def_zh: 市长

examples.en: The city mayor gave an inspiring speech about new green initiatives yesterday afternoon.
examples.zh: 市长昨天下午就新的绿色环保倡议发表了一场鼓舞人心的演讲。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a mayor or the office of mayor
lemmas.def_zh: 市长的

examples.en: Both candidates spent months campaigning intensely to win the upcoming mayoral election this autumn.
examples.zh: 两位候选人花了数月时间激烈竞选，以争取赢得今年秋天的市长选举。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 major（更大的、年长的），原指首领，现专指城市或城镇的行政长官。

lemmas.def_en: a learned person (especially in the humanities); someone who by long study has gained mastery in one or more disciplines
lemmas.def_zh: 学者, 奖学金获得者, 有文化者, 学习者

examples.en: The renowned scholar spent decades researching the complex history of the ancient empire.
examples.zh: 这位著名的学者花了几十年的时间研究这个古代帝国的复杂历史。

lemmas.def_en: financial aid provided to a student on the basis of academic merit
lemmas.def_zh: 学问, 学术成就, 奖学金

examples.en: Her remarkable academic performance earned her a prestigious scholarship to study in London.
examples.zh: 她出色的学业成绩为她赢得了去伦敦留学的著名奖学金。

lemmas.def_en: characteristic of scholars or scholarship
lemmas.def_zh: 学者派头的, 学者风度的, 有学问的, 博学的, 好学的

examples.en: He published several scholarly articles in prestigious international journals during his doctoral studies.
examples.zh: 攻读博士期间，他在顶尖国际期刊上发表了数篇学术论文。

lemmas.def_en: not scholarly
lemmas.def_zh: 不象学者的, 没有学问的

examples.en: The reviewer criticized the historical book for its casual tone and unscholarly approach.
examples.zh: 评论家批评这本历史书用词随意，且缺乏严谨的学术态度。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 schole（闲暇、求知），由学校引申出学者及相关学识概念。
family_guide.core_distinction: scholar 指有学问的学者；scholarship 指奖学金或学术成就；scholarly 强调学术性的修养与作风。

lemmas.def_en: the most extreme possible amount or value
lemmas.def_zh: 山峰, 巅, 山顶, 顶点, 尖峰, 帽舌

examples.en: Tourist numbers usually peak during the warm summer months before declining sharply in autumn.
examples.zh: 游客人数通常在温暖的夏季月份达到顶峰，然后在秋季急剧下降。

lemmas.def_en: [I] to reach the highest point, level, or value
lemmas.def_zh: 达到最高点，达到峰值

examples.en: Tourist numbers usually peak during the warm summer months before declining sharply in autumn.
examples.zh: 游客人数通常在温暖的夏季月份达到顶峰，然后在秋季急剧下降。

lemmas.def_en: having or as if having especially high-pitched spots
lemmas.def_zh: 有峰的, 多峰的, 尖的, 消瘦的

examples.en: She looked a bit peaky after recovering from the long winter flu.
examples.zh: 在漫长的冬季流感痊愈后，她看起来有点消瘦憔悴。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语族，指尖端、山巅，引申为各领域发展的最高峰或极值状态。

lemmas.def_en: a recompense for worthy acts or retribution for wrongdoing
lemmas.def_zh: 报酬, 酬谢, 赏金

examples.en: The company offered a generous reward for the return of the lost data.
examples.zh: 公司悬赏重金寻找丢失的数据。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To give something to someone because they have done good work, behaved well, or achieved success.
lemmas.def_zh: 奖赏，报答，酬谢；使得到应有回报

examples.en: The company offered a generous reward for the return of the lost data.
examples.zh: 公司悬赏重金寻找丢失的数据。

lemmas.def_en: not rewarding; not providing personal satisfaction
lemmas.def_zh: 无报酬的, 不值得做的

examples.en: Filing paperwork all day felt like a dull and completely unrewarding task.
examples.zh: 整天整理文件感觉是一项枯燥且毫无回报的任务。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语，由 re-（回）与 ward（注视、守护）演化，核心意象为对他人付出的回报或奖赏。

lemmas.def_en: the food served and eaten at one time
lemmas.def_zh: 一餐, 膳食, 粗粉

examples.en: They enjoyed a hearty warm meal together after a long day of hiking.
examples.zh: 在徒步一整天后，他们一起享用了一顿丰盛的温热晚餐。

lemmas.def_en: containing meal or made of meal
lemmas.def_zh: 粉状的

examples.en: These stored apples have turned mealy and lost all their crisp sweetness.
examples.zh: 这些储存的苹果已经变得粉碎绵软，失去了清脆的甜味。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，本义指固定的时间或量度，后特指一日内定时摄入的一顿饭食。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of medical science that treats disease or injury by operative procedures
lemmas.def_zh: 外科, 手术, 手术室, 换球术

examples.en: The patient is recovering well after undergoing minor knee surgery this morning.
examples.zh: 病人在今天上午接受了膝关节小手术后恢复良好。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or involving or used in surgery
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 外科的，手术上的；精准的，精确的

examples.en: The team carried out the raid with surgical precision.
examples.zh: 该团队以手术般的外科级精度执行了这次突袭。

lemmas.def_en: not surgical
lemmas.def_zh: [医] 非外科的

examples.en: The specialist recommended nonsurgical therapies before considering any invasive procedure.
examples.zh: 专家建议在考虑任何有创手术之前先尝试非外科疗法。

lemmas.def_en: in a surgical manner; by means of surgery
lemmas.def_zh: 如外科手术般地

examples.en: The damaged knee cartilage was surgically removed during a routine minor operation.
examples.zh: 受损的膝部软骨在一次常规的小手术中被手术切除了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 kheir（手）与 ergon（工作），字面指“用手劳作”，引申为外科手术及诊室。

lemmas.def_en: a traveler riding in a vehicle (a boat or bus or car or plane or train etc) who is not operating it
lemmas.def_zh: 乘客, 旅客

examples.en: Every passenger must fasten their seatbelt before the flight prepares to take off.
examples.zh: 在航班准备起飞之前，每位乘客都必须系好安全带。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自法语 passager（经过者、旅行者），现专指乘坐交通工具而非驾驶它的乘客。

lemmas.def_en: message that is transmitted by radio or television
lemmas.def_zh: 广播, 传播

examples.en: The station will broadcast the championship football game live to millions of fans.
examples.zh: 电视台将向数百万球迷现场直播这场足球冠军赛。

lemmas.def_en: someone who broadcasts on radio or television
lemmas.def_zh: 播送者, 广播装置, 播种机

examples.en: The experienced broadcaster delivered the breaking evening news with calm authority.
examples.zh: 这位经验丰富的播音员从容权威地播报了傍晚的突发新闻。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To transmit programmes or information by radio or television. 2. [T] To tell a large number of people about something. 3. [T] To scatter seeds widely over the ground.
lemmas.def_zh: 广播，播放（电视或电台节目）；散播，广而告之；播撒（种子）

examples.en: The station will broadcast the championship football game live to millions of fans.
examples.zh: 电视台将向数百万球迷现场直播这场足球冠军赛。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词 broad（广泛地）+ cast（投掷、播撒），原指大面积撒种，后引申为无线电及电视广播。
family_guide.core_distinction: broadcast 指广播内容或播出行为；broadcaster 指播音员或广播电台机构。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of a person's voice
lemmas.def_zh: 音调, 音质, 语调, 语气, 色调, 气氛, 状况, 思想状态

examples.en: His harsh tone of voice clearly indicated that he was very annoyed.
examples.zh: 他严厉的语气清楚地表明他非常生气。

lemmas.def_en: lime- or lemon-flavored carbonated water containing quinine
lemmas.def_zh: 补药, (音乐)主调音或基音

examples.en: A brisk walk in the fresh mountain air was a wonderful tonic.
examples.zh: 在清新的山间空气中快走是一剂极好的滋补良药。

lemmas.def_en: a solution containing chemicals that can change the color of a photographic print
lemmas.def_zh: 调色剂

examples.en: The office printer ran out of black toner right before the big meeting.
examples.zh: 办公室打印机在大考前夕恰好耗尽了黑色墨粉。

lemmas.def_zh: 朗诵, 语调, 唱
lemmas.def_en: rise and fall of the voice pitch
any of 24 major or minor diatonic scales that provide the tonal framework for a piece of music
lemmas.def_zh: 音调, 色调

examples.en: The composer experimented with shifting tonality to create an unsettling musical atmosphere.
examples.zh: 作曲家尝试改变调性，以营造一种令人不安的音乐氛围。

lemmas.def_en: the elastic tension of living muscles, arteries, etc. that facilitate response to stimuli
lemmas.def_zh: 强壮, 肌肉弹性

examples.en: Proper physical therapy helps restore normal muscle tonicity after a severe injury.
examples.zh: 适当的物理治疗有助于在重伤后恢复正常的肌肉张力。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (archaic or literary) To utter words in a rhythmic, monotonous, or chanting voice; intone. 2. [T] To make muscles or the body firmer and stronger.
lemmas.def_zh: 吟诵，用单调的声音念；使（身体或肌肉）结实；给……定色调

examples.en: His harsh tone of voice clearly indicated that he was very annoyed.
examples.zh: 他严厉的语气清楚地表明他非常生气。

lemmas.def_zh: 吟咏
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To intone words or a prayer means to say or chant them slowly in a serious, solemn, and steady tone.

examples.en: The monks began to intone their evening prayers in a solemn rhythm.
examples.zh: 僧侣们开始以庄严的节奏吟诵晚祷。

lemmas.def_en: employing variations in pitch to distinguish meanings of otherwise similar words
lemmas.def_zh: 音调的, 色调的

examples.en: Mandarin Chinese is a tonal language where pitch changes alter a word's meaning.
examples.zh: 汉语普通话是一种声调语言，声调的变化会改变词义。

lemmas.def_en: lacking in tone or expression
lemmas.def_zh: 缺乏声调的, 单调的, 沉闷的

examples.en: He answered the detective's urgent questions in a completely flat, toneless voice.
examples.zh: 他用毫无起伏、极其单调的声音回答了侦探的紧急提问。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 tonos（张力、音调），由绳子紧绷产生的音高引申为语调、气氛及色调。

lemmas.def_en: an imaginary creature usually having various human and animal parts
lemmas.def_zh: 怪物, 恶人, 巨物

examples.en: The brave knight set out into the dark forest to defeat the terrifying monster.
examples.zh: 勇敢的骑士出发进入黑暗森林，去击败那只可怕的怪物。

lemmas.def_zh: 畸形, 奇怪, 怪异
lemmas.def_en: a person or animal that is markedly unusual or deformed

examples.en: The modern concrete tower was considered an architectural monstrosity by local residents.
examples.zh: 当地居民认为那座现代混凝土塔楼是一座建筑怪胎。

lemmas.def_zh: 巨大的, 畸形的, 怪异的
lemmas.def_en: abnormally large

examples.en: A monstrous wave suddenly crashed over the deck of the small fishing boat.
examples.zh: 一个巨大的浪头突然猛烈地打在小渔船的甲板上。

lemmas.def_zh: 可怕地；荒唐地；强烈地
lemmas.def_en: in a hideous manner

examples.en: her face was hideously disfigured after the accident

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 monstrum（预兆、异象），原指具有警示意味的异物，后指恐怖或巨大的怪物。

lemmas.def_en: street names for gamma hydroxybutyrate
lemmas.def_zh: [计] 最大

examples.en: You can invite up to four guests to the private party at max.
examples.zh: 你最多只能邀请四位客人参加这个私人聚会。

family_guide.root_logic: maximum（最大量、极大值）的非正式截短形式，常用于口语及非正式书面表达。

lemmas.def_en: to or in any or all places; ; ; ; ; (`everyplace' is used informally for `everywhere')
lemmas.def_zh: 各处, 到处

examples.en: During the spring festival, colorful lanterns and bright banners could be seen everywhere.
examples.zh: 在春节期间，到处都可以看到五颜六色的灯笼和鲜艳的横幅。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词 every（每个）+ where（哪里），逻辑上表示无处不在、全方位的处所副词。

lemmas.def_en: a numerical scale used to compare variables with one another or with some reference number
lemmas.def_zh: 索引, 指针, 指数, 指标

examples.en: You can quickly locate the specific topic by checking the book's index.
examples.zh: 你可以通过查阅书后的索引快速找到特定主题。

lemmas.def_en: a system of economic regulation: wages and interest are tied to the cost-of-living index in order to reduce the effects of inflation
lemmas.def_zh: [经] 指数化

examples.en: The government introduced wage indexation to protect workers against rising inflation rates.
examples.zh: 政府引入了工资指数化，以保护工人免受通货膨胀上升的影响。

lemmas.def_en: someone who provides an index
lemmas.def_zh: 编索引的人

examples.en: The publisher hired a freelance indexer to organize the academic textbook thoroughly.
examples.zh: 出版社聘请了一位自由职业索引编制者，对这本学术教科书进行全面整理。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To create an alphabetical index for a book, document, or collection. 2. [T] To list or record something in an index.
lemmas.def_zh: 为……编索引；将……编入索引

examples.en: The editor spent several days indexing all key terms in the manuscript.
examples.zh: 编辑花了几天时间为书稿中的所有关键词编制索引。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or serving as an index
lemmas.def_zh: 索引的, 像索引排列的

examples.en: Words like 'here' and 'now' have an indexical meaning in everyday conversation.
examples.zh: 像“这里”和“现在”这样的词在日常交谈中具有指示性意义。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 index（指示者、食指），引申为引导阅读的索引或衡量趋势的指标。

lemmas.def_en: a body of people who settle far from home but maintain ties with their homeland; inhabitants remain nationals of their home state but are not literally under the home state's system of government
lemmas.def_zh: n. 殖民地；群体

examples.en: The island was once a British colony.
examples.zh: 这座岛屿曾经是英国的殖民地。

lemmas.def_en: a resident of a colony
lemmas.def_zh: n. 殖民地居民

examples.en: The colonials demanded greater autonomy from the empire.
examples.zh: 殖民地居民要求帝国给予更大的自治权。

lemmas.def_en: the act of colonizing; the establishment of colonies
lemmas.def_zh: [医] 移生, 移地发育; 集中护理(精神病人)

examples.en: The rapid colonization of the gut by beneficial bacteria helps improve digestion.
examples.zh: 有益细菌在肠道内的快速定植有助于改善消化。

lemmas.def_en: a person who settles in a new colony or moves into new country
lemmas.def_zh: 殖民地居民, 移民

examples.en: Every early colonist had to work hard to build homes and clear land.
examples.zh: 每位早期殖民定居者都必须辛勤劳作以建造房屋和清理土地。

lemmas.def_en: someone who helps to found a colony
lemmas.def_zh: 殖民地开拓者, 殖民者, 移入选民

examples.en: The European colonizers imposed their language and legal system on the local population.
examples.zh: 欧洲殖民者将他们的语言和法律体系强加给当地居民。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To send settlers to an area to establish political control over it. 2. [T] (biology) (of plants or animals) To establish itself and spread in a new area.
lemmas.def_zh: 在……开拓殖民地，使殖民地化；（生物）大量繁殖于，占领

examples.en: Scientists are investigating how plants first colonized the barren volcanic islands.
examples.zh: 科学家正在研究植物最初是如何在贫瘠的火山岛上移生定居的。

lemmas.def_en: [T] to establish political control over an area and send settlers there; (of plants or animals) to populate a new habitat
lemmas.def_zh: 使殖民地化，开拓殖民地；（动植物）大批繁殖于，聚居于

examples.en: British settlers began to colonise the eastern coast of Australia in the eighteenth century.
examples.zh: 英国定居者在十八世纪开始在澳大利亚东海岸开拓殖民地。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 colere（耕作、居住），引申为向外开拓的定居地及群体
family_guide.core_distinction: colony 指殖民地或群体本身；colonial 则指殖民地居民（名词用法）。

lemmas.def_en: the status of being a champion
lemmas.def_zh: n. 锦标赛；冠军头衔

examples.en: She won the national swimming championship last year.
examples.zh: 她去年赢得了全国游泳锦标赛冠军。

family_guide.root_logic: champion（斗士/冠军）+ -ship（身份、状态），指冠军地位或争夺冠军的赛事

lemmas.def_en: not agitated; without losing self-possession
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 平静的，镇静的；n. 平静；v. 使平静，镇定

examples.en: Try to stay calm and take a deep breath.
examples.zh: 尽量保持镇定，深吸一口气。

lemmas.def_en: steadiness of mind under stress
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 平静的，镇静的；n. 平静；v. 使平静，镇定

examples.en: Try to stay calm and take a deep breath.
examples.zh: 尽量保持镇定，深吸一口气。

lemmas.def_en: steadiness of mind under stress
lemmas.def_zh: 平静, 镇静, 冷静

examples.en: Her remarkable calmness during the emergency prevented the passengers from panicking.
examples.zh: 她在紧急情况下的非凡冷静避免了乘客陷入恐慌。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] to make someone or something calm and peaceful, or to become calm
lemmas.def_zh: （使）平静，（使）镇定，平息

examples.en: Try to stay calm and take a deep breath.
examples.zh: 尽量保持镇定，深吸一口气。

lemmas.def_en: with self-possession (especially in times of stress)
lemmas.def_zh: adv. 平静地，从容不迫地

examples.en: He calmly explained what had happened.
examples.zh: 他从容不迫地解释了所发生的事情。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 kauma（炎热），原指地中海正午无风的闷热状态，引申为平静、无风浪
family_guide.core_distinction: calm 可兼作形、名、动词；calmly 为其副词修饰形式。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or concerned with a city or densely populated area
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 城市的，都市的

examples.en: Traffic congestion is a major issue in urban areas.
examples.zh: 交通拥堵是城市地区的一个主要问题。

lemmas.def_zh: 彬彬有礼的
lemmas.def_en: showing a high degree of refinement and the assurance that comes from wide social experience

examples.en: His urbane manners and witty conversation instantly charmed everyone at the formal dinner party.
examples.zh: 他温文尔雅的举止和风趣的谈吐立刻吸引了晚宴上的所有人。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] to make an area or population more urban in character, infrastructure, or lifestyle.
lemmas.def_zh: 使都市化，使城市化

examples.en: Rapid industrial growth continues to urbanize once quiet rural areas across the province.
examples.zh: 工业的快速增长持续使全省昔日宁静的乡村地区走向城市化。

lemmas.def_zh: 都市化
lemmas.def_en: the condition of being urbanized

examples.en: Rapid urbanization is causing significant changes to natural habitats in the region.
examples.zh: 快速的城市化正在导致该地区自然栖息地发生巨大变化。

lemmas.def_en: polished courtesy; elegance of manner
lemmas.def_zh: 彬彬有礼, 都市性, 文雅的举止

examples.en: His polished speech and natural urbanity charmed everyone at the formal dinner.
examples.zh: 他文雅的谈吐和天生的儒雅举止赢得了正式晚宴上所有人的好感。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 urbs（城市），核心表示与城市或都市生活相关

lemmas.def_en: [I] to stop being visible; to cease to exist or be found
lemmas.def_zh: 消失，不见；消亡，失踪

examples.en: The mist began to disappear as the sun rose.
examples.zh: 太阳升起时，薄雾开始消散。

lemmas.def_en: the act of leaving secretly or without explanation
lemmas.def_zh: n. 消失，失踪

examples.en: Police are investigating the mysterious disappearance of the painting.
examples.zh: 警方正在调查这幅画作的神秘失踪案。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 dis-（消失、相反）+ appear（出现），核心义为从视线或存在中隐去
family_guide.core_distinction: disappear 为动词动作；disappearance 为其表示现象或事件的名词形式。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (+ up/onto) To fasten or secure something with a hook. 2. [T] To catch or hold something with or as if with a hook.
lemmas.def_zh: 用钩子钩住，扣紧；钩住，捕获；吸引

examples.en: He managed to hook a huge salmon.
examples.zh: 他成功钓到了一条巨大的鲑鱼。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To unfasten hooks on something, or to release or remove something from a hook.
lemmas.def_zh: 解开……的钩子；从钩上取下

examples.en: She reached behind her back to unhook the heavy necklace after the party.
examples.zh: 聚会结束后，她伸手到背后解开了沉重项链的搭扣。

lemmas.def_en: United States general in the Union Army who was defeated at Chancellorsville by Robert E. Lee (1814-1879)
lemmas.def_zh: n. 妓女；（橄榄球）前锋

examples.en: He plays as a hooker for the local rugby team.
examples.zh: 他在当地橄榄球队担任前锋。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 鹰钩状的；钩状的；着迷的
lemmas.def_en: curved like a hook; (informal) enjoying sth so much that you want to do it as much as possible
lemmas.usage_note: 常用于描述五官特征（a hooked nose 鹰钩鼻）；口语中常与 on 连用表示入迷上瘾（hooked on drugs/a TV show）。

examples.en: He had prominent cheekbones and a hooked nose.
examples.zh: 他颧骨突出，长着一个鹰钩鼻。

family_guide.root_logic: 日耳曼语源，指弯曲的金属或木制工具，引申为钩住、吸引或特定职业指代
family_guide.core_distinction: hook 作动词指钩住或连接；hooker 特指橄榄球前锋或俚语中的妓女。

lemmas.def_en: unable to see; --Kenneth Jernigan
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 盲的；盲目的；n. 百叶窗；掩体；v. 使失明；蒙蔽

examples.en: Love can sometimes make people blind to reality.
examples.zh: 爱情有时会让人对现实视而不见。

lemmas.def_en: people who have severe visual impairments, considered as a group
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 盲的；盲目的；n. 百叶窗；掩体；v. 使失明；蒙蔽

examples.en: Love can sometimes make people blind to reality.
examples.zh: 爱情有时会让人对现实视而不见。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being blind or lacking sight
lemmas.def_zh: 盲目, 失明, 愚昧

examples.en: Early detection of the disease can often prevent permanent blindness in older adults.
examples.zh: 及早发现该病通常可以预防老年人永久性失明。

lemmas.def_en: blind consisting of a leather eyepatch sewn to the side of the halter that prevents a horse from seeing something on either side
lemmas.def_zh: 眼罩

examples.en: The coach placed blinders on the racehorse to keep it focused on the track.
examples.zh: 教练给赛马戴上眼罩，以使其专心注视跑道。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To make someone permanently or temporarily unable to see. 2. [T] (of light) To dazzle someone so they cannot see clearly. 3. [T] To make someone unable to understand or perceive things clearly.
lemmas.def_zh: 使失明；使目眩，使眩晕；蒙蔽，使失去判断力

examples.en: Love can sometimes make people blind to reality.
examples.zh: 爱情有时会让人对现实视而不见。

lemmas.def_en: without seeing or looking
lemmas.def_zh: 轻率地, 盲目地

examples.en: You should never blindly follow investment advice without doing your own research first.
examples.zh: 在自己做调查之前，你绝不应该盲目听从投资建议。

family_guide.root_logic: 日耳曼语源，核心语义为“视线受阻、看不见”，引申为遮蔽或盲从
family_guide.core_distinction: blind 可作形容词、动词（使失明/遮蔽）及名词（百叶窗/掩体）。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To make something more difficult, complex, or problematic to deal with.
lemmas.def_zh: 使复杂化，使恶化，使棘手

examples.en: Bad weather will only complicate the rescue operation.
examples.zh: 恶劣的天气只会使救援行动更加复杂。

lemmas.def_en: the act or process of complicating
lemmas.def_zh: 复杂化, 复杂情况

examples.en: The patient developed a serious complication that delayed his release from the hospital.
examples.zh: 病人出现了严重的并发症，推迟了他出院的时间。

lemmas.def_en: lacking complexity
lemmas.def_zh: 简单的；不复杂的

examples.en: She prefers an uncomplicated lifestyle focused on simple meals and regular daily exercise.
examples.zh: 她更喜欢简单的生活方式，注重清淡饮食和日常定期锻炼。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 com-（共同）+ plic-（折叠、缠绕），字面义为“折叠在一起”，引申为使复杂

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To close an entrance or container securely to prevent entry or escape of gas, liquid, or people. 2. [T] To make an agreement or decision official, final, or certain.
lemmas.def_zh: 封上，密封；盖印确认；确定

examples.en: Make sure you seal the envelope before mailing it.
examples.zh: 寄出信件前一定要把信封封好。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To break the seal of a letter, container, or document to open it.
lemmas.def_zh: 拆封，启封，打开……的封口

examples.en: The lawyer was authorized to unseal the confidential document before the court.
examples.zh: 律师获准在法庭面前拆开并查阅这份机密文件。

lemmas.def_en: fastener consisting of a resinous composition that is plastic when warm; used for sealing documents and parcels and letters
lemmas.def_zh: v. 密封；盖印；确认；n. 印章；封条；海豹

examples.en: Make sure you seal the envelope before mailing it.
examples.zh: 寄出信件前一定要把信封封好。

lemmas.def_en: a kind of sealing material that is used to form a hard coating on a porous surface (as a coat of paint or varnish used to size a surface)
lemmas.def_zh: [计] 密封层, 密封器

examples.en: Apply a coat of waterproof sealer to the patio tiles to protect against rain.
examples.zh: 在露台地砖上涂一层防水密封剂，以防止雨水侵蚀。

lemmas.def_en: a kind of sealing material that is used to form a hard coating on a porous surface (as a coat of paint or varnish used to size a surface)
lemmas.def_zh: 密封剂

examples.en: Workers injected silicone sealant into the gaps around the window frames to stop leaks.
examples.zh: 工人们在窗框周围的缝隙中注入硅酮密封胶以防止渗漏。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 sigillum（印章）与日耳曼语同形词（海豹），两词源融合为印章/密封及海兽两组含义
family_guide.core_distinction: seal 兼作动词（密封/盖印）与名词（印章/海豹）。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] to express discontent, displeasure, pain, or resentment; make a formal complaint.
lemmas.def_zh: 抱怨，发牢骚；投诉，申诉

examples.en: Customers have the right to complain about poor service.
examples.zh: 顾客有权对恶劣的服务提出投诉。

lemmas.def_en: an often persistent bodily disorder or disease; a cause for complaining
lemmas.def_zh: n. 抱怨；投诉；疾病

examples.en: Customer service received several complaints about the delayed delivery.
examples.zh: 客服部门收到了数起关于配送延误的投诉。

lemmas.def_en: a person who brings an action in a court of law
lemmas.def_zh: 发牢骚的人, 原告

examples.en: The judge asked the complainant to provide clear evidence supporting the legal claims.
examples.zh: 法官要求原告提供确凿证据来支持其法律诉求。

lemmas.def_en: a person given to excessive complaints and crying and whining
lemmas.def_zh: 老是抱怨的人

examples.en: Nobody in the office likes working with a chronic complainer who never offers solutions.
examples.zh: 办公室里没人愿意和一个从不提供解决方案且总是抱怨的人共事。

lemmas.def_en: not complaining
lemmas.def_zh: 没有怨言的, 不发牢骚的, 不诉苦的, 耐心的, 坚忍的

examples.en: Her uncomplaining nature won the deep respect of the entire medical staff.
examples.zh: 她毫无怨言的性格赢得了全体医护人员的由衷敬佩。

lemmas.def_en: without complaining
lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 任劳任怨；不诉苦地

examples.en: The young soldiers worked uncomplainingly in the freezing mud to repair the damaged bridge.
examples.zh: 年轻的士兵们任劳任怨地在冰冷的泥泞中抢修受损的桥梁。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 com-（强烈）+ plain-（捶胸、悲叹），核心义为表达痛苦、不满或委屈

lemmas.def_en: headdress that protects the head from bad weather; has shaped crown and usually a brim
lemmas.def_zh: n. 帽子；v. 给……戴帽

examples.en: He raised his hat politely as she entered the room.
examples.zh: 她进屋时，他礼貌地脱帽致意。

lemmas.def_en: someone who makes and sells hats
lemmas.def_zh: 帽子制造者, 帽商

examples.en: The skilled hatter crafted custom felt hats for wealthy clients across the country.
examples.zh: 这位手艺精湛的制帽师傅为全国各地的富裕客户定制毛呢帽子。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To put a hat on someone; to supply or cover with a hat.
lemmas.def_zh: 给……戴上帽子；为……提供帽子

examples.en: He raised his hat politely as she entered the room.
examples.zh: 她进屋时，他礼貌地脱帽致意。

family_guide.root_logic: 日耳曼语源，指代遮盖头部的服饰，作动词时意为“给……戴帽”或“提供帽子”
family_guide.core_distinction: hat 作名词是常见衣饰；作及物动词时多用于特定装配语境。

lemmas.def_en: concerned with principles of right and wrong or conforming to standards of behavior and character based on those principles
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 道德的；n. 寓意，道德

examples.en: He felt a moral obligation to help the victims.
examples.zh: 他感到有一种帮助受害者的道德责任。

lemmas.def_en: narrowly and conventionally moral
lemmas.def_zh: 道德家的, 说教的, 道德主义的

examples.en: The novel was criticized for having a dull plot and an overly moralistic tone.
examples.zh: 这部小说因情节枯燥且带有过于说教的语气而受到批评。

lemmas.def_en: the significance of a story or event
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 道德的；n. 寓意，道德

examples.en: He felt a moral obligation to help the victims.
examples.zh: 他感到有一种帮助受害者的道德责任。

lemmas.def_en: concern with the distinction between good and evil or right and wrong; right or good conduct
lemmas.def_zh: n. 道德，道德准则

examples.en: Standards of morality vary across different cultures.
examples.zh: 不同文化之间的道德标准有所不同。

lemmas.def_zh: 道德家, 讲道德的人, 伦理学者
lemmas.def_en: a philosopher who specializes in morals and moral problems

examples.en: The strict moralist frequently criticized the decadence of modern popular culture on television.
examples.zh: 这位严苛的道德家经常在电视上批评现代流行文化的堕落。

lemmas.def_zh: 道德主义, 格言, 说教
lemmas.def_en: a moral maxim

examples.en: The literary critic disliked the novel because of its heavy-handed and shallow moralism.
examples.zh: 文学评论家不喜欢这部小说，因为其道德说教生硬且肤浅。

lemmas.def_en: with respect to moral principles
lemmas.def_zh: adv. 道德上，道义上

examples.en: What they did was legally permissible but morally wrong.
examples.zh: 他们的所作所为在法律上被允许，但在道德上是错误的。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 mos/moris（习俗、风尚），引申为社会公认的行为准则与道德
family_guide.core_distinction: moral（形/名：道德的/寓意）与 morality（纯名词：道德规范）易混；morally 为副词。

lemmas.def_en: round yellow to orange fruit of any of several citrus trees
lemmas.def_zh: n. 橙子；橙色；adj. 橙色的

examples.en: She peeled an orange and offered half to me.
examples.zh: 她剥开一个橙子，分了一半给我。

lemmas.def_en: of the color between red and yellow; similar to the color of a ripe orange
lemmas.def_zh: n. 橙子；橙色；adj. 橙色的

examples.en: She peeled an orange and offered half to me.
examples.zh: 她剥开一个橙子，分了一半给我。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自梵语 naranga（橙树），经由波斯语和阿拉伯语进入欧洲，兼指水果与该颜色的特征
family_guide.core_distinction: orange 既指具体的水果名词，也可直接用作颜色形容词。

lemmas.def_en: the Crown (or the reigning monarch) as the symbol of the power and authority of a monarchy
lemmas.def_zh: n. 王冠，桂冠；顶点；v. 加冕；使圆满

examples.en: The victory crowned years of hard training.
examples.zh: 这次胜利使多年的刻苦训练圆满收官。

lemmas.def_zh: 加冕礼
lemmas.def_en: the ceremony of installing a new monarch

examples.en: Dignitaries from around the globe attended the magnificent royal coronation ceremony.
examples.zh: 来自全球的政要出席了这场盛大的王室加冕礼。

lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To officially place a crown on someone's head in a royal ceremony, making them monarch. 2. To complete or make something perfect or successful.
lemmas.def_zh: 为……加冕；使圆满，使达到顶峰

examples.en: The victory crowned years of hard training.
examples.zh: 这次胜利使多年的刻苦训练圆满收官。

lemmas.def_zh: 给...加冕
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (formal / historical) To crown a monarch formally in a coronation ceremony.

examples.en: The archbishop arrived at the cathedral prepared to coronate the young monarch.
examples.zh: 大主教抵达大教堂，准备为这位年轻的君主加冕。

lemmas.def_en: not having an (artificial) crown on a tooth; used especially of molars and bicuspids
lemmas.def_zh: 未戴皇冠的, 未举行加冕礼的

examples.en: He was regarded as the uncrowned king of the local jazz scene.
examples.zh: 他被视为当地爵士乐界无冕之王。

lemmas.def_en: not (especially not yet) provided with a crown
lemmas.def_zh: 未加冕的

examples.en: The crownless prince wandered the continent, seeking allies to reclaim his stolen throne.
examples.zh: 失去王冠的王子流浪大陆，寻求盟友夺回王位。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 korone（弯曲物、花环），后演变为象征王权的冠冕及为之加冕的动作
family_guide.core_distinction: crown 作名词指王冠或顶点；作动词指加冕或使圆满。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. To turn around and around quickly, or make something do this. 2. To twist fibers into thread.
lemmas.def_zh: （使）快速旋转；纺（纱，线）；眩晕

examples.en: The dancer can spin rapidly on one foot.
examples.zh: 舞者能单脚快速旋转。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] Past tense and past participle of spin; to have turned around rapidly, or twisted fibers into thread.
lemmas.def_zh: （使）快速旋转（spin 的过去式和过去分词）；纺（纱）

examples.en: She spun the wool into fine yarn.
examples.zh: 她把羊毛纺成了细纱。

lemmas.def_en: someone who spins (who twists fibers into threads)
lemmas.def_zh: 纺纱工人, 旋床工人, 纺纱机, 机头罩, 旋转动作, (美)(非正式)卡车司机

examples.en: The fisherman tied a bright metal spinner to his line to attract bass.
examples.zh: 垂钓者在钓线上系上亮色旋转假饵以吸引鲈鱼。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，核心语义为“快速旋转”或“纺纱”。

lemmas.def_en: holding or containing nothing
lemmas.def_zh: 空的, 空虚的, 空腹的, 空洞的

examples.en: Please do not take medicine on an empty stomach without consulting a doctor.
examples.zh: 咨询医生前，请勿空腹服药。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To remove everything from a container or space. 2. [I] To become empty. 3. [I] (of a river) To flow into a larger body of water.
lemmas.def_zh: 排空，倒空；变空；流入（大海或河流）

examples.en: Please do not take medicine on an empty stomach without consulting a doctor.
examples.zh: 咨询医生前，请勿空腹服药。

lemmas.def_en: the state of containing nothing
lemmas.def_zh: 空虚, 无知

examples.en: Despite his professional success, a persistent sense of emptiness haunted his quiet evenings.
examples.zh: 尽管事业成功，每逢宁静夜晚他总难免感到空虚。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，核心语义为“无内含物”及“倒出”。

lemmas.def_en: a condition that accompanies or influences some event or activity
lemmas.def_zh: 条件；环境；境遇

examples.en: Under no circumstances should you leave the door unlocked.
examples.zh: 在任何情况下你都不能不锁门。

lemmas.def_en: fully detailed and specific about particulars
lemmas.def_zh: 依照情况的

examples.en: The prosecution relied heavily on circumstantial evidence because no witnesses were present.
examples.zh: 由于没有目击者，控方主要依赖间接证据。

lemmas.def_en: according to circumstances
lemmas.def_zh: 依照情况地

examples.en: The two incidents were circumstantially linked, but investigators found no direct connection.
examples.zh: 这两起事件在情理上看似有关，但调查人员未发现直接联系。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 circum（周围）+ stare（站立），指“周围围绕的环境或状况”。

lemmas.def_en: a quantity of no importance
lemmas.def_zh: 零, 零点, 零度, 无, 乌有, 最低点

examples.en: The thermometer plummeted to zero degrees during the bitter winter night.
examples.zh: 寒冬深夜里，温度计读数骤降至零度。

lemmas.def_en: indicating the absence of any or all units under consideration
lemmas.def_zh: 零的, 没有的

examples.en: The thermometer plummeted to zero degrees during the bitter winter night.
examples.zh: 寒冬深夜里，温度计读数骤降至零度。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] to adjust an instrument or measuring device so that it reads zero 2. [T] to aim or calibrate a weapon precisely at a target
lemmas.def_zh: 将（仪器、仪表等）调零，归零；瞄准，校准（武器）

examples.en: The thermometer plummeted to zero degrees during the bitter winter night.
examples.zh: 寒冬深夜里，温度计读数骤降至零度。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自阿拉伯语，经由意大利语传入，表示“无、零”或“归零”。

lemmas.def_en: showing reason or sound judgment
lemmas.def_zh: 合情合理的；公道的

examples.en: The hotel offers clean rooms at a reasonable price.
examples.zh: 这家酒店以合理的价格提供干净的房间。

lemmas.def_en: not reasonable; not showing good judgment
lemmas.def_zh: 不合理的；过分的

examples.en: It is unreasonable to expect perfection from beginners.
examples.zh: 指望初学者做到完美是不合理的。

lemmas.def_en: the state of having good sense and sound judgment
lemmas.def_zh: [计] 合理性

examples.en: The judge carefully evaluated the reasonableness of the proposed settlement terms.
examples.zh: 法官仔细评估了拟议和解条款的合理性。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 reason（理由、理智），-able 表“能够……的”，指合乎理智。
family_guide.core_distinction: reasonable 指合乎情理的；unreasonable 指不讲理或过度的。

lemmas.def_en: any activity that is performed alone without assistance
lemmas.def_zh: 独奏, 独唱, 单独表演

examples.en: The guitarist delivered a breathtaking solo that brought the entire audience to tears.
examples.zh: 吉他手献上一段惊艳的独奏，令全场观众落泪。

lemmas.def_en: a musician who performs a solo
lemmas.def_zh: 独奏者, 独唱者

examples.en: The guest soloist received a standing ovation after finishing the demanding violin concerto.
examples.zh: 客座独奏家在演奏完高难度的小提琴协奏曲后赢得了全场起立鼓掌。

lemmas.def_en: [I] To fly an aircraft alone without an instructor or co-pilot; to perform a piece of music or an act alone.
lemmas.def_zh: 单独飞行；单飞，独自表演

examples.en: The guitarist delivered a breathtaking solo that brought the entire audience to tears.
examples.zh: 吉他手献上一段惊艳的独奏，令全场观众落泪。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 solus（单独的），引申为“单独行动或演奏”。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To put something underground and cover it with earth, or conceal it from sight. 2. [T] To place a dead body in a grave or tomb.
lemmas.def_zh: 埋藏，掩盖，隐藏；埋葬，安葬

examples.en: The dog likes to bury bones in the backyard.
examples.zh: 这只狗喜欢把骨头埋在后院。

lemmas.def_en: the ritual placing of a corpse in a grave
lemmas.def_zh: 埋葬；葬礼

examples.en: They held a private burial service for family members.
examples.zh: 他们为家人举行了一场不对外的葬礼。

lemmas.def_en: not buried
lemmas.def_zh: 未埋葬的

examples.en: Ancient tales tell of unburied heroes whose spirits still wander the misty shores.
examples.zh: 古老的传说讲述着未安葬英雄的英灵仍在雾蒙蒙的岸边游荡。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，核心语义为“掩埋”、“藏于地下”。
family_guide.core_distinction: bury 为动作动词；burial 为表示安葬仪式的名词。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. To offer a particular price for something, especially at an auction or for a commercial contract. 2. (bid for/to do) To make an effort or attempt to achieve something.
lemmas.def_zh: 出价，喊价；投标，竞标；努力争取

examples.en: Several companies will bid for the construction project.
examples.zh: 几家公司将参与该建筑项目的竞标。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (formal / archaic) Past participle of bid; to command, invite, or offer a price.
lemmas.def_zh: bid的过去分词

examples.en: The quiet monk spoke only when he was specifically bidden to address guests.
examples.zh: 这位沉默的僧人只有在被明确邀请时才会对客人讲话。

lemmas.def_en: someone who makes an offer
lemmas.def_zh: 出价人, 投标人

examples.en: The rare painting was finally sold to an anonymous bidder over the telephone.
examples.zh: 这幅罕见的名画最终通过电话卖给了一位匿名竞拍者。

lemmas.def_en: a Chadic language spoken in northern Nigeria
lemmas.def_zh: 巴德语（尼日利亚北部的一种乍得语族语言）

examples.en: She bade her colleagues a warm farewell before departing on her long journey.
examples.zh: 在踏上长途旅程之前，她向同事们温情道别。

lemmas.def_en: willing to carry out the orders or wishes of another without protest
lemmas.def_zh: 顺从的, 可叫牌的

examples.en: The puppy proved surprisingly biddable, learning basic commands in just a few days.
examples.zh: 这只小狗出奇地顺从，仅仅几天就掌握了基本指令。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，融合了“出价”与“吩咐/致意”两种语意源流。

lemmas.def_en: amounting to a large indefinite number
lemmas.def_zh: 众多的；许多的

examples.en: She has written numerous articles on climate change.
examples.zh: 她撰写了许多关于气候变化的文章。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 numerus（数字），-ous 表“充满……的”，即数量众多的。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To spread over a large area, distance, or period of time. 2. [I, T] To make your body or limbs straight and reach out; to pull or spread something wider or longer.
lemmas.def_zh: 延伸，伸展，延绵；伸长（肢体）；拉长，撑大

examples.en: You should stretch your muscles gently before attempting any rigorous physical workout.
examples.zh: 在进行高强度锻炼之前，你应该先温和地拉伸肌肉。

lemmas.def_en: a large and unbroken expanse or distance
lemmas.def_zh: 伸展, 张开, 连绵, 一段路, 一段时间

examples.en: You should stretch your muscles gently before attempting any rigorous physical workout.
examples.zh: 在进行高强度锻炼之前，你应该先温和地拉伸肌肉。

lemmas.def_en: a wooden framework on which canvas is stretched and fixed for oil painting
lemmas.def_zh: 担架, 延伸器

examples.en: Paramedics carefully lifted the injured athlete onto a stretcher and left the field.
examples.zh: 医护人员小心翼翼地将受伤运动员抬上担架并撤离赛场。

lemmas.def_en: capable of being easily stretched and resuming former size or shape
lemmas.def_zh: 可延伸的, 有弹性的, 易延伸过长的

examples.en: These yoga pants are made from a stretchy fabric that allows complete freedom.
examples.zh: 这些瑜伽裤由高弹面料制成，能让人活动自如。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，核心语义为“拉长”、“延伸”、“舒展”。

lemmas.def_en: [T] to support an event, activity, or person by providing money or goods; officially organize or propose something
lemmas.def_zh: 赞助，资助；主办，发起；倡议（法案等）

examples.en: A multinational corporation agreed to sponsor the local youth soccer tournament this year.
examples.zh: 一家跨国公司同意赞助今年的本地青少年足球锦标赛。

lemmas.def_en: someone who supports or champions something
lemmas.def_zh: 保证人, 赞助者, 发起者, 倡议者, 教父

examples.en: The local charity event found a generous corporate sponsor to cover all costs.
examples.zh: 当地的慈善活动找到了一家慷慨的企业赞助商来承担所有费用。

lemmas.def_en: the act of sponsoring (either officially or financially)
lemmas.def_zh: 赞助；赞助金

examples.en: The festival relies heavily on corporate sponsorship.
examples.zh: 该艺术节在很大程度上依赖企业的赞助。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 spondere（庄严保证），引申为“出资保证者”或“赞助”。
family_guide.core_distinction: sponsor 既作动词也作赞助者名词；sponsorship 指赞助行为、赞助金或赞助关系。

lemmas.def_en: group of guns or missile launchers operated together at one place
lemmas.def_zh: 电池；一套；排炮

examples.en: My phone battery died in the middle of the call.
examples.zh: 通话途中我的手机电池没电了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 battuere（打击），由“炮兵连（连续炮击）”引申至物理上的“电池组/电池”。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To move up and down quickly or repeatedly, especially on the surface of water.
lemmas.def_zh: 上下浮动，晃动；行屈膝礼

examples.en: The small boat bobbed gently on the waves.
examples.zh: 小船在波浪上轻轻地上下浮动。

lemmas.def_en: a small float usually made of cork; attached to a fishing line
lemmas.def_zh: 浮子

examples.en: He watched the red bobber dip suddenly beneath the surface of the calm lake.
examples.zh: 他看着红色的浮子突然沉入平静的湖面之下。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词，模拟轻快上下跳动或漂浮的动作。

lemmas.def_en: a motor vehicle with two wheels and a strong frame
lemmas.def_zh: 自行车, 脚踏车

examples.en: She prefers to bike to the office every morning instead of taking the crowded subway.
examples.zh: 她更喜欢每天早上骑自行车去办公室，而不是挤拥挤的地铁。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To travel or ride on a bicycle or motorcycle.
lemmas.def_zh: 骑自行车；骑摩托车

examples.en: She prefers to bike to the office every morning instead of taking the crowded subway.
examples.zh: 她更喜欢每天早上骑自行车去办公室，而不是挤拥挤的地铁。

family_guide.root_logic: bicycle 的口语截短词，可指代自行车及其骑行行为。

lemmas.def_en: a plant consisting of one or more buildings with facilities for manufacturing
lemmas.def_zh: 工厂；制造厂

examples.en: The car factory employs over two thousand workers.
examples.zh: 这家汽车工厂雇用了两千多名工人。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 factor（制造者），-y 表地点，即“制造物品的场所”。

lemmas.def_en: a prescribed selection of foods
lemmas.def_zh: 日常饮食, 议会

examples.en: Maintaining a balanced diet is essential for your long-term health and daily energy.
examples.zh: 保持均衡的饮食对你的长期健康和日常充沛精力至关重要。

lemmas.def_en: a person who diets
lemmas.def_zh: 节食者

examples.en: Many a dieter struggles to resist the temptation of freshly baked sweet pastries.
examples.zh: 许多节食者都难以抵挡新鲜烘焙甜糕点的诱惑。

lemmas.def_zh: 饮食学家, 营养学家
lemmas.def_en: a specialist in the study of nutrition

examples.en: The certified dietician designed a balanced nutrition plan for the recovering patient.
examples.zh: 注册营养师为康复中的患者设计了均衡的营养计划。

lemmas.def_en: [I] To restrict one's intake of food or eat prescribed foods, especially to lose weight or for medical reasons.
lemmas.def_zh: 节食；按规定饮食

examples.en: Maintaining a balanced diet is essential for your long-term health and daily energy.
examples.zh: 保持均衡的饮食对你的长期健康和日常充沛精力至关重要。

lemmas.def_zh: 饮食的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the diet

examples.en: Please inform the catering staff if you have any special dietary requirements.
examples.zh: 如果您有任何特殊的饮食要求，请告知餐饮服务人员。

lemmas.def_zh: 饮食的, 适于特殊饮食的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the diet

examples.en: The hospital cafeteria offers special dietetic meals for diabetic patients.
examples.zh: 医院食堂为糖尿病患者提供特殊的饮食餐。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 diaita（生活方式、起居饮食），核心指日常摄入的食物或特定节食制度。

lemmas.def_en: a social unit living together
lemmas.def_zh: 一家人, 家庭, 家族, 王室

examples.en: Smart home devices are now commonly found in almost every modern urban household.
examples.zh: 智能家居设备如今在几乎每个现代城市家庭中都很常见。

lemmas.def_en: someone who owns a home
lemmas.def_zh: 一家之主, 家长, 户长

examples.en: Every householder in this neighborhood is responsible for clearing snow from their own sidewalk.
examples.zh: 该社区的每位户主都负责清理自家门前人行道上的积雪。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 house（房屋）+ hold（容纳/持有）构成，指同一个屋檐下共同生活的一家人或户口。

lemmas.def_en: an arbitrary sign (written or printed) that has acquired a conventional significance
lemmas.def_zh: 符号, 象征, 代号, 信条

examples.en: The white dove has long been recognized as a universal symbol of peace.
examples.zh: 白鸽长期以来一直被公认为和平的普遍象征。

lemmas.def_en: the use of symbols to convey meaning
lemmas.def_zh: 符号化, 符号表现

examples.en: The artist uses the subtle symbolization of wilting flowers to represent the passage of time.
examples.zh: 艺术家用凋零花朵的微妙象征表现来代表时光的流逝。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or using or proceeding by means of symbols
lemmas.def_zh: 象征的, 符号的

examples.en: Lighting the eternal flame was a deeply symbolic gesture of remembrance for fallen heroes.
examples.zh: 点燃不灭之火是对牺牲英雄深具象征意义的缅怀之举。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or using or proceeding by means of symbols
lemmas.def_zh: 象征的, 象征性的, 符号的, 用作符号的, 使用符号的, 象征派的

examples.en: The ancient ritual carried a heavy symbolical meaning that few outsiders fully understood.
examples.zh: 这一古老仪式蕴含着厚重的象征意义，极少有外人能完全理解。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To represent or be a symbol of something, such as an idea or quality.
lemmas.def_zh: 象征，代表；用符号表示

examples.en: In many ancient cultures, dragons symbolize immense power, strength, and great good fortune.
examples.zh: 在许多古代文化中，龙象征着巨大的力量、实力和极大的好运。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To represent an idea, quality, or entity by means of a symbol; to be a symbol of something.
lemmas.def_zh: 象征，代表，作为……的象征

examples.en: These interconnected rings symbolise the unbreakable bond of unity between the two friendly nations.
examples.zh: 这些环环相扣的指环象征着两国之间牢不可破的团结纽带。

lemmas.def_en: in a symbolic manner
lemmas.def_zh: 象征性地

examples.en: The mayor symbolically handed over the key to the city during the grand opening.
examples.zh: 在盛大的开幕式上，市长象征性地移交了城市钥匙。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 symbolon（用来对照辨识的记号），引申为代表特定概念的符号、象征。
family_guide.core_distinction: symbolic 强调具有象征意义的表征特性，与具象的 symbol（符号本身）相对应。

lemmas.def_en: [T] to save someone or something from danger, harm, or difficulty
lemmas.def_zh: 营救，援救，解救

examples.en: Firefighters managed to rescue three trapped hikers from the steep, dangerous mountain cliff.
examples.zh: 消防员成功从陡峭危险的山崖上救出了三名被困的徒步者。

lemmas.def_en: recovery or preservation from loss or danger
lemmas.def_zh: 援救, 解救, 营救

examples.en: Firefighters managed to rescue three trapped hikers from the steep, dangerous mountain cliff.
examples.zh: 消防员成功从陡峭危险的山崖上救出了三名被困的徒步者。

lemmas.def_en: a person who rescues you from harm or danger
lemmas.def_zh: 救助者

examples.en: The brave rescuer dove into the freezing river without hesitation to save the child.
examples.zh: 勇敢的救援人员毫不犹豫地跳入冰冷的河水中去救那个孩子。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 rescourre（重新夺回、救出），核心语义为从危险或困境中解救出来。

lemmas.def_en: the sacred writings of the Christian religions
lemmas.def_zh: 《圣经》

examples.en: The Holy Bible is the sacred scripture of the Christian faith.
examples.zh: 《圣经》是基督教信仰的圣书。

lemmas.def_en: of or pertaining to or contained in or in accordance with the Bible
lemmas.def_zh: 圣经的

examples.en: The coastal region suffered damage of almost biblical proportions after the violent hurricane struck.
examples.zh: 强飓风袭击后，沿海地区遭受了几乎如同圣经所载般规模的毁灭性破坏。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 biblia（书籍集合），特指基督教《圣经》，引申指某一领域的权威经典。

lemmas.def_en: a way of regarding situations or topics etc.
lemmas.def_zh: 远景, 透视感, (观察问题的)视角, 透视法, 看法, 透视图

examples.en: Traveling to remote foreign countries often gives people a fresh perspective on everyday life.
examples.zh: 前往偏远的异国旅行往往能让人们对日常生活产生全新的视角。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 per-（穿透）+ spect（看）+ -ive，原指透视画法，引申为看待事物的角度、观点或洞察力。

lemmas.def_en: a vehicle that can fly
lemmas.def_zh: 航空器, 飞机

examples.en: The advanced military aircraft flew silently at high altitudes to avoid modern radar detection.
examples.zh: 这架先进的军用飞机在高空无声飞行，以避开现代雷达的探测。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 air（空中）+ craft（飞行器/船只/技能）构成，指任何在空中飞行的航空器（单复数同形）。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To become or make someone less tense, anxious, or tired. 2. [T] To make rules or control less strict.
lemmas.def_zh: （使）放松，（使）缓解；休息；放宽（规则）

examples.en: Listening to soft classical music helps him relax completely after a stressful workday.
examples.zh: 在紧张的工作日之后，听柔和的古典音乐有助于他彻底放松身心。

lemmas.def_en: (physiology) the gradual lengthening of inactive muscle or muscle fibers
lemmas.def_zh: 松弛, 放松, 减轻, 缓和, 休息, 休养

examples.en: A warm bath scented with essential oils provides the ultimate feeling of pure relaxation.
examples.zh: 带有精油香气的温水浴能带来纯粹放松的极致体验。

lemmas.def_en: a drug that relaxes and relieves tension
lemmas.def_zh: 弛缓药

examples.en: The doctor prescribed a mild muscle relaxant to relieve his severe back pain.
examples.zh: 医生开了一种温和的肌肉松弛药来缓解他的严重背痛。

lemmas.def_en: any agent that produces relaxation
lemmas.def_zh: 松弛机；放松者

examples.en: A warm bath before bed serves as the perfect relaxer after a stressful day.
examples.zh: 在紧张忙碌的一天后，睡前泡个热水澡是绝佳的放松方式。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 放松的；自在的；悠闲的
lemmas.def_en: calm, untroubled, and not worried, nervous, or stressed; easygoing
lemmas.usage_note: 常用于描述人的心理状态、肢体姿势或整体环境氛围，如 a relaxed atmosphere。

examples.en: She felt completely relaxed after a long, quiet weekend in the mountains.
examples.zh: 在山里度过了一个漫长而安静的周末后，她感到彻底放松了。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 re-（向后/松开）+ lax（松弛），核心概念是松弛紧绷的状态，无论是身体还是心理。
family_guide.core_distinction: relax 为动作，relaxation 侧重放松的状态、活动或消遣方式。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To cook food, especially bread, cakes, or pies, by dry heat in an oven. 2. [I, T] To become or make something extremely warm or dry through intense heat.
lemmas.def_zh: 烘焙，烤制（面包、糕点等）；（使）受暴晒，烤热

examples.en: She decided to bake fresh bread and cookies for her family this weekend.
examples.zh: 她决定这个周末为家人烤新鲜的面包和饼干。

lemmas.def_en: someone who bakes commercially
lemmas.def_zh: 面包师

examples.en: The local baker starts preparing fresh loaves of bread early every morning.
examples.zh: 当地的面包师每天清晨就开始准备新鲜的面包。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 烘烤的；被晒干的
lemmas.def_en: cooked by dry heat in an oven; dried out by heat or exposure to sunlight
lemmas.usage_note: 既可指经烘烤烹饪的食物（如 baked potato），也可描述被烈日暴晒而干裂的地表（baked earth）。

examples.en: The sun-baked earth cracked after months without any rainfall.
examples.zh: 数月没有降雨，烈日炙烤的大地龟裂了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 bacan（烘烤），专指利用干热（通常在烤箱中）制作食物。
family_guide.core_distinction: bake 为动作，baker 指从事烘焙的人（面包师/糕点师）。

lemmas.def_en: a group of machine parts that fit together to form a self-contained unit
lemmas.def_zh: 与会者, 集会, 装配, 组件

examples.en: Hundreds of workers gathered at the plant for the annual general assembly.
examples.zh: 数百名工人在工厂集合参加年度大会。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 assemble（聚集、组装），-y 为名词后缀，兼具人群的“集会”与物品的“装配”两层含义。

lemmas.def_en: considered individually
lemmas.def_zh: 分别的, 各自的

examples.en: After the meeting ended, all the participants returned to their respective offices.
examples.zh: 会议结束后，所有与会者都回到了各自的办公室。

lemmas.def_en: in the order given
lemmas.def_zh: 各自地, 独自地, 个别地, 分别地

examples.en: Tom and Mary scored ninety and eighty-five points on the final exam, respectively.
examples.zh: 汤姆和玛丽在期末考试中分别获得了90分和85分。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 respect（考虑/方面），强调各自独立对应、分别看待的属性。
family_guide.core_distinction: respective 为形容词修饰复数名词，respectively 为副词通常置于句末表示“按上述顺序分别地”。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To think carefully about something, especially before deciding; to regard in a specified way.
lemmas.def_zh: 仔细考虑，斟酌；认为，看作；顾及

examples.en: You should carefully consider all the potential risks before accepting the job offer.
examples.zh: 在接受这份工作录用之前，你应该仔细考虑所有潜在的风险。

family_guide.root_logic: 根词 consider（源自拉丁语，原指观察星象以作决断），引申为仔细思考、权衡。

lemmas.def_en: of or belonging to a corporation
lemmas.def_zh: 社团的, 合伙的, 公司的

examples.en: She has worked in the corporate finance sector for more than ten years.
examples.zh: 她已经在企业财务部门工作了十多年。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 corpus（身体/肉体），引申为凝聚成一个法人实体的社团，现代专指“公司的、企业的”。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To find a number or amount using mathematics. 2. [T] To estimate or judge a future situation or probability.
lemmas.def_zh: 计算，核算；推测，估测

examples.en: Scientists are trying to calculate the long-term impact of climate change.
examples.zh: 科学家们正试图计算气候变化的长期影响。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To calculate a number or amount incorrectly. 2. [I, T] To judge or estimate a situation or risk wrongly.
lemmas.def_zh: 算错，误算；误判，估计错误

examples.en: The captain miscalculated the ship's fuel reserves and had to call for assistance.
examples.zh: 船长算错了船上的燃油储备，不得不寻求援助。

lemmas.def_en: the procedure of calculating; determining something by mathematical or logical methods
lemmas.def_zh: n. 计算；估算；深思熟虑

examples.en: By my calculations, we should arrive before sunset.
examples.zh: 按照我的估算，我们应该能在日落前赶到。

lemmas.def_zh: 结石；微积分学
lemmas.def_en: a hard lump produced by the concretion of mineral salts; found in hollow organs or ducts of the body

examples.en: Students must master basic algebra before they can tackle advanced university calculus.
examples.zh: 学生在攻读大学的高等微积分之前，必须先掌握基础代数。

lemmas.def_en: an expert at calculation (or at operating calculating machines)
lemmas.def_zh: n. 计算器

examples.en: You are not allowed to use a calculator during the math exam.
examples.zh: 数学考试期间不允许使用计算器。

lemmas.def_en: a mistake in calculating
lemmas.def_zh: 算错, 失算, 估计错误

examples.en: A minor miscalculation in the initial budget led to a significant project delay.
examples.zh: 最初预算中的微小失算导致了项目严重延期。

lemmas.def_zh: 可计算的, 可信赖的, 可靠的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being calculated or estimated

examples.en: The economic impact of the new trade policy is calculable and modest.
examples.zh: 新贸易政策带来的经济影响是可以估算且较为温和的。

lemmas.def_en: used of persons
lemmas.def_zh: 计算的, 善于计算的, 精明的

examples.en: He gave a calculative glance at the contract before agreeing to sign it.
examples.zh: 在同意签署合同之前，他精明地扫了一眼合同内容。

lemmas.def_en: in a calculating manner
lemmas.def_zh: calculating的变形

examples.en: The suspect answered each difficult question calculatingly to avoid implicating his partner.
examples.zh: 嫌疑人精于算计地回答每个难题，以避免牵连他的同伙。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 calculus（小石子），古人用小石子计数，引申为“计算、核算”。
family_guide.core_distinction: calculation 指计算行为或结果；calculator 指执行计算的工具或人。

lemmas.def_en: a plant consisting of one or more buildings with facilities for manufacturing
lemmas.def_zh: 压榨机, 磨坊, 制造厂

examples.en: The ancient stone mill by the river has been converted into a museum.
examples.zh: 河边那座古老的石磨坊已经被改建成了一座博物馆。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (+ around/about) (of a crowd) To move around in a confused or aimless mass. 2. [T] To crush or grind grain, ore, etc. into powder or small pieces.
lemmas.def_zh: （人群等）四处游荡，兜圈子，乱转；碾磨，磨碎

examples.en: The ancient stone mill by the river has been converted into a museum.
examples.zh: 河边那座古老的石磨坊已经被改建成了一座博物馆。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语词根，核心义为“磨研、压碎”，由此延伸出磨坊、工厂及碾磨行为。

lemmas.def_en: a writer for newspapers and magazines
lemmas.def_zh: n. 新闻记者；新闻工作者

examples.en: The investigative journalist uncovered a major financial scandal.
examples.zh: 这位调查记者揭露了一桩重大金融丑闻。

lemmas.def_en: newspapers and magazines collectively
lemmas.def_zh: 新闻业, 报章杂志

examples.en: She decided to study journalism because she wanted to uncover political scandals.
examples.zh: 她决定学习新闻学，因为她想揭露政治丑闻。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or having the characteristics of journalism
lemmas.def_zh: 新闻业的, 新闻工作者的, 报刊特有的, 新闻工作的

examples.en: The writer maintained strict journalistic standards throughout his long career.
examples.zh: 这位作者在漫长的职业生涯中始终坚守严格的新闻准则。

lemmas.def_en: by journalists
lemmas.def_zh: 报刊地

examples.en: The controversial documentary was journalistically sound and thoroughly researched.
examples.zh: 从新闻专业角度来看，这部有争议的纪录片严谨且调研充分。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 journal（日志、日报）+ -ist（从事…的人），核心指记录每日新闻的人。

lemmas.def_en: an inquiry into public opinion conducted by interviewing a random sample of people
lemmas.def_zh: 投票, 民意测验, 选举投票, 投票数, 一组人中的一个, 头颈和后脑部, 鹦鹉

examples.en: The latest public opinion poll shows that voter turnout may reach record highs.
examples.zh: 最新的民意测验显示，选民投票率可能会创下历史新高。

lemmas.def_zh: 无角(截去角)的动物, 截去树梢的树, 麸皮
lemmas.def_en: a tree with limbs cut back to promote a more bushy growth of foliage

examples.en: Workers will pollard the willows each spring to control their overall height.
examples.zh: 工人们每年春天都会修剪柳树的树冠，以控制其总体高度。

lemmas.def_zh: 民意调查人, 民意测验经办人
lemmas.def_en: someone who conducts surveys of public opinion

examples.en: Every major pollster predicted an extremely close race ahead of election day.
examples.zh: 在选举日前夕，每位主流民意测验专家都预测选情将异常胶着。

lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To ask a group of people specific questions to discover their opinions. 2. To receive a particular number of votes in an election.
lemmas.def_zh: 对……进行民意调查；获得（票数）；投票

examples.en: The latest public opinion poll shows that voter turnout may reach record highs.
examples.zh: 最新的民意测验显示，选民投票率可能会创下历史新高。

family_guide.root_logic: 原指“头、头顶”，由“数人头”引申为投票、民意调查。

lemmas.def_en: something determined in relation to something that includes it
lemmas.def_zh: 部分, 一份, 命运, 嫁妆

examples.en: He only ate a small portion of the steak and took the rest home.
examples.zh: 他只吃了一小份牛排，把剩下的带回了家。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (often 'portion out') To divide something into parts or servings and distribute them.
lemmas.def_zh: 分配，分发；把……分成多份

examples.en: The chef portioned the roast chicken carefully so every guest received an equal serving.
examples.zh: 厨师仔细地分切烤鸡，以确保每位客人分得同样的分量。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 portio（一部分、份额），指从整体中分割出的一部分。

lemmas.def_en: the rising of a body of water and its overflowing onto normally dry land
lemmas.def_zh: 洪水, 大量之水, 涨潮

examples.en: Heavy seasonal rains caused a massive flood that submerged several villages along the river.
examples.zh: 季节性暴雨引发特大洪水，淹没了沿河的数个村庄。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To cover dry land with water, or become covered with water. 2. [I, T] To arrive, fill, or enter in overwhelmingly large numbers or amounts.
lemmas.def_zh: （使）淹没，泛滥；大量涌入，充斥

examples.en: Heavy seasonal rains caused a massive flood that submerged several villages along the river.
examples.zh: 季节性暴雨引发特大洪水，淹没了沿河的数个村庄。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语，与 flow（流动）同源，指水流极大、漫溢成灾。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To take advance orders for a forthcoming publication, or agree to buy shares in a company. 2. [I] To pay money regularly to receive a service, product, or publication.
lemmas.def_zh: 征订，招募预订；认购（股份）；定期订购，订阅；赞同

examples.en: I subscribe to several educational podcasts.
examples.zh: 我订阅了几个教育播客。

lemmas.def_en: a payment for consecutive issues of a newspaper or magazine for a given period of time
lemmas.def_zh: n. 订阅费；订阅服务；签署

examples.en: You can cancel your monthly streaming subscription at any time.
examples.zh: 你可以随时取消你的包月流媒体订阅服务。

lemmas.def_en: someone who expresses strong approval
lemmas.def_zh: n. 订户；签署者；赞同者

examples.en: The YouTube channel reached one million subscribers this week.
examples.zh: 该YouTube频道本周突破了一百万订阅者。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 sub-（在下面）+ scribe（写），原指在文件底部签名以示同意或购买，引申为“订阅、认购”。
family_guide.core_distinction: subscription 指订阅行为或订阅服务；subscriber 指订阅者本人。

lemmas.def_en: the atomic process that occurs during a chemical reaction
lemmas.def_zh: 机修工，机械师

examples.en: The mechanic inspected the conveyor belt to locate the mechanical fault.
examples.zh: 机修工检查了传送带，以找出机械故障所在。

lemmas.def_en: a craftsman skilled in operating machine tools
lemmas.def_zh: n. 机修工；技工

examples.en: The mechanic diagnosed the engine trouble in just five minutes.
examples.zh: 机修工仅用了五分钟就查出了发动机故障。

lemmas.def_zh: 机械技师, 机械学者, 机械论者
